While Hashem originally made man upright, desiring that no one ever sin in deed—content with the minimal darkness of the Serpent's mental incitement—once Adam sinned, the path of the Tree of Life (the unblemished tzaddik who never sins, like Eliyahu) was concealed. Thenceforth, the only path to eternal life is repentance (u'v'atah pen yishlach yado—"now" meaning repentance, Bereishis Rabbah 21:6), entering through the first letter Hei of the Name Havayah, where Hashem crowns him with the Crown of a Good Name hinted in the first Hei of Ehyeh.

p: וְכָךְ הַמִּשְׁפָּט: מִי שֶׁתּוֹלֶה בִּזְכוּת עַצְמוֹ, תּוֹלִין לוֹ בִּזְכוּת אֲחֵרִים, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרָכוֹת י׳ עַמּוּד ב׳)
And such is the divine judgment: "Whoever hangs his deliverance upon his own merit, Heaven hangs it upon the merit of others," as written in Berachos (10b);
וְהַיְינוּ דְּאִם הוּא מַחְשִׁיב הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּתוֹ לִכְלוּם, אִם כֵּן הוּא נִפְרָד עֲדַיִין מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
meaning that if he considers his personal striving as having independent efficacy, he remains as yet detached from the Blessed Name;
וְכָל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא הִגִּיעַ לַדְּבֵיקוּת הַגָּמוּר, אֵין הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּתוֹ כְּלוּם עֲדַיִין עַל הָאֱמֶת, וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מַרְאֶה לוֹ דְּהַכֹּל מִמֶּנּוּ
and as long as he has not attained absolute cleaving, his striving in ultimate truth is nothing, and the Blessed Name shows him that everything derives from Him;

וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁשָּׁמַעְתִּי עַל מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּרֵישׁ פֶּרֶק כֵּיצַד מְבָרְכִין (בְּרָכוֹת ל״ה עַמּוּד א׳): כְּתִיב ״לַה׳ הָאָרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ״ (תְּהִלִּים כ״ד:א׳) וְכוּלֵיהּ, כָּאן קוֹדֶם בְּרָכָה וְכוּלֵיהּ

and after the manner that I heard regarding what is written in the opening of Perek Keitzad Mevorchin (Berachos 35a): it is written "The earth is Hashem's, and the fullness thereof" (Tehillim 24:1), yet it is written "the earth He has given to the children of men" (ibid. 115:16)—here before a blessing, there after a blessing;
דְּהַבְּרָכָה הוּא הַכָּרַת הָאָדָם שֶׁהַכֹּל מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
for a blessing represents human recognition that everything derives from the Blessed Name;
וְקוֹדֶם שֶׁיַּכִּיר זֶה וְסָבוּר שֶׁהוּא שֶׁלּוֹ, אָז הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ אוֹמֵר: הַכֹּל שֶׁלִּי
and before a person acknowledges this, assuming that reality belongs to him, then the Blessed Name says: "Everything is Mine";
אֲבָל מִשֶּׁמַּכִּיר וּמוֹסֵר הַכֹּל לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, אָז הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מוֹסֵר הַכֹּל לוֹ: ״הָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי אָדָם״ (תְּהִלִּים קט״ו:ט״ז)
but once he recognizes and surrenders everything unto the Blessed Name, then the Blessed Name commits everything unto him: "the earth He has given to the children of men" (Tehillim 115:16);
וּלְכָךְ, כַּאֲשֶׁר חוֹשֵׁב שֶׁהוּא חָכְמָתוֹ וּגְבוּרָתוֹ, אֵין מָקוֹם לְהִתְהַלֵּל כְּלָל, דְּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ אוֹמֵר דְּהַכֹּל מִמֶּנּוּ, שֶׁהוּא בְּרָאוֹ כָּךְ חָכָם, גִּבּוֹר וְעָשִׁיר

and therefore, when one assumes that it is his own wisdom and might, there is no place to glory at all, for the Blessed Name says that everything is from Him, He having created him thus wise, mighty, and rich.
וְכֵן מִי שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק גָּמוּר, הוּא שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּרָאוֹ כָּךְ, דְּ״בָּרָאתָ צַדִּיקִים״ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא ט״ז עַמּוּד א׳)
And likewise one who is a wholly righteous man, it is because the Blessed Name created him thus: "You have created the righteous" (Bava Batra 16a);
אֲבָל ״בְּזֹאת יִתְהַלֵּל״ (יִרְמְיָה ט:כג), כְּשֶׁמַּכִּיר שֶׁהַכֹּל מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, אָז הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ אוֹמֵר שֶׁהַכֹּל שֶׁל הָאָדָם, דַּהֲרֵי מָסַר הַבְּחִירָה לִבְנֵי אָדָם

but "in this let him glory" (Yirmiyah 9:23): when he acknowledges that all is from the Blessed Name, then the Blessed Name says that it is all credited to the person, having granted free choice unto mortals;
וּרְשָׁעִים נִדְמֶה לָהֶם כְּחוּט הַשַּׂעֲרָה, כִּי אֶצְלָם הָיָה קַל לִכְפּוֹת, וְעַל כֵּן בּוֹכִים שֶׁלֹּא כְּפָאוּהוּ (סֻכָּה נ״ב עַמּוּד א׳)
while to the wicked the yetzer appears like a thread of hair, because for them it was easy to subdue, wherefore they weep that they did not subdue it (Sukkah 52a);
וְהַזּוֹכֶה לְמַדְרֵיגַת בַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה וּלִבְכִיָּה זוֹ בְּחַיָּיו עַד שֶׁיָּשׁוּב אֶל ה׳ וִירַחֲמֵהוּ
and one who merits the rung of penitents and this contrite weeping during his lifetime until he returns unto Hashem and He has mercy upon him (Yeshayah 55:7),
אָז יִזְכֶּה לְמַדְרֵיגוֹת חָכָם, גִּבּוֹר וְעָשִׁיר שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהִתְהַלֵּל בָּהֶם
then will merit the authentic rungs of wise, mighty, and rich in which one may genuinely glory;
וְהוּא הַכֶּתֶר שֵׁם טוֹב הָעוֹלֶה עַל גַּבֵּיהֶן עַל יְדֵי הָאוֹר הַבָּא מִתּוֹךְ הַחֹשֶׁךְ
and this is the Crown of a Good Name that ascends above them all through the light that shines specifically out of darkness.
וְעַל זֶה הָיְתָה עִיקַּר בְּרִיאַת הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁהָיָה לִתְלוֹת בְּהִשְׁתַּדְּלוּת בְּנֵי אָדָם וְשֶׁהֵם זָכוּ לְמַה שֶּׁזָּכוּ
And toward this purpose was the primary creation of the universe: that reward be suspended upon human striving and that they merit what they merited,
כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יֹאכְלוּ בָּעוֹלָם הַבָּא מִ״נַהֲמָא דְּכִסּוּפָא״ (יְרוּשַׁלְמִי עָרְלָה פֶּרֶק א׳ הֲלָכָה ג׳), וְהַיְינוּ רַק עַל חֲשׁוֹכָא הַקּוֹדֵם
so that they not eat in the World to Come the "bread of shame" (nahama d'chisufa), and this is achieved specifically through preceding darkness;
וְעַל כֵּן הָיָה מָקוֹם לִטְעוֹת דְּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ חָפֵץ בְּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם כְּדֵי לָשׁוּב אַחַר כָּךְ
and therefore there was room to err into assuming that the Blessed Name actually desires the sinful deeds in order that they repent subsequently;
וּבֶאֱמֶת: ״[אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה] הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאָדָם יָשָׁר״ (קֹהֶלֶת ז:כט), וּבָחַר בְּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים, וְשֶׁלֹּא יֶחֱטָא הָאָדָם בְּפֹעַל כְּלוּם
but in truth: "God made man upright" (Koheles 7:29), choosing the deeds of the righteous, desiring that man never sin in concrete deed at all;
וְהַחַשְׁכוּת וְסִכְלוּת מְעַט, דַּי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הֶעְלֵם בַּמַּחֲשָׁבָה לְבַד וּבְהַסָּתַת נָחָשׁ לְבַד שֶׁהוּא בְּרִיאַת הַיֵּצֶר
and as for darkness and a little folly (Koheles 10:1), it would have sufficed that concealment exist in thought alone and in the Serpent's instigation alone (which is the creation of the yetzer),
הֲגַם שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁמַע לוֹ וְלֹא יִמָּשֵׁךְ אַחֲרָיו, מִכָּל מָקוֹם הַהַסָּתָה לְבַד יֵשׁ בָּהּ חַשְׁכוּת וְהֶעְלֵם מוּעָט עַל כָּרְחֲךָ שֶׁיֵּשׁ מָקוֹם לַהַסָּתָה
for even without listening to it or being drawn after it, the mere presence of incitement contains darkness and subtle concealment perforce to allow temptation room to exist.
וּמִצַּד חֵפֶץ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הָיָה שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הָאָדָם יָשָׁר, אֶלָּא שֶׁמִּכָּל מָקוֹם מָסַר שְׁתֵּי הַדְּרָכִים לְפָנָיו
And from the desire of the Blessed Name the ideal was that man remain upright, yet He nonetheless placed the two paths before him (Devarim 30:19);
וְאַחַר שֶׁחָטָא וְקִלְקֵל, הֶעֱלִים מִמֶּנּוּ דֶּרֶךְ עֵץ הַחַיִּים
and after man sinned and corrupted his way, Hashem concealed from him the path of the Tree of Life,
שֶׁהוּא לִזְכּוֹת לְמַדְרֵיגַת צַדִּיק גָּמוּר בִּשְׁלֵימוּת בְּלֹא חֵטְא כְּאֵלִיָּהוּ שֶׁלֹּא חָטָא וְחַי לְעוֹלָם
which is to merit the rung of a consummate tzaddik in sinless perfection like Eliyahu who never sinned and lives forever;
דְּלֹא זוֹ הַדֶּרֶךְ מוֹצִיאָתוֹ מִידֵי עֲבֵירָה הַקּוֹדֶמֶת, דִּלְתַקֵּן הַחֵטְא הַקּוֹדֵם צָרִיךְ לְמַדְרֵיגַת בַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה
for that sinless path cannot extract him from the past transgression, seeing that to rectify past sin one requires the rung of penitents;
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כ״א:ו׳) עַל פָּסוּק ״וְעַתָּה פֶּן יִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וְגוֹמֵר״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג:כב): אֵין ״וְעַתָּה״ אֶלָּא תְּשׁוּבָה
and this is what the Sages stated (Bereishis Rabbah 21:6) on the verse "And now, lest he put forth his hand, etc." (Bereishis 3:22): "'And now' denotes nothing other than repentance";
רָצָה לוֹמַר עַתָּה שֶׁחָטָא אֵין לוֹ תַּקָּנָה אֶלָּא תְּשׁוּבָה, וְהוּא הַדֶּרֶךְ הַמְבִיאָתוֹ לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם
meaning: now that he has sinned he has no remedy other than repentance, which is the true path leading him to eternal life;
וְצָרִיךְ לְהַעְלִים מִמֶּנּוּ דֶּרֶךְ עֵץ הַחַיִּים כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לִמְקוֹם שֶׁבַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה עוֹמְדִין
and it was necessary to conceal from him the direct path to the Tree of Life so that he would merit the place where penitents stand;
וְהוּא בְּהֵ״א רִאשׁוֹנָה דַּהֲוָיָ״ה, וְאָז הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אוֹמֵר: אֲנִי קוֹשֵׁר לוֹ כֶּתֶר כָּמוֹתִי
and this resides within the first letter Hei of Havayah [Binah], whereupon the Holy One says: "I tie for him a crown like Mine,"
הוּא כֶּתֶר שֵׁם טוֹב הָרָמוּז בְּהֵ״א רִאשׁוֹנָה דְּאֶהְיֶ״ה:
this being the Crown of a Good Name alluded to in the first letter Hei of Ehyeh.
The theme: The four New Years, the four soul-powers, the four cosmic elements, and the rectification of dust
afar
and iron
barzel

. At the Exodus, Israel merited the illumination of all four crowns embedded in Nissan, the head of all months. In their expansion, they branch into the four New Years: Nissan, Tishrei, Elul, and Shevat
Rosh Hashanah 2a
. These correspond to the four soul faculties
Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, and Neshama le-Neshama / Chayah-Yechidah
, parallel to the four bodily elements
fire, air, water, earth
and the four kingdoms of creation
inanimate, vegetative, animal, speaking
. Earth
afar
encompasses all
"all were of the dust", Koheles 3:20; Koheles Rabbah 3:20—even the solar orb

, and "all return to dust" is the mystery of repentance returning to the Source. On the first of Tishrei—the New Year for Shemitah and Yovel—holiness is infused into the earth and mineral kingdom through the penitent who humbles himself until his soul is as dust to all
v'nafshi ke-afar la-kol tihyeh
. While the Serpent was cursed with eating dust
Bereishis 3:14
, and iron
barzel
forms the harsh wall of exile and the sword of Esav
Berachos 32b
, David HaMelech raised the yoke of repentance to turn the rejected stone into the head cornerstone
Tehillim 118:22
. Mystically, BARZEL (בַּרְזֶל) forms the acronym of the four Matriarchs who built the House of Israel: Bilhah, Rachel, Zilpah, Leah (בלהה, רחל, זלפה, לאה); together with Yaakov
copper / nechoshes
, they form the protective footwear of Knesset Israel: "Iron and brass shall be your shoes"
Devarim 33:25
וּבִיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם זָכוּ לְהֶאָרַת כָּל הַד׳ כְּתָרִים
And at the Exodus from Egypt they merited the radiant illumination of all four crowns;
דְּהַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה רִאשׁוֹן לְכָל חָדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה, שֶׁבּוֹ כָּלוּל מַעֲלוֹת כָּל הַחֳדָשִׁים מִצַּד הִתְכַּלְּלוּתָן בְּרֵאשִׁיתָן בַּכֶּתֶר
for this month is the first of all the months of the year (Shemos 12:2), containing the virtues of all the months through their integration at their inception within Keser;
וּבִפְרָטָן בְּהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּתָן, הֵם מִתְפַּשְּׁטִים בְּאַרְבַּע רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה שֶׁהֵם אַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים: נִיסָן, וְתִשְׁרֵי, אֱלוּל, וּשְׁבָט
and in their specific manifest expansion, they branch into the four New Years across four months: Nissan, Tishrei, Elul, and Shevat (Rosh Hashanah 2a);
וְהֵם גַּם כֵּן נֶגֶד ד׳ כֹּחוֹת הַנֶּפֶשׁ: נֶפֶשׁ, רוּחַ, נְשָׁמָה, וּנְשָׁמָה לַנְּשָׁמָה הַכּוֹלֶלֶת חַיָּה יְחִידָה בְּסוֹד מַקִּיף
and they correspond likewise to the four soul faculties: Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, and Neshama le-Neshama which encompasses Chayah and Yechidah in the mystery of the surrounding light (or makif);
וְנֶגְדָּם אַרְבָּעָה יְסוֹדוֹת: אֵשׁ, רוּחַ, מַיִם, עָפָר שֶׁבַּגּוּף
and parallel to them are the four bodily elements: fire, air, water, and earth;
שֶׁהֵם נֶגֶד אַרְבָּעָה מִינֵי נִבְרָאִים: דּוֹמֵם, צוֹמֵחַ, חַי, מְדַבֵּר הַכְּלוּלִים כּוּלָּם בָּאָדָם
which correspond to the four orders of creatures: mineral (domem), vegetative (tzome'ach), animal (chai), and articulate speaking human (medaber), all incorporated within man.
וְהֵם ג׳ אִמּוֹת אָלֶ״ף מֵ״ם שִׁי״ן (סֵפֶר יְצִירָה ג:ב), וִיסוֹד הֶעָפָר הוּא הַכּוֹלְלָן
And these parallel the three primary "Mother" letters Aleph-Mem-Shin (Sefer Yetzirah 3:2), with the element of earth (afar) encompassing them all,
דְּ״הַכֹּל הָיָה מִן הֶעָפָר״ (קֹהֶלֶת ג:כ), וְאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ג:כ): אֲפִילּוּ גַּלְגַּל חַמָּה
for "all were of the dust" (Koheles 3:20), which the Sages expounded (Koheles Rabbah 3:20): even the solar sphere;
דְּגַם כָּל הַיְסוֹדוֹת אָלֶ״ף מֵ״ם שִׁי״ן תְּחִלָּתָן מֵעָפָר
for all elements Aleph-Mem-Shin [air, water, fire] have their physical origin in dust;
וְ״הַכֹּל שָׁב אֶל הֶעָפָר״ (קֹהֶלֶת שָׁם) הוּא סוֹד הַתְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁחוֹזֵר לַמָּקוֹר
and "all turn to dust again" (ibid.) is the esoteric secret of repentance returning to the divine Source;
וְזֶהוּ נֶגֶד אֶחָד בְּתִשְׁרֵי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לִשְׁמִטִּין וּלְיוֹבְלוֹת
and this corresponds to the first of Tishrei, the New Year for Shemitah and Jubilee years (Rosh Hashanah 2a),
שֶׁהוּא זְמַן קְדֻשַּׁת הָאָרֶץ, דְּיוּכְלוּ לְהַכְנִיס הַקְּדוּשָׁה גַּם בַּדּוֹמְמִים וִיסוֹד הֶעָפָר
which is the season of the sanctity of the Land, enabling holiness to be infused even into the inanimate minerals and the element of earth.
זֶהוּ עַל יְדֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה, דְּמַכִּיר שִׁפְלוּתוֹ וְנַפְשׁוֹ כְּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה
This is accomplished through repentance, where one recognizes his lowliness so that his soul is as dust to all;
וְעַל יְדֵי תֹּקֶף הַמְּרִירוּת לִמְאוֹס בְּחַיָּיו בְּהַכִּירוֹ גֹּודֶל חֶטְאוֹ לַהַמְרוֹת רְצוֹן מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
and through the intensity of bitter remorse loathing his earthly existence upon realizing the gravity of his rebellion against the King of kings,
עַד שֶׁיְּבוּטַּל גַּם גּוּף הָעַפְרִי בַּמְּצִיאוּת ״מִפְּנֵי פַּחַד ה׳ וּמֵהֲדַר גְּאוֹנוֹ״ (יְשַׁעְיָה ב:י)
until the physical earthly body is completely nullified in its existence "from the dread of Hashem and from the glory of His majesty" (Yeshayah 2:10);
וּבָזֶה יְתוּקַּן יְסוֹד הֶעָפָר וְהַדּוֹמֵם שֶׁבְּכָל הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ
and through this is rectified the element of earth and mineral throughout the cosmos;
דְּהַכֹּל כָּלוּל בָּאָדָם, שֶׁכָּל הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ נִבְרָא בִּשְׁבִילוֹ וּלְצַוּוֹת לוֹ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרָכוֹת ו׳ עַמּוּד ב׳)
for all is incorporated in man, the entire universe having been created for his sake and to accompany him, as written in Berachos (6b);
וּבְתִיקּוּנוֹ וּשְׁלֵימוּתוֹ נִשְׁלָם כָּל הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ
and in man's personal rectification and perfection the whole universe is brought to completion.
וְעָפָר הוּא תַּכְלִית הַשִּׁפְלוּת שֶׁאֵין לְמַטָּה הֵימֶנּוּ
And dust is the ultimate nadir of lowliness below which there is nothing;
וּכְשֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל יוֹרְדִים, יוֹרְדִים עַד לֶעָפָר
and when Israel descend in exile, they descend unto the very dust (Megillah 16a);
שֶׁכֵּן אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם רֹאשׁ אוּמָּה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית אָמַר עַל עַצְמוֹ: ״וְאָנֹכִי עָפָר [וָאֵפֶר]״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית י״ח:כ״ז)
as Avraham Avinu, the head of the Israelite nation, proclaimed of himself: "and I am but dust and ashes" (Bereishis 18:27);
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּמִּדְבָּר רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ב:י״ב) דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁפָלִים וְנִבְזִים בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וַעֲתִידִים לְהִתְעַלּוֹת
and as written (Bamidbar Rabbah 2:12) that Israel are lowly and despised in this world yet destined to be exalted;
וְהַיְינוּ אַחַר הַתְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁיַּחְזְרוּ לַמָּקוֹר דְּ״הַכֹּל הָיָה מִן הֶעָפָר״ וְהוּא לְמַעְלָה מֵהַכֹּל
that is, following repentance when they return to the primordial Source wherein "all were of the dust," which is higher than all;
וִיסוֹד זֶה אֵין לוֹ שְׁלֵימוּת אֶלָּא עַל יְדֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה
and this element of earth attains completion solely through repentance;
דְּ״אֵין לְךָ דָּבָר שֶׁעוֹמֵד בִּפְנֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה״ (יְרוּשַׁלְמִי פֵּאָה פֶּרֶק א׳ הֲלָכָה א׳), רָצָה לוֹמַר שֶׁחוֹצֵץ בְּפָנָיו
for "nothing stands in the way of repentance" (Yerushalmi Pe'ah 1:1), meaning nothing can create an impassable barrier before it;
וְאֵין לְךָ חוֹצֵץ יוֹתֵר מֵעָפָר וְדוֹמֵם שֶׁהוּא תַּחְתּוֹן הַנִּבְרָאִים וּבוֹ עִיקַּר שְׁלִיטַת כָּל מִינֵי רָע
and there is no denser barrier than dust and rock, the lowest of creations, wherein resides the primary dominion of all evil;
וּבְקִלְלַת נָחָשׁ נִיתַּן לוֹ ״וְעָפָר תֹּאכַל כָּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג:יד), כִּי אֵין לוֹ שְׁלִיטָה אֶלָּא בִּיסוֹד זֶה
and in the curse of the Serpent it was decreed "and dust shall you eat all the days of your life" (Bereishis 3:14), for he has no dominion except within this dense element;
וּמִמֶּנּוּ הוּא ״הַמְּחִיצַת בַּרְזֶל שֶׁבֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לַאֲבִיהֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם״, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרָכוֹת ל״ב עַמּוּד ב׳)
and from it issues the "iron barrier that divides between Israel and their Father in Heaven," as written in Berachos (32b);
וְהוּא כֹּחוֹ שֶׁל עֵשָׂו: ״[וְ]עַל חַרְבְּךָ תִחְיֶה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כ״ז:מ׳), דְּבַרְזֶל הוּא הַקָּשֶׁה וְהֶחָזָק שֶׁבַּדּוֹמְמִים
being the sword-power of Esav: "and by your sword shall you live" (Bereishis 27:40), iron being the hardest and most unyielding of minerals,
וְהוּא מִצַּד הָרָע שֶׁעוֹמֵד בְּקוֹשְׁיוֹ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי כֹּל
representing the side of evil which persists in its obstinacy and will not yield before anything.
וְדָוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם מִצַּד הַטּוֹב שֶׁהֵקִים עוּלָּהּ שֶׁל תְּשׁוּבָה (עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה ה׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
And David HaMelech, peace be upon him, stands from the side of good, having raised up the yoke of repentance (Avodah Zarah 5a);
כִּי אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהַשִּׂיג הַטּוֹב שֶׁבַּיְסוֹד הַיּוֹתֵר גָּרוּעַ הַזֶּה אֶלָּא עַל יְדֵי תְּשׁוּבָה
for it is impossible to extract the goodness within this lowest element of dust except through repentance;
דְּאָז: ״אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה״ (תְּהִלִּים קי״ח:כ״ב), דְּהוּא רֹאשׁ וּמְקוֹר הַכֹּל
wherefore: "The stone which the builders rejected is become the head-stone of the corner" (Tehillim 118:22), becoming the pinnacle and source of all;
כִּי הוּא בְּסוֹד אִימָּא עִילָּאָה, וּמַאן דְּהוּא נָקֵי אַגַּב אִמֵּיהּ — סָלֵיק וּמִתְעַלֶּה
for it reflects the mystery of the Supernal Mother (Imma Ila'ah / Binah), and whoever is cleansed through his Mother ascends and is exalted (Chagigah 15b);
וְכֵן ״בַּרְזֶל״ רָאשֵׁי תֵּיבוֹת ד׳ אִמָּהוֹת שֶׁל שִׁבְטֵי יָהּ בּוֹנֵי אוּמָּה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית כַּנּוֹדָע [בִּלְהָה, רָחֵל, זִלְפָּה, לֵאָה]
and so BARZEL
(בַּרְזֶל)
forms the acronym of the four Matriarchs of the holy tribes who built the Israelite nation as is known: Bilhah, Rachel, Zilpah, Leah;
וְיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם עִם אַרְבַּע נָשָׁיו הֵם מִנְעָלִים שֶׁל כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁלֹּא יִקְרַב אֲלֵיהֶם זָר וְחִיצוֹנִי
and Yaakov Avinu with his four wives constitute the protective shoes of Knesset Israel so that no stranger or external defilement may touch them;
וְעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר: ״בַּרְזֶל וּנְחֹשֶׁת מִנְעָלֶךָ״ (דְּבָרִים ל״ג:כ״ה)
and concerning this it is said: "Iron and brass shall be your shoes" (Devarim 33:25);
וְיָדוּעַ בַּזֹּוהַר דִּנְחֹשֶׁת הוּא רוֹמֵז לְיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and it is known in the Zohar that copper/brass alludes to Yaakov Avinu;
וְהוּא מִטָּתוֹ שְׁלֵימָה, דְּלֹא יְאֻנֶּה אֵלָיו רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא יִקְרַב (תְּהִלִּים צ״א:י׳)
and this is his unblemished bed, where "no evil shall befall you, neither shall any plague come near your tent" (Tehillim 91:10);
וַאֲפִילּוּ שֶׁיֶּחֱטָא, לֹא יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח עַל יְדֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁיָּשׁוּבוּ לְשָׁרְשָׁן וּמְקוֹרָן מֵאָבוֹת:
so that even if an Israelite sins, "no outcast shall be expelled from Him" (II Shmuel 14:14) through repentance, returning to their ancestral root in the Patriarchs.

8.h: The theme: The Shofar of Rosh Hashanah, the Ten Days of Repentance, the Crown of Royalty (Keser Malchus), and the soul of David in Sodom. On Rosh Hashanah—"the day of the conception of the world" (Yom harat olam)—the souls of Israel who arose in primordial thought ascend to their Source through the simple sound of the Shofar (kol pashut), which precedes the articulation of verbal letters (the 22 letters of Creation). Moshe prayed: "Hear, Hashem, the voice of Judah" (Devarim 33:7), that Yehudah's voice of repentance merge into the primal "voice of Jacob" (Bereishis 27:22). Through the Shofar, the divine ascends from judgment to mercy ("God ascends with a blast, Hashem with the sound of the shofar", Tehillim 47:6), inaugurating the Ten Days of Repentance that culminate on Yom Kippur in the gate of freedom (tar'a d'cheiru / the higher Hei of Binah). The final Hei of Ehyeh crowns the final Hei of Havayah (Malchus), rectifying the primeval chaos (tohu) when the world was entirely water. Water fosters physical lust, the sin of the generation of the Flood; rectified, water becomes the lovingkindness of Avraham ("the desire of a man is his kindness", Mishlei 19:22). In pagan kings, monarchic power fosters unbridled physical lust; in Jewish kings, royalty requires absolute awe ("once a king bows, he does not straighten", Berachos 34b). Rava challenged Bar Sheshach (Avodah Zarah 65a): "You fear a mortal king who restrains your pleasure, whereas Israel's fear of Hashem is their very desire!" The Midrash asks: "Where did I find David My servant? In Sodom!" (Bereishis Rabbah 41:4)—the very crucible of depravity, whose fire incinerated evil through the fear of Yitzchak. Lot was rescued through the soul of David and the spirit of Mashiach which "hovered over the face of the waters" (Bereishis 1:2; Bereishis Rabbah 2:4)—the Crown of holy Royalty that hovers over all desires, touching yet not touching (noge'a v'eino noge'a), to elevate them into the Sanctuary.

p: וְזֶהוּ סוֹד רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, ״יוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם״ (פִּיּוּט זִכְרוֹנוֹת), וְיִשְׂרָאֵל עָלוּ בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה א:ד)
And this is the esoteric secret of Rosh Hashanah: "the day of the conception of the world," and Israel who arose in primordial divine thought (Bereishis Rabbah 1:4);
מִתְעַלִּים הַכֹּל לִמְקוֹרָן עַל יְדֵי קוֹל שׁוֹפָר, שֶׁהוּא קוֹל פָּשׁוּט הַכּוֹלֵל כָּל פְּרָטֵי הַדִּבּוּרִים
all ascending unto their Source through the blast of the Shofar, which is an unarticulated simple sound encompassing all particular words of speech;
שֶׁהוּא כְּלַל הַבְּרִיאָה, דִּ״בִדְבַר ה׳ שָׁמַיִם נַעֲשׂוּ״ (תְּהִלִּים ל״ג:ו׳)
which constitutes the totality of Creation, for "by the word of Hashem were the heavens made" (Tehillim 33:6);
וְהֵם צֵירוּפֵי אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁהָיְתָה כְּלִי אוּמָּנוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרֵישׁ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (א:א)
these being the permutations of the letters of the Torah which served as His craft-instrument, as written at the beginning of Bereishis Rabbah (1:1);
וְהַחְזָרַת הַדָּבָר לַמָּקוֹר שֶׁבַּמַּחֲשָׁבָה וְהֵרָיוֹן הוּא עַל יְדֵי קוֹל פָּשׁוּט שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ חִיתּוּךְ אוֹתִיּוֹת כְּלָל
and returning creation unto its Source in Thought and Conception is accomplished through this simple sound devoid of verbal articulation;
דְּהוּא: ״הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כ״ז:כ״ב), מְקוֹר הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
which is: "the voice is the voice of Jacob" (Bereishis 27:22), the primordial source of Knesset Israel;
וְנִתְפַּלֵּל מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם: ״שְׁמַע ה׳ קוֹל יְהוּדָה״ (דְּבָרִים ל״ג:ז׳), שֶׁיְּקֻבַּל תְּשׁוּבָתוֹ, שֶׁיָּשׁוּב קוֹלוֹ לִהְיוֹת קוֹל יַעֲקֹב לְהִתְכַּלֵּל בִּמְקוֹרוֹ
and Moshe Rabbeinu prayed: "Hear, Hashem, the voice of Judah" (Devarim 33:7), that his repentance be accepted, that his voice return to become the voice of Yaakov, integrated into its Source.
וְזֶהוּ: ״עָלָה אֱלֹהִים [בִּתְרוּעָה ה׳] בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר״ (תְּהִלִּים מ״ז:ו׳; וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כ״ט:ג׳)
And this is: "God ascends with a shout, Hashem with the sound of a horn" (Tehillim 47:6; Vayikra Rabbah 29:3);
שֶׁבְּקוֹל זֶה הוּא עֲלִיּוֹת הָעוֹלָמוֹת ״מִן הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם״ (תְּהִלִּים ק״ו:מ״ח)
for through this sound occurs the ascent of all worlds "from world to world" (Tehillim 106:48);
וְאָז מַתְחִילִין יְמֵי תְּשׁוּבָה עַד יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, שֶׁבּוֹ נִשְׁלָם עֲשֶׂרֶת יְמֵי תְּשׁוּבָה
and then begin the Days of Repentance culminating on Yom Kippur, wherein are completed the Ten Days of Repentance;
דְּהַיְינוּ שְׁלֵימוּת כָּל קוֹמָה שְׁלֵימָה שֶׁל הַתְּשׁוּבָה, דְּכָל קוֹמָה כָּלוּל מֵעֶשֶׂר מַדְרֵיגוֹת כַּנּוֹדָע
namely the perfection of the complete spiritual stature of repentance, every stature comprising ten Sefirotic levels;
וְאָז זוֹכֶה לְ״תַרְעָא דְּחֵירוּ״, סוֹד אִימָּא עִילָּאָה, סוֹד עוֹלָם הַבָּא כַּנּוֹדָע
and then one merits the "gate of freedom" (tar'a d'cheiru), the mystery of the Supernal Mother (Binah), the mystery of the World to Come;
וְזֶהוּ הַהֵ״א דַּהֲוָיָ״ה [הָרִאשׁוֹנָה], וְרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה הוּא כֶּתֶר שֶׁל אוֹתָהּ קוֹמָה, הוּא הַהֵ״א דְּאֶהְיֶ״ה הָרִאשׁוֹנָה
and this is the first letter Hei of Havayah, while Rosh Hashanah is the crown of that stature, being the first Hei of the Name Ehyeh.
וְהֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה הִיא כֶּתֶר דְּהֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה דַּהֲוָיָ״ה
And the final letter Hei of Ehyeh is the crown of the final Hei of Havayah [Malchus];
שֶׁהוּא קוֹדֶם הַתִּיקּוּן דְּ״וְהָאָרֶץ הָיְתָה תֹהוּ [וָבֹהוּ וְחֹשֶׁךְ עַל פְּנֵי תְהוֹם]״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית א:ב), שֶׁהָיָה הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ מַיִם
which prior to rectification corresponds to "and the earth was without form, and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep" (Bereishis 1:2), when the whole world was water;
דִּתְחִלַּת הִתְגַּלּוּת יְסוֹד הֶעָפָר עַל יְדֵי הַקִּלְקוּל וַחֲשׁוֹכָא דְּקָדִים לִנְהוֹרָא, נַעֲשָׂה מַיִם כִּבְדוֹר הַמַּבּוּל
for the initial manifestation of the element of earth through corruption and preceding darkness was inundated with water, as in the generation of the Flood;
וּבְמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בִּתְחִלַּת הַבְּרִיאָה עָלָה לְפָנָיו הַכֹּל: כָּל הַקִּלְקוּלִים וְהַחַשְׁכוּת שֶׁיִּהְיֶה, וְהָאוֹר שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה אַחַר כָּךְ
and in His divine thought at the beginning of Creation there arose before Him everything: all corruptions and darkness that would unfold, and the supernal light destined to be revealed afterward;
וּבְעֵת הַחַשְׁכוּת הָיָה תֹּהוּ וָמַיִם, וּמִזֶּה נַעֲשָׂה אַחַר הַתִּיקּוּן יְסוֹד הַמַּיִם שֶׁל קִיּוּם הָעוֹלָם הַמְגַדֵּל כָּל מִינֵי צְמָחִים נֶגֶד הַצּוֹמֵחַ

and during that darkness existed chaos and water, from which was formed after rectification the life-giving element of water that nurtures all vegetation, corresponding to the vegetative realm (tzome'ach);
וּמַה שֶּׁהוּא בָּרָע — תַּאֲוָה, שֶׁזֶּה הָיָה חֵטְא דּוֹר הַמַּבּוּל, וּמַיִם מַצְמִיחִים כָּל מִינֵי תַּאֲוָה
and what water represents in evil is lust, which was the sin of the generation of the Flood, water causing all manners of physical lust to sprout;
וְעִיקַּר הַתְחָלַת הַתַּאֲוָה הָיָה בַּצּוֹמֵחַ [עֵץ הַדַּעַת]
and the primary inception of lust began in the vegetative realm (the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge);
וְעֵץ הַדַּעַת אַחַר הַתִּיקּוּן נַעֲשָׂה מִכֹּחַ זֶה כֹּחַ גְּמִילוּת חֲסָדִים
and the Tree of Knowledge after rectification was transformed through this force into the power of lovingkindness (Gemilus Chasadim);
דַּרְגָּא דְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם אִישׁ חֶסֶד כִּידוּעַ, דְּ״תַּאֲוַת אָדָם — חַסְדּוֹ״ (מִשְׁלֵי י״ט:כ״ב)
the spiritual rung of Avraham Avinu, the man of kindness, as is known: "the desire of a man is his kindness" (Mishlei 19:22).
וְזֶהוּ כֶּתֶר מַלְכוּת שֶׁבְּהֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה, דְּתֹקֶף הַתַּאֲוָה בַּמְּלָכִים שֶׁיְּכוֹלִים לְמַלֹּאות כָּל תַּאֲוָתָם
And this is the Crown of Royalty (Keser Malchus) in the final letter Hei: for intense power of desire is found among kings who possess the dominion to fulfill all their lusts;
דְּעַל כֵּן צָרִיךְ לִהְיוֹת בּוֹ נֶגֶד זֶה בְּמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִצַּד הַקְּדוּשָׁה גַּם כֵּן תֹּקֶף הַיִּרְאָה
wherefore in the kings of Israel from the side of holiness there must exist countering this an immense intensity of holy awe;
דְּ״כֵּיוָן שֶׁכָּרַע — שׁוּב אֵינוֹ זוֹקֵף״, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרָכוֹת ל״ד עַמּוּד ב׳)
where "once a king bows in prayer, he does not straighten again until the end" (Berachos 34b);
וּכְמוֹ בְּ״אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ה׳״ (מִשְׁלֵי ל״א:ל׳), רָזָא דְּ״אֵשֶׁת חַיִל״, דִּבְ״אֵשֶׁת זְנוּנִים״ הֵם שְׁנֵי הֲפָכִים
matching "a woman that fears Hashem" (Mishlei 31:30), the mystery of the "Woman of Valor," which stands in polar opposition to the "Woman of Harlotry";
וְעַל כֵּן אָמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא לְבַר שֵׁשַׁךְ (עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה ס״ה עַמּוּד א׳): ״אַתּוּן אִית לְכוּ אֵימָתָא דְּמַלְכוּתָא״
wherefore Rava said to the gentile dignitary Bar Sheshach (Avodah Zarah 65a): "You people live under the terror of mortal kingship";
דְּיֵשׁ לָהֶם מוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ בָּשָׂר וָדָם הַמְסַלֶּקֶת וּמְבַטֶּלֶת וְעוֹצֶרֶת מִילּוּי תַּאֲוָתוֹ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ
for the gentiles possess the dread of a mortal king of flesh and blood which suppresses and restricts their personal lusts;
אֲבָל אֵצֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם יְרֵאִים מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, אַדְּרַבָּא זֶהוּ כָּל תַּאֲוָתָם וְחֶשְׁקָם: לִירָא מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
whereas among Israel who fear the Blessed Name, on the contrary this is their supreme lust and passion: to fear the Blessed Name!
וְזֶהוּ מִילּוּי תַּאֲוָתָם: יִחוּד אַהֲבָה וְיִרְאָה, הוּא יִחוּד קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ, דְּ״לֹא עָשָׂה כֵן לְכָל גּוֹי״ (תְּהִלִּים קמ״ז:כ׳)

And this is the sacred fulfillment of their desire: the union of love and awe, which is the supernal union of the Holy One and His Shechinah, which "He has not dealt so with any nation" (Tehillim 147:20);
וּבְמַלְכֵיהֶם: ״בִּמְשֹׁל רָשָׁע יֵאָנַח עָם״ (מִשְׁלֵי כ״ט:ב׳), דַּאֲחִיזַת מַלְכוּתָם רַק מִצַּד מִדַּת הַדִּינָא דְּמַלְכוּתָא
and among pagan kings: "when the wicked bears rule, the people mourn" (Mishlei 29:2), their dominion resting purely upon the severe judgment of the law;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן מַלְכוּת דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, אַף דְּ״מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִיד אָרֶץ״ (שָׁם:ד׳), בּוֹ תֹּקֶף הַחֶסֶד וּ״בְאוֹר פְּנֵי מֶלֶךְ — חַיִּים״ (שָׁם ט״ז:ט״ו)

unlike the monarchy of Israel, where although "the king by justice establishes the land" (ibid. 29:4), within him resides intense lovingkindness, and "in the light of the king's countenance is life" (ibid. 16:15).
וְ״אַבָּא יָסַד בְּרַתָּא״ (זֹוהַר), וְ״הֵיכָן מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי? בִּסְדוֹם״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מ״א:ד׳)
And "the Father founded the Daughter" (Zohar), and "Where did I find David My servant? In Sodom!" (Bereishis Rabbah 41:4),
מְקוֹם תֹּקֶף הַתַּאֲוָה, וְנִידּוֹנוּ בְּאֵשׁ שֶׁנִּשְׂרְפוּ מֵאֵשׁ הַגְּבוּרוֹת שֶׁל יִרְאָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה
in the very locus of rampant lust, who were judged with fire, consumed by the burning severities of holy awe;
שֶׁהִתְחִיל לְהִתְעוֹרֵר עַל יְדֵי בְּשׂוֹרַת לֵידַת יִצְחָק, שֶׁהִיא הַשּׂוֹרֶפֶת כָּל תַּאֲווֹת רָעוֹת
which began to awaken through the tidings of the birth of Yitzchak (the embodiment of holy Gevurah and awe) which consumes all evil lusts;
וְלוֹט נִיצּוֹל עַל יְדֵי נֶפֶשׁ דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וְרוּחוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ הַמְרַחֵף עַל פְּנֵי הַמַּיִם
and Lot was rescued from Sodom on account of the soul of David HaMelech and the spirit of Mashiach hovering over the face of the waters;

כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ב:ד) עַל פָּסוּק ״וְרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים מְרַחֶפֶת [עַל פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם]״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית א:ב): שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַכֶּתֶר מַלְכוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה
as the Sages stated (Bereishis Rabbah 2:4) on the verse "and the spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters" (Bereishis 1:2): this is the soul-root of the Crown of holy Royalty;
הַמְרַחֵף עַל פְּנֵי כָּל הַתַּאֲווֹת לְהַכְנִיסָם אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ, לֹא בְּשִׁיקּוּעַ, רַק מְרַחֶפֶת עַל פְּנֵי ״נוֹגֵעַ וְאֵינוֹ נוֹגֵעַ״:
hovering over the face of all physical desires to elevate them into the Sanctuary, not by falling into immersion, but hovering over them in the mystical state of "touching yet not touching."

8.h: The theme: The holy root of Shevat, the tribe of Asher, the New Year for Trees, and the rectification of the covenant. The final letter Hei of the Name Havayah embodies the feminine principle (sod ha-nukva), the "wisdom of women" (chochmas nashim) that channels intense passion into holy awe ("a woman that fears Hashem", Mishlei 31:30). The Serpent instigated woman because within her resides the root of the "lower waters" (mayin nukvin) that weep to draw near unto the King, reflecting Israel’s yearning for Hashem ("the desire of a woman is to her husband; the desire of Israel is to the Holy One", Bereishis Rabbah 20:7). This quality spreads through the tribe of Asher ("for the daughters will call me blessed [ishruni]", Bereishis 30:13; "blessed be Asher above sons", Devarim 33:24), whose daughters were beautiful and married kings and High Priests (Bereishis Rabbah 71:10; 99:12), from whose maternal line Mashiach is destined to descend. In the order of the tribal princes in Nissan, Asher corresponds to the month of Shevat—the New Year for Trees (Rosh Hashanah 2a). By the fifteenth of Shevat most of the year's rains have fallen (Rosh Hashanah 14a); descending upper waters evoke ascending lower waters, enabling trees to blossom and bear fruit. Physical fruitfulness derives from the sanctified drive of passion (ko'ach ha-ta'avah bi-kdushah, Yoma 69b); the vegetative soul (nefesh ha-tzomachat) from the element of water generates the righteous offspring of Israel ("seed for you to sow", Bereishis 47:23). Shevat is the crown and root of this power, paralleling the final Hei of Ehyeh, making it the prime season during the weeks of Shovavim to rectify nocturnal emissions and wasted seed. Because the unholy shell mirrors the holy (zeh l'umas zeh), Asher's territory was most vulnerable to involuntary emissions; Amos, descended from Asher, challenged: "Are you not as children of the Ethiopians unto Me?" (Amos 9:7), culminating in "the treader of grapes with him that draws forth the seed" (ibid. 9:13). Overcoming this deficiency rectifies the Nefesh. In contrast, rectifying the Ruach occurs in Elul through the letter Vav (the element of air/spirit) and its crown Yud of Ehyeh, celebrated on the first of Elul as the New Year for animal tithing (ma'asar behemah), rectifying the animal spirit (ruach ha-behemah) through the prince of Gad in preparation for Tishrei.

p: וְרֹאשׁ הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת קְדֻשָּׁה זוֹ בַּשְּׁבָטִים, נִרְאֶה לִי שֶׁהוּא בְּשֵׁבֶט אָשֵׁר
And the primary head of the expansion of this holiness among the tribes appears to me to reside within the tribe of Asher;
דְּכָל שֵׁבֶט יֵשׁ לוֹ דָּבָר שֶׁבּוֹ הוּא מְיוּחָד וּמְנוּשָּׂא עַל כָּל הַשְּׁבָטִים
for each tribe possesses a distinct domain in which it is unique and elevated above all the other tribes;
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכּוּלָּם ״גּוֹי אֶחָד״ (שְׁמוּאֵל ב ז:כג), וּקְדֻשַּׁת כָּל אֶחָד כָּלוּל בְּכוּלָּם
and although all of them are "one nation in the earth" (II Shmuel 7:23), and the specific sanctity of each is incorporated within them all;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם בְּדָבָר זֶה הוּא הָרֹאשׁ, וְכֹחוֹ הוּא שֶׁמִּתְפַּשֵּׁט בְּכוּלָּם וְהַכֹּל מֵעֲנָפָיו
nevertheless in that specific attribute that tribe is the head, and its power spreads throughout all of them, all deriving from its branches.
וְיָדוּעַ דְּהֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה הִיא סוֹד הַנּוּקְבָא
And it is known that the final letter Hei of the Name Havayah is the mystical secret of the Feminine (Nukva);
שֶׁהִיא חָכְמַת נָשִׁים (מִשְׁלֵי י״ד:א׳), לִהְיוֹת ״אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ה׳״ (שָׁם ל״א:ל׳) בִּמְקוֹם תֹּקֶף הַתַּאֲוָה שֶׁבָּהֶם
which is the "wisdom of women" (Mishlei 14:1), to be "a woman that fears Hashem" (ibid. 31:30) in the very locus of intense passion;
דְּעַל כֵּן הַסָּתַת הַנָּחָשׁ בְּתַאֲוָה הָיָה רַק בָּאִשָּׁה
wherefore the Serpent's seduction through physical desire targeted the woman specifically (Bereishis 3:1–6);
שֶׁבָּהּ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַמַּיִם תַּחְתּוֹנִים, מַיִין נוּקְבִין, דְּ״בָכְיָין אֲנַן בָּעְיָין לְמֶהֱוֵי קֳדָם מַלְכָּא״ (זֹוהַר חֵלֶק א׳ כ״ט עַמּוּד ב׳)
within whom resides the root of the "lower waters," the feminine waters (mayin nukvin), which weep: "we desire to be united before the King" (Zohar I, 29b);
דְּזֶהוּ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַחֵשֶׁק וְתַאֲוָה שֶׁבְּנַפְשׁוֹת דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
this being the holy root of passion and longing within the souls of the Children of Israel;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כ:ז): ״אֵין תְּשׁוּקָה שֶׁל אִשָּׁה אֶלָּא לְבַעְלָהּ... אֵין תְּשׁוּקָתָן שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלָּא לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא״
as the Sages of blessed memory expounded (Bereishis Rabbah 20:7): "A woman's desire is solely unto her husband... and Israel's desire is solely unto the Holy One, blessed be He";
וְעַל כֵּן נִקְרָא ״אָשֵׁר״: ״כִּי אִשְּׁרוּנִי בָנוֹת״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל:יג)
wherefore he was named Asher: "for the daughters will call me happy (ishruni)" (Bereishis 30:13);
שֶׁהוּא הַמְבוֹרָךְ מִנָּשִׁים
he being the one most blessed through women;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה סוֹף פָּרָשָׁה צ״ט:י״ב) עַל פָּסוּק ״רְצוּי אֶחָיו [וְטֹבֵל בַּשֶּׁמֶן רַגְלוֹ]״ (דְּבָרִים ל״ג:כ״ד)
as written in Bereishis Rabbah (99:12) on the verse "acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil" (Devarim 33:24);
וּבִבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (סוֹף פָּרָשָׁה ע״א:י׳) עַל פָּסוּק ״אֲבִי בִרְזָיִת״ (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א ז:ל״א): דִּבְנוֹתָיו נָאוֹת וּנְשׂוּאוֹת לִמְלָכִים [וּלְכֹהֲנִים גְּדוֹלִים]
and in Bereishis Rabbah (71:10) on the verse "the father of Birzavith" (I Divrei HaYamim 7:31): that his daughters were exceedingly fair and married unto kings and High Priests.
וְנִרְאֶה לִי דְּגַם מָשִׁיחַ וַדַּאי יִהְיֶה מִצֶּאֱצָאָיו מִנּוּקְבָתָא
And it appears to me that Mashiach as well will certainly descend from Asher's seed through maternal lineage;
וְהוּא נֶגֶד שְׁבָט בֶּחֳדָשִׁים כְּפִי סִדְרָן שֶׁל נְשִׂיאִים בְּקָרְבָּנוֹת דְּי״ב יָמִים דְּנִיסָן, שֶׁהֵם נֶגֶד י״ב חָדְשֵׁי הַשָּׁנָה

and Asher corresponds to the month of Shevat according to the order of the tribal princes in the dedicatory offerings of the twelve days of Nissan (Bamidbar 7), which parallel the twelve months of the year;
וְהַרְבֵּה סְדָרִים שׁוֹנִים יֵשׁ בְּסִידּוּר הַשְּׁבָטִים לַחֳדָשִׁים, כָּל אֶחָד אֱמֶת בִּבְחִינָה מְיוּחָד
and there exist multiple distinct arrangements correlating the tribes to the months, each being absolute truth in its own dimension;
וְהַסֵּדֶר הַמִּתְגַּלֶּה בְּשָׁרְשָׁן וְכִתְרָן בְּנִיסָן שֶׁהוּא רֹאשׁ לֶחֳדָשִׁים שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּתָן, הוּא הַסֵּדֶר שֶׁל נְשִׂיאִים שֶׁבּוֹ

and the arrangement manifest at their root and crown in Nissan—which is the head of the months whence all expand—is the order of the princes dedicated therein [where Pagiel ben Ochran of Asher offered on the eleventh day, corresponding to Shevat];
דְּאָשֵׁר הוּא נֶגֶד שְׁבָט, וְהוּא רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לָאִילָנוֹת
for Asher corresponds to Shevat, containing the New Year for Trees (Rosh Hashanah 2a);
נֶפֶשׁ הַצּוֹמֵחַ שֶׁבָּאָדָם: ״[כִּי הָאָדָם] עֵץ הַשָּׂדֶה״ (דְּבָרִים כ:יט), הַנִּמְשָׁךְ וּמִתְרַבֶּה וְנִשְׁפָּע מִיסוֹד הַמַּיִם שֶׁבּוֹ
the vegetative soul (nefesh ha-tzomachat) within man: "for man is as the tree of the field" (Devarim 20:19), which grows, multiplies, and receives influx from the element of water within him.
וְאָז יָצְאוּ רוֹב גִּשְׁמֵי שָׁנָה, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה (י״ד עַמּוּד א׳)
And by Shevat the majority of the year's rains have fallen, as written in Rosh Hashanah (14a);
הַיְינוּ דְּמֵימֵי כָּל שָׁנָה יֵשׁ לוֹ עִנְיָן מְיוּחָד בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ, דְּאֵין שָׁנָה דּוֹמָה לַחֲבֶרְתָּהּ
meaning that the rainfall of each year possesses a unique spiritual character, no year resembling its fellow;
וְהַגְּשָׁמִים הֵם מַיִם עֶלְיוֹנִים, וּכְנֶגְדָּם עוֹלִים טִפַּיִם מַיִם תַּחְתּוֹנִים
and the rains are the supernal waters (mayin dechurin), opposite which two drops of lower waters (mayin nukvin) ascend (Bereishis Rabbah 13:13);
וְנַעֲשִׂים בַּעְלָהּ דְּאַרְעָא, וְהִרְוָה וְהִצְמִיחָה
becoming the fructifying consort of the earth, watering it and causing it to sprout;
וּבִשְׁבָט הוּא זְמַן חֲנִיטַת הַפֵּירוֹת הַנִּצְמָחִים מִגִּשְׁמֵי הַשָּׁנָה, שֶׁהוּא עִיקַּר הַמְכֻוָּון בַּגְּשָׁמִים
and in Shevat is the season of the blossoming of the fruits that sprout from the year's rains, which is the ultimate purpose of rainfall;
וְעַל זֶה עִיקַּר כֹּחַ הַתַּאֲוָה, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּיוֹמָא (ס״ט עַמּוּד ב׳): דִּכְשֶׁכָּבְשׁוּ יִצְרָא דַּעֲרָיוֹת, לָא אִשְׁתְּכַח בִּיעֲתָא בַּת יוֹמָא
and upon this rests the vital power of desire, as written in Yoma (69b): when they captured the yetzer of sexual desire, a fresh egg could not be found throughout the land;
שֶׁעֲשִׂיַּית פֵּירוֹת הוּא עַל יְדֵי כֹּחַ הַתַּאֲוָה כְּשֶׁהִיא בִּקְדֻשָּׁה, דְּהַיְינוּ שֶׁכְּלוּלָה בְּיִרְאָה
for the production of fruit occurs through the force of passion when sanctified in holiness, that is, when enveloped in holy awe:
כִּי ״[הִנֵּה] כִי כֵן יְבֹרַךְ גָּבֶר יְרֵא ה׳... אֶשְׁתְּךָ כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה [בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בֵיתֶךָ]״ (תְּהִלִּים קכ״ח:ד׳, ג׳)
for "Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that fears Hashem... Your wife shall be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house" (Tehillim 128:4, 3);
וְעִיקַּר כֹּחַ נֶפֶשׁ הַצּוֹמַחַת שֶׁמִּיְסוֹד הַמַּיִם, הוּא כֹּחַ עֲשִׂיַּית הַפֵּירוֹת וְהוֹלָדַת תּוֹלְדוֹתֵיהֶם שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים
and the essential power of the vegetative soul deriving from the element of water is the capacity for producing fruit and giving birth to the righteous generations of the tzaddikim;
וְזֶהוּ כֹּחַ הֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה דְּשֵׁם הֲוָיָ״ה בְּסוֹד ״הֵא לָכֶם זֶרַע״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית מ״ז:כ״ג; זֹוהַר חֵלֶק א׳ כ״ה עַמּוּד ב׳)
and this is the power of the final letter Hei of the Name Havayah, in the mystical secret of "Lo, here is seed for you" (Heh lachem zera, Bereishis 47:23; Zohar I, 25b);
וְכִתְרָהּ הִיא שׁוֹרֶשׁ, וְעֹומֶק רֵאשִׁית דְּכֹחַ זֶה הוּא בִּשְׁבָט
and its supernal crown is the root, the primordial depth of this generative power residing within Shevat;
שֶׁהוּא נֶגֶד הַהֵ״א דְּאֶהְיֶ״ה, שֶׁהוּא הַתְחָלַת הַמְשָׁכַת כֹּחַ זֶה בְּנַפְשׁוֹת דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהָאַיִן הַנֶּעְלָם
corresponding to the final Hei of the Name Ehyeh, which is the inception of drawing this creative power into the souls of Israel from the concealed Nothingness (Ayin).
וְנִרְאֶה לִי דְּעַל כֵּן חֹדֶשׁ זֶה מְסֻגָּל לְתַקֵּן עֲוֹן קֶרִי וְהוֹצָאַת זֶרַע לְבַטָּלָה בְּפָרָשַׁת הַשּׁוֹבָבִי״ם שֶׁהֵם בְּחֹדֶשׁ זֶה
And it appears to me that therefore this month [Shevat] is propitious for rectifying the sin of accidental nocturnal emission and wasted seed during the Torah portions of Shovavim read in this month;
כִּי יוּכְלוּ לְהַכְנִיס גַּם כָּל נִיצוֹצוֹת הַמִּתְפַּזְּרִים עַל יְדֵי תַּאֲווֹת זָרוֹת אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ
because then one can restore all holy sparks scattered through alien lusts back into the Sanctuary.
וְקִבַּלְתִּי דִּבְשֵׁבֶט אָשֵׁר מָצוּי עִנְיַן מִקְרֵה לַיְלָה וּרְאִיַּית קֶרִי יוֹתֵר מִבְּכָל הַשְּׁבָטִים
And I received as a tradition that within the tribe of Asher the incidence of nocturnal emission and seminal discharges was more frequent than among all other tribes;
וּדְעַל כֵּן עָמוֹס שֶׁהָיָה מִשֵּׁבֶט אָשֵׁר אָמַר פָּרָשָׁה: ״הֲלוֹא כִבְנֵי כֻשִׁיִּים [אַתֶּם לִי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל]״ (עָמוֹס ט:ז)
and therefore Amos who descended from Asher proclaimed the prophecy: "Are you not as children of the Ethiopians unto Me, O children of Israel?" (Amos 9:7);
דְּכוּלָּהּ נֶאֶמְרָה עַל עִנְיָן זֶה, שֶׁעַל יָדוֹ נִרְאֶה שַׁחֲרוּת וְכֵיעוּר כִּבְנֵי כוּשִׁיִּים
the entire chapter being uttered concerning this flaw, through which blackness and spiritual ugliness appear like the children of Cushites;
וְסוֹף: ״[וְנִגַּשׁ חוֹרֵשׁ בַּקֹּצֵר] וְדֹרֵךְ עֲנָבִים בְּמֹשֵׁךְ הַזָּרַע [וְהִטִּיפוּ הֶהָרִים עָסִיס] וְגוֹמֵר״ (שָׁם:י״ג)
concluding: "and the treader of grapes with him that draws forth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, etc." (ibid. 9:13);
וְהַיְינוּ כִּידוּעַ בְּסוֹד ״עֵת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַט הָאָדָם בְּאָדָם [לְרַע לוֹ]״ (קֹהֶלֶת ח:ט), דְּהַשְּׁלִיטָה הוּא מַמָּשׁ אֵבֶר בְּאֵבֶר
and this follows the mystical secret of "a time wherein one man has power over another to his own hurt" (Koheles 8:9), the unholy husk dominating organ against organ;
וּכְפִי תֹּקֶף הַמָּקוֹם בִּקְדֻשָּׁה, כֵּן לְעֻומָּתוֹ תֹּקֶף הַקְּלִיפָּה הַסּוֹבַבְתּוֹ
and according to the supreme intensity of a faculty in holiness, directly opposite it is the intensity of the encasing shell (kelipah);
וּבְכָל דָּבָר שֶׁהוּא מְקוּדָּשׁ בּוֹ בְּיוֹתֵר, בּוֹ בַּדָּבָר הוּא הִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַיֵּצֶר עָלָיו
and in whatever realm an individual is most holy, in that very realm the assault of the yetzer is fiercest upon him;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (סֻכָּה נ״ב עַמּוּד א׳): ״כָּל הַגָּדוֹל מֵחֲבֵירוֹ — יִצְרוֹ גָּדוֹל הֵימֶנּוּ״, הַיְינוּ בְּאוֹתוֹ דָּבָר שֶׁגָּדוֹל
as written (Sukkah 52a): "Whoever is greater than his fellow, his yetzer is greater than he," meaning specifically in that domain wherein he is great;
וְעַל כֵּן בִּמְקוֹם הַחִסָּרוֹן שָׁם הוּא הַמַּעֲלָה גַּם כֵּן, לִכְשֶׁיְּתוּקַּן הַחִסָּרוֹן וְיִתְגַּלֶּה הַמַּעֲלָה שֶׁבּוֹ מִשָּׁרְשׁוֹ
wherefore in the locus of greatest deficiency resides the highest virtue, once the blemish is rectified and the virtue of its root is revealed;
וְזֶהוּ רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לָאִילָנוֹת וַחֲנִיטַת הַפֵּירוֹת, לִהְיוֹת ״מַזְרִיעַ זֶרַע... עֹשֶׂה פְרִי לְמִינוֹ״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית א:יא–יב) וְלֹא לְבַטָּלָה, וְזֶהוּ תִּיקּוּן הַנֶּפֶשׁ:
and this is the New Year for Trees and the budding of fruits: to be "yielding seed... yielding fruit after its kind" (Bereishis 1:11–12) and not in vain, this being the rectification of the Nefesh.
וְתִיקּוּן הָרוּחַ הוּא בֶּאֱלוּל, נֶגֶד הַוָּי״ו דְּשֵׁם הֲוָיָ״ה שֶׁהוּא נֶגֶד יְסוֹד הָרוּחַ
And the rectification of the Ruach occurs in Elul, corresponding to the letter Vav of the Name Havayah, which parallels the element of air/spirit (ruach);
וְכִתְרוֹ יוּ״ד דְּאֶהְיֶ״ה, שֶׁרֹאשׁ אוֹת הַוָּי״ו הוּא יוּ״ד
and its crown is the letter Yud of Ehyeh, the head of the letter Vav being a Yud;
שֶׁהִיא עַל שֵׁם הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה, כִּדְפֵירֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י עַל פָּסוּק ״אָז יָשִׁיר״ (שְׁמוֹת ט״ו:א׳), וְהִיא הַנְּקֻדָּה
which signifies divine Thought, as Rashi explained on the verse "Then sang Moshe" (Shemos 15:1), being the primordial point;
וְהַוָּי״ו הוּא הַמְשָׁכַת הַנְּקֻדָּה לִהְיוֹת קַו הַמִּתְפַּשֵּׁט וְנִמְשָׁךְ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה
and the Vav is the extension of that point into a straight line expanding from one end of existence to the other;
דְּ״הַכֹּל בְּרוּחַ״, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּבָבָא מְצִיעָא (ק״ז עַמּוּד ב׳)
for "all is governed by spirit/wind," as written in Bava Metzia (107b);
וְגַם הַבְּהֵמָה יֵשׁ לָהּ רוּחַ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״[וּ]רוּחַ הַבְּהֵמָה הַיֹּרֶדֶת [הִיא לְמַטָּה לָאָרֶץ]״ (קֹהֶלֶת ג:כא), כִּי כָּל חַיּוּת הוּא בְּרוּחַ
and an animal likewise possesses a spirit: "and the spirit of the beast that goes downward to the earth" (Koheles 3:21), for all bodily animation resides in the spirit;
וְעַל כֵּן אֶחָד בֶּאֱלוּל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לְמַעְשַׂר בְּהֵמָה, לְתַקֵּן נֶפֶשׁ הַבַּהֲמִית
wherefore the first of Elul is the New Year for animal tithing (Rosh Hashanah 2a), to rectify the animal spirit.
וְזֶהוּ הֲכָנָה לִימֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה דְּתִשְׁרֵי, שֶׁהוּא הַחְזָרַת הַדָּבָר לִמְקוֹרָן עַל יְדֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁמַּגַּעַת עַד כִּסֵּא הַכָּבוֹד (יוֹמָא פ״ו עַמּוּד ב׳)
And this serves as preparation for the Days of Repentance in Tishrei, which is the restoration of reality to its Source through repentance reaching the Throne of Glory (Yoma 86b);
דְּמִשָּׁם אֲצִילוּת שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
whence emanates the soul-root of the Children of Israel;
דְּמִשָּׁם הוּא הַמְשָׁכַת אוֹר מַקִּיף דִּנְשָׁמָה לַנְּשָׁמָה, דְּעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְקַן הַכֹּל בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים
whence is drawn down the surrounding light (or makif) of Neshama le-Neshama, through which all is rectified on Yom Kippur;
וְהַהֲכָנָה לָזֶה בֶּאֱלוּל, לְהַכְנִיס קְדוּשָׁה בְּרוּחַ הַבַּהֲמִית שֶׁבּוֹ
and the preparation for this occurs in Elul: infusing holiness into the animal spirit within man;
וְהוּא כְּפִי סִדְרָן שֶׁל נְשִׂיאִים נֶגֶד שֵׁבֶט גָּד:
and in the order of the princes dedicated in Nissan, Elul corresponds to the tribe of Gad [Eliasaph ben Deuel, offering on the sixth day].
The theme: The curse of Gad
arur shocheiv im kol behemah
, the kelipah of the dog, and Eliyahu subverting pagan desire into Torah. Among the eleven curses of Mount Ebal
Devarim 27
, "Cursed be he that lies with any manner of beast" corresponds to Gad, following the authority in Kilayim
that a dog is halachically categorized as a beast
kelev min behemah
. The Talmud notes that the Torah is beloved to Israel as a queen
shegal
is to the nations
Rosh Hashanah 4a
, comparing gentile lust to a female dog because a dog remains locked during coitus
Sanhedrin 108b
; so too, the Aramite woman is bound to her paramour like a dog
Tanchuma, Vayeshev 3
. The nations are chained to physical lust; Israel’s lust is bound to the Torah, for illicit passion exists only in a heart empty of Torah
Rambam, Issurei Biah 22:21; Kiddushin 30b
. In the unholy realm, this animal passion is the shell of the dog
"Deliver my soul from the sword, my only one from the power of the dog", Tehillim 22:21
. The dog is the most promiscuous of beasts, mating even aboard Noach's Ark
Sanhedrin 108b
; the numerical value of Behemah (בְּהֵמָה = 52) equals Kelev (כֶּלֶב = 52). The Midrash expounds "Gad comes"
ba Gad, Bereishis 30:11
as "he who cuts down
goded
the foundation of the nations"
Bereishis Rabbah 71:9
—namely shattering their unholy lust. This was accomplished by the prophet Eliyahu from the tribe of Gad
Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5
, who embodies the antithesis of animal lust and therefore lives forever
chai l'olam
. Physical death stems from the Serpent casting defilement into Chavah
Shabbat 146a
; Israel channels desire into the Torah of eternal life. Pinchas—who is Eliyahu
Bava Metzia 114b
—displayed holy zealotry against Zimri and Cozbi, meriting the Crown of Priesthood
Keser Kehunah
which guards Israel's genealogical purity
Kesubos 13a
. The High Priest is sequestered seven days before Yom Kippur
Yoma 2a
to atone for the fallen angels Uzza and Azael
Yoma 67b
, and before burning the Red Heifer to cleanse the taint of death, attaining the purity of an angel
mal'ach
וְקִבַּלְתִּי דְּיַ״א אֲרוּרִים שֶׁנֶּגֶד הַשְּׁבָטִים כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתַב רַשִׁ״י, הַיְינוּ הַחֶסְרוֹנוֹת שֶׁבְּכָל שֵׁבֶט
And I received as a tradition that the eleven curses on Mount Ebal (Devarim 27) which correspond to the tribes, as Rashi noted, represent the potential deficiencies within each tribe;
״אָרוּר שֹׁכֵב עִם כָּל בְּהֵמָה״ (דְּבָרִים כ״ז:כ״א) הוּא נֶגֶד גָּד
"Cursed be he that lies with any manner of beast" (Devarim 27:21) corresponds to the tribe of Gad;
וּדְאָתְיָאן לְמַאן דְּאָמַר (כִּלְאַיִם פֶּרֶק ח׳ מִשְׁנָה ו׳): ״כֶּלֶב — מִין בְּהֵמָה״
and this follows the authority who holds (Kilayim 8:6): "A dog is categorized as a beast";
כָּלְשׁוֹן הַזֶּה שָׁמַעְתִּי וְלֹא פוֹרַשׁ לִי יוֹתֵר, וְהַדְּבָרִים סְתוּמִים וַחֲתוּמִים
in this exact phrasing I heard it and no more was explained to me, the matter remaining sealed and hidden.
וְנִרְאֶה לִי לְהָבִין קְצָת בְּמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה (ד׳ עַמּוּד א׳): דַּחֲבִיבָה תּוֹרָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּשֵׁגָל לְאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם
And it appears to me to understand this slightly through what is written in Rosh Hashanah (4a): that the Torah is as beloved to Israel as a queen (shegal) is to the nations of the world;
עִנְיַן מָשָׁל זֶה דַּחֲבִיבוּת הַכַּלְבְּתָא אֶצְלָם, לְפִי שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּ״חֵלֶק״ (סַנְהֶדְרִין ק״ח עַמּוּד ב׳) דְּכֶלֶב נִקְשָׁר
the inner meaning of this parable comparing the canine lust of the nations, for they stated in Perek Chelek (Sanhedrin 108b) that a dog remains physically bound during coitus;
וְכֵן אָמְרוּ (תַּנְחוּמָא פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב ג׳): בַּאֲרַמִּית קְשׁוּרָה בּוֹ כְּכֶלֶב
and likewise they stated (Tanchuma, Vayeshev 3): regarding an Aramite woman, she is bound unto him like a dog;
דְּזֶה תַּאֲוַת הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים: לִהְיוֹת קְשׁוּרִים בְּתַאֲוָתָם
for this is the lust of the idolaters: to be inextricably chained within their animal passions;
וְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִתְקַשְּׁרִים בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה, וְזֶהוּ תַּאֲוָתָם דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל
while Israel bind themselves unto words of Torah, this being the sublime desire of Israel;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב רַמְבַּ״ם הִלְכוֹת אִיסּוּרֵי בִּיאָה (פֶּרֶק כ״ב הֲלָכָה כ״א): דְּאֵין הַתַּאֲווֹת מְצוּיוֹת אֶלָּא בְּלֵב פָּנוּי מִדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
and as the Rambam wrote (Hilchos Issurei Biah 22:21): illicit thoughts are found only in a heart vacant of words of Torah;
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (קִדּוּשִׁין ל׳ עַמּוּד ב׳): ״בָּרָאתִי יֵצֶר הָרָע — בָּרָאתִי לוֹ תוֹרָה תַּבְלִין״
and regarding this the Sages expounded (Kiddushin 30b): Hashem said, "I created the evil inclination, and I created the Torah as its antidote";
״וּמָשְׁכֵהוּ לְבֵית הַמִּדְרָשׁ״ (סֻכָּה נ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳)
"drag it to the study hall" (Sukkah 52b);
הַיְינוּ דִּסְתָם יִצְרוֹ הוּא בְּתַאֲוָה, בִּפְרָט אַחַר שֶׁבִּטְּלוּ יִצְרָא דַּעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (יוֹמָא ס״ט עַמּוּד ב׳)
meaning that the primary inclination is sexual desire, especially after the Men of the Great Assembly nullified the inclination for idolatry (Yoma 69b);
וְהוּא הַנִּקְרָא ״מְנֻוָּול״ (סֻכָּה נ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳), שֶׁאֵין לְךָ נִיוּוּל מִזֶּה: ״חֲמַת מְלֵאָה צוֹאָה וּפִיהָ מָלֵא דָּם״ (שַׁבָּת קנ״ב עַמּוּד א׳)
and it is called the "vile one" (Sukkah 52b), for there is no greater vileness than the carnal body: "a vessel filled with excrement and its opening filled with blood" (Shabbat 152a);
וְדַי מַה שֶּׁמּוּכְרָח לְמִצְוָה, אֲבָל הַכֹּל רָצִין עַל יְדֵי יֵצֶר הַתַּאֲוָה הַנָּטוּעַ בַּלֵּב
and that which is strictly necessary for procreation sufficed, yet mortals run after pleasure through the yetzer planted in the heart;
וְהָעֵצָה שֶׁבָּרָא הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לָזֶה — הַתַּאֲוָה בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה, שֶׁיַּמְשִׁיכוּ כָּל תַּאֲוָתָם לְדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה
and the divine counsel created by the Blessed Name is passionate desire for words of Torah, redirecting their appetite to Torah study;
שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם חֵשֶׁק וְתַאֲוָה גְּדוֹלָה לָזֶה, וּמוֹצְאִים בָּהּ מִילּוּי תַּאֲוָתָם
possessing a profound longing for it and finding within it the consummate fulfillment of their desire.
וְהַחֵשֶׁק הוּא הַמַּיִין נוּקְבִין, וּבְסִטְרָא אָחֳרָא הוּא קְלִיפַּת הַכֶּלֶב
And holy longing constitutes the feminine waters (mayin nukvin), while in the unholy realm it is the shell of the dog;
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתַב הָאֲרִיזַ״ל בְּ״לִקּוּטֵי תּוֹרָה״ (תְּהִלִּים כ״ב) עַל פָּסוּק בְּנֵי נֵכָר, וּדְעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר: ״[הַצִּילָה מֵחֶרֶב נַפְשִׁי] מִיַּד כֶּלֶב יְחִידָתִי״ (תְּהִלִּים כ״ב:כ״א)
as the Arizal wrote in Likkutei Torah on the verse regarding aliens, and concerning this it is said: "Deliver my soul from the sword, my only one from the power of the dog" (Tehillim 22:21);
דְּעִיקַּר הַתַּאֲוָה מִנֶּפֶשׁ הַבַּהֲמִית, וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתַב בְּסוֹטָה (ט״ו עַמּוּד ב׳): ״הִיא עָשְׂתָה מַעֲשֵׂה בְּהֵמָה, לְפִיכָךְ קָרְבָּנָהּ מַאֲכַל בְּהֵמָה״
for physical desire originates from the animal soul, as written in Sotah (15b): "She acted like a beast, therefore her offering is the food of a beast [coarse barley]";
הַיְינוּ שֶׁמַּקְרִיב נֶפֶשׁ הַבַּהֲמִית גַּם כֵּן לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
meaning that one must offer his animal soul likewise unto the Blessed Name;
וְהַמַּאֲכָל הוּא קִיּוּם הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַנּוֹתֵן בּוֹ כֹּחַ וְחַיּוּת, הַיְינוּ שֶׁמְּקָרֶבֶת כָּל כֹּחַ וְחַיּוּת נֶפֶשׁ בַּהֲמִיּוּתָהּ לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
food being the sustenance of the soul imparting strength, meaning that she offers the full vitality of her animal soul unto Hashem;
וְהַכֶּלֶב הוּא הַזַּנַּאי שֶׁבַּבְּהֵמוֹת, דְּעַל כֵּן שִׁימֵּשׁ בַּתֵּיבָה כְּעוֹרֵב בָּעוֹפוֹת, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (סַנְהֶדְרִין ק״ח עַמּוּד ב׳)
and the dog is the most promiscuous of beasts, wherefore it cohabited aboard the Ark like the raven, as written in Sanhedrin (108b);
וּבוֹ תֹּקֶף הַתַּאֲוָה הַמַּקִּיף כָּל חֶלְקֵי הַנֶּפֶשׁ עַד הַיְחִידָה
within it residing that rampant lust which encircles all soul-levels up to the Yechidah;
שֶׁהוּא יִחוּד הַנֶּפֶשׁ בִּמְקוֹרָהּ בִּיחִידוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם יִתְבָּרַךְ שְׁמוֹ אֵצֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
which in the Children of Israel represents the soul's union at its Source with the Unique One of the Universe;
וְאֵצֶל אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם יִחוּד נַפְשׁוֹתָם בִּמְקוֹרָהּ, הַיְינוּ בַּמַּה שֶּׁשּׁוֹרֶשׁ נַפְשָׁם תָּלוּי, הוּא בַּתַּאֲווֹת שֶׁבָּזֶה תָּלוּי כָּל חַיּוּת נַפְשָׁם, הוּא בִּקְלִיפַּת הַכֶּלֶב
whereas among the nations of the world, their soul's source is rooted in physical lusts where their vitality hangs, embodied in the shell of the dog;

דְּהַחֵשֶׁק נִמְשָׁךְ מִשּׁוֹרֶשׁ הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁהוּא כֹּחַ הַיְחִידָה שֶׁבַּנֶּפֶשׁ, מִמֶּנּוּ נִמְשָׁךְ תֹּקֶף הַחֵשֶׁק לְאֵיזֶה דָּבָר בְּכָל חַיּוּתוֹ וְנַפְשׁוֹ בְּהִתְקַשְּׁרוּת עָצוּם שֶׁהוּא הַיְסוֹד דְּנוּקְבָא
for intense longing is drawn from the soul-root which is the Yechidah, whence issues the passion for an object with all one's life in ferocious attachment (Yesod d'Nukva);
דִּבִיסוֹד הוּא הַהִתְקַשְּׁרוּת, וְהוּא עַל יְדֵי תֹּקֶף הַחֵשֶׁק הֶעָצוּם שֶׁמִּזֶּה בָּא הַמַּיִין נוּקְבִין
for in Yesod resides bonding through powerful passion whence the feminine waters issue;
וְעַל כֵּן בּוֹעֵל אֲרַמִּית קְשׁוּרָה כְּכֶלֶב, כִּי הוּא חָפֵץ לִידָּבֵק בְּחֵשֶׁק שֶׁל אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם
wherefore he who cohabits with an Aramite woman is bound like a dog, seeking to cleave unto the carnal desire of the nations;
דְּהֵם ״נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ״ (תְּהִלִּים מ״ט:י״ג), וּבְנֵי אָדָם הַדּוֹמִין לִבְהֵמָה
who "are like the beasts that perish" (Tehillim 49:13), humans resembling beasts,
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּסוֹף פֶּרֶק הָאוֹמֵר (קִדּוּשִׁין ס״ט עַמּוּד א׳): ״וָלָד בִּמְעֵי שִׁפְחָה — כִּבְמְעֵי בְּהֵמָה״
as written at the end of Kiddushin (69a): "an offspring in the womb of a Canaanite maidservant is legally like an embryo in the belly of an animal";
וּ״בְהֵמָה״ (52) בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״כֶּלֶב״ (52), כִּי הוּא הַיְסוֹד דְּנֶפֶשׁ הַבַּהֲמִית שֶׁהוּא הַמַּיִין נוּקְבִין וְהַחֵשֶׁק דִּבְהֵמָה
and Behemah
has the identical numerical value of Kelev
being the Yesod of the animal soul which is the feminine waters of beasts.
וְעַל כֵּן אָמְרוּ בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (פָּרָשָׁה ע״א:ט׳): ״בָּא גָד״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל:יא) — בָּא מִי שֶׁבָּא לִגְדּוֹד מַשְׁתִּיתָן שֶׁל אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, פֵּירוּשׁ יְסוֹדָן

And therefore the Sages expounded in Bereishis Rabbah (71:9): "'Gad comes' (Bereishis 30:11)—he comes who is destined to cut down (ligdod) the foundation (mashtisan) of the nations," meaning their Yesod;
וְהַיְינוּ תֹּקֶף חֵשֶׁק הַתַּאֲוָה, וְהוּא אֵלִיָּהוּ מִשֵּׁבֶט גָּד, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ב:ג)
which is the raw intensity of lust, and this redeemer is the prophet Eliyahu who descended from the tribe of Gad (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5);
שֶׁהָיָה מַמָּשׁ הֵיפֶךְ זֶה, דְּעַל כֵּן חַי לְעוֹלָם
who was the absolute opposite of lust, wherefore he lives forever;
דְּעִיקַּר הַמִּיתָה הוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי הַתַּאֲוָה, שֶׁזֶּהוּ עֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ שֶׁבָּא עַל חַוָּה וְהֵטִיל בָּהּ זוּהֲמָא (שַׁבָּת קמ״ו עַמּוּד א׳)
for mortality entered solely through carnal desire, which was the Serpent's instigation when he cohabited with Chavah and injected defilement into her (Shabbat 146a);
וְהִיא הַהִתְחַבְּרוּת לַנֶּפֶשׁ הַבַּהֲמִית
this being the corrupt union with the animal soul;
וְעַל כֵּן שׁוֹרֶשׁ נַפְשׁוֹת אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם בַּתַּאֲווֹת, כִּי שָׁרְשָׁן בָּא מִצַּד חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן בִּידִיעַת טוֹב וָרָע שֶׁהָיָה בְּתַאֲוָה
wherefore the root of the souls of the nations is embedded in physical lusts, their inception issuing from Adam's sin in the Tree of Knowledge which occurred through bodily desire;
כִּי כָּל תַּאֲווֹת נִקְרְאוּ בִּלְשׁוֹן אֲכִילָה, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״אָכְלָה וּמָחֲתָה פִיהָ״ (מִשְׁלֵי ל:כ)
for all carnal lusts are scripturally designated by the term of eating: "she eats, and wipes her mouth" (Mishlei 30:20),
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּכְתוּבּוֹת (ס״ד עַמּוּד ב׳) עַל ״אוֹכֶלֶת עִמּוֹ לֵילֵי שַׁבָּת״ (כְּתוּבּוֹת ס״ה עַמּוּד ב׳)
and as written in Kesubos (65b) regarding the euphemism of "she eats with him on Friday nights";
וְעַל זֶה נִגְזַר עָלָיו מִיתָה
and on account of this lust mortality was decreed upon mankind;
וְשׁוֹרֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִצַּד הַטּוֹב, לְהַמְשִׁיךְ הַתַּאֲוָה לְדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה שֶׁנִּקְרָא ״חַיֵּי עוֹלָם״
while the root of Israel belongs to the good, channeling passion into words of Torah which are "eternal life" (chayei olam);
וְעַל כֵּן יִזְכּוּ לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
wherefore all Israel who possess a portion in the World to Come will merit eternal life,
וְלִתְחִיַּיִת הַמֵּתִים דְּאָז יִהְיוּ כְּחוֹלְמִים, וְהַמִּיתָה רַק דּוּגְמַת שֵׁינָה כֵּיוָן שֶׁעֲתִידִים לְהָקִיץ
and the Resurrection of the Dead when they will be like dreamers (Tehillim 126:1), death having been merely like sleep since they are destined to awaken.
וְעַל כֵּן הוּזְהֲרוּ עַל בִּיאַת אֲרַמִּית דְּאֵין לָהֶם שַׁיָּיכוּת עִמָּהֶם
And therefore Israel were warned against cohabiting with an Aramite woman, having no affinity with them;
וּפִינְחָס זֶה אֵלִיָּהוּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתַב רַשִׁ״י בְּבָבָא מְצִיעָא (קי״ד עַמּוּד ב׳)
and Pinchas is Eliyahu, as Rashi wrote in Bava Metzia (114b);
הוּא הַמְקַנֵּא עַל זֶה, וְנִתְכַּהֵן אָז, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (זְבָחִים ק״א עַמּוּד ב׳)
he being the one who was zealous against this sin (Bamidbar 25:7–13), and was consecrated as a Kohen then (Zevachim 101b);
שֶׁזָּכָה לְכֶתֶר כְּהֻנָּה שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ שְׁמִירַת הַיִּחוּס דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
meriting the Crown of Priesthood which is the foundation of guarding the genealogical lineage of Israel;
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב פֶּרֶק קַמָּא דִּכְתוּבּוֹת (י״ג עַמּוּד א׳): ״אִישׁ פְּלוֹנִי וְכֹהֵן הוּא״, פֵּירֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י: מְיוּחָס
as written in Kesubos (13a): "so-and-so is an upright man and a Kohen," Rashi explaining: genealogically certified;
וְהוּא עַל יְדֵי הַהַגְדָּרָה בַּתַּאֲווֹת דְּעִיקָּרָהּ בַּכֹּהֲנִים, דְּעַל כֵּן נִקְרְאוּ ״קְדֹשִׁים יִהְיוּ לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם״ (וַיִּקְרָא כ״א:ו׳)
achieved through strict restraint in carnal desires which is the hallmark of Kohanim, wherefore they are commanded: "They shall be holy unto their God" (Vayikra 21:6);
וְ״כָל מָקוֹם שֶׁאַתָּה מוֹצֵא גֶּדֶר עֶרְוָה — אַתָּה מוֹצֵא קְדוּשָׁה״ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כ״ד:ו׳)
and "wherever you find a fence against sexual immorality, you find holiness" (Vayikra Rabbah 24:6);
וְעַל כֵּן הַסּוֹטָה צָרִיךְ לְהָבִיא אֶל הַכֹּהֵן (בַּמִּדְבָּר ה:טו)
wherefore the suspected adulteress (Sotah) must be brought unto the Kohen (Bamidbar 5:15);
וְשִׁבְעַת יָמִים קוֹדֶם יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים מַפְרִישִׁין כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מִבֵּיתוֹ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב רֵישׁ יוֹמָא (ב׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
and seven days prior to Yom Kippur the High Priest is sequestered from his home (Yoma 2a),
לְהוֹסִיף קְדוּשָׁה עַל קְדוּשָׁה שֶׁבָּא לְכַפֵּר אָז עַל מַעֲשֵׂה עֻזָּא וַעֲזָאֵל, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּיוֹמָא (ס״ז עַמּוּד ב׳)
to add holiness upon holiness as he comes to atone for the fallen angels Uzza and Azael (Yoma 67b),
הַיְינוּ בַּתַּאֲווֹת לִדְחוֹת הַשָּׂטָן הַמַּשְׂטִין עַל זֶה
namely atoning for lust to repel the prosecuting Satan;
וְכֵן לִפְנֵי שְׂרֵיפַת הַפָּרָה הַבָּאָה לְטַהֵר מִטֻּמְאַת מֵת, שֶׁהוּא לְהָסִיר חֶלְאַת הַמִּיתָה
and likewise the Kohen is sequestered prior to burning the Red Heifer which purifies from corpse-defilement, removing the scourge of mortality;
וְעַל כֵּן: ״[כִּי] שִׂפְתֵי כֹהֵן [יִשְׁמְרוּ דַעַת] וְתוֹרָה [יְבַקְשׁוּ מִפִּיהוּ] כִּי מַלְאַךְ [ה׳ צְבָאוֹת הוּא]״ (מַלְאָכִי ב:ז)
wherefore: "For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the angel (mal'ach) of Hashem of hosts" (Malachi 2:7),
הַיְינוּ נָקִי מִתַּאֲווֹת כְּמַלְאָךְ, דְּזֶהוּ עִיקַּר הֶבְדֵּל בֵּין מַלְאָךְ לְאָדָם:
meaning pure from physical lusts like an angel, which is the essential distinction between an angel and a mortal human being.

8.h: The theme: Pinchas/Eliyahu as the Angel of the Covenant and the salvation of the Jewish soul from Gehinnom. Eliyahu became a complete angel (mal'ach), and initially Pinchas was likewise an angel whom Rachav did not need to hide (Tanchuma, Pinchas 1), expounded on "And an angel of Hashem came up from Gilgal" (Shoftim 2:1)—this was Pinchas. He is designated the "Angel of the Covenant" (Mal'ach HaBris, Malachi 3:1), for whom a chair is set at every circumcision, demarcating the boundary between Israel and the nations regarding sexual desire. Spiritual foreskin (orlah) applies only to the nations: even when gentiles practice physical circumcision (Nedarim 31b), their root remains embedded in lust; conversely, even an uncircumcised Jew is called circumcised (mahul b'kho'ach) because at his ancestral root he is circumcised. Therefore, Avraham Avinu—the head of the circumcised—sits at the entrance of Gehinnom to extract every circumcised Jew from punishment (Eruvin 19a), the covenant of circumcision testifying on their behalf that their sins were merely like external thorns around the myrtle (asa d'kayei beinei hotzei). The sole exception is one who cohabited with an Aramite woman (bo'el aramiss), whose foreskin is drawn down (mimshecha orlasei) so that Avraham does not recognize him. Yet even the person with a drawn foreskin (mashuch) is biblically circumcised, his defect being merely outward to human eyes; Hashem Himself, Who looks into the heart (I Shmuel 16:7), rescues him, seeing that in the depths of his soul he remains circumcised. Pinchas/Eliyahu became zealous over this sin, turning into an angel who perceives the inner thoughts of man (Tosafos, Shabbat 12b), seeing with the heavenly court (Hu u-veit dino) that even the fallen Jew remains pure in the inner depths of his heart.

p: וְאֵלִיָּהוּ שָׁב מַלְאָךְ לְגַמְרֵי
And Eliyahu transformed into a complete angel;
וּבַתְּחִלָּה פִּינְחָס גַּם כֵּן הָיָה כְּמַלְאָךְ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (תַּנְחוּמָא פָּרָשַׁת פִּינְחָס א׳) דְּלֹא הָיְתָה צְרִיכָה רָחָב לְהַצְפִּינוֹ מִפְּנֵי כֵן
and initially Pinchas was likewise like an angel, as written in Tanchuma (Pinchas 1) that Rachav did not need to hide him for he was invisible;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (שָׁם) עַל פָּסוּק: ״וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ ה׳ מִן הַגִּלְגָּל [אֶל הַבֹּכִים]״ (שׁוֹפְטִים ב:א) — זֶה פִּינְחָס
and as written (ibid.) on the verse: "And an angel of Hashem came up from Gilgal to Bochim" (Shoftim 2:1)—this was Pinchas;
וְנִקְרָא ״מַלְאַךְ הַבְּרִית״ (מַלְאָכִי ג:א), וּמְכִינִים כִּסֵּא בִּשְׁבִילוֹ בְּכָל בְּרִית מִילָה (פִּרְקֵי דְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר פֶּרֶק כ״ט)
and he is called the "Angel of the Covenant" (Malachi 3:1), for whom we prepare a chair at every circumcision (Kisei shel Eliyahu, Pirkei D'Rabbi Eliezer, ch. 29);
כִּי זֶהוּ הַמַּבְדִּיל בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים בַּתַּאֲווֹת
because this covenant is the boundary distinguishing Israel from the nations regarding carnal desires;
דְּאֵין הָעָרְלָה אֶלָּא עַל שֵׁם אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, וַאֲפִילּוּ מוּלֵי אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (נְדָרִים ל״א עַמּוּד ב׳)
for the foreskin is designated solely upon the name of the nations, and even circumcised gentiles are legally termed uncircumcised (Nedarim 31b);
רָצָה לוֹמַר: הַמּוּגְדָּרִים בַּתַּאֲווֹת בְּפֹעַל, שָׁרְשָׁם וִיסוֹדָם הוּא בַּתַּאֲוָה
meaning: even those gentiles who exercise outward moral restraint, their essential root is embedded in lust,
אֶלָּא שֶׁמַּכְנִיסִים תַּאֲוָתָם בְּדָבָר אֶחָד וְתַאֲוָה אַחֶרֶת הַגְּרוּעָה עוֹד יוֹתֵר
merely trading one desire for another more corrupted lust;
וַאֲפִילּוּ עַרְלֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, רָצָה לוֹמַר שֶׁאֵין מוּגְדָּרִים בְּפֹעַל, נִקְרָאִים מוּלִים בְּכֹחַ
while even uncircumcised Israelites, meaning those who lack outward restraint in deed, are termed circumcised in potential;
דְּמִשָּׁרְשָׁם בַּתּוֹלָדָה הֵם נִימּוֹלִים, וְאֵין לָהֶם שִׁיקּוּעַ בַּתַּאֲווֹת
for from their hereditary soul-root they are circumcised, possessing no intrinsic immersion in lust.
וְעַל כֵּן אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם רֹאשׁ הַנִּימּוֹלִים, הוּא מַעֲלֶה כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִגֵּיהִנָּם, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (עֵירוּבִין י״ט עַמּוּד א׳)
And therefore Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, the head of the circumcised, raises all Israelites out of Gehinnom, as written in Eruvin (19a);
דְּהַכֹּל יוֹרְדִין עַל עִסְקֵי גֵּיהִנָּם וְהַמִּתְפַּתֶּה בְּיִצְרוֹ נוֹפֵל שָׁם, הַיְינוּ בַּתַּאֲווֹת, וְחוֹתַם הַבְּרִית מֵעִיד לְהַצִּילָם
for sinners descend to Gehinnom seduced by their yetzer in lust, and the seal of the Covenant testifies to rescue them;
וְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ מִדַּת הַחֶסֶד שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת הַתַּאֲווֹת רָעוֹת
and Avraham Avinu who is the root of Chesed, whence unrectified lusts can expand,
דְּעַל כֵּן יָצָא מִמֶּנּוּ הַפְּסֹולֶת דְּיִשְׁמָעֵאל הַמָּלֵא נִיאוּף, הוּא שֶׁנִּיתַּן לוֹ בְּרִית מִילָה
wherefore from him issued the dross of Yishmael who was steeped in licentiousness, unto Avraham specifically was given the covenant of circumcision;
דְּאַחַר כָּךְ הוֹלִיד אֶת יִצְחָק לִהְיוֹת אָב לָאוּמָּה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית, וְ״[כִּי] בְיִצְחָק יִקָּרֵא לְךָ זָרַע״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כ״א:י״ב)
so that afterward he begot Yitzchak to be the father of the Israelite nation: "for in Isaac shall your seed be called" (Bereishis 21:12);
וְהוּא הַמַּעֲלָם מִגֵּיהִנָּם, שֶׁמֵּעִיד עַל הַבַּעֲלֵי תַּאֲווֹת שֶׁבָּהֶם דְּהָיָה רַק מִצַּד הַהוֹצֵי דִּסְבִיב הָאָסָא
and Avraham extracts them from Gehinnom, testifying that the sins of those who fell into lust derived merely from the thorns encircling the myrtle (Sanhedrin 44a);
אֲבָל שָׁרְשָׁם בַּתּוֹלָדָה נִימּוֹלִים וּמוּגְדָּרִים מִתַּאֲווֹת
but their essential root at birth is circumcised and fenced against true evil.
חוּץ מִבּוֹעֵל אֲרַמִּית דִּמְמַשְּׁכָא עָרְלָתֵיהּ וְלָא מִבַּשְׁקַר לֵיהּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב שָׁם (עֵירוּבִין י״ט עַמּוּד א׳)
Except for one who cohabited with an Aramite woman, whose foreskin is drawn down so that Avraham does not recognize him (Eruvin 19a);
עַל יְדֵי הַחֵשֶׁק שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ לִידָּבֵק בְּאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, וְנִמְשָׁךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ עַד שֶׁקְּשׁוּרָה בּוֹ, הִיא נַעֲשֵׂית לוֹ עָרְלָה מַקֶּפֶת לַמִּילָה
through his desire to cleave unto the nations, running after her until she is bound unto him like a dog, she becomes for him an unholy foreskin encircling his circumcision;
וְהַמָּשׁוּךְ גַּם הוּא מָהוּל מִן הַתּוֹרָה, וְרַק מִשּׁוּם מַרְאִית הָעַיִן צָרִיךְ לַחֲזוֹר לָמוּלוֹ (יְבָמוֹת ע״ב עַמּוּד א׳)
yet one whose foreskin is drawn down remains biblically circumcised, requiring rabbinic re-circumcision merely for outward appearance (Yevamos 72a);
וְזֶהוּ ״דְּלָא מִבַּשְׁקַר״, מִצַּד הָאָדָם שֶׁיִּרְאֶה לַעֵינַיִם אֵין מַכִּיר וְסָבוּר שֶׁזֶּה עָרֵל
and this is what the Talmud means by "Avraham does not recognize him": from the perspective of man who looks upon outward appearance he appears uncircumcised;
וְאֵין מַצִּילוֹ אֶלָּא הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּעַצְמוֹ, אֲשֶׁר ״יִרְאֶה לַלֵּבָב״ (שְׁמוּאֵל א ט״ז:ז׳)
and none rescues him except the Blessed Name Himself, Who "looks on the heart" (I Shmuel 16:7),
דְּאַף הוּא בְּשׁוֹרֶשׁ מַעֲמַקֵּי לְבָבוֹ מָהוּל
seeing that in the ultimate depths of his heart he too remains circumcised!
וּפִינְחָס זֶה אֵלִיָּהוּ מַלְאַךְ הַבְּרִית נִתְקַנֵּא עַל זֶה, שֶׁמּוֹשֵׁךְ עָרְלָתוֹ וְנִרְאֶה עָרֵל לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם
And Pinchas—who is Eliyahu, the Angel of the Covenant—became zealous over this, where a Jew draws down his foreskin and appears uncircumcised to human eyes;
וְזָכָה לְהִתְהַפֵּךְ לְמַלְאָךְ, דִּלְפִי דַּעַת הַתּוֹסָפוֹת פֶּרֶק קַמָּא דְּשַׁבָּת (י״ב עַמּוּד ב׳) הַמַּלְאָכִים יוֹדְעִים מַחְשְׁבוֹת בְּנֵי אָדָם
and he merited to be transformed into an angel, for according to Tosafos in Shabbat (12b) angels know the thoughts of human beings;
וְהַיְינוּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים בִּלְשׁוֹן הַכָּתוּב דְּהַמַּלְאָךְ נִקְרָא בְּשֵׁם ה׳
meaning, as found in Scripture where an angel is addressed by the Divine Name (Bereishis 22:15–16);

וְגַם לְשׁוֹן הַכָּתוּב: ״וַה׳ יִרְאֶה לַלֵּבָב״ (שְׁמוּאֵל א ט״ז:ז׳), בְּצֵירוּף הַוָּי״ו, דְּרַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת [אָמְרוּ]: הוּא וּבֵית דִּינוֹ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה נ״א:ב׳)
and likewise the verse "And (v') Hashem looks on the heart" (I Shmuel 16:7), with the conjunctive Vav, which the Sages expound: "He and His heavenly court" (Bereishis Rabbah 51:2);
וְהֵם הַמַּלְאָכִים צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם הָעוֹמְדִים מִימִינוֹ וּשְׂמֹאלוֹ
they being the ministering angels, the host of heaven standing on His right and on His left (I Melachim 22:19);
וְהֶרְאָה לוֹ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מַעֲמַקֵּי הַלְּבָבוֹת דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
and the Blessed Name showed Eliyahu the inward depths of the hearts of the Children of Israel,
דַּאֲפִילּוּ אוֹתָם שֶׁלֹּא כֵן, הוּא רַק לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי אָדָם:
that even with those who appear fallen, it is so merely to the eyes of mortal men!
The theme: The revelation of Eliyahu, the purification of desire, the mystery of the End of Days
Keitz
, and the name of Eliyahu. The revelation of Eliyahu
Gilui Eliyahu

is granted to one whose inward heart is illuminated by Hashem in purity from every trace of lust. Prior to the great and terrible day of Hashem, Eliyahu is sent to purify the hearts of Israel from all evil desires at their very root, leading directly to the Resurrection of the Dead
Sotah 49b
and turning the heart of the fathers to the children
Eduyot 8:7; Malachi 3:24

. The Patriarchs rectified the sin of Adam HaRishon in their own personal root, but in their descendants this rectification remains incomplete until the Keitz—which Yaakov Avinu sought to reveal to his sons
Bereishis 49:1; Pesachim 56a
, but which was closed to him because the Keitz belongs to divine Foreknowledge
Yedi'ah
while human history is governed by free choice
Bechirah
. The Tetragrammaton with its feminine filling
milui ha-nukva
has the numerical value of Ban (ב״ן = 52), reflecting "You are children
banim
unto Hashem your God"
Devarim 14:1
and the holy feminine waters
mayin nukvin
. The nations, who are not called Adam
Yevamos 61a
but Behemah (בְּהֵמָה = 52), channel this into carnal lust; Israel, called Adam (אָדָם = 45 / מ״ה), channel it into the masculine world of Mah (עולם התיקון). Eliyahu equals 52
Ban / ב״ן
and in small gematria 16 (יו״ד-וָי״ו), uniting the Yud of Ehyeh with the Vav of Havayah—the "true sign"
os emes
that Rachav sought when converting
Zohar III, 2a
. Coitus with an Aramite woman severs one from this holy covenant, plunging the soul into the unholy shell of the dog (כֶּלֶב = 52). David feared this after marrying the captive woman
yefat to'ar, Sanhedrin 107a
, which bore Avshalom, crying: "Deliver my soul from the sword, my only one from the power of the dog"
Tehillim 22:21
. Rachav converted and married Yehoshua, producing prophets and priests; Eliyahu unites both as the prophet-priest who resolves all halachic doubts
Teiku
and will restore the Kohanim to their service using the ashes of the Red Heifer.
וְגִלּוּי אֵלִיָּהוּ הוּא לְמִי שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מֵאִיר לוֹ נְקִיּוּן פְּנִימִיּוּת לְבָבוֹ מִכָּל שֶׁמֶץ תַּאֲוָה
And the revelation of Eliyahu (Gilui Eliyahu) is granted unto one whose inward heart the Blessed Name enlightens in purity from every trace of lust;
וְלִפְנֵי ״[בּוֹא] יוֹם ה׳ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא״ (מַלְאָכִי ג:כג) לָדוּן עַמִּים, יִשְׁלַח לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת אֵלִיָּהוּ
and before the coming of the great and terrible day of Hashem to judge the nations, He will send unto the Children of Israel the prophet Eliyahu,
שֶׁיָּאִיר מַעֲמַקֵּיהֶם בְּטָהֳרָה מִכָּל מִינֵי תַּאֲווֹת רָעוֹת בְּשָׁרְשָׁם
that he may illuminate their innermost depths in purity from all manner of evil lusts at their very root;
דְּבָזֶה הוּא עִיקַּר דִּין הֶעָתִיד לְאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם
for in this domain of unbridled lust lies the primary future judgment of the nations of the world;
דְּעַל כֵּן אֵלִיָּהוּ מֵבִיא לִידֵי תְּחִיַּיִת הַמֵּתִים, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב סוֹף סוֹטָה (מ״ט עַמּוּד ב׳)
wherefore Eliyahu brings about the Resurrection of the Dead, as written at the end of Sotah (49b);
שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי תִּיקּוּן הַתַּאֲוָה דְּחֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן
which is accomplished through rectifying the carnal desire of the sin of Adam HaRishon;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה: ״וְהֵשִׁיב לֵב אָבוֹת [עַל בָּנִים וְלֵב בָּנִים עַל אֲבוֹתָם] וְגוֹמֵר״ (מַלְאָכִי ג:כד), כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב סוֹף עֵדֻיּוֹת (פֶּרֶק ח׳ מִשְׁנָה ז׳)
and through this: "And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, etc." (Malachi 3:24), as written at the end of Eduyot (8:7);
דִּידוּעַ דְּהָאָבוֹת כְּבָר תִּיקְּנוּ חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן
for it is known that the Patriarchs already rectified the sin of Adam HaRishon;
אֶלָּא שֶׁהֵם תִּיקְּנוּ רַק מִצַּד עַצְמָם וְשָׁרְשָׁם שֶׁהֵם אֲבוֹת הָעוֹלָם
except that they rectified it merely from the perspective of their own individual souls and root as the Patriarchs of the world;
אֲבָל מִצַּד הַהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת בִּבְנֵיהֶם וְתוֹלְדוֹתֵיהֶם, לֹא נִתְבָּרַר עֲדַיִין עַד עֵת קֵץ
but from the aspect of the historical expansion within their children and descendants, it has not yet been clarified until the time of the End;
וְהוּא הַקֵּץ שֶׁבִּקֵּשׁ יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם לְגַלּוֹת לְבָנָיו (בְּרֵאשִׁית מ״ט:א׳; פְּסָחִים נ״ו עַמּוּד א׳)
and this was the End (Keitz) that Yaakov Avinu sought to reveal unto his sons (Bereishis 49:1; Pesachim 56a);
שֶׁהוּא כְּבָר יְדָעוֹ מִצַּד שָׁרְשׁוֹ שֶׁכְּבָר נִתְבָּרַר
which he already knew from his own spiritual root that had already been fully rectified;
וְאַף דִּבְבָנָיו עֲדַיִין הוּא בְּהֶעְלֵם, יָדַע זְמַן הַבֵּירוּר אֶצְלָם
and even though within his sons it remained in concealment, he knew the appointed hour of their final purification;
אֶלָּא שֶׁכְּשֶׁבָּא לְגַלּוֹת נִסְתַּם מִמֶּנּוּ
except that when he came to reveal it, it was suddenly shut from him (Pesachim ibid.);
כִּי אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהִתְגַּלּוֹת זֶה כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא נִתְגַּלָּה הַבֵּירוּר, כִּי דָּבָר זֶה תָּלוּי בִּבְחִירָה
because it is impossible for this to be unveiled as long as their purification has not manifested in deed, this process depending upon free choice;
וִידִיעַת הַקֵּץ הוּא רַק מִצַּד הַיְּדִיעָה שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה מֵהַבְּחִירָה וּלְמִי שֶׁכְּבָר נִשְׁלַם
and the knowledge of the End belongs exclusively to the dimension of divine Foreknowledge (Yedi'ah) that transcends free choice, and unto one who is already wholly perfected;
וְקוֹדֶם הַבֵּירוּר נִרְאֶה הַלְּבָבוֹת דְּאָבוֹת וּבָנִים כִּמְפוֹרָדִים וּמְרוּחָקִים, אֲבָל הוּא יְשִׁיבֵם וִיאַחֲדֵם
and prior to that purification the hearts of fathers and sons appear divided and distant, but Eliyahu will turn them and unite them.
וְזֶהוּ שְׁלֵימוּת שֵׁם הֲוָיָ״ה, כַּנּוֹדָע דִּשְׁתֵּי אוֹתִיּוֹת הָרִאשׁוֹנוֹת הֵם אָבוֹת וְהָאַחֲרוֹנוֹת תּוֹלָדוֹת

And this is the consummate perfection of the Name Havayah, as is known that the first two letters (Yud-Hei) represent the fathers [Chochmah and Binah], and the last two letters (Vav-Hei) represent the offspring [Middos and Malchus];
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הוּא הַגִּידּוּד לְמַשְׁתִּיתָן שֶׁל אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, דְּעַל יְדֵיהֶן אֵין הַשֵּׁם שָׁלֵם
and through this is accomplished the shattering (giddud) of the foundation of the nations of the world, through whose existence the Divine Name remains incomplete;
וְאוֹתִיּוֹת הַמִּילּוּי הֵם נִקְרָאִים גַּם כֵּן ״בָּנִים״ לְגַבֵּי אוֹתִיּוֹת הָעִיקָּר שֶׁהֵם הָאָבוֹת הַמּוֹלִידִים אוֹתָם
and the letters of the spelled-out filling (milui) are likewise termed "children" relative to the primary letters which are the fathers giving birth to them;
וְגִימַטְרִיָּא שֵׁם הֲוָיָ״ה עִם הַמִּילּוּי דִּכְפָלָא שֶׁהוּא מִילּוּי הַנּוּקְבָא הָרוֹמֵז לִכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, כַּנּוֹדָע, בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא בָּ״ן (52) [יוֹ״ד הֵ״ה וָי״ו הֵ״ה]
and the numerical value of the Name Havayah with the doubled feminine filling (milui d'kuflei / Shem Ban = 52), which alludes to Knesset Israel, equals Ban
(ב״ן = 52); וְהַיְינוּ דְּעַל יְדֵי זֶה: ״בָּנִים אַתֶּם לַה׳ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם״ (דְּבָרִים י״ד:א׳), ״וְהֵשִׁיב לֵב בָּנִים עַל אֲבוֹתָם״ (מַלְאָכִי ג:כד), לִהְיוֹת דְּבוּקִים בַּה׳ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים

meaning that through this is fulfilled: "You are the children of Hashem your God" (Devarim 14:1), and "he shall turn the heart of the children to their fathers" (Malachi 3:24), to become cleaved unto Hashem, the Living God;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה: ״וְאַתֶּם הַדְּבֵקִים [בַּה׳ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם] חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם [הַיּוֹם]״ (דְּבָרִים ד:ד), יִזְכּוּ לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם
