וּבְכָל קָרְבָּנוֹת נֶאֱמַר ״רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ״ (בַּמִּדְבָּר כ״ח:ב׳), וְכֵן כָּל הַמִּצְוֹת לְנַחַת רוּחַ לְפָנָיו
and regarding all sacrifices it is written "a sweet savour" (Bamidbar 28:2), and so all commandments bring gratification before Him;
וְנֶאֱמַר: ״צוּר יְלָדְךָ תֶּשִׁי״ (דְּבָרִים ל״ב:י״ח), וְשֶׁמַּתִּישִׁין חַס וְשָׁלוֹם כֹּחַ פַּמַלְיָא שֶׁל מַעְלָה בַּחֲטָאֵיהֶם (אֵיכָה רַבָּה א:לג)

and it is said: "Of the Rock that begot you you are unmindful (teshi)" (Devarim 32:18), expounded that they weaken (matishin), God forbid, the power of the celestial entourage through their sins (Eichah Rabbah 1:33);
וְהַיְינוּ כִּי ״יוֹתֵר מִמַּה שֶּׁהָעֵגֶל רוֹצֶה לִינוֹק — פָּרָה רוֹצָה לְהָנִיק״ (פְּסָחִים קי״ב עַמּוּד א׳)
meaning that "more than the calf wishes to suck, the cow yearns to suckle" (Pesachim 112a);
וְעַל כֵּן הֲגַם שֶׁהִיא מַשְׁפִּיעָה, הִיא מְקַבֶּלֶת גַּם כֵּן בָּזֶה שֶׁמַּשְׁפִּיעָה, כֵּיוָן דְּהִיא רוֹצָה וּמִשְׁתּוֹקֶקֶת לְהַשְׁפִּיעַ
wherefore even though she bestows, she likewise receives in the very act of bestowing, since she desires and yearns to bestow.

וַהֲרֵי מָצִינוּ: אִשָּׁה מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת בַּהֲנָאָה שֶׁנּוֹתֶנֶת לְאָדָם חָשׁוּב, שֶׁנֶּהֱנֵית בְּקַבָּלָתוֹ, דְּנֶחְשָׁב שֶׁהִיא מְקַבֶּלֶת מַה שֶּׁהוּא מְקַבֵּל מִמֶּנָּה, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב פֶּרֶק קַמָּא דְּקִדּוּשִׁין (ז׳ עַמּוּד א׳)

And behold we find: a woman can be betrothed through the benefit she grants to a distinguished man (adam chashuv), taking pleasure in his acceptance, it being reckoned as if she receives from what he accepts from her, as written in Kiddushin (7a);

וְעַל כֵּן אֵינוֹ סוֹתֵר מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (מִדְרַשׁ שְׁמוּאֵל פָּרָשָׁה ד׳; בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה מ״ד:א׳): ״לֹא נִתְּנוּ הַמִּצְוֹת אֶלָּא לְצָרֵף בָּהֶן אֶת הַבְּרִיּוֹת, וְכִי מָה אִכְפַּת לֵיהּ לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בֵּין שׁוֹחֵט מִן הַצַּוָּאר וְכוּלֵיהּ״

and therefore this does not contradict what is written elsewhere (Midrash Shmuel 4; Bereishis Rabbah 44:1): "The mitzvos were given only to refine human beings, for what does the Holy One care whether one slaughters from the neck or the nape?";
דְּהָא וְהָא אִיתֵיהּ
for both principles are fully true:

מֵאַחַר שֶׁרְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הָיָה בָּזֶה לְצָרֵף הַבְּרִיּוֹת שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה יוּכַל לְהַשְׁפִּיעַ לָהֶם כָּל טוֹבָה, מִמֵּילָא גַּם הוּא מְקַבֵּל הֲנָיָה מֵהֶם, דְּנַחַת רוּחַ לְפָנָיו שֶׁאָמַר וְנַעֲשָׂה רְצוֹנוֹ (סִפְרֵי בַּמִּדְבָּר קמ״ג)

since the will of the Blessed Name was to refine mankind so that He could bestow all goodness upon them, automatically He receives pleasure from them, there being gratification before Him that He spoke and His will was done (Sifrei Bamidbar §143);
וְכֵן מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב: ״אִם צָדַקְתָּ מַה תִּתֶּן לּוֹ וּמַה מִיָּדְךָ [יִקָּח] וְגוֹמֵר״ (אִיּוֹב ל״ה:ז׳), גַּם כֵּן אֵין סוֹתֵר זֶה מִטַּעַם הַנִּזְכָּר
and likewise the verse: "If you be righteous, what give you Him? or what receives He of your hand?" (Iyov 35:7) does not contradict this, for the reason mentioned.
מִלְּבַד דִּידוּעַ דִּלְעַצְמוּת אֵין סוֹף יִתְבָּרַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת אֵין שַׁיָּיכוּת לַעֲבוֹדָה וּמַעֲשֵׂה הַתַּחְתּוֹנִים
Besides, it is known that relative to the infinite Essence (Atzmut Ein Sof), blessed be He, human worship and earthly deeds have no bearing whatsoever;
רַק לַאֲצִילוּת קָדְשׁוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, דְּגַם הוּא עַצְמוּתוֹ שֶׁהֶאֱצִיל אוֹר הַמּוּשָּׂג לַתַּחְתּוֹנִים
but rather unto the holy emanation (Atzilus), which is likewise His Essence that emanated an intelligible light accessible to lower beings,
כְּשֶׁעָלָה בִּרְצוֹנוֹ לִבְרוֹא נִבְרָאִים וְשֶׁהוּא יִמְלוֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם וִינַהֲלֵם וְהֵם יַכִּירוּ כֹּחַ מַלְכוּתוֹ
when it arose in His divine will to bring forth creatures, to reign over them, and that they recognize the power of His sovereignty;
וְהוּכְרַח לְהַאֲצִיל אוֹר בְּמִדּוֹת נִמְדָּדוֹת לְפִי מִדַּת הַמְקַבְּלִים
He having emanated light in measured attributes according to the capacity of the recipients;
וְכָל שְׁמוֹתָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ וְהַהַשָּׂגוֹת שֶׁל כָּל הַמַּלְאָכִים וּשְׂרָפִים וְאוֹפַנִּים וּנְבִיאִים וַחֲכָמִים, הַכֹּל רַק בַּמִּדּוֹת הַנֶּאֱצָלוֹת
and all His holy Names and the perceptions of all angels, seraphim, ophanim, prophets, and sages operate exclusively within these emanated attributes.

וְהָאָדָם הוּא תַּכְלִית הַבְּרִיאָה, שֶׁזֶּה עִיקַּר הַמְכֻוָּון: שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אָדָם גּוּפָנִי בְּהַאי עָלְמָא דְּשִׁקְרָא הַמָּלֵא כָּל מִינֵי רָע וּדְבָרִים הַמַּשְׁכִּיחִים וּמַעֲלִימִים הַכָּרַת הַבּוֹרֵא יִתְבָּרַךְ

And man is the ultimate purpose of Creation, the primary intent being that a physical man exist in this world of falsehood filled with all manners of evil and distractions obscuring the recognition of the Creator;
וְהַבְּחִירָה מְסוּרָה בְּיָדוֹ לִבְחוֹר בָּרָע גַּם כֵּן, וְעִם כָּל זֶה הוּא גּוֹבֵר נֶגֶד כָּל מִינֵי רָע
free choice being granted to choose evil as well, yet despite this he overpowers all forms of evil,
וּמַכִּיר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹרֵא כָּל עוֹלָמִים וְשֶׁרָאוּי לְעָבְדוֹ, וְזֶה הָיָה כְּלַל הַמְכֻוָּון בַּבְּרִיאָה
recognizing that there is a Creator of all worlds Whom it is fitting to serve, this being the overarching objective of Creation;
וְעַל כֵּן הַכֹּל הָיָה בִּדְמוּת אָדָם, וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב (קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ב:יב): ״גָּדוֹל כֹּחָן שֶׁל נְבִיאִים שֶׁמְּדַמִּין צוּרָה לְיוֹצְרָהּ וְכוּלֵיהּ״
wherefore the entire divine architecture was patterned in the form of Man, as written in Koheles Rabbah (2:12): "Great is the power of the prophets who compare the form unto its Creator,"
וְ״עַל דְּמוּת הַכִּסֵּא דְּמוּת כְּמַרְאֵה אָדָם [עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה]״ (יְחֶזְקֵאל א:כו)
and "upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it" (Yechezkel 1:26);

וְהַיְינוּ ״אָדָם דַּאֲצִילוּת״, שֶׁגַּם הַמִּדּוֹת הַנֶּאֱצָלוֹת, מֵאַחַר שֶׁהֵם אֲצִילוּת לְצֹרֶךְ הָאָדָם כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהַשִּׂיג מְצִיאוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, הֲרֵי מִדָּתָן כְּפִי מִדַּת הַשָּׂגָתוֹ שֶׁל הַמַּשִּׂיג

this being the Adam d'Atzilus, for since the emanated attributes exist for the sake of man so that he may comprehend His divine existence, their measure matches the perceptual capacity of the human perceiver,
וְעַל כֵּן גַּם אֲצִילוּת הַשָּׂגָה הַמּוּשֶּׂגֶת הוּא ״כְּמַרְאֵה אָדָם״
wherefore the divine emanation is portrayed "as the appearance of a man."
וְכֵן הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁהִיא דְּפוּס כָּל מַעֲשֵׂה בְּרֵאשִׁית
And likewise the Torah which is the blueprint of Creation (Bereishis Rabbah 1:1);
כִּי הִיא מִדַּת הַנְהָגָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁעַל פִּיהָ הָיָה כָּל הַבְּרִיאָה כּוּלָּהּ בִּדְרָכִים מוּגְבָּלִים וּמְצוּמְצָמִים עַל פִּי דַּרְכֵי הַתּוֹרָה, הוּא גַּם כֵּן בִּדְמוּת אָדָם
being the measure of His divine governance according to which the entire creation was formed in limited, contracted channels, is likewise patterned in the form of Man;
כִּידוּעַ דְּרַמַ״ח מִצְוֹת עֲשֵׂה וּשְׁסָ״ה לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה נֶגֶד רַמַ״ח אֵיבָרִים וּשְׁסָ״ה גִּידִין (מַכּוֹת כ״ג עַמּוּד ב׳)
as is known that the 248 positive commandments and 365 negative commandments correspond to the 248 limbs and 365 sinews of the human body (Makkos 23b);
וּלְגַבֵּי אֲצִילוּת הַשָּׂגָה זוֹ שַׁפִּיר שַׁיָּיךְ הַנַּחַת רוּחַ וְהַתָּשַׁת כֹּחַ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם
and relative to this emanated realm of human perception, divine gratification (nachas ruach) and the weakening of strength, God forbid, appropriately apply;
כִּי הַהַשָּׂגָה רַק לְצֹרֶךְ הַמַּשִּׂיגִים, וְאִם אֵין מַשִּׂיגִים מַה צֹּרֶךְ לַהַשָּׂגָה
for this emanated perception exists solely for the sake of the recipients, and if they do not perceive, what need is there for this revealed realm?
הֲרֵי עַצְמוּת אֵין סוֹף הוּא אוֹר עֶלְיוֹן וּמֻפְלָא הַרְבֵּה יוֹתֵר מֵאוֹר הָאֲצִילוּת לְאֵין שִׁיעוּר וָעֵרֶךְ
seeing that the infinite Essence (Atzmut Ein Sof) is a supernal light infinitely more exalted than the light of Atzilus beyond all measure;
וְכָל הָאֲצִילוּת הַיְינוּ רַק הַשָּׂגָה מוּשֶּׂגֶת לַנִּבְרָאִים, וְהַיְינוּ לָאָדָם תַּכְלִית הַבְּרִיאָה
and the entire realm of Atzilus is merely light made intelligible to creatures, namely to Man, the ultimate purpose of Creation;
אִם כֵּן כְּפִי הִתְעַלּוּת הַשָּׂגַת אָדָם, כָּךְ הוּא הִתְעַלּוּת הָאוֹר הַהוּא הַמּוּשָּׂג:
if so, according to the spiritual elevation of man's perception, so is the elevation of that intelligible divine light.

9.h: The theme: The final rung of Atzilus manifest as the Shechinah in the hearts of Israel. The final downward rung of the lights of Atzilus is the manifestation of the Shechinah, which is the divine light dwelling within the hearts of the Children of Israel ("God is the rock of my heart", Tehillim 73:26; Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2). She is designated Knesset Israel—the gathering of all Jewish souls who are an actual portion of Hashem breathed from His innermost spirit. Just as Hashem emanated of His spirit upon the prophets ("The spirit of Hashem spoke by me", II Shmuel 23:2; Bamidbar 11:29) so that His light overflowed into the chambers of their hearts to utter "Thus says Hashem," so too this spirit resides within every single Jewish soul. At Mount Sinai all Israel attained prophecy, hearing the first two commandments directly from the Almighty (Makkos 24a); and in the Future He will pour out His spirit upon all flesh (Yoel 3:1). Although in this world this spirit is deeply concealed except among prophets, the essential soul-root of all Israel is emanated from His divine spirit, being the light of His Shechinah dwelling in their innermost hearts as their very vitality.

p: וּמַדְרֵגָה אַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁל הִשְׁתַּלְשְׁלוּת אוֹרוֹת אֲצִילוּת קָדְשׁוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ עַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מוּשָּׂג לָאָדָם הַמַּשִּׂיג
And the final rung of the downward cascade of the lights of His holy Atzilus until becoming intelligible to the human perceiver;
הוּא הַמַּדְרֵיגָה דְּגִלּוּי שְׁכִינָה, שֶׁהוּא הָאוֹר הַשּׁוֹכֵן בְּלִבְּבוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
is the spiritual level of the manifestation of the Shechinah, which is the light dwelling within the hearts of the Children of Israel;

כְּטַעַם ״צוּר לְבָבִי [וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם]״ (תְּהִלִּים ע״ג:כ״ו), שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ה:ב): דְּהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לִבָּן שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל

after the meaning of "God is the rock of my heart and my portion forever" (Tehillim 73:26), which the Sages expounded (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2): that the Holy One, blessed be He, is the heart of Israel;
וְכִידוּעַ דְּהוּא הַנִּקְרָא גַּם כֵּן ״כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל״
and as is known, she is likewise termed Knesset Israel;
הַיְינוּ דִּכְנֶסֶת וְקִיבּוּץ כְּלַל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם חֵלֶק ה׳ מַמָּשׁ
meaning the gathering and assembly of all the souls of Israel who are literally a portion of Hashem,
שֶׁנָּפַח בְּאַפָּיו מֵרוּחוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּאָדָם הַנּוֹפֵחַ מֵרוּחוֹ
having breathed into his nostrils from His divine spirit like a man who breathes from his innermost soul;
כָּךְ כִּבְיָכוֹל שַׁיָּיךְ זֶה בְּמִדּוֹת הָאֲצִילוּת שֶׁהֵם דּוּגְמַת קוֹמַת אָדָם
so, as it were, this applies within the attributes of Atzilus which are patterned after the stature of Man;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁהֶאֱצִיל מֵרוּחוֹ עַל הַנְּבִיאִים, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״רוּחַ ה׳ דִּבֶּר בִּי [וּמִלָּתוֹ עַל לְשׁוֹנִי]״ (שְׁמוּאֵל ב כ״ג:ב׳), ״כִּי יִתֵּן ה׳ אֶת רוּחוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם״ (בַּמִּדְבָּר י״א:כ״ט)

and as He emanated of His spirit upon the prophets, as written: "The spirit of Hashem spoke by me, and His word was upon my tongue" (II Shmuel 23:2), and "that Hashem would put His spirit upon them" (Bamidbar 11:29);
שֶׁהוּא הַהַשָּׂגָה דְּמַאֲמַר הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, הַיְינוּ מַה שֶּׁשּׁוֹפֵעַ בְּחַדְרֵי לְבָבוֹ אוֹרוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ לְהַשִּׂיג מַה הוּא רְצוֹנוֹ
which is the perception of the utterance of the Blessed Name, His divine light overflowing into the chambers of the heart to comprehend His will,
וְדִבּוּרָיו הֵם דְּבַר ה׳ שֶׁאוֹמֵר ״כֹּה אָמַר ה׳״
so that the prophet's words are the word of Hashem, declaring: "Thus says Hashem";
כָּךְ יֵשׁ רוּחַ זֶה בְּכָל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל
so too does this divine spirit reside within all the souls of Israel;
שֶׁהֲרֵי כּוּלָּם הִגִּיעוּ בְּמַעֲמַד הַר סִינַי לְמַדְרֵיגַת נְבוּאָה, וְשָׁמְעוּ ״אָנֹכִי״ וְ״לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ״ מִפִּי הַגְּבוּרָה (מַכּוֹת כ״ד עַמּוּד א׳)
for behold, all of them attained the level of prophecy at Mount Sinai, hearing Anochi and Lo yihyeh lecha directly from the mouth of the Almighty (Makkos 24a);
וְכֵן יַגִּיעוּ לָזֶה לֶעָתִיד שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְשָׁפַכְתִּי אֶת רוּחִי עַל כָּל בָּשָׂר [וְנִבְּאוּ בְּנֵיכֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיכֶם]״ (יוֹאֵל ג:א)
and so will they all attain this in the Future, as it is said: "I will pour out My spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy" (Yoel 3:1);
אֶלָּא שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה הוּא אֶצְלָם בְּהֶעְלֵם עָצוּם, וְאֵינוֹ בְּהִתְגַּלּוּת אֶלָּא בַּנְּפָשׁוֹת הַגְּבוֹהוֹת הַנִּבְחָרִים לִנְבִיאֵי ה׳
except that in this world this spirit is deeply concealed within them, manifest only in exalted souls chosen as prophets of Hashem;
אֲבָל שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵם כּוּלָּם אֲצוּלִים מֵרוּחוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ
but the essential root of all the souls of Israel is emanated from His holy spirit;
וְהוּא הוּא אוֹר שְׁכִינָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ הַשּׁוֹכֵן בְּקֶרֶב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבְמַעֲמַקֵּי לְבָבָם, וְזֶהוּ שׁוֹרֶשׁ חַיּוּתָם:
and this is the very light of His Shechinah dwelling amidst the Children of Israel and in the depths of their hearts, which is the root of their vitality.

9.h: The theme: The emergence of Knesset Israel at the Exodus, the indestructible pillar of faith, and the ultimate repentance of all Jewish souls. The construction of Knesset Israel as an integrated nation began at the Exodus. The Patriarchs had been solitary individuals who recognized the Creator; even regarding Yaakov Avinu, whose bed was unblemished (Pesachim 56a), it had not yet been proven that every one of his descendants—even those submerged in the depths of materialism—possessed an unbreakable root cleaved unto Hashem. This root is faith (emunah): they are "believers, the children of believers" (Shabbat 97a), and in the merit of faith they were redeemed from Egypt (Mechilta, Beshalach 6). Habakkuk based the entire Torah upon this single pillar: "the righteous shall live by his faith" (Habakkuk 2:4; Makkos 24a), which sustains Israel even in the lowest descent. This faith is planted in every single Jew without exception; even Jewish sinners have sacrificed their lives for the sanctification of the Name (Kiddush Hashem), as expounded on "the fragrance of his traitors" (rei'ach bogdav, Bereishis Rabbah 65:22). Even those who apostatized out of spite, upon hearing that Mashiach has arrived, will immediately believe and return; and heretics who ignore the tidings will tremble and repent when the great Shofar is sounded (Yeshayah 27:13), so that "no outcast shall be expelled from Him" (II Shmuel 14:14). Unlike gentiles whose root is in evil, Jewish sinners return directly to their ancestral root of pure love for Hashem. The ultimate purpose of Creation is this: that mortals living in the lowest corporeal realm, surrounded by darkness, should recognize His kingdom and sanctify His Name, bringing greater glory to Hashem than thousands of ministering angels.

p: וּתְחִלַּת בִּנְיַן קוֹמַת כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם
And the inception of the construction of the spiritual stature of Knesset Israel occurred at the Exodus from Egypt;
שֶׁנִּבְנוּ אָז לִהְיוֹת עַם אֶחָד וְגוֹי מְיוּחָד בָּאָרֶץ לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
when they were formed to become one people and a unique nation in the earth unto the Blessed Name (II Shmuel 7:23);
דְּמִתְּחִלָּה אֲבוֹת הָעוֹלָם הָיוּ יְחִידִים שֶׁהִכִּירוּ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
for initially the Patriarchs of the world were solitary individuals who recognized the Blessed Name;
וְאַף יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁמִּטָּתוֹ שְׁלֵימָה, לֹא נִתְבָּרַר עֲדַיִין שֶׁהוּא כֵּן בְּכָל זַרְעוֹ
and even regarding Yaakov Avinu whose bed was unblemished (Pesachim 56a), it was not yet verified that this held true across all his future seed:
אַף אוֹתָם הַמְשׁוּקָּעִים בְּתַכְלִית הַשִּׁיקּוּעַ בְּעִנְיְנֵי עוֹלָם הַזֶּה, יֵשׁ בָּהֶם שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַדָּבוּק בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
that even those submerged in the deepest immersion in the mundane affairs of this world possess an inner root cleaved unto the Blessed Name;
וְהוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ הָאֱמוּנָה, שֶׁהֵם ״מַאֲמִינִים בְּנֵי מַאֲמִינִים״ (שַׁבָּת צ״ז עַמּוּד א׳)
and this is the root of faith, they being "believers, the children of believers" (Shabbat 97a);
וּמִיָּד שֶׁבָּא מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וְעוֹרְרָם, ״וַיַּאֲמֵן הָעָם״ (שְׁמוֹת ד:לא) מִיָּד בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
and immediately when Moshe Rabbeinu came and aroused them, "and the people believed" (Shemos 4:31) immediately in the Blessed Name;
וּבִזְכוּת הָאֱמוּנָה נִגְאֲלוּ (מְכִילְתָּא בְּשַׁלַּח ו׳)
and in the merit of faith they were redeemed (Mechilta, Beshalach 6);
הַיְינוּ כִּי עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְעוֹרֵר הָאוֹר מְעַט מְעַט בְּקֶרֶב לְבָבָם, עַד שֶׁזָּכוּ לָצֵאת מֵאֲפֵלָה לְאוֹר גָּדוֹל
meaning that through this the light awakened little by little within their hearts, until they merited to emerge from darkness into great light.
כִּי הָאֱמוּנָה הוּא הַתְחָלַת הַשָּׂגַת אוֹר שְׁכִינָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בַּתַּחְתּוֹנִים
For faith is the very beginning of perceiving the light of His Shechinah in the lower realms;
כַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא בְּתַכְלִית הַהֶעְלֵם שֶׁאֵין לוֹ שׁוּם הַשָּׂגָה כְּלָל, דַּי בְּהַשָּׂגָה זוֹ דֶּרֶךְ אֱמוּנָה פְּשׁוּטָה בַּלֵּב שֶׁיֶּשְׁנָהּ בְּכָל הַהֲמוֹנִים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
when an individual is in total concealment lacking any conscious intellectual perception, this perception through simple faith in the heart (present within all the masses of Israel) suffices;
דְּעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (מַכּוֹת כ״ד עַמּוּד א׳): ״בָּא חֲבַקּוּק וְהֶעֱמִידָהּ עַל אַחַת: ׳[וְצַדִּיק] בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ יִחְיֶה׳ (חֲבַקּוּק ב:ד)״
concerning which the Sages stated (Makkos 24a): "Habakkuk came and established the entire Torah upon a single foundation: 'the righteous shall live by his faith' (Habakkuk 2:4)";
שֶׁהוּא עַמּוּד אֶחָד שֶׁעָלָיו אָנוּ חַיִּים וְקַיָּימִים גַּם בְּשִׁפְלוּתֵנוּ זֶה שֶׁאֵין שׁוּם הַשָּׂגָה גְּלוּיָה בַּלֵּב
which is the single pillar upon which we live and endure even in our lowliness when there is no revealed perception in the heart;
וְכָל הַשָּׂגוֹת הַמַּשִּׂיגִים גַּם כֵּן הוּא רַק דֶּרֶךְ אֱמוּנָה עַל הָרוֹב
and all perceptions of spiritual masters likewise operate mostly through faith;
אֶלָּא שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה יוּכְלוּ לִזְכּוֹת בְּעִתִּים מְזוּמָּנִים גַּם לְהַשָּׂגָה אֲמִיתִּית הַמְבוֹרֶרֶת וְנִיכֶּרֶת לְעֵינֵי הַשֵּׂכֶל וְהַלֵּב
except that through faith they merit at appointed seasons a verified perception clear to the eyes of intellect and heart;
וְזֶהוּ רַק לַיְּחִידִים הַמַּשִּׂיגִים, אֲבָל כְּלַל הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא רַק דֶּרֶךְ אֱמוּנָה לְבַד
yet this clarity is granted only to unique masters, while for collective Knesset Israel the connection is maintained through faith alone.
וּבֶאֱמוּנָה זוֹ תְּקוּעִים כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶחָד לֹא נֶעְדָּר
And in this faith are rooted all the souls of the Children of Israel, not a single one missing;
וַאֲפִילּוּ פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהִגְדִּילוּ עֲבֵירוֹת הַרְבֵּה, אֱמוּנָה זוֹ עֲדַיִין תְּקוּעָה בִּלְבָבָם
and even the sinners of Israel who multiplied many transgressions, this faith remains embedded in their hearts;
וְכִידוּעַ דְּהַרְבֵּה פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מָסְרוּ נַפְשָׁם עַל קִדּוּשׁ הַשֵּׁם
and as is known, many Jewish sinners sacrificed their lives for the sanctification of the Name (Kiddush Hashem);
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (פָּרָשָׁה ס״ה:כ״ב) עַל פָּסוּק ״[וַיָּרַח אֶת] רֵיחַ בְּגָדָיו״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כ״ז:כ״ז) — ״רֵיחַ בּוֹגְדָיו״ (סַנְהֶדְרִין ל״ז עַמּוּד א׳)
as the Sages expounded in Bereishis Rabbah (65:22) on the verse "and he smelled the fragrance of his garments (begadav)"—the fragrance of his traitors (bogdav, Sanhedrin 37a);
וַאֲפִילּוּ אוֹתָם שֶׁלֹּא עָלָה בְּלִבָּם הִרְהוּרֵי תְּשׁוּבָה בְּשׁוּם פַּעַם וְנִשְׁתַּמְּדוּ לְהַכְעִיס
and even those in whose hearts thoughts of repentance never arose, who apostatized out of spite;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם אִם יְבַשְּׂרוּם שֶׁמָּשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד בָּא, וַדַּאי יַאֲמִינוּ וְיָשׁוּבוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵימָה
nevertheless, if they are informed that Mashiach ben David has arrived, they will certainly believe and return in complete repentance;
וַאֲפִילּוּ אוֹתָם הָאֶפִּיקוֹרְסִים שֶׁלֹּא יָשׁוּבוּ בִּבְשׂוֹרָה בְּעָלְמָא, כְּשֶׁיִּתָּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל, אָז ״[וּבָאוּ] הָאֹבְדִים... וְהַנִּדָּחִים״ (יְשַׁעְיָה כ״ז:י״ג)
and even those heretics who would not repent from mere tidings, when the great Shofar is sounded, then "they shall come that were lost... and that were outcasts" (Yeshayah 27:13),
דְּיֶחֶרְדוּ וְיָשׁוּבוּ, וְאָז ״לֹא יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח״ (שְׁמוּאֵל ב י״ד:י״ד)
for they will tremble and return, and then "no outcast shall be expelled from Him" (II Shmuel 14:14);
דְּגַם כָּל הַנִּדָּחִים שֶׁנִּטְמְעוּ בֵּין הָעַמִּים יָשׁוּבוּ
for even all the outcasts who assimilated among the nations will return.
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם דְּאֵין בָּהֶם שׁוֹרֶשׁ זֶה בְּמַעֲמַקֵּי הַלֵּב, לְהֵיכָן יָשׁוּבוּ
Unlike the nations of the world who lack this holy root in the depths of their hearts: unto where would they return?
דְּהַתְּשׁוּבָה הוּא רַק שֶׁיַּחְזְרוּ לְשָׁרְשָׁם, וְהֵם שָׁרְשָׁם בָּרָע
for repentance means returning unto one's root, and their root is embedded in evil;
וְאִם יִשְׁמְעוּ יְשׁוּעָה אֲמִיתִּית, אִם יַאֲמִינוּ לָזֶה יְאַבְּדוּ עַצְמָם לָדַעַת, אוֹ יָבוֹאוּ לִלְחוֹם עַל ה׳ וְעַל מְשִׁיחוֹ (תְּהִלִּים ב:ב)
and if they hear of true divine salvation, if they believe it they will either take their own lives or assemble to wage war against Hashem and His anointed (Tehillim 2:2);
זוּלַת אוֹתָם הַגֵּרִים גְּרוּרִים (עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה ג׳ עַמּוּד ב׳) שֶׁיִּהְיוּ עֲבָדִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
except for those proselytes who are drawn along (gerim gerurim, Avodah Zarah 3b) who will become servants unto Israel;
כְּמוֹ רַבִּים מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ שֶׁנִּתְיַהֲדוּ בִּימֵי מָרְדֳּכַי וְאֶסְתֵּר (אֶסְתֵּר ח:יז) מִצַּד הַפַּחַד וְלֹא לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם
like many of the people of the land who converted in the days of Mordechai and Esther (Esther 8:17) out of fear and not for the sake of Heaven;
וְעַל כֵּן אֵין מְקַבְּלִים גֵּרִים אָז (יְבָמוֹת כ״ד עַמּוּד ב׳)
wherefore no converts will be accepted in the Messianic era (Yevamos 24b);
אֶלָּא שֶׁמִּכָּל מָקוֹם אֵין הַמִּשְׁפָּט לְהַאֲבִידָם, וְיִהְיוּ עֲבָדִים
yet divine justice will not destroy them, and they will become servants;
אֲבָל פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיָּד שֶׁיָּשׁוּבוּ, יָשׁוּבוּ לְגַמְרֵי לְשָׁרְשָׁן מֵאֲבוֹתָם, לְאַהֲבָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת בְּכָל לֵב וָנֶפֶשׁ וּמְאֹד:
but the sinners of Israel, immediately upon repenting, will return completely to their ancestral root, to love the Blessed Name in truth with all their heart, soul, and might.
וְדָבָר זֶה הָיָה כְּלַל הַבְּרִיאָה: שֶׁיִּהְיֶה כְּנֵסִיָּה שְׁלֵימָה מִבְּנֵי אָדָם דְּבוּקִים בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, אֲפִילּוּ בִּהְיוֹתָם מְשׁוּקָּעִים בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁמְּשׁוּקָּעִים

And this was the overarching purpose of Creation: that there exist an entire congregation of mortals cleaved unto the Blessed Name even while submerged in whatever spiritual depths they are submerged;
כִּי מִי שֶׁהַשָּׂגָתוֹ גְּדוֹלָה, מַה רְבוּתָא הוּא מִי שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ רִבּוֹנוֹ וְהוּא לְנֹכַח עֵינָיו וְלֹא יִמְרוֹד בּוֹ
for one whose spiritual perception is immense, what greatness is there in knowing his Master when He is directly before his eyes, not rebelling against Him?
וְעִיקַּר קִילּוּסוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וּכְבוֹד שָׁמַיִם מִתְרַבֶּה, כְּשֶׁמְּקוֹמוֹת הַיּוֹתֵר שְׁפָלִים וְיוֹתֵר תַּחְתּוֹנִים יַכִּירוּ גַּם כֵּן כֹּחַ מַלְכוּתוֹ
Rather, the primary praise of the Blessed Name and the glory of Heaven are magnified when the lowest and most fallen realms likewise recognize the power of His sovereignty;
וְעַל זֶה הָיָה תַּכְלִית הַבְּרִיאָה וְהִשְׁתַּלְשְׁלוּת הַנִּבְרָאִים עַד עוֹלָם הַזֶּה הַגּוּפָנִי הַזֶּה
and toward this end was the ultimate design of Creation and the cascading descent of worlds down unto this physical corporeal world;
וְהַרְבֵּה מַלְאָכִים וּשְׂרָפִים יֵשׁ שֶׁמַּכִּירִים גָּדְלוֹ
and there are myriads of angels and seraphim who perceive His greatness;
אֶלָּא שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ רוֹצֶה וּמִתְפָּאֵר בִּתְהִלַּת עַמּוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמַטָּה
but the Blessed Name desires and glories in the praise of His people Israel below;
וְכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁמְּשׁוּקָּעִים בְּגוּפָנִיּוּת יוֹתֵר, הַקִּילּוּס גָּדוֹל עוֹד יוֹתֵר:
and the deeper they are submerged in physical corporeality, the greater and more sublime is their praise!

9.h: The theme: The election of Yaakov's seed, the descent into the fiftieth gate of impurity in Egypt, and the breakthrough of simple faith (Emunah). Before Yaakov Avinu, only isolated individuals in each generation recognized the divine presence. With Yaakov—whose bed was unblemished—his entire seed was chosen, yet this election required testing in the crucible of Egypt, where Israel sank to the nadir of degradation ("a nation from the midst of another nation", Devarim 4:34). Moshe feared they would not believe him (Shemos 4:1) because they had reached the fiftieth gate of impurity (Sha'ar Ha-Nun), where a branch appears severed from its tree. The fiftieth gate mirrors the Jubilee year (Yovel): even the pierced Hebrew slave (eved nirtza) who refused to leave must go free against his will; so too, at Sinai Hashem suspended the mountain like a barrel (kafah aleihem har k'gigis, Shabbat 88a), demonstrating that Israel is eternally bound to Him. Hashem rebuked Moshe for doubting them: Israel are "believers, the children of believers" (Shabbat 97a), and in their deepest heart they never lost faith that "I am Hashem Who dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanness" (Vayikra 16:16). Recognizing that Hashem is with them even in the valley of the shadow of death (Tehillim 23:4; 139:8) allows the light to dawn from within the darkness, unlocking their speech to chant Hallel so powerfully that it pierced the roofs (hallel paka igara, Pesachim 85b).

p: וּבַתְּחִלָּה הָיוּ רַק אֲנָשִׁים מְיוּחָדִים בְּכָל דּוֹר בַּעֲלֵי הַשָּׂגָה שֶׁהִכִּירוּ אֱלָהוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, וַעֲלֵיהֶם הָיָה הָעוֹלָם עוֹמֵד
And initially there were only solitary, unique individuals in each generation endowed with spiritual perception who recognized His Godliness, blessed be He, upon whom the world stood;
עַד שֶׁבָּא יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, ״[כִּי] יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ״ (תְּהִלִּים קל״ה:ד׳), דְּכָל זַרְעוֹ נִבְחָרוּ

until Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, arrived, regarding whom it is said: "For the Lord has chosen Jacob unto Himself, and Israel for His peculiar treasure" (Tehillim 135:4), where all his seed was chosen;
אֶלָּא שֶׁעֲדַיִין הָיָה צָרִיךְ בְּחִירָה זוֹ לְבֵירוּרִים
except that this election still required spiritual purifications (beirurim);
וְעַל זֶה הָיָה גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם, שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּעְבְּדוּ בְּחֹמֶר וּלְבֵנִים וְכָל עֲבוֹדָה בְּתַכְלִית הַהִשְׁתַּקְּעוּת
and toward this end came the exile of Egypt, where they were subjugated in mortar and brick and all manner of labor in the ultimate depth of immersion;
עַד שֶׁנָּפְלוּ לְמָקוֹם שֶׁנָּפְלוּ כִּידוּעַ מִדִּבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״[לָקַחַת לוֹ] גּוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי״ (דְּבָרִים ד:לד)
until they fell into the depth wherein they fell, as known from the teachings of our Rabbis of blessed memory, and as written: "to take Him a nation from the midst of another nation" (Devarim 4:34);
וְאָז דַּיְיקָא רָאָה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁהִגִּיעַ עִתָּם ״עֵת דֹּדִים״ (יְחֶזְקֵאל ט״ז:ח׳), לְהִתְדַּבֵּק בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּתַכְלִית תֹּקֶף הָאַהֲבָה
and specifically then the Blessed Name saw that their time had arrived, "the time of love" (Yechezkel 16:8), to cleave unto the Blessed Name in the ultimate intensity of love;
וְהַבֵּירוּר הָיָה דְּמִיָּד בְּבוֹא מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, ״וַיַּאֲמֵן הָעָם״ (שְׁמוֹת ד:לא)
and the clarification was: immediately upon the arrival of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, "and the people believed" (Shemos 4:31).
וְיָדוּעַ דִּבְכָל מָקוֹם ״הָעָם״ מוֹרֶה עַל שִׁפְלוּת
And it is known that everywhere the term "the people" (ha-am) denotes lowliness;
וּבְסֵפֶר ״אוֹר זָרוּעַ״ (הִלְכוֹת קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע סִימָן ז׳) פֵּירֵשׁ ״עַם הָאָרֶץ״, מִלַּת ״עַם״ כְּמוֹ ״עֲמֵיָא״ בַּאֲרַמִּית, דְּרָצָה לוֹמַר כֵּהָיוֹן וְהֶעְדֵּר הָאוֹר
and in the book Or Zarua (Hilchot Keriat Shema §7) he explains that in am ha'aretz, the word am is like the Aramaic amya, meaning dimness and the absence of light;
וְעַל כֵּן מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם נִתְיָירֵא: ״הֵן לֹא יַאֲמִינוּ לִי״ (שְׁמוֹת ד:א)
and therefore Moshe Rabbeinu feared: "Behold, they will not believe me" (Shemos 4:1);
כִּי יָדַע מַצָּבָם אָז בְּתַכְלִית הַשִּׁפְלוּת שֶׁאֵין לְמַטָּה מִמֶּנּוּ
for he knew their spiritual condition was in the ultimate nadir below which there is nothing;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּזִיקּוּק לְטָהֳרָה ״מְזֻקָּק שִׁבְעָתָיִם״ (תְּהִלִּים י״ב:ז׳), הַיְינוּ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים שֶׁבַע דְּהוּא מ״ט
and just as there exists in refining for purity "refined sevenfold" (Tehillim 12:7), which is seven times seven, totaling forty-nine;
כָּךְ יֵשׁ בְּהֵיפֶךְ בְּזִיקּוּק לְטוּמְאָה וָרָע
so too does there exist in reverse in the sinking into impurity and evil [forty-nine gates of defilement];
וְשַׁעַר הַנּוּ״ן הוּא דּוּגְמַת שְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל, שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ עֲבָדִים יוֹצְאִים לְחֵירוּת
and the fiftieth gate (Sha'ar Ha-Nun) is comparable to the Jubilee year (Yovel), wherein even slaves go free to liberty (Vayikra 25:10);
וְהָעֶבֶד הוּא הַיּוֹתֵר שָׁפָל שֶׁבָּאוּמָּה
the slave being the lowliest member of the nation.
וְהַיּוֹתֵר שָׁפָל שֶׁבָּעֲבָדִים הוּא הַנִּרְצָע
And the lowliest of all slaves is the pierced slave (eved nirtza);
שֶׁאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהִגִּיעַ זְמַנּוֹ לָצֵאת לְחֵירוּת, אֵין רוֹצֶה לָצֵאת
who, even though his time has arrived to go out to freedom, refuses to leave (Shemos 21:5–6);
וְעִם כָּל זֶה בַּיּוֹבֵל גַּם הוּא יוֹצֵא בְּעַל כָּרְחוֹ (קִדּוּשִׁין כ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳)
and nevertheless in the Jubilee he too goes out against his will (Kiddushin 22b);
עַל דֶּרֶךְ לֶעָתִיד: ״[חַי אָנִי... אִם לֹא] בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה וּבְחֵמָה שְׁפוּכָה אֶמְלוֹךְ עֲלֵיכֶם״ (יְחֶזְקֵאל כ:לג)
after the manner of the Future: "As I live... surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out, will I be King over you" (Yechezkel 20:33);
וְאַף בִּשְׁעַת מַתַּן תּוֹרָה הָיָה כְּפִיַּית הַר כְּגִיגִית (שַׁבָּת פ״ח עַמּוּד א׳) בְּעַל כָּרְחָם לְעִנְיָן זֶה
and even at the Giving of the Torah there was the suspending of the mountain like a barrel (Shabbat 88a) against their will for this very reason:
לוֹמַר דִּמְשֻׁעְבָּדִים בְּעַל כָּרְחָם לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, וְשֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לָצֵאת כְּלָל מִשִּׁעְבּוּדוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ הַקּוֹדֵם
to proclaim that they are subjugated against their will unto the Blessed Name, and that it is impossible ever to break free from His primordial covenant;
וּבִשְׁנַת הַיּוֹבֵל הַזֹּאת יָשׁוּב אִישׁ לַאֲחֻזָּתוֹ (וַיִּקְרָא כ״ה:י״ג), לְשָׁרְשׁוֹ וּלִמְקוֹרוֹ
and in this Jubilee year "every man shall return unto his possession" (Vayikra 25:13), to his pristine root and source;
וּבַהַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ אֵין רָע כְּלָל
and within that divine root there is no evil whatsoever.
וְדָבָר זֶה הָיָה אַחַר מַתַּן תּוֹרָה, שֶׁכְּבָר נִקְנוּ לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְנִשְׁתַּעְבְּדוּ לוֹ בְּשִׁעְבּוּד גָּמוּר
And this immutable reality took effect after the Giving of the Torah, when they were acquired by the Blessed Name and bound to Him in absolute servitude;
וְהַקִּנְיָן הָיָה בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ע:ח): ״בְּיוֹקֶר הֵן עוֹמְדִין לִי, מִשְׁפָּחוֹת מִשְׁפָּחוֹת וְכוּלֵיהּ״
and the initial acquisition occurred at the Exodus, as the Sages stated (Bereishis Rabbah 70:8): "At great cost they stand unto Me, family by family, etc.";
וּבְמַתַּן תּוֹרָה נִגְמַר הַקִּנְיָן
and at the Giving of the Torah the acquisition was completed;
וּמִקּוֹדֶם זֶה, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁכְּבָר נִבְחַר יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, עַדַיִין לֹא נִתְבָּרַר הַקִּנְיָן הַגָּמוּר בְּכָל זַרְעוֹ אֲפִילּוּ שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיוּ בַּנִּגְלֶה כֵּן
whereas prior to this, although Yaakov Avinu had already been chosen, this unshakeable covenant had not yet been verified across all his seed even when outwardly degraded.
וְהַטּוּמְאָה בְּשַׁעַר הַחֲמִשִּׁים הַיְינוּ שֶׁלֹּא יוּכַל לַחֲזוֹר עוֹד לְשָׁרְשׁוֹ כְּעָנָף הַנִּכְרָת מִן הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ
And defilement in the fiftieth gate would signify that one could never return to his root, like a branch severed completely from the tree;
וּמִזֶּה פָּחַד מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, אוּלַי נִשְׁקְעוּ כָּל כָּךְ עַד שֶׁלֹּא יַאֲמִינוּ גַּם כֵּן
and of this Moshe Rabbeinu was afraid: lest they had sunk so deeply that they would no longer believe,
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁנֶּעֶקְרוּ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם מֵהַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ הַטּוֹב שֶׁבָּהֶם מוֹרָשָׁה מֵאָבוֹת לְגַמְרֵי
meaning that they were uprooted, God forbid, from the good ancestral root inherited from the Patriarchs entirely;
וְעַל זֶה חָרָה לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיַּחְשׁוֹד לְזֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל כֵּן
and concerning this the Blessed Name was angered that he should suspect the seed of Israel thus (Shemos 4:14; Shabbat 97a):
שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יַנִּיחֵם לְהִשְׁתַּקֵּעַ כָּל כָּךְ, וְהֵם חֶלְקוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ, מַאֲמִינִים בְּנֵי מַאֲמִינִים
that the Blessed Name would ever allow them to sink so far, they being His portion and heritage, believers the children of believers,
דְּבָזֶה אִי אֶפְשָׁר לָהֶם לְהִשְׁתַּקֵּעַ כָּל כָּךְ
for in faith it is impossible for them to ever sink completely;
וְהֲגַם דְּ״צוֹפֶה רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וּמְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ״ (תְּהִלִּים ל״ז:ל״ב) לְגַמְרֵי חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, ״ה׳ לֹא יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ״ (שָׁם:ל״ג)
and though "the wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him" (Tehillim 37:32) completely, God forbid, "Hashem will not leave him in his hand" (ibid. 37:33).
וְהֶרְאָה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ דַּאֲפִילּוּ שֶׁמְּשׁוּקָּעִים בַּחַשְׁכוּת כָּל כָּךְ, עִם כָּל זֶה לֹא אָבְדָה הָאֱמוּנָה וְנִכְרְתָה מִפִּיהֶם וְלִבָּם
And the Blessed Name demonstrated that even when submerged in such deep darkness, nevertheless faith was not lost nor severed from their mouth and heart;
וְעִיקַּר הָאֱמוּנָה הוּא לְהַאֲמִין זֶה: שֶׁאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא, עִם כָּל זֶה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עִמּוֹ
and the core of faith is to believe this: that even though a person is wherever he is, nevertheless the Blessed Name is with him,
כִּי ״אֲנִי ה׳ הַשֹּׁכֵן אִתָּם בְּתוֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָם״ (וַיִּקְרָא ט״ז:ט״ז)
for "I am Hashem Who dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanness" (Vayikra 16:16);
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה מִמֵּילָא יוּכַל לָצֵאת מֵהָאֲפֵילָה וְהַטּוּמְאָה
and through this he can automatically emerge from darkness and defilement;
דְּכֵיוָן שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עִמּוֹ אֵין רָע כְּלָל, רַק הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ רָצָה כֵּן שֶׁיִּהְיֶה בְּרֵישָׁא חֲשׁוֹכָא וַהֲדַר נְהוֹרָא (שַׁבָּת ע״ז עַמּוּד ב׳)
for since the Blessed Name is with him no true evil exists, the Blessed Name having willed merely that first come darkness and then light (Shabbat 77b);
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת... לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי״ (תְּהִלִּים כ״ג:ד׳)
and after the manner of: "Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me" (Tehillim 23:4);
גַּם שָׁם בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת, דְּאֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ וְאֶפֶס זוּלָתוֹ אֲפִילּוּ בִּשְׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּית
even there in the valley of the shadow of death, for there is none else beside Him even in the lowest pit of Sheol,
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״וְאַצִּיעָה שְּׁאוֹל — הִנֶּךָּ... גַּם שָׁם [יָדְךָ תַנְחֵנִי] וְתֹאחֲזֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ״ (תְּהִלִּים קל״ט:ח׳–י׳)
as it is written: "and if I make my bed in Sheol, behold, You are there... even there shall Your hand lead me, and Your right hand shall hold me" (Tehillim 139:8–10);
וּבָזֶה הוּא יָכוֹל לָשׁוּב לִמְקוֹרוֹ וְשָׁרְשׁוֹ וְלָצֵאת מִמַּעֲמַקֵּי שְׁאוֹל
and through this realization he is capable of returning to his source and root, emerging from the depths of Sheol;
וּכְמוֹ בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם, דְּמֵאֲפֵילָה זוֹ דַּיְיקָא יָצְאוּ לְאוֹר גָּדוֹל
and as occurred at the Exodus, where precisely out of that darkness they emerged into great light;
כִּי כָּךְ רָצָה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ: שֶׁיִּהְיֶה קִילּוּסוֹ עוֹלֶה גַּם מִמְּקוֹמוֹת הַיּוֹתֵר אֲפֵלִים וַחֲשׁוּכִים, וְעַד שֶׁגַּם הֵם יַשִּׂיגוּ אוֹר גָּדוֹל
for so the Blessed Name willed: that His praise ascend even from the darkest realms, until they too attain immense light.
וְאָז הָיָה בִּנְיַן הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לִהְיוֹת קוֹמָה שְׁלֵימָה בְּגִלּוּי שְׁכִינָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּחַדְרֵי לְבָבָם
And then was the building of Knesset Israel as a complete spiritual stature through the revelation of His Shechinah within the chambers of their hearts;
עַד שֶׁנִּפְתַּח פִּיהֶם לְהוֹדוֹת וּלְקַלֵּס לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ: ״כְּזֵיתָא פִּסְחָא וְהַלֵּילָא פָּקַע אִיגָּרָא״ (פְּסָחִים פ״ה עַמּוּד ב׳)
until their mouths opened to give thanks and praise unto the Blessed Name: "an olive's bulk of Passover offering was eaten and the Hallel pierced the roofs" (Pesachim 85b);
כִּי בְּגָלוּת מִצְרַיִם הָיָה הַדִּבּוּר בְּגָלוּת
for during the exile of Egypt speech was in exile;
הַיְינוּ הַדִּבּוּר שֶׁל אוּמָּה יִשְׂרְאֵלִית, שֶׁכָּל דִּבּוּרָם הוּא לְקַלֵּס לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יְדֵי שְׁכִינָה הַמְדַבֶּרֶת מִתּוֹךְ גְּרוֹנָם
that is, the speech of the Israelite nation, whose entire speech is to praise the Blessed Name through the Shechinah speaking from their throat;
כְּמָה שֶׁאוֹמְרִים קוֹדֶם הַתְּפִלָּה: ״אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד [תְּהִלָּתֶךָ]״ (תְּהִלִּים נ״א:י״ז):
as we recite before prayer: "O Lord, open my lips; and my mouth shall declare Your praise" (Tehillim 51:17).
The theme: The throat
simanim
, eating as a sacred offering, and the Hallel that pierces the roof
paka igara
. The Name of Adonut signifies Hashem's sovereign indwelling below, revealed through eating the Korban Pesach. The windpipe
kaneh
and esophagus
veshes
are adjacent organs forming the "signs"
simanim

of physical vitality: the windpipe breathes the spirit and articulates speech, while the esophagus ingests food. For an Israelite, physical vitality is sustained not by bread alone, but by "every word that proceeds out of the mouth of Hashem"
Devarim 8:3
. When food is consumed with pure intent for Heaven—sustaining the soul created by Hashem
Ta'anis 22b; Chullin 7a
—the table resembles the Altar
Chagigah 27a
, excelling an altar of physical stones. On weekdays food is sanctified by the blessing; on Shabbat and Yom Tov eating is an explicit mitzvah of delight
oneg
; and on Pesach night eating the Korban Pesach and Matzah is an absolute obligation where the physical substance itself is holy, mirroring the priests eating sacrificial offerings
Kohanim ochlim u-ve'alim miskaprim, Pesachim 59b
. Through this, the internal organs are sanctified like the Holy of Holies, the blood carries vitality to the heart, and the mouth bursts into Hallel that "pierces the roof"
paka igara
. The word "roof"
gag, ג-ג
represents arrogance and height, from which the name of Gog is derived; an ordinary roof does not elevate itself higher than its construction and lacks the letter Vav
the spirit of life
, whereas Gog inflates himself with the Vav (ג-ו-ג) to rise against Hashem and His anointed.
וְשֵׁם הָאַדְנוּת הוּא הַמּוֹרֶה אֲדוֹנוּתוֹ וּשְׁכִינָתוֹ בַּתַּחְתּוֹנִים
And the Name of Adonut indicates His sovereignty and the indwelling of His Shechinah within the lower realms;
וְאָז לֹא הָיָה נִגְלֶה זֶה עַדַיִין עַד יְצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם, וְעַל זֶה נִצְטַוּוּ בַּאֲכִילַת הַפֶּסַח
and this had not yet been revealed until the Exodus, wherefore they were commanded regarding the eating of the Passover offering.
כִּי הַקָּנֶה וָוֶשֶׁט סְמוּכִים זֶה לָזֶה
For the windpipe (kaneh) and the esophagus (veshes) are adjacent to one another;
זֶה מוֹצִיא דִּבּוּר וָקוֹל, וְזֶה מַכְנִיס מַאֲכָל, וְהֵם נִקְרָאִים ״סִימָנִים״ שֶׁבָּהֶם סִימַן הַחַיּוּת
the one produces speech and voice, while the other takes in food, being called the "signs" (simanim) in which resides the vital sign of life;
בַּקָּנֶה הוּא שׁוֹאֵף הַחַיּוּת בְּרוּחַ דְּלוּלֵי זֶה אֵין לוֹ חַיּוּת, וּבָאָדָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה יֵשׁ בּוֹ כֹּחַ הַדִּבּוּר לִהְיוֹת ״רוּחַ מְמַלְּלָא״
through the windpipe man inhales life-giving air without which he cannot live, and in man through this resides the power of speech to become "a speaking spirit";
וּבַאֲכִילָה דְּוֶשֶׁט הוּא קִיּוּם הַחַיּוּת
and in the eating of the esophagus is the physical preservation of vitality;
וְשׁוֹרֶשׁ הַחַיּוּת שֶׁל אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי תָּלוּי רַק בַּמַּה שֶּׁמַּכִּיר רִבּוֹנוֹ וְשֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שׁוֹכֵן בְּקִרְבּוֹ, וְ״אַתָּה מְחַיֶּה אֶת כֻּלָּם״ (נְחֶמְיָה ט:ו)
and the essential vitality of a Jew depends entirely upon recognizing his Master, knowing that the Blessed Name dwells within him and that "You preserve them all" (Nechemyah 9:6);
וְהַחַיּוּת שֶׁמְּקַבֵּל מֵאֲכִילָה הוּא גַּם כֵּן רַק מִמַּה שֶּׁרְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הָיָה שֶׁיֹּאכַל וִיקַבֵּל מִזֶּה חַיּוּת
and the vitality he receives from food derives solely from the fact that it was the will of the Blessed Name that he eat and receive sustenance from it;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״כִּי לֹא עַל הַלֶּחֶם לְבַדּוֹ [יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם]... כִּי עַל כָּל מוֹצָא פִי ה׳ [יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם]״ (דְּבָרִים ח:ג)
as it is written: "that man does not live by bread only... but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of Hashem does man live" (Devarim 8:3);
וְרָצָה לוֹמַר לֹא לֶחֶם לְבַד נִפְרָד מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, רַק בְּצֵירוּף הַמּוֹצָא פִי ה׳ עִם הַלֶּחֶם זֶה הוּא הַמְחַיֶּה
meaning not physical bread alone severed from the Blessed Name, but the divine utterance joined within the bread is that which gives life;
דְּלוּלֵי הַכָּרָה זוֹ אֵין נִקְרָא חַיּוּת אֵצֶל אִישׁ יִשְׂרְאֵלִי כְּלָל
for without this recognition it is not termed life in a Jew at all.
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נֶחְשָׁב הָאֲכִילָה כְּקָרְבָּן וְחָשׁוּב עוֹד יוֹתֵר
And through this, eating is accounted as a sacrifice and even more precious;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (מִדְרַשׁ לֶקַח טוֹב בְּרֵאשִׁית כ״ז:כ׳) עַל פָּסוּק ״כִּי הִקְרָה ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנָי״: אִם לְקָרְבָּנְךָ הִזְמִין, לְמַאֲכָלְךָ לֹא כָּל שֶׁכֵּן

as the Sages stated (Midrash Lekach Tov, Bereishis 27:20) on the verse "Because Hashem your God sent me good speed": if He provided for your sacrificial offering, how much more so for your daily food;
כִּי הַשֻּׁלְחָן דּוֹמֶה לַמִּזְבֵּחַ (חֲגִיגָה כ״ז עַמּוּד א׳)
for the dining table is compared to the Altar (Chagigah 27a);
וְכֵן אִיתָא (יוֹמָא ע״א עַמּוּד א׳): ״הַמְמַלֵּא גְּרוֹנָם שֶׁל תַּלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים יַיִן — כְּמַקְרִיב נְסָכִים״
and so is it taught (Yoma 71a): "Whoever fills the throat of Torah scholars with wine is as if he poured wine libations upon the altar";
כִּי הֵיכַל ה׳ וּמִזְבַּח ה׳ הֵמָּה, וַעֲדִיפֵי מִמִּזְבַּח אֲבָנִים הַגַּשְׁמִי
for their bodies are the Sanctuary of Hashem and the Altar of Hashem, surpassing an altar of physical stones.
וְאָמְנָם לָזֶה צָרִיךְ שְׁלֵימוּת הַכַּוָּונָה לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם, שֶׁלֹּא יֹאכַל לְתַאֲוָתוֹ
However, for this transformation one requires consummate intention for the sake of Heaven, not eating for hedonistic lust;
רַק לְפִי שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ קָבַע כֵּן בַּבְּרִיאָה דְּקִיּוּם חַיּוּת הוּא עַל יְדֵי מַאֲכָל עַל כֵּן זֶהוּ רְצוֹנוֹ
but because the Blessed Name established in Creation that physical life is sustained through food, wherefore eating to live is His divine will;
וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ פֶּרֶק קַמָּא דְּחֻלִּין (ז׳ עַמּוּד א׳): ״אֲנִי הוֹלֵךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹן קוֹנִי״ עַל הִלּוּךְ הַטִּבְעִי שֶׁל הַנָּהָר
after the manner related in Chullin (7a) regarding the river: "I am going to perform the will of my Maker" through its natural flow,
כֵּיוָן שֶׁקָּבַע הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הַטֶּבַע כָּךְ זֶה רְצוֹנוֹ
for since the Blessed Name fixed natural law thus, that natural function is His will;
וְאִיכָּא נַמֵּי מִצְוָה עַל זֶה: ״נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתִּי בְךָ — הַחֲיֶהָ״, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּתַעֲנִית (כ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳)
and there is likewise a mitzvah in this: "the soul which I placed within you—sustain it!", as written in Ta'anis (22b);
וְעַל זֶה תִּקְּנוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה הַבְּרָכָה לִפְנֵי כָּל אֲכִילָה, לְהַכִּיר שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הוּא שֶׁיָּצַר הַמַּאֲכָל לְהַחֲיוֹתוֹ
and toward this our Rabbis instituted the blessing prior to all eating, to acknowledge that the Blessed Name created the food to sustain him.
וְזֶהוּ אַף בְּחוֹל, וּמוֹסִיף עָלֶיהָ שַׁבָּת וְיוֹם טוֹב דְּהָאֲכִילָה מִצְוָה
And this applies even on weekdays, and is elevated on Shabbat and Yom Tov where eating itself is an explicit mitzvah;
דְּאָז אַף מַה שֶּׁאוֹכֵל מוֹתָרוֹת הַכֹּל הוֹלֵךְ לִקְדוּשָׁה כִּידוּעַ מֵהָאֲרִיזַ״ל, כֵּיוָן דְּהַכֹּל מִצְוָה כְּשֶׁמִּתְעַנֵּג מִזֶּה
for then even eating beyond strict necessity is consecrated to holiness as known from the Arizal, since physical delight itself is a mitzvah (oneg Shabbat);
וְעַדַיִין גַּם זֶה אֵינוֹ מִצְוָה גְּמוּרָה, שֶׁהֲרֵי מִי שֶׁהַתַּעֲנִית עוֹנֶג לוֹ רַשַּׁאי לְהִתְעַנּוֹת גַּם כֵּן
yet even this is not a consummate imperative, for one who finds delight in fasting is permitted to fast on Shabbat (Eruvin 41a),
וְגַם אֵין מְבָרְכִין עָלֶיהָ ״אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ״ וְגַם אֵין אוֹתוֹ מַאֲכָל פְּרָטִי מִצְוָה
nor do we recite the blessing "Who has sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us," nor is the specific item of food an intrinsic mitzvah;
מוֹסִיף עָלֶיהָ אֲכִילַת פֶּסַח וּמַצָּה וְכַיּוֹצֵא, שֶׁגּוּף אֲכִילַת אוֹתוֹ מַאֲכָל מִצְוָה גְּמוּרָה שֶׁאֵינוֹ רַשַּׁאי לְהִתְבַּטֵּל מִמֶּנָּה
elevated further by eating the Korban Pesach and Matzah, where eating that specific food is an absolute commandment from which one cannot abstain;
וּמְבָרְכִין עָלֶיהָ ״אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ״, דְּכוּלּוֹ קֹדֶשׁ מַמָּשׁ לַה׳
and we recite the formal blessing "Who has sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us," the food being literally holy unto Hashem;
וּכְאַכִילַת כֹּהֲנִים קָרְבָּנוֹת, דְּעַל יְדֵי זֶה בְּעָלִים מִתְכַּפְּרִים כְּמוֹ בְּגוּף הַהַקְרָבָה לַה׳ בִּזְרִיקַת דָּמִים וְהַקְטָרַת אֵימוּרִין
akin to the priests eating sacrificial meat, through which the owners achieve atonement just as through sprinkling the blood and burning the fats upon the altar (Pesachim 59b);
דְּכֹהֲנִים מִשֻּׁלְחַן גָּבוֹהַּ קָא זָכוּ, וְהֵם שְׁלוּחֵי דְּרַחֲמָנָא (קִדּוּשִׁין כ״ג עַמּוּד ב׳)
for the Kohanim merit from the table of the Most High, acting as the emissaries of the Merciful One (Kiddushin 23b);
וְכָךְ כָּל אֲכִילוֹת מִצְוָה
and such is the status of all commanded eating.
וּבָזֶה מִתְקַדְּשִׁים אֵבְרֵי הַוֶּשֶׁט וּקְרָבַיִם וּמֵעַיִם כִּקְדֻשַּׁת מִקְדָּשׁ וּמִזְבֵּחַ
And through this, the organs of the esophagus, viscera, and intestines are sanctified like the holiness of the Sanctuary and the Altar,
לִהְיוֹת מִשְׁכָּן לִקְדוּשָׁתוֹ וּשְׁכִינָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּקִרְבּוֹ
to become a dwelling for His holiness and His Shechinah within;
וְלִהְיוֹת הַמַּאֲכָל נוֹתֵן חַיּוּת וָדָם לַלֵּב, וּמִמֶּנּוּ מִתְפַּשֵּׁט הַחַיּוּת לְכָל אֵיבָרִים
the food providing pure blood and vitality to the heart, whence life spreads to all the limbs;
עַל יְדֵי זֶה מִתְקַדֵּשׁ הַלֵּב בִּקְדֻשַּׁת בֵּית קָדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּוהַר
whereby the heart is consecrated with the sanctity of the Holy of Holies as written in the Zohar;
וּמִתְפַּשֵּׁט הַקְּדוּשָׁה בְּכָל הַגּוּף עַד שֶׁמַּגִּיעַ לִכְלֵי הַדִּבּוּר, וְנִפְתָּח הַפֶּה לוֹמַר הַלֵּל שֶׁאוֹמְרִים חֶצְיוֹ אַחַר כָּךְ מִטַּעַם זֶה
and holiness spreads through the whole body until reaching the organs of speech, the mouth opening to chant Hallel, whose second half is recited after eating for this reason;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה ״פָּקַע אִיגָּרָא״, פֵּירוּשׁ שֶׁבּוֹקֵעַ וְעוֹלֶה עַד לָרָקִיעַ
and through this "it pierces the roof" (paka igara), meaning that the song cleaves through and ascends to the firmament,
וְהוּא כְּאִילּוּ נִפְקַע הַגַּג הַמַּפְסִיק וְחוֹצֵץ בֵּינוֹ לִרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם
as though the intervening roof dividing between him and the heavens were split open!
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁעִיקַּר הָעֲלִיָּה הוּא הַהַלֵּל, הוּא דַּיְיקָא עַל יְדֵי כְּזַיִת פֶּסַח הַקּוֹדֵם
And even though the essential ascent is achieved by the Hallel, it is powered specifically by the preceding olive's bulk of the Korban Pesach;
וַאֲפִילּוּ אוֹכֵל הַרְבֵּה, אוֹתוֹ כְּזַיִת שֶׁהוּא חוֹבָה הוּא הַנּוֹתֵן כֹּחַ בַּהֲלִילָא שֶׁיִּפְקַע אִיגָּרָא
and even if one eats much, that mandatory olive's bulk is what imparts strength to the Hallel to pierce the roof.
וְשָׁמַעְתִּי דְּמִלַּת ״גַּג״ הוֹרָאָתוֹ עַל הַגּוֹבַהּ וְהַגַּאֲוָה
And I heard that the word "roof" (gag,
ג-ג)
signifies height and arrogance;
[שֶׁעַל זֶה עִיקַּר הוֹרָאַת הַגִּימֶ״ל לְבַדָּהּ גַּם כֵּן, שֶׁמִּזֶּה נִבְנֶה מִלַּת ״גֵּאֶה״ וּמִלַּת ״גַּיְא״, כִּי כָּל דָּבָר מוֹרֶה עַל דָּבָר וְהֶפְכּוֹ בְּכָל שָׁרְשֵׁי לְשׁוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ]
[the single letter Gimmel itself denoting both extremes, whence are formed the word ge'eh (proud) and gai (valley), for every Hebrew root denotes an entity and its opposite];
דְּעַל שֵׁם זֶה נִקְרָא ״גּוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַמָּגוֹג״ (יְחֶזְקֵאל ל״ח:ב׳) עַל שֵׁם גַּאֲוָתוֹ
wherefore "Gog, king of Magog" (Yechezkel 38:2) is named after his haughtiness;
וְהַגַּג דְּאֵין מַגְבִּיהַּ עַצְמוֹ יוֹתֵר מִמַּה שֶּׁהוּא וּמִמַּה שֶּׁעֲשָׂאוּהוּ, לֹא בָּא בוֹ הַוָּי״ו [שֶׁהוּא אוֹת הַמּוֹרֶה עַל רוּחַ הַחַיִּים]
and an architectural roof (gag), which does not raise itself higher than its construction, lacks the letter Vav [the letter signifying the spirit of life];
הָרוֹמֵז עַל הַבָּא לְהִתְגָּאוֹת יוֹתֵר מִמַּה שֶּׁהוּא, וְעַל כֵּן חָפֵץ לָקוּם עַל ה׳ וְעַל מְשִׁיחוֹ
while Gog adds the letter Vav
hinting to one who inflates himself with life-force beyond his stature, rising against Hashem and His anointed;
כָּךְ שָׁמַעְתִּי:
thus did I hear.
The theme: Arrogance as the root of cosmic evil, holy pride versus unholy pride, and piercing the roof
peki'at igara
. Arrogance
ga'avah
is the primordial root of all cosmic evil, originating from the shattering of the primordial kings
melachin kadma'in d'mitu, Zohar I, 24b
where each declared "I shall reign"
ana emloch

. The entire creation began through the arousal of Malchus, for "there is no king without a nation." Planted within man, this drive forms the root of the yetzer tov: desiring to cleave unto Hashem, imitate His ways
Shabbat 133b
, and be called by His Name
Bava Batra 75b
. This is "pride in a mitzvah": "conduct your presidency with haughty dignity"
Kesubos 103b
and "his heart was lifted up in the ways of Hashem"
II Divrei HaYamim 17:6
. Without holy pride, a person falls into spiritual despair
"By slothfulness the rafters sink in", Koheles 10:18
, imagining his deeds are worthless. To counter this, one must know he is an actual portion of Hashem from Above, declaring: "When will my deeds reach the deeds of my fathers?"
Tanna D'vei Eliyahu Rabbah, ch. 25
. Conversely, the yetzer hara perverts this into unholy pride: "you shall be as gods"
Bereishis 3:5
, seeking independence from the Creator. Piercing the roof
peki'at igara

is the nullification of this unholy pride, which forms the dividing wall between Israel and Hashem. For Israel, evil is merely an external husk around the fruit; unlike the nations whose corruption begins in pride, Israel’s stumbling begins in lust, which subsequently drags them into pride. While an ordinary roof is raised only as high as man builds it, Gog possesses an innate Vav (ג-ו-ג) of essential haughtiness extending from beginning to end; his war will erupt at the End of Days, when Israel achieves the final purification of pride through Mashiach.
וְיָדוּעַ דְּגַאֲוָה הוּא הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ שֶׁל כָּל מִינֵי רָע, שֶׁנִּצְמַח מִמְּלָכִין קַדְמָאִין דְּמִיתוּ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד אָמַר: ״אֲנָא אֶמְלוֹךְ״, כַּנּוֹדָע (זֹוהַר חֵלֶק א׳ כ״ד עַמּוּד ב׳)
And it is known that arrogance is the root of all manners of evil, which sprouted from the primordial kings who died because each of them declared: "I shall reign," as is known (Zohar I, 24b);
וְהַיְינוּ דְּכָל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת הַבְּרִיאָה הָיָה עַל יְדֵי הִתְעוֹרְרוּת מִדַּת הַמַּלְכוּת, דְּ״אֵין מֶלֶךְ בְּלֹא עָם״, וְרָצָה שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מְצִיאוּת מַלְכוּת
meaning that the entire arousal of Creation occurred through arousing the attribute of Malchus, for "there is no king without a nation," Hashem willing that sovereignty exist;
וּמִזֶּה נִשְׁתַּלְשֵׁל כָּל הָאֲצִילוּת וְעַד בְּרִיאַת אָדָם ״בְּצַלְמֵנוּ כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית א:כו), נִטְבַּע גַּם בּוֹ רָצוֹן זֶה
and from this cascaded the entire Atzilus down unto the creation of man "in our image, after our likeness," this sovereign drive being embedded within him as well;

שֶׁמִּזֶּה הוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַיֵּצֶר טוֹב, שֶׁהוּא לִדָּבֵק בַּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְלָלֶכֶת בִּדְרָכָיו: ״מַה הוּא [רַחוּם — אַף אַתָּה הֱיֵה רַחוּם] וְכוּלֵיהּ״ (שַׁבָּת קל״ג עַמּוּד ב׳), לִהְיוֹת כָּמוֹהוּ
whence derives the root of the yetzer tov: to cleave unto the Blessed Name and walk in His pathways: "as He is merciful, so be you merciful, etc." (Shabbat 133b), to resemble Him;
וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא ע״ה עַמּוּד ב׳): ״עֲתִידִים צַדִּיקִים שֶׁיִּקָּרְאוּ בִּשְׁמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא״
and as the Sages stated (Bava Batra 75b): "In the Future the righteous will be called by the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He";
וּמַה הוּא מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים וּפוֹקֵד עֲקָרוֹת וּשְׁאָר דְּבָרִים, אַף הַצַּדִּיקִים כֵּן
and just as He revives the dead and remembers the barren, so do the righteous (Bereishis Rabbah 77:1).
וְזֶהוּ הַגַּאֲוָה שֶׁל מִצְוָה, שֶׁאָמַר רַבִּי לִבְנוֹ (כְּתוּבּוֹת ק״ג עַמּוּד ב׳): ״נְהוֹג נְשִׂיאוּתְךָ בְּרָמִים״
And this is the holy pride of a mitzvah, where Rebbe commanded his son: "conduct your presidency with haughty dignity" (Kesubos 103b);
דְּזֶהוּ תוֹעֶלֶת לַעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בִּיהוֹשָׁפָט: ״וַיִּגְבַּהּ לִבּוֹ בְּדַרְכֵי ה׳״ (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים ב י״ז:ו׳)
this serving divine worship, after the manner stated of Yehoshaphat: "And his heart was lifted up in the ways of Hashem" (II Divrei HaYamim 17:6);
דִּ״בִשְׁפַלְתַּיִם יִמַּךְ הַמְּקָרֶה״ (קֹהֶלֶת י:יח), שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שִׁפְלוּתוֹ יַחְשׁוֹב שֶׁאֵין כָּל מַעֲשָׂיו כְּלוּם וְשֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לוֹ לְהַגִּיעַ לְשׁוּם מַעֲלָה וּמַדְרֵגָה
for "by slothfulness the rafters sink in" (Koheles 10:18): through unholy lowliness a person may assume his deeds are worthless and that he can never attain spiritual heights,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִתְעַצֵּל בְּמַעֲשֶׂה וְהִשְׁתַּדְּלוּת, וְעַד שֶׁיִּהְיֶה כְּלַל הַבַּיִת מָלֵא דֶּלֶף טוֹרֵד
lapsing into lethargy until his entire house is filled with a continuous dropping;
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלֹּא יִגְבַּר עָלָיו יֵצֶר הָרָע לְשַׁקְּעוֹ בְּרָע גָּמוּר, עַל כָּל פָּנִים לֹא יַנִּיחַ לוֹ שׁוּם דָּבָר טוֹב בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ
for even if the yetzer does not submerge him in actual sin, it deprives his mind of every noble aspiration;
וְעַל כֵּן צָרִיךְ לָזֶה גַּבְהוּת הַלֵּב, שֶׁיֵּדַע שֶׁהוּא חֵלֶק אֱלוֹהַּ מִמַּעַל וְשֶׁיּוּכַל לִהְיוֹת בְּתַכְלִית הַשְּׁלֵימוּת וְהַמַּעֲלָה
wherefore one requires holy loftiness of heart, knowing he is an actual portion of God from Above, capable of reaching the ultimate perfection;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּתַנָּא דְּבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה (פָּרָשָׁה כ״ה:א׳): ״חַיָּיב כָּל אָדָם לוֹמַר: מָתַי יַגִּיעוּ מַעֲשַׂי לְמַעֲשֵׂה אֲבוֹתַי אַבְרָהָם, יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב״
as written in Tanna D'vei Eliyahu Rabbah (ch. 25): "Every man is obligated to say: When will my deeds reach the deeds of my fathers, Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov?";
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לֶעָתִיד: ״הַנִּכְשָׁל בָּהֶם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה כְדָוִיד״ (זְכַרְיָה י״ב:ח׳)
and as it will be in the Future: "he that stumbles among them at that day shall be as David" (Zechariah 12:8);
וְזֶהוּ כָּל עִיקַּר כֹּחַ הַיֵּצֶר טוֹב: לַהֲסִיתוֹ לְהַשִּׂיג הַמַּעֲלָה הַגְּדוֹלָה וּלְדַמּוֹת לְקוֹנוֹ
and this is the core power of the yetzer tov: stirring man to attain the greatest heights and resemble his Maker.
וְעִיקַּר הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע הוּא גַּם כֵּן לַהֲסִית עַל זֶה: ״וִהְיִיתֶם כֵּאלֹהִים [יֹדְעֵי טוֹב וָרָע]״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג:ה)
And the primary incitement of the yetzer hara likewise mimics this: "and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil" (Bereishis 3:5);
מַה הוּא בּוֹרֵא עוֹלָמוֹת [אַף אַתֶּם בּוֹרְאִין עוֹלָמוֹת] (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה י״ט:ד׳)
"just as He creates worlds, so will you create worlds" (Bereishis Rabbah 19:4);
אֲבָל מִצַּד הָרָע וְהַפֵּירוּד, שֶׁיּוּכַל לִהְיוֹת מֵעַצְמוֹ כֵּאלֹהִים וּכְנֶגְדּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ
but from the vantage of evil and separation: that he can exist autonomously like God, an independent sovereign opposite Him;
וְזֶהוּ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַגַּאֲוָה הָרָע: שֶׁלֹּא לְהִתְבַּטֵּל מִמִּי שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לְהִתְבַּטֵּל, וְלַחְפּוֹץ לַעֲלוֹת לְמַעְלָה מִמַּדְרֵיגָתוֹ וְהָרָאוּי לוֹ
and this is the root of corrupt arrogance: refusing to nullify oneself before the Creator, seeking to ascend beyond his designated boundary;
וּבָזֶה הוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַסָּתַת הַיֵּצֶר וְהַנָּחָשׁ הַקַּדְמוֹנִי, וְהוּא הַהַתְחָלָה לְכָל מִינֵי רָע
and herein lies the instigation of the yetzer and the Ancient Serpent, the inception of all evil.
וְיֵשׁ לוֹמַר דְּזֶהוּ פְּקִיעַת אִיגָּרָא, הַיְינוּ בִּיטּוּל שׁוֹרֶשׁ הָרָע דְּגַאֲוָה
And one can say that this is the piercing of the roof (peki'at igara): the nullification of the evil root of arrogance;
שֶׁזֶּהוּ הַמְּחִיצָה שֶׁבֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לַאֲבִיהֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם
which is the very partition dividing between Israel and their Father in Heaven;
וְאֵצֶל נַפְשׁוֹת דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין בָּהֶם שׁוּם רַע בְּעֶצֶם
and within the souls of Israel no evil exists intrinsically;
רַק הַכֹּל מִצַּד הַקְּלִיפָּה הַסּוֹבֶבֶת לַפְּרִי וְהַחוֹחִים הַסּוֹבְבִים לַשּׁוֹשַׁנָּה עֶלְיוֹנָה שֶׁהִיא כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
but all derives from the husk encircling the fruit and the thorns surrounding the supernal rose which is Knesset Israel;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמָּשְׁלוּ בְּסַנְהֶדְרִין (מ״ד עַמּוּד א׳) לְהוֹצֵי דִּסְבִיב הָאָסָא
as they compared in Sanhedrin (44a) to the thorns encircling the myrtle;
וְשׁוֹרֶשׁ הָרָע דְּגַאֲוָה גַּם כֵּן אֵינוֹ בָּהֶם בְּעַצְמוּתָם, רַק מִצַּד הַמַּקִּיפִים, וְזֶהוּ הָאִיגָּרָא הַמַּקִּיף
and the evil root of arrogance likewise does not touch their essence, but merely encases them as an external surrounding, this being the roof (igara) that encloses;
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהַגַּג אֵין מַגְבִּיהַּ עַצְמוֹ יוֹתֵר מִמַּה שֶּׁהוּא, מִכָּל מָקוֹם הָאָדָם עוֹשֵׂהוּ בְּגוֹבַהּ כַּמָּה שֶׁיִּרְצֶה
and although a roof does not raise itself higher than its construction, man can construct it as high as he pleases;
וְאֵצֶל יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁשָּׁרְשָׁם מִמְּקוֹם הַקְּדוּשָׁה, עִיקַּר הַגַּאֲוָה שֶׁלָּהֶם הוּא מִצַּד הַקְּדוּשָׁה
and with Israel whose root derives from holiness, their primary pride stems from holiness;
וְהַסָּתַת הַיֵּצֶר לָהֶם בָּא מִצַּד הַתַּאֲוָה, דְּדָבָר זֶה הָיָה בְּשׁוֹרֶשׁ הַתְחָלַת הַסָּתַת הַמֵּסִית הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּפֹעַל בַּאֲכִילַת עֵץ הַדַּעַת
while the yetzer's temptation assaults them through physical lust, which was the active inception of the primeval serpent's seduction in eating from the Tree of Knowledge;
וּמַה שֶּׁיָּצָא לְפֹעַל יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ הַהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת לִיכָּנֵס גַּם אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ דְּנַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל
and that which materialized in action possesses the capacity to spread even into the holiness of the souls of Israel,
מִצַּד הַהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת דְּ״סָבִיב רְשָׁעִים יִתְהַלָּכוּן״ (תְּהִלִּים י״ב:ט׳)
through the expansion of "the wicked walk on every side" (Tehillim 12:9);
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ שֶׁבַּכֹּחַ שֶׁהֵבִיא אֶל הַפּוֹעַל בְּהַסָּתַת ״וִהְיִיתֶם כֵּאלֹהִים״, שֶׁהוּא יִצְרָא דַּעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה
unlike the potential root which brought forth the temptation of "you shall be as gods"—which is the yetzer of idolatry;
לֹא יָצָא אֶל הַפֹּעַל בְּאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת, רַק בְּאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם מִזַּרְעוֹ אַחַר כָּךְ
which did not materialize into deed within Adam HaRishon (the root of all souls), but only among the pagan nations born of his seed afterward.

וְעַל כֵּן אַף שֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ כְּשֶׁיָּצָא לְפֹעַל בְּאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם נִתְפַּשֵּׁט גַּם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, מִכָּל מָקוֹם אִיתָא (סַנְהֶדְרִין ס״ג עַמּוּד ב׳): ״לֹא עָבְדוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה אֶלָּא כְּדֵי לְהַתִּיר לָהֶם עֲרָיוֹת [בְּפַרְהֶסְיָא]״
Wherefore even when it later expanded from the nations into Israel, the Talmud affirms (Sanhedrin 63b): "Israel served idols only in order to permit themselves public sexual immorality";
דְּאֶצְלָם לֹא מָצָא יֵצֶר זֶה הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת גָּמוּר בְּקֶרֶב לִבָּם מִצַּד עַצְמוֹ, רַק מִצַּד הַהַסָּתָה לְתַאֲווֹת בָּאוּ לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה
for within Israel the inclination for idolatry never found a foothold on its own, but was embraced solely as an excuse to indulge physical lusts;
וְעַד דִּלְבָתַר דַּאֲבִיקוּ בַּהּ, אָז הוּא שֶׁנִּכְנַס גַּם יֵצֶר זֶה בְּקֶרֶב לִבָּם מַמָּשׁ
and only after they became habituated to it did that foreign drive penetrate their hearts;
וְכָךְ הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת הַגַּאֲוָה שֶׁהוּא הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ דְּיִצְרָא דַּעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הוּא שֶׁבָּא יֵצֶר הַתַּאֲוָה דַּעֲרָיוֹת
and so too with arrogance, which is the root of idolatry whence issues sexual lust:
וְאֵצֶל אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם הַהַתְחָלָה הוּא מִלְּמַעְלָה לְמַטָּה, מֵאַחַר דְּשָׁרְשָׁם בָּרָע
among the nations the descent begins from Above to below (arrogance leading to lust), their root being in evil;
אֵצֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא לְהֵיפֶךְ, וְעַל יְדֵי הַתַּאֲוָה בָּאִים לְגַאֲוָה
while among Israel it is the reverse: through physical desire they fall into arrogance;
כְּשֶׁנִּכְנַס בּוֹ הַחֶמְדָּה לְתַאֲווֹת עוֹלָם הַזֶּה, הוּא חוֹמֵד גַּם לְהִתְנַשְּׂאוּת וְהִתְגָּאוּת שֶׁגַּם זֶה מִכְּלַל תַּאֲווֹת עוֹלָם הַזֶּה
for when craving for worldly lusts enters, one craves self-aggrandizement which is part of physical desire.
וְעַל כֵּן נִמְשַׁל אֶצְלָם הַגַּאֲוָה לְגַג, שֶׁהוּא נַעֲשָׂה גָּבוֹהַּ עַל יְדֵי פְּעֻלַּת אָדָם הַמַּגְבִּיהוֹ אַחַר שֶׁנִּבְנָה בִּנְיָן
Wherefore in Israel arrogance is compared to an architectural roof (gag), which is raised high through human labor only after the house is built;
וְכָךְ הַגַּאֲוָה דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא עַל יְדֵי פְּעֻלַּת הַהַגְבָּהָה שֶׁהַיֵּצֶר מַגְבִּיהוֹ אַחַר שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה אִישׁ וּבַעַל הַבַּיִת בְּכֹחוֹת גּוּפוֹ וְלִבָּבוֹ
this pride being elevated by the yetzer only after it has established itself as an owner within the body;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן גּוֹג עִם וָי״ו [ג-ו-ג], דְּמוֹרֶה עַל עַצְמוּתוֹ, מִצַּד עַצְמוֹ הוּא כֵּן כּוּלּוֹ מִשָּׁרְשׁוֹ עַד קְצֵהוּ מַבְרִיחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה
unlike Gog spelled with the letter Vav
which indicates that his very essence from head to toe is intrinsically haughty;
וּמִלְחַמְתּוֹ יִהְיֶה בְּעֵת קֵץ
and the war against Gog will erupt at the End of Days;
דְּנִיצּוּחַ כָּל אוּמָּה הוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהַנְּפָשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזְדַּכְּכִים בְּדָבָר זֶה שֶׁבּוֹ כֹּחַ אוֹתָהּ אוּמָּה מִצַּד הָרָע הַמַּקִּיף לַטּוֹב
for the triumph over any nation is accomplished when the souls of Israel are purified of that specific trait which animates that nation;
וּבָזֶה הֵם נוֹצְחִים לְבַטֵּל אוֹתוֹ הָרָע הַמַּקִּיפָם כַּאֲשֶׁר ״יֵצֵא כַנֹּגַהּ צִדְקָם״ (יְשַׁעְיָה ס״ב:א׳) בְּאוֹתוֹ פְּרָט, נָקִי מִכָּל סִיג וּפְסֹולֶת וְתַעֲרוֹבֶת רָע
nullifying the surrounding evil when their righteousness shines forth like radiant light, purged of all dross;
וְכָךְ הֵם הוֹלְכִים וּמִתְבָּרְרִים עַד עֵת קֵץ, שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ הַבֵּירוּר לְהַתְחָלַת הָרָע בְּשָׁרְשׁוֹ שֶׁהוּא בְּגַאֲוָה, וְאָז יִתְעוֹרֵר גּוֹג
and thus Israel proceeds in purifications until the End of Days, when the purification reaches the primal inception of evil in arrogance, at which point Gog will be aroused;
שֶׁעַדַיִין לֹא נִתְבָּרְרוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּזֶה עַד אָז, דְּיִתְבָּרְרוּ עַל יְדֵי מָשִׁיחַ גַּם בָּזֶה:
for until then Israel will not have been completely clarified in this primal trait, to be finally refined through Mashiach in this domain as well!

9.h: The theme: The slaying of Mashiach ben Yosef, the mutual accusations of Yosef and his brethren, and the descent into Egypt as the purification of desire. Mashiach ben Yosef will be slain in the end-time battle against Gog (Sukkah 52b) because within Yosef lay a subtle root of pride, sensed by his brothers when they asked: "Shall you indeed reign over us?" (Bereishis 37:8). This subtle root later branched into the blatant idolatry of his royal descendants Jeroboam and Ahab, who married off Israel to the Baalim (Bereishis Rabbah 84:10). This flaw gives Gog temporary power over Mashiach ben Yosef, whereas Mashiach ben David triumphs over Gog because David embodies consummate humility, remaining "small" (ha-katan, I Shmuel 17:14) even upon the throne. Through David, death is swallowed up forever (Yeshayah 25:8) and Mashiach ben Yosef is revived, clarifying that Yosef's pride was directed solely against the heathen nations (Egypt). The sale of Yosef precipitated the Egyptian exile: pagan nations cannot burn the Torah or defile the Temple until Israel does so first through internal strife; when the brothers accused Yosef of pride and he accused them of carnal lust, their mutual recriminations provoked a prosecution on High. Accusations rebound upon the accuser (as when Yeshayahu declared "I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips" and his mouth was seared with a burning coal, Yeshayahu 6:5–6; Tanchuma, Vayishlach 2). To break Yosef's perceived pride, they sold him into slavery; yet slavery is the archetype of sexual license (Kiddushin 22b; Pesachim 113b). Because Israel's essential purification must proceed from bottom to top—from bodily lust to intellectual pride—Israel was exiled into the depravity of Egypt, where they guarded the covenant of circumcision and achieved the first stage of national purification.

p: וּמָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף יֵהָרֵג (סֻכָּה נ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳), כִּי בְּיוֹסֵף הָיָה קְצָת שׁוֹרֶשׁ מִזֶּה
And Mashiach ben Yosef will be slain (Sukkah 52b), because within Yosef lay a slight root of this subtle arrogance;
מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ לוֹ אֶחָיו: ״הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ [עָלֵינוּ אִם מָשׁוֹל תִּמְשֹׁל בָּנוּ] וְגוֹמֵר״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל״ז:ח׳)
of which his brothers challenged him: "Shall you indeed reign over us? or shall you indeed have dominion over us?" (Bereishis 37:8);
וּמִזֶּה בָּא יִצְרָא דַּעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה בְּזַרְעוֹ יָרָבְעָם וְאַחְאָב
and from this issued the inclination for idolatry in his royal seed, Jeroboam and Ahab;

דְּאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה פ״ד:י׳) עַל פָּסוּק: ״[וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל אָחִיו] הִנֵּה בַּעַל הַחֲלֹמוֹת [הַלָּזֶה בָּא]״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל״ז:י״ט): זַרְעוֹ שֶׁל זֶה עָתִיד לְהַשִּׂיא לַבְּעָלִים
as the Sages of blessed memory stated (Bereishis Rabbah 84:10) on the verse: "Behold, this dreamer comes": the seed of this one is destined to marry off Israel to the Baalim;
שֶׁהִרְגִּישׁוּ הַשְּׁבָטִים גַּם זֶה עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהִרְגִּישׁוּ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַהִתְנַשְּׂאוּת בּוֹ
the tribes sensing this future idolatry because they perceived the subtle root of self-exaltation within him;
וּמִצַּד הַזֶּה גַּם כֵּן יִהְיֶה שְׁלִיטָה לְגוֹג עַל מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף
and from this aspect Gog will have temporary dominion over Mashiach ben Yosef.
אֲבָל מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד יְנַצְּחֶנּוּ, כִּי דָּוִד הוּא הַקָּטָן שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ שׁוּם הִתְנַשְּׂאוּת כְּלָל גַּם בְּמַלְכוּתוֹ
But Mashiach ben David will vanquish him, because David is "the small one" (I Shmuel 17:14), possessing no haughtiness whatsoever even in his royal monarchy.
וְאָז יִהְיֶה שְׁלֵימוּת הַבֵּירוּר וְהַתִּיקּוּן לְחֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן
And then will be the consummate purification and rectification of the sin of Adam HaRishon;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה ״חַיִּים שָׁאַל מִמְּךָ — נָתַתָּה לּוֹ״ (תְּהִלִּים כ״א:ה׳), וּ״בֻלַּע הַמָּוֶת לָנֶצַח״ (יְשַׁעְיָה כ״ה:ח׳)
and through this: "He asked life of You, You gave it to him" (Tehillim 21:5), and "He will swallow up death forever" (Yeshayah 25:8);
וְיִחְיֶה גַּם מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף
and Mashiach ben Yosef will likewise be revived;
כִּי יְבוֹרַר דְּגַם בּוֹ לֹא הָיָה הִתְנַשְּׂאוּת וְגַאֲוָה דְּרָע כְּלָל
for it will be clarified that within him, too, there was no evil arrogance at all,
וְלֹא נִתְגַּלָּה אֶלָּא נֶגֶד אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם וּמִי שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לְהִתְגָּאוֹת נֶגְדָּם
and it manifested solely against the nations of the world and those against whom it is necessary to exercise holy pride;
וּכְמוֹ דְּמַלְכוּת יוֹסֵף הָיָה עַל מִצְרַיִם וְאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, וְנֶגְדָּם מוּתָּר שֶׁיִּתְגָּאֶה
just as the reign of Yosef was over Egypt and the nations, against whom it is permitted to display majesty;
וְהֵם חָשְׁבוּ שֶׁרוֹצֶה לִמְלוֹךְ וּלְהִתְנַשֵּׂאת גַּם עֲלֵיהֶם
whereas the brothers assumed he sought to reign and exalt himself over them as well.
וּמְכִירַת יוֹסֵף הָיָה הַסִּבָּה לְגָלוּת מִצְרַיִם שֶׁהוּא רֵאשִׁית הַגָּלֻיּוֹת
And the selling of Yosef was the catalyst for the Egyptian exile which was the first of all the exiles,
שֶׁהֵם לְבָרֵר אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִטַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ פְּסֹולֶת
which purpose is to refine Israel and demonstrate that Yaakov Avinu's bed is free of all dross;
וְיָדוּעַ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה: מֵעוֹלָם לֹא שָׂרְפוּ אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם הַתּוֹרָה עַד שֶׁהֵם שָׂרְפוּ תְּחִלָּה, וְלֹא טִמְּאוּ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ עַד שֶׁהֵם טִמְּאוּ תְּחִלָּה
and it is known what the Sages stated: never did the nations burn the Torah until Israel burned it first, nor did they defile the Temple until Israel defiled it first;
וְכֵן כָּל קִטְרוּג הוּא בָּא עַל יְדֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַצְמָם, דְּלוּלָא כֵן אֵין פֶּה לַמְקַטְרֵג לְקַטְרֵג
and likewise every prosecution Above is triggered by the Children of Israel themselves, for otherwise the accuser has no mouth to prosecute;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם מִינַּיְיהוּ וּבֵינַיְיהוּ אָזְלִין וְאָמְרִין
as written: the nations hear the accusations circulating among Israel and repeat them,
וּכְמַלְכוּתָא דְּאַרְעָא כֵּן מַלְכוּתָא דִּרְקִיעָא (בְּרָכוֹת נ״ח עַמּוּד א׳)
and as is earthly kingship, so is heavenly kingship (Berachos 58a).
וְעַל יְדֵי שֶׁהַשְּׁבָטִים הִתְחִילוּ לְקַטְרֵג עַל יוֹסֵף בְּגַאֲוָה, וְהוּא הֵבִיא דִּבָּתָם רָעָה בַּעֲרָיוֹת וְתַאֲווֹת
And because the tribes began by accusing Yosef of arrogance, while he brought their evil report regarding sexual immorality and lust;
וְהֵם עַצְמָם כָּל אֶחָד חָשַׁב עַל חֲבֵירוֹ שֶׁיֵּשׁ פְּסֹולֶת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בְּזֶרַע יַעֲקֹב
and each brother suspected his fellow of containing spiritual dross, God forbid, within the seed of Yaakov;
עַל יְדֵי זֶה גָּרְמוּ קִטְרוּג לְמַעְלָה לְהַצְרִיךְ בֵּירוּרִין עַל זֶה
through this they provoked an accusation on High, necessitating spiritual purifications;
וְהַתְחָלַת הַבֵּירוּרִין דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא בַּתַּאֲווֹת שֶׁבָּזֶה הוּא הַתְחָלַת הַהַסָּתָה בְּזֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל
and the inception of Israel's purification begins in physical lusts, where temptation first enters the seed of Israel;
וְעַל כֵּן גָּלוּ לְמִצְרַיִם עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ, מְקוֹם תֹּקֶף הַזִּמָּה, ״כְּמַעֲשֵׂה אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם [אֲשֶׁר יְשַׁבְתֶּם בָּהּ לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ]״ (וַיִּקְרָא י״ח:ג׳)
wherefore they were exiled to Egypt, the nakedness of the land, the epicenter of depravity: "after the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein you dwelt, shall you not do" (Vayikra 18:3).
וְהֵם גָּדְרוּ עַצְמָן מִן הָעֲרָיוֹת, דִּבִזְכוּת זֶה נִגְאָלוּ
And they fenced themselves against sexual immorality, in which merit they were redeemed (Vayikra Rabbah 32:5);
כְּשֶׁנִּתְבָּרְרוּ בָּזֶה דְּעִם כָּל תֹּקֶף הִשְׁתַּקְּעוּתָם בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּתַכְלִית הַחַשְׁכוּת, לֹא פָּרְצוּ גֶּדֶר עֶרְוָה וְתַאֲוָה
having proven that despite the intensity of their immersion in Egypt in absolute darkness, they never breached the fence of sexual purity;
וְאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה דְּהָיָה עַל יְדֵי יוֹסֵף שֶׁגָּדַר מִן הָעֶרְוָה, וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִגְדְּרוּ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרָיו
and the Sages stated that this occurred through Yosef who first guarded the covenant, through which all Israel were subsequently fenced (Vayikra Rabbah 32:5);
כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹמָה אַחַת וְגוֹי אֶחָד
for in truth all Israel constitute a single stature and one nation;
וּלְעָתִיד כְּשֶׁיְּבוֹרַר נְקִיּוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִגַּאֲוָה עַל יְדֵי מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד, יִחְיֶה גַּם מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף דַּהֲרֵי גַּם הוּא מִכְּלַל הַקּוֹמָה
and in the Future when the purity of Israel from arrogance is clarified through Mashiach ben David, Mashiach ben Yosef will likewise live, being an integral part of that collective stature;
וְכֵן בְּמִצְרַיִם כְּשֶׁנִּגְדַּר הוּא מֵעֶרְוָה, נִגְדְּרוּ גַּם הֵם
and so in Egypt, when he fenced himself against immorality, they too were fenced.
וְהַתְחָלַת הַגָּלוּת הִתְחִיל בּוֹ דַּיְיקָא דִּ״לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף״ (תְּהִלִּים ק״ה:י״ז)
And the beginning of exile struck him specifically, where "Yosef was sold for a servant" (Tehillim 105:17);
אַף שֶׁעִיקָּרוֹ בָּא לְבֵירוּר הַתַּאֲווֹת וְהוּא הָיָה נָקִי בָּזֶה יוֹתֵר מֵהֶם וְהֵבִיא דִּבָּתָם
even though the exile was to refine lust and he was cleaner in this than they, having reported on them;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם כָּל קִטְרוּג מְמַהֵר לָבוֹא עַל הַמְקַטְרֵג עַצְמוֹ
nevertheless every accusation swiftly rebounds upon the accuser himself;
שֶׁהֲרֵי גַּם עַל עַצְמוֹ הוּא מְקַטְרֵג, דְּגַם הוּא מִכְּלַל קוֹמַת הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
for he is accusing his own body, he too being part of the single stature of Knesset Israel;

וְעַל כֵּן אִיתָא (מִדְרַשׁ תַּנְחוּמָא וַיִּשְׁלַח ב׳) בִּישַׁעְיָהוּ שֶׁאָמַר ״[כִּי אִישׁ טְמֵא שְׂפָתַיִם אָנֹכִי] וּבְתוֹךְ עַם טְמֵא שְׂפָתַיִם [אָנֹכִי יוֹשֵׁב]״ (יְשַׁעְיָה ו:ה), דִּבְיָדוֹ ״רִצְפָּה״ (שָׁם:ו׳) — רְצוֹץ פֶּה דְּדֵין

wherefore it is taught (Tanchuma, Vayishlach 2) regarding Yeshayahu who said "in the midst of a people of unclean lips I dwell" (Yeshayah 6:5), that the angel carried a ritzpah (glowing coal), expounded: shatter the mouth (retzotz peh) of this prosecutor;
וְהוּא עַצְמוֹ בְּרוּחַ ה׳ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בּוֹ הִקְדִּים לוֹמַר עַל עַצְמוֹ: ״אִישׁ טְמֵא שְׂפָתַיִם אָנֹכִי״
and Yeshayahu himself, by the spirit of Hashem that spoke through him, had preceded to proclaim upon himself: "I am a man of unclean lips";
הַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי זֶה עַצְמוֹ שֶׁקִּטְרֵג עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם טְמֵא שְׂפָתַיִם
meaning through the very act of accusing Israel of being unclean of lips;
דְּזוּלַת זֶה וַדַּאי הָיָה טְהוֹר שְׂפָתַיִם
for otherwise he was certainly pure of lips;
אֲבָל כֵּיוָן שֶׁבָּא לְקַטְרֵג בָּזֶה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, קִטְרֵג גַּם עַל עַצְמוֹ, וְדִבּוּר זֶה עַצְמוֹ הוּא טֻמְאַת שְׂפָתַיִם שֶׁלּוֹ, וְהִתְחִיל הָעֹונֶשׁ בּוֹ בִּרְצִיצַת פֶּה
but once he accused Israel, he incriminated himself, and that very speech became his own uncleanness of lips, the retribution beginning with his mouth;
וְכָךְ הָיָה בְּיוֹסֵף וְאֶחָיו שֶׁמְּכָרוּהוּ, דְּפֹעַל הַטְּעָנָה עָלָיו בָּא עַל יְדֵי קִטְרוּגָם
and so it was with Yosef and his brothers who sold him: the active charge materialized through their accusations.

וְעַל כֵּן נֶאֱמַר לֶעָתִיד: ״וְהִבִּיטוּ אֵלַי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דָּקָרוּ״ (זְכַרְיָה י״ב:י׳), וְדָרְשׁוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּ״הֶחָלִיל״ (סֻכָּה נ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳): עַל מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף שֶׁיֵּהָרֵג, וּכְאִלּוּ הֵם דְּקָרוּהוּ

And therefore it is said of the Future: "and they shall look unto Me whom they have pierced" (Zechariah 12:10), which the Sages expounded in tractate Sukkah (52b) regarding Mashiach ben Yosef who will be slain, as if they pierced him;
כִּי עַל יְדֵי קִטְרוּג אֲחֵי יוֹסֵף בָּא זֶה, שֶׁהֵם חֲשָׁבוּהוּ לִפְסֹולֶת מִזֶּרַע יַעֲקֹב כְּמוֹ שֶׁיָּצָא מֵאַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק
for through the accusation of Yosef's brothers this death was wrought, they having judged him as dross from Yaakov's seed like the dross that issued from Avraham and Yitzchak;
וְצוּרָתוֹ שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב חֲקוּקָה בְּכִסֵּא הַכָּבוֹד בִּדְמוּת אָדָם שֶׁעַל הַכִּסֵּא, שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ ״בְּצַלְמֵנוּ כִּדְמוּתֵנוּ״
and the visage of Yaakov is engraved upon the Throne of Glory in the form of Man upon the Throne, which is the root of "in our image, after our likeness";
וְחָשְׁבוּ שֶׁמִּזֶּה יָצָא הַפְּסֹולֶת שֶׁל גַּאֲוָה דְּ״וִהְיִיתֶם כֵּאלֹהִים״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג:ה)
and they presumed that from this issued the dross of pride: "and you shall be as gods" (Bereishis 3:5);
וְעַל כֵּן מְכָרוּהוּ לְעֶבֶד שֶׁזֶּהוּ תַּכְלִית הַשִּׁפְלוּת, דְּאִם אֵין שָׁרְשׁוֹ כָּךְ, חָשְׁבוּ דְּעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִשְׁפַּל גַּאֲוָתוֹ
wherefore they sold him as a slave which is the absolute nadir of lowliness, assuming that if his root was not incurably proud, through slavery his pride would be broken.
וּבֶאֱמֶת הָעַבְדוּת הָיָה לָהֶם לְבָרֵר מִתַּאֲוָה, דְּעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיוּ גַּם כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדִים בְּמִצְרַיִם
Yet in truth, slavery was destined for them to refine them from carnal lust, wherefore all Israel became slaves in Egypt;
דַּעֲבָדִים פְּרוּצִים בַּעֲרָיוֹת, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּפֶרֶק שְׁלֹשָׁה שֶׁאָכְלוּ (בְּרָכוֹת מ״ה עַמּוּד ב׳): ״אֵין עוֹשִׂין חֲבוּרָה נָשִׁים וַעֲבָדִים מִשּׁוּם פְּרִיצוּתָא״
for slaves are naturally steeped in sexual promiscuity, as written in Berachos (45b): "Women and slaves may not form a company together for the meal because of promiscuity";
וּבְפֶרֶק עַרְבֵי פְסָחִים (פְּסָחִים קי״ג עַמּוּד ב׳): ״דְּצִוָּה כְּנַעַן לְבָנָיו: אֶהֱבוּ אֶת הַזִּמָּה״
and in Pesachim (113b): "Canaan commanded his sons: Love licentiousness";
וּבְגִיטִּין (י״ג עַמּוּד א׳): ״בְּשִׁפְחָה — זִילָא לֵיהּ, שְׁכִיחָא לֵיהּ, פְּרִיצָא לֵיהּ״
and in Gittin (13a): "a maidservant is degraded to him, accessible, and promiscuous";
כִּי מִצַּד הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת כָּל מִינֵי רָע בִּפְרָטִיּוּתָן, הַתַּאֲוָה הוּא הֵיפֶךְ מִגַּאֲוָה, שֶׁהוּא מְזַלְזֵל עַצְמוֹ עַל יְדֵי זֶה
for in the detailed manifestation of evil, lust is the opposite of pride, because man degrades himself through lust;
וְעַל יְדֵי שִׁפְלוּת רָעָה מִתְפָּרֵץ יוֹתֵר בַּתַּאֲווֹת, אֶלָּא שֶׁבְּשָׁרְשָׁן הַכֹּל אֶחָד
and through unholy degradation one breaches even further into lust, although in their metaphysical root they are one.
וְהֵם שֶׁטָּעֲנוּ עָלָיו שׁוֹרֶשׁ הָרָע דְּגַאֲוָה, מִמֵּילָא יֵשׁ בּוֹ קִטְרוּג גַּם עַל הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת רָע דְּתַאֲווֹת גַּם כֵּן
And they, having accused him of the root of arrogance, automatically invoked an accusation upon the expansion of lust as well;
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם לֹא הָיָה צָרִיךְ בֵּירוּרִים לְדַעְתָּם אֶלָּא בְּגַאֲוָה
nevertheless according to their view purifications were necessary only in arrogance;
אַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת הוּא יְחִידִי וְהֵם עִיקַּר הַכְּנֵסִיָּה, וְהָיוּ צְרִיכִים אָז בֵּירוּרִים עַל הָעִיקָּר
yet in truth he was an individual while they formed the core assembly, and purification was needed for the collective;
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן הַהַתְחָלָה מִמַּטָּה לְמַעְלָה
and purification proceeds from the bottom up [from lust to pride];
וְהָיָה גַּם הוּא צָרִיךְ לְהִתְבָּרֵר בִּפְרָט דִּבָּתוֹ עַל עִיקַּר הַכְּנֵסִיָּה בְּתַאֲוָה, דְּגַם זֶה נִכְלַל גַּם כֵּן בְּקִטְרוּגָם:
and Yosef too needed to be purified regarding his report accusing the holy assembly of lust, which was included in their mutual recrimination.

9.h: The theme: The Exodus as the purification of lust, the roasted meat of kings, and the ten plagues rectifying the stature of evil. The Exodus marks the beginning of Israel's purification from physical lust—the root of Adam's sin which culminated in the physical eating of the forbidden fruit. Hence, their first commandment was an eating mitzvah: eating meat, "meat of desire" (b'sar ta'avah), the peak of human craving ("there is no rejoicing except with meat", Pesachim 109a). Eating roasted meat (tzali) is the banquet of kings (Chullin 132b), which for Israel was transformed into a mitzvah. The ten plagues in Egypt were ten purifications, proving that Israel was clean of the full stature of evil. The structure of evil begins at the top with pride (its crown) and terminates at the bottom with lust (the feminine / nukva).
