וְרַק דּוֹרְשֵׁי רְשׁוּמוֹת הֵם הִשִּׂיגוּ גַּם רְשִׁימוּ זֶה
and only the dorshei reshumot [literally: expounders of impressions/traces] perceived this subtle reshimu;
וְסוֹף סוֹף יֵשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, וְכוּלָּם דְּבֵקִים בַּה׳ אֱלֹהֵיהֶם לִהְיוֹת ״חַיִּים כֻּלְּכֶם הַיּוֹם״ (דְּבָרִים ד:ד)
and ultimately they have a portion in the World to Come, all being cleaved unto Hashem their God to be "alive every one of you this day" (Devarim 4:4).
וְהוּא הַדְּבֵיקוּת דְּעוֹלַם הָעֲשִׂיָּה בַּאֲצִילוּת בְּסוֹד ״נָעוּץ סוֹפָן בִּתְחִלָּתָן״ (סֵפֶר יְצִירָה א:ז)
And this is the ultimate cleaving of the world of Asiyah unto Atzilus, in the mystery of "their end is wedged in their beginning" (Sefer Yetzirah 1:7);
שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה כְּשֶׁיְּחַדֵּשׁ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עוֹלָמוֹ, וְיִתְהַפֵּךְ הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה לְעוֹלָם הַבָּא
which will be unveiled when the Holy One renews His cosmos, and this earthly world is transformed into the World to Come;
וְכָל הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה הֲכָנָה לוֹ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּאָבוֹת (ד:טז) ״כִּפְרוֹזְדוֹר״, וּכְעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת שֶׁלִּפְנֵי הַשַּׁבָּת (עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה ג׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
this world being merely a preparation for it, like an antechamber (prozdor, Avos 4:16) and like the eve of Shabbat before Shabbat (Avodah Zarah 3a).
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם מִצַּד הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה שֶׁהוּא עָלְמָא דְּשִׁקְרָא וְרוּבּוֹ רַע בְּפֹעַל, נִקְרָא ״סִפְרָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים״
And nevertheless from the perspective of this world, which is a world of falsehood where evil predominates in outward deed, it is termed "the book of the wicked";

[וּפֵירוּשׁ ״נִכְתָּבִין וְכוּלֵיהּ״ עַל מַעֲשֵׂה הָרִשְׁעוּת, וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ הָאֲרִיזַ״ל עַל מַאֲמָרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה ״מַעֲשָׂיו נִפְטָרִין לְפָנָיו״ כְּפִי גִּירְסָא הַיְשָׁנָה בְּתַעֲנִית י״א עַמּוּד א׳

[and the meaning of their being inscribed in this book refers to the physical deeds of wickedness, after the manner the Arizal interpreted the statement: "his deeds are dismissed (niftarin) before him" according to the ancient reading in Ta'anis (11a);

לֹא כְּהַגָּהַת מַהֲרִ״י בֵּירַב שָׁם ״נִפְרָטִין״ עַיֵּין שָׁם, וְלֹא רָאָה דִּבְרֵי הָאֲרִ״י בְּלִקּוּטֵי שַׁ״ס עַיֵּין שָׁם דִּמְפָרֵשׁ נוֹ״י, וּדְבָרָיו בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ שֶׁאֵין לְהַרְהֵר אַחֲרָיו]
not like the emendation of Mahari Beirav who emended it to "itemized" (nifratin), he not having seen the words of the Ari in Likkutei Shas, whose words are in the Holy Spirit without question];
וְהַיְינוּ רִשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
and this book of the wicked refers exclusively to the sinners of Israel!
דְּרִשְׁעֵי עוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אֵין לָהֶם שׁוּם סֵפֶר וַחֲקִיקָה בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּלָל
For the wicked of the heathen nations have no book or engraving in His divine thought whatsoever;
רַק פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁעֲתִידִין שֶׁיִּקָּרְאוּ ״חֲסִידִים״, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּאַלְפָא בֵּיתָא דְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא עַל פָּסוּק ״וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ״ (תְּהִלִּים קל״ב:ט׳)

but only the transgressors of Israel, who are destined to be called Chassidim [pious ones], as written in the Aleph-Beis of Rabbi Akiva on the verse "and let Your pious ones shout for joy" (Tehillim 132:9);
שֶׁהוּא לְמַעְלָה מִצַּדִּיקִים, וְהַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה, דִּ״בִמְקוֹם שֶׁבַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה עוֹמְדִין [אֵין צַדִּיקִים גְּמוּרִים יְכוֹלִין לַעֲמוֹד]״ (בְּרָכוֹת ל״ד עַמּוּד ב׳):
which is exalted even above tzaddikim, achieved through repentance, for "in the place where penitents stand, even wholly righteous men cannot stand" (Berachos 34b)!

11.h: The theme: The superiority of Israel over the angels, the mystery of the "Book of the Wicked" (Sifran shel Resha'im), and the sixty myriads of letters in Thought, Speech, and Script. The entire superiority of Israel over the ministering angels lies in the fact that Israel possesses a yetzer hara and struggles with sin, yet climbs and ascends from within the pitch darkness, Hashem being an illumination unto them ("though I sit in darkness, Hashem is a light unto me", Michah 7:8); the angels, residing in pure celestial light, present no novelty in seeing and reflecting light. Therefore, the "Book of the Wicked"—though outwardly the lowest—embodies "he who is small is great" (man d'ihu ze'eir ihu rav, Zohar I, 122b), being rooted in the highest realm of divine Thought (Machshavah), the primordial root of the souls of Israel where no defect can touch. The three books opened on Rosh Hashanah parallel the three worlds: Yetzirah (the world of angels formed from divine speech) is the Book of Speech (Sefer ha-Dibur), the Book of the Intermediates (Beinonim); Beriah (the Throne of Glory whence the Neshamah is hewn) is the Written Torah (Sefer ha-Kotev), the Book of the Righteous (Tzaddikim); and Asiyah (where the bodily deed reveals the depth of Thought) holds the sixty myriads of concealed letters of Thought (Otiyot ha-Machshavah / Chayah and Yechidah). In the Future, when it is revealed that "all our works You have wrought for us" (Yeshayah 26:12), it will be clarified that even the sins of Israel were ordered from the six days of Creation (Shabbat 89b), turning their transgressions white as snow and earning them the title of Chassidim acting for the sake of Heaven (es la'asos la-Hashem hefeiru Toratecha, Tehillim 119:126).

p: וְכָל מַעֲלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל הַמַּלְאָכִים הוּא רַק מִצַּד שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם יֵצֶר הָרָע וּמְלֵאֵי עָוֹן
And the entire superiority of Israel over the ministering angels is solely on account of their possessing an evil inclination and being full of iniquity;
וְעִם כָּל זֶה גַּם בְּתוֹךְ הַחֹשֶׁךְ ״ה׳ אוֹר לָהֶם״ (מִיכָה ז:ח), וּמְטַפְּסִים וְעוֹלִים בַּחֹשֶׁךְ
yet despite this, even within the darkness "Hashem is a light unto them" (Michah 7:8), and they climb and ascend from within the darkness;
זֶהוּ רְבוּתָא, וּמַה שֶּׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מִתְאַוֶּוה לָהֶם
this is the supreme greatness, and that which the Blessed Name passionately desires of them;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן הַמַּלְאָכִים שֶׁהֵם בִּמְקוֹם הָאוֹרָה, מַה רְבוּתָא שֶׁרוֹאִים וְשֶׁמֵּאִיר לָהֶם
unlike the angels who dwell in the realm of celestial radiance: what greatness is there in their seeing and having light shine upon them?

וְעַל כֵּן ״סִפְרָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים״ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ט״ז עַמּוּד ב׳) שֶׁהוּא הַיּוֹתֵר גָּרוּעַ, ״מַאן דְּאִיהוּ זְעֵיר — אִיהוּ רַב״ (זֹוהַר חֵלֶק א׳ קכ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳), וְהוּא בֶּאֱמֶת הַיּוֹתֵר גָּדוֹל
Wherefore the "Book of the Wicked" (Rosh Hashanah 16b), which is outwardly the most degraded, embodies "he who is small is great" (Zohar I, 122b), being in inner truth the most exalted of all;
אֶלָּא שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה הוּא בְּהֶעְלֵם עַצְמוּת הַסֵּפֶר דְּמַחֲשָׁבָה
except that in this world the essence of this "book of Thought" remains in profound concealment;
וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הִבְטִיחַ ״כִּי לֹא יִדַּח מִמֶּנּוּ נִדָּח״ (שְׁמוּאֵל ב י״ד:י״ד)
and the Blessed Name promised that "no outcast shall be expelled from Him" (II Shmuel 14:14);
וְהַעֲלָאָתָם הוּא בְּהַגָּעָה לִמְקוֹרָם וְשָׁרְשָׁם בַּמַּחֲשָׁבָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה, שֶׁהוּא מָקוֹם הַיּוֹתֵר עֶלְיוֹן שֶׁל שׁוֹרֶשׁ נִשְׁמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל
and their ultimate elevation is achieved through arriving at their source and root in the Supernal Thought, which is the most supreme dimension of the soul-root of Israel;
כִּי לְמַטָּה כְּבָר קִלְקְלוּ, וְצָרִיךְ לְהַעֲלוֹתָם לַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ הָעֶלְיוֹן שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְקַלְקְלוֹ
for below in action they have already corrupted their ways, requiring that they be elevated to the supernal root which can never be corrupted;
וְזֶהוּ נְעִיצַת הַסּוֹף דַּיְיקָא בַּהַתְחָלָה (סֵפֶר יְצִירָה א:ז)
and this is specifically the wedging of the end into the beginning (Sefer Yetzirah 1:7).
וְעוֹלַם הַיְצִירָה שֶׁהוּא עוֹלַם הַמַּלְאָכִים שֶׁנִּבְרְאוּ מִדִּבּוּרוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ
And the world of Yetzirah, which is the realm of the angels created from His divine speech,
כִּרְמוּז בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּפָרָשַׁת חֵלֶק (סַנְהֶדְרִין ק״ה עַמּוּד ב׳) עַל פָּסוּק ״וַיָּשֶׂם ה׳ דָּבָר בְּפִי בִלְעָם״ (בַּמִּדְבָּר כ״ג:ה׳): מַלְאָךְ
as alluded to by the Sages in Perek Chelek (Sanhedrin 105b) on the verse "And Hashem put a word in Balaam's mouth" (Bamidbar 23:5): an angel;
הוּא ״סֵפֶר הַדִּבּוּר״, וְהֵם שׁוֹמְעִים קוֹל דְּבָרוֹ (תְּהִלִּים ק״ג:כ׳)
is the "book of Speech," the angels listening to the voice of His word (Tehillim 103:20);
וְשָׁם הַטּוֹב וָרָע שָׁוֶה כַּנּוֹדָע, וְזֶהוּ ״סִפְרָן שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים״
and therein good and evil stand equally balanced as is known, this being the "Book of the Intermediates" (Beinonim).
וְ״סִפְרָן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים״ שׁוֹמְרֵי תּוֹרַת ה׳, הוּא הַסֵּפֶר תּוֹרָה דִּכְתִיבָא וּמַנָּחָא לְכָל הַדּוֹרוֹת, לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת
And the "Book of the Righteous" who guard the Torah of Hashem is the Sefer Torah written and laid open for all generations, to perform all the words of this law (Devarim 28:58);
כִּידוּעַ דְּשִׁשִּׁים רִיבּוֹא אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה נֶגֶד שִׁשִּׁים רִיבּוֹא נְשָׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהֵם עַצְמָן אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה
as is known that the 600,000 letters of the Torah correspond to the 600,000 root souls of Israel, they themselves being the letters of the Torah;
וְיָדוּעַ דְּיֵשׁ שָׁלֹשׁ מַדְרֵיגוֹת: נֶפֶשׁ, רוּחַ, נְשָׁמָה
and it is known that there are three primary soul-levels: Nefesh, Ruach, and Neshamah:
״נַפְשִׁין״ מֵעֲשִׂיָּה, וְשָׁם הַחֵטְא גּוֹרֵם הַמְיוּחָס לְחֵלֶק הַנֶּפֶשׁ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא״ (וַיִּקְרָא ד:ב)
Nefashot derive from Asiyah, where sin takes effect attributed to the faculty of Nefesh, as it is said: "If a soul (nefesh) shall sin" (Vayikra 4:2);
״וְרוּחִין״ מִיצִירָה, הוּא ״רוּחַ מְמַלְּלָא״ וְכֹחַ בַּדִּבּוּר
and Ruchot derive from Yetzirah, which is the "speaking spirit" and the power within speech;
״וְנִשְׁמָתִין״ אִתְגְּזָרוּ מִכּוּרְסְיָא עוֹלַם הַבְּרִיאָה, הוּא חֶלְקָן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים
and Nishmatin are hewn from the Throne of Glory in the world of Beriah, being the portion of the righteous;
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי — טְהוֹרָה הִיא״ (בְּרָכוֹת ס׳ עַמּוּד ב׳)
as written: "The soul (neshamah) which You have placed within me is pure" (Berachos 60b);
וְשָׁם הוּא הָאוֹר הַגָּנוּז לַצַּדִּיקִים לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא, דְּאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (חֲגִיגָה י״ב עַמּוּד א׳): הֵיכָן גְּנָזוֹ? בַּתּוֹרָה
and therein resides the primordial light hidden for the righteous in the Future, of which the Sages asked: Where did He conceal it? In the Torah;
הַיְינוּ בַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וּבָאוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁבִּכְתָב שֶׁבָּהֶם רֵאשִׁית הִשְׁתַּלְשְׁלוּת הַגִּלּוּי מֵאוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
meaning in the Written Torah and its graphic letters wherein begins the manifest descent from the letters of Thought.
וּבְהִתְגַּלּוּת זֶה אֵין צָרִיךְ לְנוֹכַח, וְהוּא בְּעוֹלַם הַבְּרִיאָה שֶׁהוּא הַתְחָלַת עָלְמִין דְּפֵירוּדִין שֶׁהֵם הֶעְלֵם הַנֹּוכַח
And in this written revelation one does not require direct face-to-face address, existing within the world of Beriah which is the inception of separated worlds wherein direct presence is concealed;
שֶׁהִיא נִמְשָׁךְ מֵהֵ״א רִאשׁוֹנָה דְּהַשֵּׁם שֶׁהִיא אִימָּא עִילָּאָה
being drawn from the first letter Hei of the Name Havayah which is the Supernal Mother (Binah);
דְּהַכָּרַת הַנֹּוכַח שָׁם לְהַשִּׂיג הַיּוּ״ד שֶׁהוּא חָכְמָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב נוֹבְלוֹת הֵימֶנָּה, וְזֶה נֶעְלָם שָׁם
for the direct perception of the Yud [Chochmah Ila'ah] from which the Written Torah is an outflowing fruit is concealed there;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בִּיצִירָה שֶׁהוּא נֶגֶד וָי״ו דְּהַשֵּׁם, סוֹד ״אַתָּה״, ״בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה׳״ כַּנּוֹדָע
unlike in Yetzirah which corresponds to the letter Vav of the Name, the mystery of Attah [You]: "Blessed are You, Hashem," as is known;
דְּשָׁם הַכָּרַת הַנֹּוכַח, אַף דְּהוּא מַדְרֵגָה קְטַנָּה, הַהַכָּרָה בּוֹ מִמַּדְרֵגָה קְטַנָּה וְאֶפְשָׁר לְהַשִּׂיג
for there resides the perception of direct presence, and even though it is a lower rung, perception is attainable;
וְעַל כֵּן שַׁיָּיךְ בּוֹ שְׁמִיעָה, אֲבָל אֵינוֹ אֶלָּא לְמִי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵעַ
wherefore hearing applies to it, yet it reaches only one who hears;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן הָרְאִיָּה הוּא לְכָל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם, וּכְשֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל צַדִּיקִים הוּא נִיכָּר לַכֹּל גַּם לְאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם
whereas sight is visible to all who enter the world, so that when Israel are righteous it is visible to all, even to the nations:
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְרָאוּ כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי שֵׁם ה׳ נִקְרָא עָלֶיךָ [וְיָרְאוּ מִמֶּךָּ]״ (דְּבָרִים כ״ח:י׳)
as it is said: "And all the peoples of the earth shall see that the Name of Hashem is called upon you; and they shall be afraid of you" (Devarim 28:10);
וְזֶהוּ מִצַּד אֲחִיזָתָם בְּשִׁשִּׁים רִיבּוֹא אוֹתִיּוֹת הַכְּתָב דְּתוֹרָה
this deriving from their hold within the 600,000 written letters of the Torah.
וְהָאֲחִיזָה בְּשִׁשִּׁים רִיבּוֹא אוֹתִיּוֹת הַדִּבּוּר, הוּא הָאֲחִיזָה דְּכָל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל בַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And the hold within the 600,000 letters of Speech is the attachment of all the souls of Israel unto the Oral Torah;
וְנִרְאֶה לִי דְּהַמִּשְׁנָיוֹת שֶׁהֵם יְסוֹד תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה וּכְלָלוּתָהּ, יֵשׁ לְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲחִיזָה בְּאוֹתִיּוֹתֵיהֶם כְּמוֹ בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה
and it appears to me that in the Mishnayot, which are the foundation and totality of the Oral Torah, all Israel possess an attachment in their letters just as in the letters of the Torah;
וְשִׁשִּׁים רִיבּוֹא אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה הֵם נֶעְלָמִים בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
and the 600,000 letters of Thought remain concealed in this world;
כִּי אֲחִיזַת נַפְשׁוֹת דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בָּהֶם הוּא מִצַּד שָׁרְשָׁם הַנֶּעְלָם, שֶׁהוּא סוֹד חַיָּה וִיחִידָה
for the attachment of the souls of Israel to them derives from their transcendent root, which is the mystery of Chayah and Yechidah;
שֶׁהֵם נֶגֶד שְׁתֵּי הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת שֶׁבַּמּוֹחַ וָלֵב, וְהֵם עוֹמְדִים רַק בְּסוֹד מַקִּיפִים כַּנּוֹדָע
which correspond to the two thoughts within the brain and the heart, standing strictly in the mystery of surrounding lights (orot makifim);
כִּי אֵין לָהֶם הִתְלַבְּשׁוּת בְּעֶצֶם נֶפֶשׁ הָאָדָם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה כְּלָל
having no direct enclothment within the conscious soul of man in this world at all;
אֲבָל יֵשׁ לָהֶם הֶיכֵּר מִצַּד הַמַּעֲשִׂים וְהַפְּעֻלּוֹת, שֶׁהוּא בְּכֹחַ הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁהִיא מַדְרֵגָה אַחֲרוֹנָה
yet they leave an impression through physical deeds and actions, which operate through the faculty of Nefesh, the final rung.
וּלְעָתִיד שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה זֶה דְּ״כָל מַעֲשֵׂינוּ פָּעַלְתָּ לָּנוּ״ (יְשַׁעְיָה כ״ו:י״ב), שֶׁכָּל פְּעֻלַּת הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַכֹּל מֵהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
And in the Future when it will be revealed that "all our works You have wrought for us" (Yeshayah 26:12), showing that all actions of the soul derived from the Blessed Name;
וְאַף הַפְּעֻלּוֹת הַיּוֹצְאוֹת מִסֵּדֶר הַתּוֹרָה הֵם ״כִּבְשֵׁי דְּרַחֲמָנָא״ (בְּרָכוֹת י׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
and even those anomalous actions that departed from the normative order of the Torah were the "secrets of the Merciful One" (Berachos 10a);
וְנִמְשָׁכִים מֵאֲמִיתַּת מַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל דֶּרֶךְ: ״עֵת לַעֲשׂוֹת לַה׳ — הֵפֵרוּ תּוֹרָתֶךָ״ (תְּהִלִּים קי״ט:קכו; בְּרָכוֹת ס״ג עַמּוּד א׳)
drawn from the absolute truth of His divine Thought after the manner of: "It is time to act for Hashem; they have made void Your Torah" (Tehillim 119:126; Berachos 63a);
זֶהוּ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּפֶרֶק רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא (שַׁבָּת פ״ט עַמּוּד ב׳): ״אִם יִהְיוּ חֲטָאֵיכֶם כַּשָּׁנִים — הַלָּלוּ שֶׁסְּדוּרוֹת וּבָאוֹת מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְּרֵאשִׁית״

this is what is written in Perek Rabbi Akiva (Shabbat 89b): "'though your sins be as scarlet (kashanim)'—these are like the cosmic years (kashanim) that have been ordered and advancing since the six days of Creation";
הַיְינוּ שֶׁכָּךְ הָיוּ מְסוּדָּרִים בְּרֵאשִׁית הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה דִּבְרִיאַת עוֹלָם שֶׁהָיָה בְּשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְּרֵאשִׁית
meaning that thus they were preordained in the primordial Thought of Creation during the six days of Genesis;
וּכְשֶׁיִּתְבָּרֵר זֶה שֶׁיִּתְגַּלּוּ אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
and when this is clarified through the unveiling of the letters of Thought;
אָז ״כַּשֶּׁלֶג יַלְבִּינוּ״ (יְשַׁעְיָה א:יח) כָּל חֲטָאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּנִּזְכָּר
then "they shall be as white as snow" (Yeshayah 1:18), all the sins of Israel being clarified as mentioned;
דְּיִהְיוּ נִקְרָאִים ״חֲסִידִים״, שֶׁכָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם בִּיצִיאָה מִדִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה הוּא כְּחָסִיד הָעוֹשֶׂה לִפְנִים מִשּׁוּרַת הַדִּין לְהַחְמִיר עַל עַצְמוֹ אוֹ מִשּׁוּם ״עֵת לַעֲשׂוֹת לַה׳״:

being termed Chassidim [pious ones], for their actions departing from normative Torah will be seen like a pious master acting beyond the strict letter of the law to be stringent upon himself or because it was a time to act for Hashem!

11.h: The theme: The precedence of the Book of the Wicked in Rosh Hashanah (16b), David's prayer against his enemies, and Moshe's plea (macheini na). Script and writing (ha-ktav v'ha-michtav, Avos 5:6) were created during the six days of Genesis (the twilight of Friday), whereas the recitation/thought (ha-sippur) in Atzilus precedes Creation. In Rosh Hashanah (16b), the Sages surprisingly gave precedence to the Book of the Wicked before the Righteous and Intermediates. Commentators questioned: why did David ask regarding his enemies "let them be blotted out of the book of the living" (Tehillim 69:29)—expounded as the Book of the Wicked—rather than being inscribed among them? Furthermore, why did Moshe say "blot me out, I pray You, from Your book which You have written" (Shemos 32:32), which Chazal identify as the Book of the Wicked? The inner resolution is profound: the "Book of the Wicked" is the transcendent Book of Divine Thought (Sefer ha-Machshavah), wherein Israel arose first in primordial thought. For the Jewish sinner, outward actions are corrupted, but his attachment endures in this highest book above all. David foresaw in the Holy Spirit that his treacherous enemies were severed from the World to Come, praying that they be blotted out even from this supreme book. Moshe, when Hashem threatened to destroy Israel and make him a great nation, refused to stand apart, demanding: "blot me out from the Book of the Wicked"—meaning: if the sinners of Israel are severed from their primordial root in Your Thought, sever me alongside them! The entire physical universe is a book written by Hashem, and the Torah is the commentary composed upon that book, with every detail in creation reflecting a divine thought.

p: וְהַכְּתָב וְהַמִּכְתָּב שֶׁהֵם ״סֵפֶר״ וְ״סוֹפֵר״ נִבְרְאוּ בְּשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְּרֵאשִׁית (אָבוֹת ה:ו)
And the script and the writing, which are the "book" (Sefer) and the "scribe" (Sofer), were created during the six days of Genesis at twilight on the eve of Shabbat (Avos 5:6);
אֲבָל הַסִּפּוּר שֶׁהוּא הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה שֶׁבַּאֲצִילוּת, לֹא שַׁיָּיךְ בּוֹ בְּרִיאָה
but the recitation (Sippur), which is divine Thought in Atzilus, does not fall under the category of "creation";
וְהוּא בַּאֲצִילוּת הַקּוֹדֵם לַבְּרִיאָה
being in Atzilus which preceded Creation;
רַק הַמַּעֲשִׂים וּפְעֻלּוֹת הַנִּמְשָׁכִים מִמֶּנָּה הֵם מְסוּדָּרִים מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְּרֵאשִׁית, וְגַם זֶה בְּהֶעְלֵם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
only the physical actions and deeds drawn from it are preordained from the six days of Genesis, and this too in deep concealment in this world.
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם מִצַּד הָאֱמֶת, הֲרֵי יֵשׁ לְסִפְרָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים קְדִימָה
And nevertheless, from the perspective of absolute Truth, the Book of the Wicked possesses metaphysical precedence;
וְעַל כֵּן הִקְדִּימוּהוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ט״ז עַמּוּד ב׳) לְסִפְרָן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים וּבֵינוֹנִיִּים
wherefore our Rabbis of blessed memory in Rosh Hashanah (16b) gave it precedence before the books of the righteous and intermediates;
וְכֵן אַחַר כָּךְ בַּמִּקְרָאוֹת דְּמַיְיתֵי הִקְדִּימוּ
and so too in the scriptural verses cited thereafter they preceded it;
וְלִכְאוֹרָה לֹא הָיָה רָאוּי לְאַקְדּוֹמֵי פּוּרְעָנוּתָא וְקִלְקוּלְתָא
and seemingly, it would not have been fitting to give precedence to retribution and corruption!
וְגַם מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב שָׁם: ״יִמָּחוּ מִסֵּפֶר״ (תְּהִלִּים ס״ט:כ״ט) — זֶה סֵפֶר שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים
And also that which is written there: "'Let them be blotted out of the book' (Tehillim 69:29)—this is the Book of the Wicked";
דִּקְדְּקוּ הַמְפָרְשִׁים: לָמָּה בִּקֵּשׁ דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם עַל שׂוֹנְאָיו שֶׁיִּמָּחוּם מִסֵּפֶר שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים, מוּטָב שֶׁיִּכָּלְלוּ עִמָּהֶם
the commentators probed: why did David HaMelech pray regarding his adversaries that they be blotted out from the Book of the Wicked, when it would have been better that they be included among them?
וְעוֹד דִּגְבֵי סֵפֶר שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים אָמַר: ״וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל יִכָּתֵבוּ״ (שָׁם), מַשְׁמָע הָא עִם רְשָׁעִים יִכָּתֵבוּ, לֹא שֶׁיִּמָּחוּ מִן הַסֵּפֶר לְגַמְרֵי
and furthermore, regarding the Book of the Intermediates he said: "and not be written with the righteous" (ibid.), implying that they should be written with the wicked, and not blotted out entirely!
וְכֵן דִּקְדְּקוּ עַל מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ: ״מְחֵנִי נָא״ (שְׁמוֹת ל״ב:ל״ב) — זֶה סִפְרָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים
and so too they probed regarding what the Sages stated: "'Blot me, I pray You' (Shemos 32:32)—this is the Book of the Wicked";
מַה טִיב מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּסֵפֶר שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים שֶׁיְּבַקֵּשׁ לְמָחְקוֹ מִשָּׁם
what connection has Moshe Rabbeinu with the Book of the Wicked that he should request to be erased from there?
אֲבָל הוּא תּוֹכֶן דְּבָרַי אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי: כִּי ״סֵפֶר שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים״ הוּא סֵפֶר הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה שֶׁל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
But this confirms the very essence of my words: for the "Book of the Wicked" is the Book of divine Thought of the Blessed Name;
שֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל עָלוּ בּוֹ בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה תְּחִלָּה וְנֶחְקְקוּ שָׁם
wherein Israel arose in primordial Thought and were engraved there;
וְהָרְשָׁעִים לֹא נִשְׁאַר לָהֶם אֲחִיזָה אֶלָּא בְּסֵפֶר זֶה הָעֶלְיוֹן שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה מִכּוּלָּם, וְהֵם אוֹתָם שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
and for Jewish sinners there remained no spiritual attachment except within this supreme book exalted above all, they being those who possess a portion in the World to Come;
וְשׂוֹנְאֵי דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁכְּבָר כְּרָתָן בְּרוּחַ הַקֹּדֶשׁ מֵעוֹלָם הַבָּא, בִּקֵּשׁ עֲלֵיהֶם שֶׁיִּמָּחוּ גַּם מִסֵּפֶר זֶה
and the adversaries of David HaMelech, whom he had already severed through the Holy Spirit from the World to Come (like Doeg and Achitophel), he prayed that they be blotted out even from this book;
דְּהַיְינוּ נִיתּוּק שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַיַּהֲדוּת, שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
meaning the absolute severing of their root of Judaism, having no portion in the World to Come.
וּמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּחֵטְא יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁרָצָה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לְהַעֲבִירָם מִן הָעוֹלָם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם לְגַמְרֵי
And Moshe Rabbeinu, during the sin of the Golden Calf when the Blessed Name threatened to annihilate Israel completely, God forbid;
וְשֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה אוֹתוֹ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל הַמְאוּחָז בְּכָל ג׳ סְפָרִים הַנִּזְכָּרִים, וְהוּא לֹא רָצָה בָּזֶה
offering to make of Moshe a great nation holding fast to all three books, and Moshe refused this;
שַׁפִּיר בִּקֵּשׁ: ״מְחֵנִי נָא מִסִּפְרָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים״
he appropriately pleaded: "Blot me out, I pray You, from the Book of the Wicked";
שֶׁהוּא הַסֵּפֶר הָעֶלְיוֹן דְּשׁוֹרֶשׁ הַיַּהֲדוּת שֶׁגַּם הָרְשָׁעִים אֲחוּזִים בּוֹ
which is the supreme book of the root of Judaism wherein even the wicked of Israel are grasped!
וּמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב: ״אֲשֶׁר כָּתָבְתָּ״ (שְׁמוֹת ל״ב:ל״ב) — זֶה סִפְרָן שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים, אֵינוֹ סוֹתֵר מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב
And that which the Gemara interprets: "'which You have written'—this is the Book of the Intermediates," does not contradict this;
וּלְמֵידַק מִינָהּ אִיפְּכָא: דְּסֵפֶר הַכְּתָב הוּא סֵפֶר שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים
nor can one deduce the reverse, that the written book belongs to the intermediates;
דְּיֵשׁ לוֹמַר: דְּדָיֵיק ״אֲשֶׁר כָּתַבְתָּ״ דְּנִקְרָא כְּתִיבָה רַק לְגַבֵּי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, זֶהוּ סֵפֶר שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים
for one can explain: Scripture emphasizes "which You have written," which is categorized as writing solely relative to the Blessed Name;
דִּלְגַבֵּיהּ גַּם הַדִּבּוּר הוּא חֲקִיקָה גְּמוּרָה וּכִכְתִיבָה
for before Him even Speech is an absolute engraving identical to writing;
וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְכָל הָעָם רֹאִים אֶת הַקּוֹלֹת״ (שְׁמוֹת כ:טו)
and as it is said: "And all the people saw the voices" (Shemos 20:15);
שֶׁאוֹתִיּוֹת הַדִּבּוּר נֶחְקְקוּ לִפְנֵיהֶם כִּבִכְתָב עַד שֶׁהָיוּ רוֹאִים אֶת הַנִּשְׁמָע
the letters of Speech being engraved before them as in script, seeing that which was heard (Mechilta, Bachodesh 9);
וְזֶהוּ ״כָּתַבְתָּ״ דַּיְיקָא, מַה שֶּׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְבָשָׂר וָדָם, הוּא סִפְרָן שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים
and this is "You have written" specifically, which is impossible for mortal man, referring to the Book of the Intermediates.
וּמַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב ״וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל יִכָּתֵבוּ״ (תְּהִלִּים ס״ט:כ״ט) — זֶה סִפְרָן שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים
And that which is expounded: "'and with the righteous let them not be written' (Tehillim 69:29)—this is the Book of the Intermediates";
לָאו מִ״אַל יִכָּתֵבוּ״ וּלְשׁוֹן כְּתִיבָה דָּיֵיק
is not deduced from the term "let them not be written";
רַק מִלְּשׁוֹן ״וְעִם צַדִּיקִים״ מַשְׁמָע דְּיֵשׁ שָׁם בַּסֵּפֶר צַדִּיקִים וּרְשָׁעִים
but from the phrasing "and with the righteous," implying that within this book there are recorded both righteous and wicked;
וּמְבַקֵּשׁ שֶׁלֹּא יִכָּתְבוּ עִם הַצַּדִּיקִים, רַק עִם הָרְשָׁעִים
and David prays that his foes not be inscribed with the righteous, but with the wicked;
[כִּי הָרְשָׁעִים שֶׁבְּסֵפֶר שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים הוּא חֵלֶק הָרָע הַמְעוֹרָב בּוֹ שֶׁעָתִיד לִיפָּרֵד וּלְהִכָּרֵת לְגַמְרֵי
[for the wicked in the Book of the Intermediates represent the mixed evil destined to be severed entirely,
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן סֵפֶר שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים דְּרוֹמֵז לְעֹומֶק טוֹב שֶׁיֵּשׁ גַּם בָּרְשָׁעִים כַּנִּזְכָּר]
unlike the Book of the Wicked which alludes to the depth of good present even within sinners as mentioned];
וְהַיְינוּ סֵפֶר שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים דְּיֵשׁ שָׁם צַדִּיק וְרָשָׁע, טוֹב וָרָע
this being the Book of the Intermediates where righteous and wicked, good and evil, are intertwined;
[וְזֶה דְּלֹא כְּ״צֶמַח צֶדֶק״ סִימָן י״א שֶׁהֵבִין דִּלְבֵינוֹנִיִּים קָרֵי ״צַדִּיקִים״ וְלָמַד מִזֶּה לְדִינָא עַיֵּין שָׁם
[and this refutes the Tzemach Tzedek (§11) who understood that the Talmud calls intermediates "tzaddikim";

וְהוּא תָּמוּהַּ, דַּאֲפִילּוּ תֵּימָא דְּנִיתַּן לֵיאָמֵר כֵּן בְּעָלְמָא בִּסְתָם... מִכָּל מָקוֹם בָּזֶה דְּמַיְירֵי בְּג׳ סְפָרִים... אֵיךְ שַׁיָּיךְ דְּיִקְרְאוּ לְבֵינוֹנִיִּים ״צַדִּיקִים״, דְּאִם כֵּן בַּמֶּה יִבָּדְלוּ מִסִּפְרָן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים
for that is astonishing: when the Gemara explicitly distinguishes three books, how could it conflate intermediates with tzaddikim?
אֲבָל פָּשׁוּט דְּלֵיתָא, וְכַוָּונַת הַגְּמָרָא מִלְּשׁוֹן ״וְעִם צַדִּיקִים״, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנִּתְבָּאֵר
but simply it is not so, the Gemara deducing it from "and with the righteous" as explained,
וּלְעוֹלָם ״צַדִּיקִים״ — צַדִּיקִים מַמָּשׁ, לֹא בֵּינוֹנִיִּים
"tzaddikim" meaning literally the righteous and not intermediates,

רַק דִּבְסִפְרָן שֶׁל בֵּינוֹנִיִּים הַתְּלוּיִם וְעוֹמְדִים עַד שֶׁיַּכְרִיעוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם, וְיֵשׁ שֶׁזָּכוּ וְיֵשׁ שֶׁלֹּא זָכוּ, הֲרֵי יֵשׁ שָׁם צַדִּיק וְרָשָׁע, וְשַׁיָּיךְ עַל זֶה לְשׁוֹן ״וְעִם צַדִּיקִים״, וּפָשׁוּט]

for in the Book of the Intermediates who hang in the balance, some merit righteousness and some fall into wickedness, wherefore the phrase "with the righteous" appropriately applies, and this is plain].
וּלְסִפְרָן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים קָרֵי ״חַיִּים״ (תְּהִלִּים ס״ט:כ״ט), דְּהֵם הַדְּבֵקִים בַּה׳ חַיִּים כּוּלָּם הַיּוֹם (דְּבָרִים ד:ד)
And the Book of the Righteous Scripture designates "the living" (Tehillim 69:29), for they cleave unto Hashem alive all of them this day (Devarim 4:4);
וּבְאִידָךְ קְרָא דָּרֵישׁ לְהוּ: ״מִסִּפְרְךָ״ (שְׁמוֹת ל״ב:ל״ב), דְּזֶהוּ סִפְרוֹ שֶׁל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּיִחוּד
and in the other verse the Gemara expounds: "from Your book" (Shemos 32:32), this being the book of the Blessed Name specifically,
דְּ״צַדִּיק הוּא ה׳״ (אֵיכָה א:יח), וְ״לֹא יְגֻרְךָ רָע״ (תְּהִלִּים ה:ה) כְּתִיב
for "Hashem is righteous" (Eichah 1:18) and "no evil can dwell with You" (Tehillim 5:5);
וְעִיקַּר בַּקָּשַׁת הַמְּחִיָּה הוּא נִסְמָךְ לְסִפְרָן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים בְּיִחוּד
and the primary plea for erasure is juxtaposed unto the Book of the Wicked specifically,
לְפִי שֶׁשָּׁם אֲחוּזִים גַּם רִשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, דְּ״עַמֵּךְ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים״ (יְשַׁעְיָה ס:כא), וְהוּא יְבַקֵּשׁ עַל מְחִיַּיִת הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ
because therein are rooted the sinners of Israel who are essentially righteous, Moshe praying concerning the eradication of this very root.
וּלְשׁוֹן כְּתִיבָה שַׁיָּיךְ בְּכוּלָּם, שֶׁהֲרֵי כּוּלָּם נִקְרָאִים ״סְפָרִים״
And the terminology of "writing" applies to all three, for all are designated "books";
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב דְּגַם עַל סֵפֶר הַדִּבּוּר יִצְדַּק כְּתִיבָה
and as explained that even regarding the book of Speech writing appropriately applies;
וְכֵן עַל סֵפֶר הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה, כְּתִיבָתוֹ הוּא בְּעוֹלַם הָעֲשִׂיָּה הַגּוּפָנִי שֶׁהִיא רוֹשֶׁם מֵאוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה הַנִּיכָּרִים מִתּוֹךְ הַמַּעֲשִׂים
and so too regarding the book of Thought, its inscription is in the corporeal world of Asiyah, which is the tangible impression of the letters of Thought discerned through deeds.
וְכָךְ קִבַּלְתִּי: כִּי הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ הוּא סֵפֶר שֶׁעָשָׂה הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
And thus I received: the entire universe is a book authored by the Blessed Name;
[וּנְהִירְנָא דִּבְיַלְדוּתִי רָאִיתִי סֵפֶר מִצְוֹת עֲשֵׂה לְהָאֲדוֹמִי, וְשָׁם מֵבִיא בְּשֵׁם סֵפֶר מְיוּחָס לַחֲנוֹךְ אֵצֶל הָאוּמּוֹת
[and I recall in my youth seeing a book on the positive commandments by Azariah de' Rossi (HaAdomi), citing from a book attributed to Chanoch among the nations,
וְכִמְדוּמֶּה דְּשָׁם נִמְצָא קְצָת שֶׁמֶץ דָּבָר מִזֶּה: אֵיךְ כָּל הַנִּבְרָאִים שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם הֵם צוּרַת אוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁחָקַק הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּעוֹלָמוֹ שֶׁהוּא סִפְרוֹ]
and methinks there was found a trace of this truth: how all creatures in the cosmos are the forms of letters engraved by the Blessed Name in His world which is His book];
וְשֶׁהַתּוֹרָה הוּא פֵּירוּשׁ שֶׁעָשָׂה וְחִבַּר עַל אוֹתוֹ סֵפֶר
and that the holy Torah is the commentary composed and authored upon that very book;
וְהֵם קוֹשְׁטְ דִּבְרֵי אֱמֶת, כִּי הַתּוֹרָה הִיא נוֹבְלוֹת אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה עַצְמָם שֶׁנִּתְגַּלְּמוּ וְנִתְלַבְּשׁוּ בְּצִיּוּר אוֹתִיּוֹת הַכְּתָב
and these are words of absolute truth, for the Torah is the direct outflow of the letters of Thought themselves, embodied and garbed in the graphic letters of script;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן הָעוֹלָם הוּא רַק רוֹשֶׁם וְהֶיכֵּר בְּעָלְמָא
whereas the physical world is merely an external impression and indicator;
וְעַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה יְכוֹלִים לְהָבִין הָרְמִיזוֹת שֶׁל הָרוֹשֶׁם וְהַהֶיכֵּר שֶׁיֵּשׁ בַּמַּעֲשִׂים עַל מַה שֶּׁבְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ
and through the Torah one can decipher the hints of the impression present within deeds matching what is in His divine Thought;
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם גַּם כָּל מַעֲשֶׂה וְנִבְרְאֵי הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ הֵם סֵפֶר שָׁלֵם שֶׁבּוֹ חָקַק כָּל אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה דֶּרֶךְ הֶעְלֵם גָּדוֹל
and nevertheless all deeds and creatures in the universe form a complete book wherein are engraved all the letters of Thought in deep concealment;
שֶׁאֵין שׁוּם נִבְרָא וְיִצוּר שֶׁאֵינוֹ רוֹשֵׁם עַל דָּבָר וְעִנְיָן מְיוּחָד בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ
there being no creature that does not correspond to a specific concept within His divine Thought;
דְּ״לֹא תֹהוּ בְרָאָהּ [לָשֶׁבֶת יְצָרָהּ]״ (יְשַׁעְיָה מ״ה:י״ח), וְהַכֹּל בְּכַוָּונָה מְיוּחֶדֶת לְמַעֲנֵהוּ, לְקִילּוּסוֹ, וּלְגַלּוֹת עַל יְדֵי זֶה כְּבוֹד שָׁמַיִם
for "He created it not a waste, He formed it to be inhabited" (Yeshayah 45:18), all formed with precise intention for His praise and to reveal the glory of Heaven;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָרַב רַבִּי בָּרוּךְ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה עַל ״מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ״ (תְּהִלִּים ק״ד:כ״ד): רָצָה לוֹמַר אֵיךְ לִקְנוֹת אוֹתְךָ וּלְהַשִּׂיג אוֹתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ:
as the holy Rabbi Baruch [of Mezhibozh] wrote on "the earth is full of Your acquisitions (kinyanecha)" (Tehillim 104:24): meaning lessons in how to "acquire" (liknot) and perceive Him, blessed be He!

11.h: The theme: All creations rooted in the souls of Israel, the future purification of impure animals (the pig), and the clarification of holy speech (Safah Berurah). All creations—even impure animals and the nations—are bound to the souls of Israel ("He set the borders of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel", Devarim 32:8). The universe was created solely for Israel to recognize His kingdom, and all creatures derive life through the souls of Israel who grasp the letters of Thought. In the Future, when Israel’s iniquity is sought and none is found (Yirmiyah 50:20) and the yetzer hara is expunged, impurity will vanish even from animals: the pig (chazir) is destined to return to its permitted state (chazar l'heitero), and the wolf will dwell with the lamb (Yeshayah 11:6). The nations will then become proselytes (gerim gerurim, Avodah Zarah 3b); though having no hold in the letters of Script (the Torah) or Thought, their speech will be rectified: "For then will I turn to the peoples a pure language (safah berurah)" (Tzefanyah 3:9), elevating them to dwell under the wings of the Shechinah. In the World to Come, when the world of Thought is fully revealed, "Hashem alone did lead him" (Devarim 32:12) will be realized exclusively for the souls of Israel who arose in primordial Thought.

p: וְהַכֹּל אֲחוּזִים בְּנַפְשׁוֹת מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, אֲפִילּוּ בַּעֲלֵי חַיִּים טְמֵאִים וְאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם
And all entities are bound unto the souls of the Children of Israel, even impure animals and the nations of the world;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״יַצֵּב גְּבֻלֹת עַמִּים לְמִסְפַּר בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (דְּבָרִים ל״ב:ח׳)
as it is said: "He set the borders of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel" (Devarim 32:8);
דְּכָל הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ לֹא נִבְרָא אֶלָּא בִּשְׁבִיל יִשְׂרָאֵל
for the entire universe was created solely for the sake of Israel (Bereishis Rabbah 1:4);
שֶׁהֵם יַכִּירוּ עַל יָדָם כֹּחַ מַלְכוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְעֹומֶק מַחֲשָׁבָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה הַנִּיכֶּרֶת מִתּוֹךְ מַעֲשָׂיו
that through them they recognize the power of His sovereignty and the primordial Thought discerned from His deeds;
וְכוּלָּם מְקַבְּלִים חַיּוּתָם מֵהַנְּפָשׁוֹת דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם אֲחוּזִים בְּעַצְמִיּוּת אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
and all creatures receive their vitality from the souls of Israel who hold fast to the essence of the letters of Thought;
וְעַל יְדֵיהֶם הוּא הִשְׁתַּלְשְׁלוּת דְּמַחֲשָׁבָה לְהַגִּיעַ לְסוֹף מַעֲשֶׂה
and through Israel is channeled the descent of divine Thought to arrive at the culmination of physical action.
וּלְעָתִיד, כְּשֶׁ״יְבֻקַּשׁ אֶת עֲוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵינֶנּוּ״ (יִרְמְיָה נ:כ), שֶׁיִּהְיוּ כּוּלָּם צַדִּיקִים וִיבוֹעַר הָרָע וְיֵצֶר הָרָע מִן הָעוֹלָם

And in the Future, when "the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none" (Yirmiyah 50:20), when all will be righteous and evil and the yetzer hara will be expunged from the world;
יִתְבַּטֵּל גַּם הַטּוּמְאָה מִבַּעֲלֵי חַיִּים, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב: ״חֲזִיר שֶׁעָתִיד לַחֲזוֹר לְהֶתֵּירוֹ״
impurity will likewise cease from animals, as written: the pig (chazir) is destined to return (lachazor) to its permissible status;
[שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ קוֹדֶם מַתַּן תּוֹרָה אוֹ קוֹדֶם חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, אַף דִּלְדִידֵיהּ נֶאֱסַר בָּשָׂר הַיְינוּ לְהָמִית אֲבָל הוּתַּר בְּמֵתָה מֵעַצְמָהּ אֲפִילּוּ מֵהַטְּמֵאִים]
[which permission it possessed prior to Sinai or prior to Adam's sin, where although slaughtering living creatures was forbidden to Adam, carrion was permitted even of impure animals];
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְגָר זְאֵב עִם כֶּבֶשׂ [וְנָמֵר עִם גְּדִי יִרְבָּץ] וְגוֹמֵר״ (יְשַׁעְיָה י״א:ו׳)
and as it is said: "And the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid, etc." (Yeshayah 11:6).
וּבְאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם נֶאֱמַר: ״כִּי אָז אֶהְפֹּךְ אֶל עַמִּים שָׂפָה בְרוּרָה [לִקְרֹא כֻלָּם בְּשֵׁם ה׳ לְעָבְדוֹ שְׁכֶם אֶחָד]״ (צְפַנְיָה ג:ט)

And regarding the nations of the world it is said: "For then will I turn to the peoples a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Hashem, to serve Him with one consent" (Tzefanyah 3:9);
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה (ג׳ עַמּוּד ב׳): דְּכוּלָּם ״גֵּרִים גְּרוּרִים״ לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא
as written in Avodah Zarah (3b): that all gentiles will become proselytes who are drawn along in the Future;
וְלֹא שֶׁיִּהְיוּ כִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, דְּ״ה׳ בָּדָד יַנְחֶנּוּ [וְאֵין עִמּוֹ אֵל נֵכָר]״ (דְּבָרִים ל״ב:י״ב)
yet they will not be equal to the Children of Israel, for "Hashem alone did lead him" (Devarim 32:12);
וְאֵין לָהֶם אֲחִיזָה אֲפִילּוּ בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת הַכְּתִיבָה וְהַתּוֹרָה, דְּ״לֹא עָשָׂה כֵן לְכָל גּוֹי״ (תְּהִלִּים קמ״ז:כ׳), וְכָל שֶׁכֵּן בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
and they possess no hold even within the letters of Script and the Torah ("He has not dealt so with any nation", Tehillim 147:20), and all the more so none in the letters of Thought;
רַק בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת הַדִּבּוּר
but solely within the letters of Speech.
דְּעוֹבֵד כּוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אֲפִילּוּ שֶׁמְּדַבֵּר בִּלְשׁוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ — לְשׁוֹנוֹ סָרוּחַ
For a gentile, even when speaking the Holy Tongue, his language is spiritually foul;
כִּי אֵין לָהֶם שַׁיָּיכוּת לַדִּבּוּר הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁהוּא ״מַלְכוּת — פֶּה, תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרִינַן לַהּ״ (תִּקּוּנֵי זֹוהַר י״ז עַמּוּד א׳)
possessing no affinity to holy speech which is "Malchus is the mouth, the Oral Torah we call it" (Tikkunei Zohar 17a);
שְׁכִינַת עוּזּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בִּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ
the indwelling of His majesty within Knesset Israel His people;
וְהוּא סִימָן דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (תַּנְחוּמָא כִּי תִשָּׂא ל״ד): ״מִי שֶׁמִּסְטוֹרַי בְּיָדוֹ וְכוּלֵיהּ״ עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and this is the unique sign of Israel, as the Sages stated (Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 34): "He who holds My secret mystery in his hand is Israel," referring to the Oral Torah.
אֲבָל אָז כְּשֶׁיִּהְיֶה בִּיטּוּל הַיֵּצֶר, לֹא בִּ״לְאַכְפְּיָא״ כְּבָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה, רַק בִּ״לְאַהְפָּכָא״ חֲשׁוֹכָא לִנְהוֹרָא וְשֶׁהַמַּר יָשׁוּב לְמָתוֹק (זֹוהַר חֵלֶק א׳ ד׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
But then when the yetzer is nullified—not merely through suppression (l'akfya) as in this world, but through transforming (l'ahpacha) darkness into light and bitterness into sweetness (Zohar I, 4a);
אָז ״אֶהְפֹּךְ וְגוֹמֵר״ גַּם לְאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָהֶם שָׂפָה בְּרוּרָה וְלֹא לָשׁוֹן סָרוּחַ
then He will turn to the nations a pure language, their speech cleansed of foulness;
שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָהֶם אֲחִיזָה בַּדִּבּוּר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
that they acquire an attachment to holy speech;
כִּידוּעַ דִּמְשְׁכַּן הַגֵּרִים תַּחַת כַּנְפֵי הַשְּׁכִינָה
as is known that the dwelling of righteous converts is beneath the wings of the Shechinah.
וְזֶהוּ לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ
And this applies to the Messianic era;
אֲבָל לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה עוֹלַם הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
but in the World to Come, when the world of divine Thought is fully unveiled;
אָז יִתְקַיֵּים ״ה׳ בָּדָד יַנְחֶנּוּ״ (דְּבָרִים ל״ב:י״ב), רַק אוֹתָם שֶׁעָלוּ בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה:
then will be fulfilled "Hashem alone did lead him" (Devarim 32:12), embracing exclusively those souls of Israel who arose in primordial Thought!
The theme: Avraham Avinu, the ascending order of the Alphabet from Aleph to Tav, and the letter Tav as the life-giving impression
Reshimu
of Mashiach. Avraham, the father of converts, initially bound the 22 letters of the Torah to his tongue in the letters of Speech alone
Sefer Yetzirah 6:7; Chagigah 3a
, until he begot Yitzchak on Rosh Hashanah
Rosh Hashanah 10b
and endured the tenth trial, ascending to Thought. Conception occurred in Tishrei
Thought
and birth in Nissan
Deed / Passover, Tosafos, Rosh Hashanah 27a
. In Nissan, speech departed from the exile of Egypt—where Israel had the status of the convert's soul
nefesh ha-ger
—opening their mouths to recount the Exodus all night and sing the Song of the Sea. This is the month of Aviv (אביב), where letters proceed in ascending order from Aleph to Shin
the foundation of truth / Yisuda d'Kshot, Zohar III, 2a, representing the Three Patriarchs who are the root of Israel
. The 22nd letter, Tav (ת), transcends this world and alludes to the World to Come. Hence talmudic exaggerations use 300
three hundred / Shin, Pesachim 119a
, the highest threshold of this world; whereas the Tav
marks the forehead with "Tav for life"
Tav tichyeh, Shabbat 55a
. Mashiach, the soul of Adam HaRishon, rectifies the root of the Serpent's instigation, asking for life and receiving it
"He asked life of You, You gave it to him", Tehillim 21:5
. Mashiach's request is life for all humanity, reviving Mashiach ben Yosef who fell because of imperfections in guarding the covenant. Even one whose foreskin is drawn down
mashuch
remains biblically circumcised, needing correction merely for appearances
mar'it ha-ayin
; through Mashiach, the letter Tav—the indelible impression
Reshimu
recognized by the Dorshei Reshumot
Sanhedrin 104b
—will be revealed upon every single Jew, confirming their portion in the World to Come and cleaving them to the Living God.
וְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁנִּקְרָא תְּחִלָּה לַגֵּרִים, בְּרֵישׁ חֲגִיגָה (ג׳ עַמּוּד א׳) אִיתָא דְּקָשַׁר כַּ״ב אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ
And Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, who was called the first of the converts (Chagigah 3a), it is taught in Sefer Yetzirah that he bound the twenty-two letters of the Torah to his tongue;
שֶׁזָּכָה תְּחִלָּה רַק לְאוֹתִיּוֹת הַדִּבּוּר, עַד שֶׁהוֹלִיד יִצְחָק וְעַד אַחַר נִסָּיוֹן עֲשִׂירִי דְּאִתְכְּלִיל וְכוּלֵיהּ
having merited initially solely the letters of Speech, until he begot Yitzchak and underwent the tenth trial whereby he was integrated into supernal holiness;
וְזֶה הָיָה בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, כְּמַאֲמָרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה י׳ עַמּוּד ב׳): דְּנִפְקְדָה שָׂרָה
and this occurred on Rosh Hashanah, as the Sages stated (Rosh Hashanah 10b): that Sarah was remembered on Rosh Hashanah;
וְהַיְינוּ בְּהֵרָיוֹן שֶׁמֵּאָז נִקְרָא אָב, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּמְגִלָּה (י״ג עַמּוּד א׳) וּבְסַנְהֶדְרִין (ס״ט עַמּוּד א׳)
meaning through conception, from which moment he was called a father, as written in Megillah (13a) and Sanhedrin (69a);
וְאָז הוּא ״הֲרַת עוֹלָם״ (פִּיּוּט זִכְרוֹנוֹת), זְמַן הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה וְהַהֵרָיוֹן
and that day is the "conception of the world," the season of Thought and pregnancy;
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתְבוּ תּוֹסָפוֹת בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה (כ״ז עַמּוּד א׳) בְּשֵׁם רַבֵּינוּ תָּם: דְּהַמַּחֲשָׁבָה הָיָה בְּתִשְׁרֵי וְהַמַּעֲשֶׂה בְּנִיסָן
as Tosafos wrote in Rosh Hashanah (27a) in the name of Rabbeinu Tam: divine Thought occurred in Tishrei while the concrete act was executed in Nissan;
וְכֵן לֵידַת יִצְחָק בְּנִיסָן בְּפֶסַח (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה י״א עַמּוּד א׳)
and so the physical birth of Yitzchak occurred in Nissan on Pesach (Rosh Hashanah 11a).
וְעַל כֵּן בְּנִיסָן הָיָה יְצִיאַת הַדִּבּוּר מֵהַגָּלוּת דְּמִצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״כִּי גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם [בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם]״ (שְׁמוֹת כ״ב:כ׳)
Wherefore in Nissan occurred the liberation of speech from the exile of Egypt, as it is said: "for you were strangers (gerim) in the land of Egypt" (Shemos 22:20);
שֶׁהָיָה שָׁם בְּסוֹד ״נֶפֶשׁ הַגֵּר״ עַד מַתַּן תּוֹרָה, שֶׁזָּכוּ לִהְיוֹת כְּנֵסִיָּה שְׁלֵימָה מְיוּחֶדֶת לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
Israel existing there in the mystical status of the "soul of the convert" until Sinai, when they merited becoming a complete holy congregation uniquely consecrated unto Hashem;
וּבְנִיסָן נִתְגַּלּוּ אוֹתִיּוֹת הַדִּבּוּר, עַד שֶׁנִּפְתַּח הַפֶּה לְהָסִיחַ וּלְסַפֵּר בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם כָּל הַלַּיְלָה וְלָשִׁיר שִׁירַת הַיָּם
and in Nissan the letters of Speech were revealed, so that the mouth was opened to converse and recount the Exodus all night long and to sing the Song of the Sea;
וְזֶהוּ חֹדֶשׁ הָאָבִיב דְּאַתְוָון כְּסִדְרָן
and this is the month of Aviv
(אָבִיב),
where the letters proceed in direct, ascending order

(א-ב-י-ב); כִּי סֵדֶר הָאוֹתִיּוֹת הֵם מִמַּטָּה לְמַעְלָה: תְּחִלָּה אָלֶ״ף, וְאַחַר כָּךְ בֵּי״ת לְמַעְלָה מִמֶּנּוּ, וְכֵן כּוּלָּם עַד הַשִּׁי״ן שֶׁהוּא ״יְסוֹדָא דִּקְשׁוֹט״ כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּוהַר (חֵלֶק ג׳ ב׳ עַמּוּד א׳)

for the natural order of human comprehension is from bottom to top: first Aleph, then Beis above it, and so forth unto Shin which is the "foundation of truth" (yisuda d'kshot) as written in the Zohar (III, 2a);
שֶׁהָאוֹתִיּוֹת הֵם אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה הַנִּקְרָא ״תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת״ (מַלְאָכִי ב:ו)
for the letters are the letters of the Torah which is termed the "Torah of truth" (Malachi 2:6);
וְהַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ וְהַהַתְחָלָה מֵעֵילָּא לְתַתָּא הוּא בְּאוֹת הַשִּׁי״ן הָרוֹמֵז לִג׳ אֲבָהָן
and the root and inception counted from Above to below is in the letter Shin (whose three branches allude to the Three Patriarchs);
כִּידוּעַ שֶׁהֵם הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ וִיסוֹד לָאוּמָּה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִית, שֶׁהֵם כּוּלּוֹ זֶרַע אֱמֶת הַנִּשְׁרָשִׁים בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה
as is known that they are the root and foundation of the Israelite nation, who are entirely a seed of truth rooted in the letters of the Torah.
אֲבָל אוֹת הַתָּי״ו קִבַּלְתִּי שֶׁהוּא רוֹמֵז לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא וּלְמַעְלָה מֵהַשָּׂגוֹת דְּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
But the letter Tav
I received as a tradition alludes to the World to Come, transcending the perceptions of this earthly world;
וּדְעַל כֵּן כָּל הַגּוּזְמוֹת הָרְגִילוֹת בַּתַּלְמוּד הֵם בְּמִסְפַּר ״תְּלָת מְאָה״ [שִׁי״ן = 300]
wherefore all the customary hyperbole in the Talmud uses the number three hundred [the letter Shin = 300];
[כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתַב רַשְׁבַּ״ם פְּסָחִים קי״ט סוֹף עַמּוּד א׳] שֶׁהוּא הַמִּסְפָּר הַיּוֹתֵר גָּדוֹל מִצַּד הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
[as the Rashbam wrote at the end of Pesachim 119a], 300 being the largest standard number representing this world;
וְנִרְאֶה לִי דְּרוֹמֵז לְאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁהוּא נִשְׁמַת מָשִׁיחַ כַּנּוֹדָע
and it appears to me to allude to Adam HaRishon who is the primordial soul of Mashiach as is known;
וַעֲלֵיהֶם הַתָּי״ו הָרוֹמֵז ״תָּי״ו — תִּחְיֶה וְכוּלֵיהּ״, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּפָרָשַׁת בַּמֶּה בְּהֵמָה (שַׁבָּת נ״ה עַמּוּד א׳)
and upon them is drawn the letter Tav hinting: "Tav—you shall live (tichyeh)," as written in Shabbat (55a);
וְאִילּוּ זָכָה אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן הָיָה גַּם עָלָיו הַתָּ״ו רוֹמֶזֶת ״תִּחְיֶה״, אֶלָּא שֶׁלֹּא זָכָה וְרָמְזָה לְהֵיפֶךְ [תָּמוּת]
and had Adam HaRishon not sinned, the Tav upon him would likewise have signaled "you shall live," but failing the trial it indicated the reverse ["you shall die", tamut];
וּמָשִׁיחַ יִזְכֶּה לְ״תָּי״ו — תִּחְיֶה״, דְּ״חַיִּים שָׁאַל מִמְּךָ — נָתַתָּה לּוֹ״ (תְּהִלִּים כ״א:ה׳)
while Mashiach will merit the "Tav of life," for "he asked life of You, You gave it to him" (Tehillim 21:5).

וּבְוַדַּאי לְעַצְמוֹ, מֵאַחַר שֶׁתִּיקֵּן אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן וְלֹא חָטָא, מַה צֹּרֶךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ, דְּמֵהֵיכָא תֵּיתֵי יָמוּת, וְ״אֵין מִיתָה בְּלֹא חֵטְא״, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב שָׁם (שַׁבָּת נ״ה עַמּוּד א׳)

And certainly for himself, having rectified Adam HaRishon and being free from sin, what need was there to ask for life? For whence would death come to him, seeing that "there is no death without sin" (Shabbat 55a)?
וְאַף דְּאִיתּוֹתַב (שָׁם עַמּוּד ב׳) מֵאַרְבָּעָה שֶׁמֵּתוּ בְּעֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ
And even though that principle was challenged from the four who died solely through the instigation of the Serpent (ibid. 55b);
מִכָּל מָקוֹם עֶטְיוֹ שֶׁל נָחָשׁ עַצְמוֹ הַיְינוּ חֵטְא שֶׁבַּשּׁוֹרֶשׁ מֵאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, וְהוּא יְתַקֵּן גַּם זֶה
nevertheless the Serpent's instigation is itself the root sin inherited from Adam, which Mashiach rectifies entirely;
וַהֲרֵי אָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ג:י״ד): אִם יֹאמַר אָדָם שֶׁגַּם אִם לֹא יֶחֱטָא יָמוּת, הֲרֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ שֶׁלֹּא חָטָא וְחַי לְעוֹלָם
and behold the Sages stated (Koheles Rabbah 3:14): if a man claims that even without sin he would die, behold Eliyahu never sinned and lives forever!
אֲבָל עִיקַּר הַשְּׁאֵלָה וְהַהַבְטָחָה הָיָה עַל בַּקָּשָׁתוֹ הַחַיִּים לְכָל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם
Rather, the essence of Mashiach's request and the divine promise was his pleading for eternal life on behalf of all the inhabitants of the world;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סֻכָּה נ״ב עַמּוּד א׳): שֶׁהוּא יְבַקֵּשׁ זֶה לְהַחֲיוֹת מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף שֶׁנֶּהֱרַג
as the Sages stated (Sukkah 52a): that he will ask for the revival of Mashiach ben Yosef who was slain;
שֶׁהוּא מִצַּד חִסָּרוֹן שֶׁיֵּשׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בִּשְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית קֹדֶשׁ, דַּרְגָּא דְּיוֹסֵף הַצַּדִּיק
whose death stems from the deficiency within Israel in guarding the holy covenant, the spiritual rung of Yosef the Righteous.
וְאַף עַל פִּי דְּעַל הָאֱמֶת גַּם עַרְלֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִקְרָאִים מוּלִים, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּנְדָרִים (ל״א עַמּוּד א׳), הַיְינוּ שׁוֹמְרֵי הַבְּרִית
And even though in absolute truth uncircumcised Israelites are legally termed circumcised (Nedarim 31a), being intrinsically guardians of the covenant;
וַאֲפִילּוּ בּוֹעֵל אֲרַמִּית, שֶׁבָּזֶה הָיָה נִסָּיוֹן יוֹסֵף דְּהוּא עִיקַּר קִלְקוּל הַבְּרִית
and even one who cohabited with an Aramite woman, which was the supreme trial of Yosef and the deepest corruption of the covenant,
שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּעֵירוּבִין (י״ט עַמּוּד א׳) דִּמְמַשְּׁכָא עָרְלָתֵיהּ וְלָא מִבַּשְׁקַר לֵיהּ
regarding whom they said in Eruvin (19a) that his foreskin is drawn down so that Avraham does not recognize him;
הֲרֵי הַמָּשׁוּךְ גַּם הוּא מָהוּל גָּמוּר מִן הַתּוֹרָה, וְאֵין צָרִיךְ לָמוּלוֹ שֵׁנִית אֶלָּא מִשּׁוּם מַרְאִית הָעַיִן (יְבָמוֹת ע״ב עַמּוּד א׳)
yet behold, one whose foreskin is drawn down remains biblically circumcised, requiring rabbinic re-circumcision merely for outward appearance (Yevamos 72a);
וְהַיְינוּ דְּלָא מִבַּשְׁקַר לְמַרְאִית הָעַיִן לְבַד
meaning that he is unrecognizable only to the external human eye;
וְכָל זֶה זְמַן הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה שֶׁהוּא עָלְמָא דְּשִׁקְרָא, דְּ״הָאָדָם יִרְאֶה לַעֵינַיִם״ (שְׁמוֹת א ט״ז:ז׳) לְבַד
and all this applies solely during this world of falsehood where man looks merely upon outward appearances;
תִּקְּנוּ חֲכָמִים הַרְבֵּה דְּבָרִים וְאִיסּוּרִים מִשּׁוּם מַרְאִית הָעַיִן, כִּי הָאָדָם צָרִיךְ שְׁמִירָה שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה עָלָיו טַעֲנָה גַּם לְמַרְאִית הָעַיִן, דְּיֵשׁ מִשְׁפָּט גַּם עַל זֶה
the Sages having instituted numerous ordinances against outward appearance, for a person must guard against claims even in outward semblance, there being judgment upon this as well.
אֲבָל כְּשֶׁיִּגָּלֶה אוֹרוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ, שֶׁהוּא שַׁעַר הַכְּנִיסָה עַל יָדוֹ לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
But when the light of Mashiach is revealed, he being the gateway of entrance unto the World to Come;
יִתְגַּלֶּה אוֹר הַתָּי״ו דְּפֵירוּשׁוֹ ״רוֹשֶׁם״ (יְחֶזְקֵאל ט:ד)
there will be revealed the light of the letter Tav
which signifies an engraved impression (roshem, Yechezkel 9:4);
שֶׁהוּא אוֹר הָרְשִׁימוּ שֶׁהָיוּ דּוֹרְשֵׁי רְשׁוּמוֹת מַכִּירִים גַּם עַל פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, דְּכוּלָּם יֵשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא (סַנְהֶדְרִין ק״ד עַמּוּד ב׳)
which is the light of the impression (reshimu) that the Dorshei Reshumot discerned even upon the sinners of Israel, that all have a portion in the World to Come (Sanhedrin 104b);
דְּאַף דְּנִיתַּק כָּל הָאוֹר, עֲדַיִין נִשְׁאַר רוֹשֶׁם
for even when the manifest light is severed, an indelible impression remains;
וְכֹל שֶׁרִישּׁוּמוֹ שֶׁל אוֹת נִיכָּר, הֲרֵי יֵשׁ צוּרַת אוֹת עָלָיו
and as long as the impression of a letter is discernible, its essential form endures upon it;
וְהִתְגַּלּוּת רְשִׁימוּ זֶה לְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל
and this impression will be unveiled for all Israel;
וְכָל הָעוֹלָם כּוּלּוֹ יִחְיֶה עַל יְדֵי מָשִׁיחַ, שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה הַתָּי״ו וְהָרוֹשֶׁם דְּ״תָּי״ו — תִּחְיֶה״
and the entire world will be revived through Mashiach when the Tav and the impression of "Tav for life" is revealed;
שֶׁהוּא הַדְּבֵיקוּת בֵּאלֹהִים חַיִּים שֶׁיֵּשׁ לְכָל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
which is the intrinsic cleaving unto the Living God possessed by every single Jew;
וְאַף דְּנִמְשְׁכָה עָרְלָתוֹ לְמַרְאִית הָעַיִן, עֲדַיִין רִישּׁוּמוֹ שֶׁל מִילָה נִיכָּר
and though his foreskin was drawn down to outward appearance, the impression of his circumcision remains discernible;
וְזֶהוּ שְׁלֵימוּת כָּל הַכַּ״ב אוֹתִיּוֹת, לְהַשִּׂיג עַד הָרְשִׁימוּ שֶׁהֵם אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה שֶׁרִישּׁוּמָן נִיכָּר בְּסוֹף מַעֲשֶׂה
and this is the perfection of all twenty-two letters: grasping unto the Reshimu, which are the letters of Thought whose impression is recognized at the end of action;
וְזֶהוּ סֵדֶר הָאָלֶ״ף־בֵּי״ת שֶׁלָּנוּ כְּפִי סֵדֶר הַשָּׂגָה שֶׁלָּנוּ מִמַּטָּה לְמַעְלָה:
and this is our ascending alphabetical order (Aleph to Tav) matching the order of human perception from bottom to top!
The theme: Nissan's ascending order versus Tishrei's descending order
Tashrak / תשר״ק
, and the Shofar uniting Thought and Action. In Nissan the world was created in physical actuality, matching human perception from below; hence the months are counted from Nissan
"this month shall be unto you the beginning of months", Shemos 12:2
, and the New Year for Jewish kings begins in Nissan
Rosh Hashanah 2a
. From Nissan Israel ascends to Sivan, receiving the Written Torah
letters of Script
, and culminates in Tishrei, the creation in Thought, which proceeds in reverse from Above to below
Tashrak, ת-ש-ר-ק, Zohar I, 2b
. On Rosh Hashanah the moon is covered
ba-keseh l'yom chageinu, Tehillim 81:4; Rosh Hashanah 8a
, reflecting Chayah and Yechidah
Keser and Chochmah
which transcend human intellect. Therefore, Rosh Hashanah is the Day of Judgment when all humanity passes before Him in a single glance
kivnei maron, Rosh Hashanah 16a
, opening the Book of Thought
Sefer ha-Machshavah

where all deeds are rooted. Hashem provided the counsel of the Shofar, hinted in the letters Tav and Shin (ת-ש), uniting the inception of Thought with the end of Action. The sound of the Shofar transcends verbal letters, expressing the primal cry of the heart
tze'akah she-ba-lev / ha-kol kol Ya'akov

. Every Jew—even a sinner—emits this authentic cry of love or awe from the depths of his heart at some point in life. The Shofar awakens these cries, sweetening the tremors of fear with the preceding and succeeding blasts of joy
teki'ah before and after
, transforming the Day of Judgment into a Day of Divine Favor. The ten days of repentance lead to Yom Kippur, the gate of freedom
tar'a d'cheiru / the World to Come
, where the primordial root of the soul is found completely unblemished
"Seek Hashem while He may be found", Yeshayah 55:6
וְזֶהוּ בְּנִיסָן, דְּאָז הָיָה בְּרִיאַת עוֹלָם בְּפֹעַל (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה י״א עַמּוּד א׳)
And this unfolds in Nissan, for then was the creation of the cosmos in physical actuality (Rosh Hashanah 11a);
שֶׁהַהַהֲכָנָה [שֶׁהַהֶאָרָה] בּוֹ מִצַּד הַשָּׂגַת הַתַּחְתּוֹנִים
its illumination reflecting the perceptual vantage of the lower creatures;
וְעַל כֵּן אָז הַתְחָלַת בִּנְיַן כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְאוּמָּה שְׁלֵימָה
wherefore then was the inception of the construction of Knesset Israel into a complete nation;
וְ״הַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה לָכֶם״ (שְׁמוֹת י״ב:ב׳) דַּיְיקָא ״רֹאשׁ חֳדָשִׁים״
and "this month shall be unto you the beginning of months" specifically;
וּלְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנִּיסָן מָנִינַן (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ב׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
and for the kings of Israel we reckon the regnal years from Nissan (Rosh Hashanah 2a);
שֶׁאָז הַתְחָלַת מְלוּכַת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהִתְגַּלּוּת כְּנֵסִיָּתָם
for then is the beginning of Israel's royal sovereignty and the revelation of their sacred assembly;
וְהוֹלְכִים וּמִתְעַלִּים בְּסִיוָון לְהַשִּׂיג אוֹתִיּוֹת הַכְּתִיבָה בְּקַבָּלַת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב
and they proceed and ascend in Sivan to attain the letters of Script through receiving the Written Torah;
וְאַחַר כָּךְ בְּתִשְׁרֵי אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה, שֶׁאָז הוּא בְּרִיאַת עוֹלָם בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה
and subsequently in Tishrei they reach the letters of Thought, for then was the creation of the world in divine Thought;
וְעַל כֵּן סִדְרָן לְמַפְרֵעַ
wherefore their order proceeds in reverse [from Tav backwards];
שֶׁזֶּהוּ הַסֵּדֶר שֶׁמִּצַּד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מֵעֵילָּא לְתַתָּא, כְּפִי סֵדֶר הִשְׁתַּלְשְׁלוּתָן מִתְּחִלַּת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה עַד סוֹף הַמַּעֲשֶׂה שֶׁהוּא עַל סֵדֶר תַּשְׁרַ״ק
which is the descending order from the perspective of the Blessed Name from Above to below, matching the cascade from Thought to Action in the order of Tashrak
(ת-ש-ר-ק); דְּעַל כֵּן אִיתָא בְּרֵישׁ הַקְדָּמַת הַזֹּוהַר (ב׳ עַמּוּד ב׳): דִּבִשְׁעַת בְּרִיאַת עוֹלָם עָאלוּ לְפָנָיו אַתְוָון לְמַפְרֵעַ, עַיֵּין שָׁם
wherefore it is taught in the Introduction to the Zohar (2b): during the creation of the world the letters entered before Him in reverse order, see there;
וְהַיְינוּ דְּזֶהוּ סִדְרָן מִצַּד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
this being their cosmic sequence from the perspective of the Blessed Name.
וְהַהַתְחָלָה בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה הוּא בְּהֶעְלֵם, וּ״בַכֶּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ״ (תְּהִלִּים פ״א:ד׳), שֶׁהַחֹדֶשׁ מִתְכַּסֶּה בּוֹ (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ח׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
And the beginning on Rosh Hashanah is in concealment: "at the covered time (ba-keseh) for our feast day" (Tehillim 81:4), where the new moon is veiled (Rosh Hashanah 8a);
רָצָה לוֹמַר חִידּוּשׁ הַלְּבָנָה שֶׁכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל נֶמְשְׁלוּ לָהּ
meaning the renewal of the moon unto which Knesset Israel is compared;
כִּי הוּא בְּסוֹד חַיָּה יְחִידָה הָעוֹמְדִים בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה רַק בְּסוֹד מַקִּיפִים
being in the mystery of Chayah and Yechidah which dwell in this world only as surrounding lights;
וְהֵם נֶגֶד כֶּתֶר וְחָכְמָה שֶׁהֵם לְמַעְלָה מֵהַשָּׂגַת אָדָם, שֶׁהוּא רַק בְּבִינָה שֶׁבַּלֵּב שֶׁשָּׁם הַהַרְגָּשָׁה
corresponding to Keser and Chochmah which transcend human perception, man grasping only in Binah within the heart where conscious feeling resides;
וְעַל כֵּן אָז יוֹם הַדִּין וּשְׁלֹשָׁה סְפָרִים נִפְתָּחִים (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ט״ז עַמּוּד ב׳)
wherefore then is the Day of Judgment and the three books are opened (Rosh Hashanah 16b);
כִּי מִצַּד הַהִתְבּוֹנְנוּת בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה, כָּל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם עוֹבְרִים ״כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן״ בִּסְקִירָה אַחַת (שָׁם עַמּוּד א׳)
for in contemplating the letters of divine Thought, all who enter the world pass like sheep in a single glance (ibid. 16a);
שֶׁבַּמַּחֲשָׁבָה אֵין שָׁם חִלּוּקִים מוּרְגָּשִׁים כִּבְאוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁבַּדִּבּוּר וּבַכְּתָב
for in Thought there are no fragmented divisions like in the letters of Speech and Script;
וּבָהּ נָעוּץ גַּם סוֹף הַמַּעֲשֶׂה, וְכָלוּל גַּם הַסְּפָרִים שֶׁבִּכְתִיבָה וּבְדִבּוּר
and within Thought the culmination of action is wedged, encompassing the books of Writing and Speech;
וּבִפְתִיחַת סֵפֶר הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה שֶׁהוּא הָרִאשׁוֹן, נִפְתָּחִים שְׁלָשְׁתָּם
and with the opening of the Book of Thought which is foremost, all three books are opened;
וּמַתְחִיל הֶאָרַת אוֹת הַתָּי״ו הָרוֹשֶׁמֶת עַל הַסְּפָרִים
and there begins the illumination of the letter Tav which inscribes the impression upon the books.
וְקֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא יָהֵיב עֵיטִין בְּכוּלָּא בִּתְקִיעַת שׁוֹפָר הָרָמוּז בְּאוֹת הַתָּ״ו וְהַשִּׁי״ן [תַּ״שׁ, רָאשֵׁי תֵּיבוֹת תְּקִיעָה שְׁבָרִים]
And the Holy One provides heavenly counsel for all through the blast of the Shofar, hinted in the letters Tav and Shin [the acronym of Teki'ah-Shevarim];
שֶׁהוּא יִחוּד וְחִבּוּר תְּחִלַּת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה עִם סוֹף הַמַּעֲשֶׂה
which is the union of the inception of Thought with the culmination of Action;
וְזֶהוּ עַל יְדֵי הַקּוֹל שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה מֵהַדִּבּוּר וְחִיתּוּךְ אוֹתִיּוֹת בְּפֹעַל
accomplished through the primal Sound which transcends speech and verbal articulation;
רַק בּוֹ מִתְגַּלֶּה אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה וְהַצְּעָקָה שֶׁבַּלֵּב
wherein are revealed the letters of Thought and the wordless cry of the heart;
כִּידוּעַ שֶׁמִּכָּל מַחֲשָׁבָה שֶׁבַּלֵּב אִי אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁלֹּא יֵצֵא לְפֹעַל אֵיזֶה קוֹל
as is known that from every deep thought in the heart it is impossible that some voice not issue forth,
הַמּוֹרֶה עַל הִשְׁתַּקְּעוּת וּתְקִיעוּת עֹומֶק הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
indicating the immersion and deep anchoring of Thought;
וְ״הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כ״ז:כ״ב) שֶׁמִּטָּתוֹ שְׁלֵימָה
and "the voice is the voice of Jacob" (Bereishis 27:22) whose bed is unblemished,
שֶׁבּוֹ מִתְגַּלֶּה אוֹר זֶה דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל עָלוּ בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה
wherein is revealed that light of Israel having arisen in primordial Thought;
וַאֲפִילּוּ פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יֵשׁ לָהֶם אֲחִיזָה בְּקוֹל זֶה שֶׁל צְעָקָה אֲמִיתִּית אֵיזֶה פַּעַם בְּכָל יְמֵי חַיָּיו מֵעוּמְקָא דְּלִבָּא לַהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
and even the sinners of Israel have a hold in this sound of genuine crying from the depths of the heart unto Hashem at some point in their lifetime;
אִם קוֹל שֶׁל שִׂמְחָה מִצַּד הָאַהֲבָה וְהַכָּרַת חֲסָדָיו וְרַחֲמָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ
whether a cry of joy from love and recognition of His mercies;
אוֹ קוֹל גְּנוּחֵי וִילּוּלֵי מִצַּד הַיִּרְאָה וְהַפַּחַד (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ל״ג עַמּוּד ב׳)
or a cry of groaning and weeping from awe and dread (Rosh Hashanah 33b);
וְזֶהוּ קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר שֶׁעַל יָדוֹ יַעֲלֶה זִכְרוֹנֵנוּ לְטוֹבָה בְּהַזְכָּרַת כָּל הַקּוֹלוֹת דְּאִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא
and this is the voice of the Shofar, through which our remembrance ascends for good by recalling all human voices of awakening from below;
וּמַמְתִּיקִים קוֹלוֹת הַפְּחָדִים בְּקוֹלוֹת הַשִּׂמְחָה דִּתְקִיעָה לִפְנֶיהָ וּלְאַחֲרֶיהָ
sweetening the tremulous sounds of fear with the joyous blasts of the simple teki'ah before and after (Rosh Hashanah 34a);
כִּי אַהֲבָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בֶּאֱמֶת חוֹפֶפֶת עָלֵינוּ מִכָּל צַד
for His love in truth hovers over us from every side.
וּבָזֶה נִתְהַפֵּךְ יוֹם הַדִּין לְיוֹם רָצוֹן
And through this the Day of Judgment is transformed into a Day of Favor;
כִּי מַה שֶּׁהָיָה בְּהֶעְלֵם וְחֹשֶׁךְ דְּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה שֶׁמֵּחֲמָתוֹ נִידּוֹן, שָׁב לְאוֹר גָּדוֹל
for that which was obscured in earthly darkness, on account of which man was judged, returns unto great light,
וְהִתְגַּלּוּת אֵיךְ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מוּשְׁרָשִׁים בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְשֶׁהוּא שׁוֹכֵן בְּקֶרֶב מַעֲמַקֵּי לִבָּם
unveiling how all Israel are rooted in His divine Thought and that He dwells in the depths of their hearts;
וְהוֹלֵךְ וָאוֹר בִּימֵי תְּשׁוּבָה כָּל עֲשֶׂרֶת מַדְרֵיגוֹת הַקּוֹמָה דִּתְשׁוּבָה, עַד יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים
this light brightening through the Ten Days of Repentance across the ten rungs of repentance, unto Yom Kippur;
שֶׁהוּא שְׁלֵימוּת כַּפָּרַת הַתְּשׁוּבָה בְּסוֹד עוֹלָם הַבָּא, ״תַּרְעָא דְּחֵירוּ״ (זֹוהַר חֵלֶק ג׳ ק״ח עַמּוּד ב׳)
which is the consummate atonement of repentance in the mystery of the World to Come, the "gate of freedom" (tar'a d'cheiru);
כִּי אֵין הַקִּלְקוּל מַגִּיעַ לְשָׁם כְּלָל, שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ הִגְדִּיל עֲווֹנוֹת זוֹ לְמַעְלָה מִזּוֹ לֹא נִיתַּק מֵהַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ
for corruption never reaches that supernal gate, so that even if one multiplied sins he was never severed from the root;
וְאָז הוּא זְמַן דִּ״בְהִמָּצְאוֹ״ (יְשַׁעְיָה נ״ה:ו׳), דְּזֶהוּ הִתְעוֹרְרוּת תְּחִלַּת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה בִּבְרִיאַת עוֹלָם שֶׁהָיָה הַבְּרִיאָה לְרָצוֹן לְפָנָיו:
and then is the time of "while He may be found" (Yeshayah 55:6), awakening the primordial Thought of Creation when all was formed in pure favor before Him.
The theme: The Sefirotic structure of Tishrei, the willow
Aravah

as holy seed, and Simchat Torah. Rosh Hashanah is the head and inception of existence ex nihilo from Ayin, corresponding to the letter Yud of the Tetragrammaton. Yom Kippur is the culmination of this head in the brain of Binah, the first letter Hei. Succos
"And Jacob journeyed to Succos", Bereishis 33:17
is the letter Vav. Hoshanah Rabbah and Shemini Atzeret embody the final letter Hei, completing the Divine Name in consummate union, wherefore on Shemini Atzeret a single bullock is offered
Bamidbar 29:36
symbolizing the unique intimacy of Israel with Hashem. All Israel forms a single bundle
agudah achat
: righteous, intermediate, and wicked alike are a seed of truth
zera emes
. Even the willow
Aravah
, which possesses neither taste nor fragrance, equals Zera (עֲרָבָה = זֶרַע = 277), teaching that although it lacks individual merit, its perfection lies in its ancestral root as holy seed
zera kodesh
. The three books are integrated with the Yud
Thought / Chayah and Yechidah
, all receiving their favorable inscription for good life and peace
"ours has conquered", Vayikra Rabbah 30:2

. On Simchat Torah, Israel completes the Torah which encompasses all three books: the Written Torah contains all Oral Torah and all letters of Thought. Through this unification, Israel rejoices in the Torah, establishing a sanctified foundation for the coming year wherein all thoughts, desires, words, and actions are holy unto Hashem.
וְרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה הוּא הָרֹאשׁ וְרֵאשִׁית הַהִתְגַּלּוּת דְּיֵשׁ מֵאַיִן נֶגֶד הַיּוּ״ד דְּשֵׁם הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And Rosh Hashanah is the head and the inception of revelation of Being ex nihilo from Ayin, corresponding to the letter Yud of the Holy Name;
וְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים הוּא סוֹף הִתְגַּלּוּת רֹאשׁ זֶה שֶׁהוּא מוֹחַ הַבִּינָה, וְהֵ״א רִאשׁוֹנָה דְּהַשֵּׁם
and Yom Kippur is the culmination of this head, which is the brain of Binah, the first letter Hei of the Name;
וְאַחַר כָּךְ ״[וְ]יַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכֹּתָה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל״ג:י״ז) הוּא הַוָּי״ו
and subsequently "And Jacob journeyed to Succos" (Bereishis 33:17) is the letter Vav;
וְהוֹשַׁעְנָא רַבָּה וּשְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת — הֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה
and Hoshanah Rabbah and Shemini Atzeret are the final letter Hei;
וּבָזֶה נִשְׁלַם הַשֵּׁם הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַמְיוּחָד בְּיִחוּד שָׁלֵם
and through this the Holy Name is completed in consummate union;
דְּעַל כֵּן בִּשְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת ״פַּר אֶחָד [אַיִל אֶחָד]״ וְכוּלֵיהּ (בַּמִּדְבָּר כ״ט:ל״ו; סֻכָּה נ״ה עַמּוּד ב׳)
wherefore on Shemini Atzeret "one bullock, one ram" is offered (Bamidbar 29:36; Sukkah 55b), symbolizing Hashem's exclusive intimacy with Israel;
וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲגֻדָּה אַחַת: רְשָׁעִים וְצַדִּיקִים וּבֵינוֹנִיִּים, כּוּלָּם יַחַד זֶרַע אֱמֶת
and all Israel form a single bundle (agudah achat): wicked, righteous, and intermediates, all together a seed of truth;
אֲפִילּוּ הָעֲרָבָה שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ לֹא טַעַם וְלֹא רֵיחַ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה ל:יב), הִיא בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״זֶרַע״ (עֲרָבָה = 277 = זֶרַע)
even the willow (aravah) which possesses neither taste nor fragrance (Vayikra Rabbah 30:12) has the numerical value of Zera (seed = 277);
לוֹמַר שֶׁאַף שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ שׁוּם שְׁלֵימוּת מִצַּד עַצְמָהּ, מִכָּל מָקוֹם שְׁלֵימוּתָהּ מִצַּד שָׁרְשָׁהּ שֶׁהַכֹּל אֲגֻדָּה אַחַת, כּוּלּוֹ זֶרַע קֹדֶשׁ
teaching that although it lacks individual virtue, its perfection is derived from its ancestral root, all being bound as one holy seed;
וְכָל הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה סְפָרִים הַכְּלוּלִים בְּשָׁלֹשׁ אוֹתִיּוֹת אַחֲרוֹנוֹת שֶׁל הַשֵּׁם עִם הַיּוּ״ד שֶׁהוּא עַל שֵׁם הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה כַּנּוֹדָע
and all three books encompassed within the last three letters of the Name with the Yud (which signifies Thought as is known);
וְהוּא וְקוּצּוֹ רוֹמְזִים לְחַיָּה וִיחִידָה כַּנּוֹדָע
the Yud and its upper thorn alluding to Chayah and Yechidah;
הַכֹּל מִתְיַיחֲדִים בְּיִחוּד שָׁלֵם, וְכוּלָּם מְקַבְּלִים פִּתְקֵיהֶם אָז בִּכְתִיבָה וַחֲתִימָה טוֹבָה לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם, דְּ״דִידַן נָצַח״ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה ל:ב)
all are unified in complete union, and all receive their sealed verdicts (piskin) for a good inscription and seal for good life and peace, where "ours has conquered" (Vayikra Rabbah 30:2);
וְאָז שְׂמֵחִין אַחַר כָּךְ בְּשִׂמְחַת תּוֹרָה, שֶׁבּוֹ מַשְׁלִימִין הַתּוֹרָה
and then they rejoice on Simchat Torah, on which they conclude the annual cycle of the Torah;
שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן שְׁלֵימוּת כָּל הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל הַכְּלוּלִים וַאֲחוּזִים בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה
which is likewise the consummate perfection of all Knesset Israel bound within the letters of the Torah;
שֶׁבָּהּ כְּלוּלִים כָּל הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה סְפָרִים, שֶׁהַכֹּל כָּלוּל בְּזֹאת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב
wherein are embraced all three books, all being synthesized within this Written Torah;
דְּגַם כָּל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה וְאוֹתִיּוֹת הַדִּבּוּר לֵיכָּא מִידֵי דְּלָא רְמִיזָא בְּאוֹרַיְיתָא (תַּעֲנִית ט׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
for even the entire Oral Torah and the letters of Speech are all hinted in the Written Torah (Ta'anis 9a);
וְכֵן כָּל אוֹתִיּוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה כְּלוּלִים בָּהּ שֶׁהֲרֵי הוּא נוֹבְלוֹת הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה
and likewise all the letters of Thought are included within it, being the outflow of supernal Thought;
וְכַאֲשֶׁר מִתְיַיחֵד הַכֹּל, אָז זוֹכִין לִשְׁלֵימוּת הַתּוֹרָה וְלִשְׂמוֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחָתָהּ
and when everything is unified, they merit the perfection of the Torah and rejoice in its joy;
וּבָזֶה נַעֲשָׂה הֲכָנָה טוֹבָה עַל כָּל הַשָּׁנָה כּוּלָּהּ
and through this a sacred foundation is established for the entire year;
לִהְיוֹת כָּל הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת וְהָרְצוֹנוֹת וְהַדִּבּוּרִים וְהַמַּעֲשִׂים קֹדֶשׁ לַה׳
that all thoughts, desires, words, and actions shall be holy unto Hashem;
אַשְׁרֵי הַזּוֹכֶה לְכָךְ בְּפֹעַל גָּלוּי בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה:
praiseworthy is he who merits this in revealed actuality in this world!
[וְהִנֵּה שׁוּב זָכִיתִי וּמָצָאתִי בְּלִקּוּטֵי הַשַּׁ״ס מֵהָאֲרִיזַ״ל בְּשֵׁם הָרַב חַיִּים וִיטַאל: דִּשְׁלֹשָׁה סְפָרִים דְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה הֵם שְׁלֹשָׁה סְפָרִים דְּסֵפֶר יְצִירָה, עַיֵּין שָׁם

[And behold, I subsequently merited to find in Likkutei HaShas of the Arizal in the name of Rabbi Chaim Vital: that the three books of Rosh Hashanah are identical to the three books (Sefer, Sofer, Sippur) of Sefer Yetzirah, see there;
וְאַהֲנִיאַן מְאֹד דְּכִיוַּנְתִּי לָאֱמֶת בְּשׁוֹרֶשׁ הַדָּבָר, אַף שֶׁלֹּא בֵּאֵר עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁבֵּאַ֫רְתִּי]:
and it brought me immense joy that I targeted the truth at the root of the matter, even though he did not elaborate in the detailed manner that I have explained].
The theme: The creation of Tishrei through the letter Lamed (ל), the "tower hovering in the air"
migdal ha-pore'ach ba-avir
, and the mystery of Yesod. According to Sefer Yetzirah
, Hashem crowned the letter Lamed in cohabitation
tashmish
, tying to it Libra
Moznayim
in the cosmos, Tishrei in the year, and the gall bladder
marah
in the soul. The Talmud and Midrash describe the letter Lamed as a "tower hovering in the air"
Sanhedrin 106b; Aruch, s.v. Migdal; Zohar II, 91a; Zohar Chadash, Shir HaShirim 7a
. The Zohar explains that within this soaring tower dwell the Holy One, blessed be He, and a certain pauper
chad miskena
, serving as the resting place of Rav Hamnuna Saba after his passing
Zohar I, 6a
. In Tikkunei Zohar
Tikkun 21, 52b; Tikkun 55, 92a
, the King's Daughter—Knesset Israel, who is spiritually poor
dalah, Pesachim 118b; Bereishis Rabbah 71:1
—sits atop this tower, and Mashiach himself is called "poor, and riding upon a donkey"
Zechariah 9:9
. The tower is "a tower of strength, the Name of Hashem"
Mishlei 18:10
, personifying Imma Ila'ah
Binah
, while the Daughter dwelling within it is Malchus. Furthermore, the Ari explains in Etz Chaim
Heichal 6, Sha'ar 2, ch. 2
and Likkutei Torah
Vayeshev
that Yesod d'Nukva
and the Yesod of Ze'ir Anpin / Imma
hovers in the air without physical support, embodying "the righteous runs into it and is set on high"
Mishlei 18:10
. This connects directly to Sefer Yetzirah: Hashem crowned the letter Lamed in tashmish, which is the realm of Yesod.

חֹדֶשׁ תִּשְׁרֵי נִבְרָא בְּאוֹת לָמֶ״ד, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר יְצִירָה (פֶּרֶק ה׳ מִשְׁנָה ח׳): ״הִמְלִיךְ אוֹת לָמֶ״ד בְּתַשְׁמִישׁ וְקָשַׁר וְכוּלֵיהּ, מֹאזְנַיִם בָּעוֹלָם, וְתִשְׁרֵי בַּשָּׁנָה, וּמָרָה בַּנֶּפֶשׁ וְכוּלֵיהּ״
The month of Tishrei was created through the letter Lamed

as written in Sefer Yetzirah (5:8): "He crowned the letter Lamed in cohabitation, tied a crown to it, and formed with it Libra in the world, Tishrei in the year, and the gall bladder in the soul, etc.";
וְיָדוּעַ דְּלָמֶ״ד נִקְרָא ״מִגְדָּל הַפּוֹרֵחַ בָּאֲוִיר״ בְּסַנְהֶדְרִין (ק״ו עַמּוּד ב׳) לְלִישָׁנָא קַמָּא דְּרַשִׁ״י שָׁם מִפִּי הַשְּׁמוּעָה, וּבֶ״עָרוּךְ״ עֵרֶךְ ״מִגְדָּל״, יְעוּיַּן שָׁם

and it is known that the letter Lamed is designated "a tower hovering in the air" in Sanhedrin (106b) according to the first phrasing of Rashi there from oral tradition, and in the Aruch under entry Migdal, see there;
וְכֵן הוּא בַּזֹּוהַר יִתְרוֹ (צ״א עַמּוּד א׳), עַיֵּין שָׁם, וּבְזֹוהַר חָדָשׁ שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים (דַּף ז׳ עַמּוּד א׳ דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל ״וּבְסִפְרָא״)
and so it is found in the Zohar (Yisro 91a), see there, and in Zohar Chadash (Shir HaShirim 7a, s.v. U'v'sifra);

וְעַיֵּין בְּהַקְדָּמַת הַזֹּוהַר (ו׳ עַמּוּד א׳): דְּדָיְירִין בְּהַאי מִגְדָּלָא דְּפָרַח בַּאֲוִירָא קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וְחַד מִסְכְּנָא, וְשָׁם בֵּית מוֹתְבָא דְּרַב הַמְנוּנָא סָבָא אַחַר פְּטִירָתוֹ, עַיֵּין שָׁם

and see in the Introduction to the Zohar (6a): that within this tower hovering in the air dwell the Holy One, blessed be He, and a certain pauper, and there was the dwelling place of Rav Hamnuna Saba after his passing, see there;

וּבְתִקּוּנֵי זֹוהַר תִּקּוּן כ״א (נ״ב רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב׳) אִיתָא: ״בְּרַתָּא אִיהִי עַל מִגְדָּלָא דְּפָרַח בַּאֲוִירָא, וּמַכְרְזִין: כָּל מַאן דְּקָטִיל לְחִוְיָא יַהֲבִין לֵיהּ לְאִנְתּוּ וְכוּלֵיהּ״
and in Tikkunei Zohar (Tikkun 21, 52b) it is taught: "The Daughter stands atop the tower hovering in the air, and they proclaim: 'Whoever slays the serpent will be given her as a wife, etc.'";
וְשָׁם תִּקּוּן נ״ה (צ״ב עַמּוּד א׳) אִיתָא: ״לָמֶ״ד — אִימָּא עִילָּאָה, דְּאִיהִי ׳מִגְדַּל עֹז שֵׁם ה׳׳ (מִשְׁלֵי י״ח:י׳)״
and there in Tikkun 55 (92a) it is taught: "Lamed is the Supernal Mother (Imma Ila'ah), who is 'a tower of strength, the Name of Hashem' (Mishlei 18:10)";
נִרְאֶה דִּמְפָרֵשׁ ״מִגְדַּל עֹז וְגוֹמֵר״ אַאוֹתוֹ מִגְדָּל הַפּוֹרֵחַ שֶׁהוּא אוֹת הַלָּמֶ״ד
it appears that the Zohar interprets "a tower of strength, etc." as referring to that soaring tower which is the letter Lamed;
וְשֶׁהַמִּגְדָּל עַצְמוֹ הוּא אִימָּא, וּבְרַתָּא הִיא דָּיְירָא וְיָתְבָא בְּמִגְדָּל זֶה
and that the tower itself is Imma [Binah], while the Daughter (Barta / Malchus) dwells and sits within this tower;

וְהִיא כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת ״דַּלָּה״, כְּמָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּפֶרֶק עַרְבֵי פְסָחִים (פְּסָחִים קי״ח עַמּוּד ב׳) עַל פָּסוּק ״דַּלּוֹתִי״ (תְּהִלִּים קט״ז:ו׳): ״אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁדַּלָּה אֲנִי וְכוּלֵיהּ״
and she is Knesset Israel who is designated "poor" (dalah), as the Sages expounded in Pesachim (118b) on the verse "I was brought low (daloti)": "although I am impoverished in mitzvos, etc.";
וּכְאַאֲמָרָם זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ע״א:י׳): דִּבְכָל מָקוֹם ״עָנִי״ וְ״רָשׁ״ וּ״מִסְכֵּן״ וְכוּלֵיהּ, בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל הַכָּתוּב מְדַבֵּר
and as the Sages of blessed memory stated (Bereishis Rabbah 71:10): everywhere Scripture speaks of the "poor," "destitute," and "pauper" (misken), it refers to Israel;
וְגַם מָשִׁיחַ נִקְרָא: ״עָנִי וְרֹכֵב [עַל חֲמוֹר] וְגוֹמֵר״ (זְכַרְיָה ט:ט), וְהוּא הַשְׁלָמַת כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְזֶהוּ ״חַד מִסְכְּנָא״
and Mashiach too is designated: "poor, and riding upon a donkey, etc." (Zechariah 9:9), he being the ultimate completion of Knesset Israel, and this is the "certain pauper" (chad miskena);
וְעַל כֵּן רַב הַמְנוּנָא סָבָא וְכֵן בְּרֵיהּ [כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּתִקּוּן כ״א שָׁם נ״ב סוֹף עַמּוּד א׳] גַּם כֵּן בֵּית מוֹתָבָם שָׁם
and therefore Rav Hamnuna Saba and likewise his son [as written in Tikkun 21, 52a] have their dwelling place there;
כִּי יֵשׁ לָהֶם שַׁיָּיכוּת עִם נִשְׁמַת מָשִׁיחַ
because they possess an intrinsic connection with the soul of Mashiach;
וְכֵן הוּא שָׁם בְּהַקְדָּמַת הַזֹּוהַר (ז׳ עַמּוּד ב׳): דַּרְאוּהוּ מַנְהִיר שְׁרָגִין בְּהֵיכָלָא דְּמַלְכָּא מְשִׁיחָא
and so it is taught there in the Introduction to the Zohar (7b): that they beheld him kindling lamps in the palace of the King Messiah;
הֲרֵי דְּהָיָה מוֹתָבֵיהּ בְּהֵיכַל הַמָּשִׁיחַ, וְזֶהוּ הַמִּגְדָּל שֶׁאָמַר לָהֶם
behold that his dwelling was in the palace of Mashiach, which is the very tower of which he spoke to them;
וּבַזֹּוהַר שְׁלַח (קס״ד סוֹף עַמּוּד א׳) אִיתָא: ״׳מִגְדַּל עֹז׳ — דָּא כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל״
and in Zohar (Shelach 164a) it is taught: "'A tower of strength'—this is Knesset Israel";
וְכֵן הוּא בְּפָרָשַׁת בְּרֵאשִׁית (ל״ז רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב׳): דְּדָא הוּא ״מִגְדַּל דָּוִד״ (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ד:ד)
and so in Parashat Bereishis (37b): that this is the "tower of David" (Shir HaShirim 4:4);
וְנִרְאֶה דְּאֵינוֹ סְתִירָה, דְּשָׁם מְפָרֵשׁ עַל הַשּׁוֹכֵן בַּמִּגְדָּל
and it appears that this is not a contradiction, for there the text interprets concerning the One who dwells within the tower;
וְכֵן אִיתָא בְּתִקּוּן י״ג (כ״ה עַמּוּד ב׳): ״בְּרַתָּא דְּמַלְכָּא דְּאִיהִי צְלוֹתָא, דְּיָתְבָא עַל מִגְדָּלָא דְּאִתְּמַר בָּהּ ׳מִגְדַּל עֹז וְגוֹמֵר׳״, עַיֵּין שָׁם
and so it is taught in Tikkun 13 (25b): "The Daughter of the King, who is Prayer, who sits atop the tower concerning which it is said: 'a tower of strength, etc.,'" see there;
וְעַיֵּין בְּ״עֵץ חַיִּים״ (הֵיכָל ו׳ שַׁעַר ב׳ פֶּרֶק ב׳): דִּיסוֹד דְּנוּקְבָא פּוֹרֵחַ בָּאֲוִיר וְאֵין לוֹ עַל מַה שֶּׁיִּסְמוֹךְ, יְעוּיַּן שָׁם
and see in Etz Chaim (Heichal 6, Sha'ar 2, ch. 2): that Yesod d'Nukva hovers in the air without anything upon which to lean, see there;
וְהוּא מְכֻוָּון לִלְשׁוֹן הַכָּתוּב: ״בּוֹ יָרוּץ צַדִּיק [וְנִשְׂגָּב]״ (מִשְׁלֵי י״ח:י׳), דְּהַיְינוּ סוֹד דִּזְעֵיר אַנְפִּין וְכַנּוֹדָע
and this aligns with the language of Scripture: "into it the righteous runs, and is set on high" (Mishlei 18:10), which is the mystery of Ze'ir Anpin as is known;

וּבְ״לִקּוּטֵי תּוֹרָה״ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב כָּתַב: כְּבָר בֵּאַרְנוּ עִנְיַן הַיְסוֹד [דִּזְעֵיר אַנְפִּין] שֶׁהוּא סוֹד מִגְדָּל הַפּוֹרֵחַ בָּאֲוִיר שֶׁאֵין לוֹ עַל מַה שֶּׁיִּסְמוֹךְ, עַיֵּין שָׁם

and in Likkutei Torah (Vayeshev) the Ari wrote: we have already explained the concept of Yesod [of Ze'ir Anpin] which is the secret of the tower hovering in the air without anything to lean upon, see there;
נִרְאֶה דְּעַל שֵׁם דְּ״בוֹ יָרוּץ וְגוֹמֵר״ נִקְרָא גַּם הוּא מִגְדָּל וְכוּלֵיהּ
it appears that because "into it the righteous runs," it too is termed a tower;
וְנִרְאֶה דְּגַם אִימָּא דְּאִיהוּ מִגְדָּל וְכוּלֵיהּ הַיְינוּ יְסוֹד דְּאִימָּא, וְכָל יְסוֹד נִקְרָא כֵּן
and it appears that Imma being termed a tower likewise refers to Yesod d'Imma, every Yesod being designated thus;
וְזֶהוּ: ״הִמְלִיךְ אוֹת לָמֶ״ד בְּתַשְׁמִישׁ״, שֶׁהוּא בִּיסוֹד:
and this is: "He crowned the letter Lamed in cohabitation," which operates within Yesod.

12.h: The theme: Letters as stones and words as houses; the straight line of scored parchment (sirtut) versus the ascending tower of the letter Lamed. Sefer Yetzirah (4:16) calls letters "stones" (avanim) and words formed from them "houses" (batim), representing permanent edifices founded on truth ("the lip of truth shall be established forever", Mishlei 12:19). For this reason, Megillah (16b) mandates that a scribe score lines (sirtut) on parchment like the truth of the Torah, comparing script lines to a masonry wall built like a brick over a half-brick (ari'ach al gabei l'veinah). A line is called a shurah, related to shura (a stone wall), requiring scored straightness so that no letter protrudes or recedes, which would reduce the writing to a fragile, portable object. All standard letters are anchored at the top by the scored upper line (sirtut), whereas their bottom length need not align, reflecting the fact that the Torah’s eternal permanence derives from its divine Source Above, while the recipients below vary across Space, Time, and Soul. The letter Lamed is the unique exception: its lower base rests within the scored line, but its neck and roof (gag) ascend and pierce above the sirtut, wherefore it is termed a "tower" (migdal) rather than a stone or house. Unlike crowns and tagin which are external additions to the head, the soaring roof of the Lamed is the very body of the letter itself, rendering it intrinsically free of upper boundary, "hovering in the air."
