and regarding this it was taught in the Tikkunim (Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 21, 50a): that they bark like dogs, crying: "Give us food, give us life!";
הַיְינוּ שֶׁלֹּא יִקְרָאוּהוּ בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְכֹחַ הַתּוֹרָה דְּאָז הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ מוּכָן לָתֵת
meaning when they do not call upon Him in truth through the power of Torah, at which level the Blessed Name is ever prepared to bestow;
רַק בָּאִים בְּטַעֲנָה ״פַּרְנְסֵנִי כְּכֶלֶב״ אַף שֶׁאֵינוֹ כְּדַאי
but come merely with the desperate plea: "feed me like a dog," even though undeserving;
וְהֲגַם שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ נוֹתֵן גַּם לָזֶה בְּכֹחַ הַתְּפִלָּה דְּעָנִי דִּמְעַטְּפָא כָּל צְלוֹתִין
and even though the Blessed Name provides even unto this petition through the power of the pauper's prayer that wraps all prayers;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ רוֹצֶה וּמִשְׁתּוֹקֵק שֶׁנִּהְיֶה בְּתַכְלִית הַשְּׁלֵימוּת כִּרְצוֹנוֹ
nevertheless the Blessed Name desires and yearns that we exist in absolute perfection according to His will;
כִּי ״אֲנִי ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְלַמֶּדְךָ לְהוֹעִיל [מַדְרִיכֲךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ תֵּלֵךְ]״ (יְשַׁעְיָה מ״ח:י״ז), בְּתַכְלִית הָעִלּוּי
for "I am Hashem your God Who teaches you for your profit" (Yeshayah 48:17), to elevate man unto the highest summit;
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם גַּם בְּעֵת הָעֲנִיּוּת הוּא הָעוֹזֵר וּמוֹשִׁיעַ בִּישׁוּעָה שְׁלֵימָה
and nevertheless even in the hour of poverty He helps and delivers in consummate salvation;
וְהוּא הַיְשׁוּעָה דְּלֶחֶם עוֹנִי דְּפֶסַח, שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ טַעַם מָן שֶׁהוּא ״לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים״ (תְּהִלִּים ע״ח:כ״ה), לֶחֶם שֶׁל מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת (יוֹמָא ע״ה עַמּוּד ב׳)
this being the salvation of the "bread of poverty" on Pesach, which contains the taste of Manna, the "bread of the mighty" (Tehillim 78:25), the bread consumed by ministering angels (Yoma 75b).
וְאַחַר כָּךְ בְּשָׁבוּעוֹת זוֹכִין לַעֲשִׁירוּת דְּתוֹרָה, וּמַתְחִיל אָז זְמַן הַשִּׂמְחָה וַאֲסִיפַת הָרְכוּשׁ
And afterward on Shavuot Israel merits the sublime wealth of Torah, and then commences the season of joy and the gathering of spiritual wealth;
דְּ״מֵעֲצֶרֶת וְעַד הֶחָג [סֻכּוֹת] — מֵבִיא וְקוֹרֵא״ (בִּכּוּרִים פֶּרֶק א׳ מִשְׁנָה ו׳)
for "from Atzeret [Shavuot] until the Feast [Succos] one brings the First Fruits and recites the declaration" (Bikkurim 1:6);
וּשְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם מַתִּירִין הֲבָאַת בִּכּוּרִים (מְנָחוֹת פ״ד עַמּוּד ב׳)
and the Two Loaves offering permits the presentation of the First Fruits (Menachos 84b);
וְעַל כֵּן מִתְבָּרְכִים עַל יָדָם פֵּירוֹת הָאִילָן, כִּדְפֵירֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה (ט״ז סוֹף עַמּוּד א׳)
wherefore through them the fruits of the tree are blessed, as Rashi explained in Rosh Hashanah (16a);
וְהַיְינוּ דְּהֵם רוֹמְזוֹת לַתּוֹרָה: ״לְכוּ לַחֲמוּ בְלַחֲמִי״ (מִשְׁלֵי ט:ה), שֶׁהוּא ״לֶחֶם מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם״
meaning that the loaves allude to the Torah: "Come, eat of my bread" (Mishlei 9:5), which is bread from heaven;
וְהֵם שְׁנַיִם נֶגֶד תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וְשֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and they are two loaves corresponding to the Written Torah and the Oral Torah;
דְּגַם תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה הוּא ״לֶחֶם מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם״
for the Oral Torah is likewise bread from heaven;
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרֵישׁ חֲגִיגָה (ג׳ עַמּוּד ב׳): ״כּוּלָּם מֵרוֹעֶה אֶחָד נִתָּנוּ״ (קֹהֶלֶת י״ב:י״א), דְּהַכֹּל מִסִּינַי
as written in Chagigah (3b): "they are all given from one Shepherd" (Koheles 12:11), all having been given at Sinai;
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּבְרָכוֹת (ה׳ עַמּוּד א׳) וּבְכַמָּה דּוּכְתֵּי
and as written in Berachos (5a) and numerous passages.
וְהַתּוֹרָה הוּא עֵץ הַחַיִּים שֶׁבְּתוֹךְ הַגָּן
And the Torah is the Tree of Life in the midst of the Garden (Bereishis 2:9);
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּתַנָּא דְּבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ רַבָּה פֶּרֶק א׳ וּבְכַמָּה דּוּכְתֵּי
as written in Tanna D'vei Eliyahu Rabbah (ch. 1) and many places;
בִּנְקֻדַּת הַמֶּרְכָּז שֶׁכָּל עֲצֵי הַגָּן יוֹנְקִים
positioned at the exact central nexus from which all trees of the Garden nurse;
וְעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע שֶׁנִּזְכַּר בַּכָּתוּב עִמּוֹ, נִרְאֶה דְּהוּא עוֹמֵד סָמוּךְ לוֹ מַמָּשׁ גַּם כֵּן בָּאֶמְצַע
and the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil mentioned in Scripture alongside it, appears to stand directly adjacent to it likewise in the center;
שֶׁכָּל הָעֵצִים יוֹנְקִים גַּם מִמֶּנּוּ
so that all trees draw sustenance from it as well;
כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת כּוּלּוֹ חַד
for in truth all was originally one;
וְאִלְמָלֵא חָטָא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן הָיָה גַּם הוּא נֶהְפָּךְ לִהְיוֹת עֵץ הַחַיִּים, שֶׁהָיָה נִכְלֶה הָרָע לְגַמְרֵי מֵהָעוֹלָם
and had Adam HaRishon not sinned, the Tree of Knowledge would have been transformed into the Tree of Life, evil being completely eradicated from the world;
וְעַל יְדֵי חֶטְאוֹ נִתְהַפֵּךְ גַּם עֵץ הַחַיִּים דְּתוֹרָה לִהְיוֹת מִסִּטְרָא דְּעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע
and through his sin, even the Tree of Life of the Torah was inverted to function from the side of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil:
כָּשֵׁר וּפָסוּל, טָמֵא וְטָהוֹר וְכוּלֵיהּ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּתִּקּוּנִים (רֵישׁ תִּקּוּנֵי זֹוהַר)
determining what is fit and unfit, defiled and pure, as written in the Tikkunim (Tikkunei Zohar 17a).
וְנִרְאֶה לִי דְּהֵם נֶגֶד תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וְשֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And it appears to me that these two trees correspond to the Written Torah and the Oral Torah:
וְאִלְמָלֵי חָטָא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, הָיָה הַכֹּל ״בִּכְתָב מִיַּד ה׳ עָלָיו הִשְׂכִּיל״ (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כ״ח:י״ט), וְלֹא צָרִיךְ לְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and had Adam HaRishon not sinned, all divine revelation would have been "in writing by His hand upon him He made him understand" (I Divrei HaYamim 28:19), without any need for an Oral Torah;

וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּנְדָרִים (כ״ב עַמּוּד ב׳): ״אִלְמָלֵא [חָטְאוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל] לֹא נִיתַּן לָהֶם אֶלָּא חֲמִשָּׁה חֻמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה וְסֵפֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּלְבַד, שֶׁעֶרְכָּהּ שֶׁל אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא״

as the Sages stated in Nedarim (22b): "Had Israel not sinned, they would have been given only the Five Books of the Torah and the Book of Joshua, which delineates the territories of the Land of Israel";
הַיְינוּ נֶגֶד תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה כּוּלָּהּ הָיָה דַּי סֵפֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ
meaning that countering the entire Oral Torah the Book of Yehoshua would have sufficed;
שֶׁבִּגְבוּלוֹת הָאָרֶץ שֶׁבּוֹ, שֶׁהוּא סִדְרֵי הָאָרֶץ הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה, נִכְלַל כָּל סִדְרֵי אֶרֶץ הָעֶלְיוֹנָה שֶׁהוּא שׁוֹרֶשׁ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה כַּנּוֹדָע
for within the boundaries of the Land delineated therein (the order of the lower earth) is encompassed the entire order of the Supernal Land, the root of the Oral Torah;
וְזֶה הָיָה אַחַר גֵּירוּשׁ אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן מִגַּן עֵדֶן
this applying after Adam was expelled from the Garden of Eden;
וְיִשְׂרָאֵל תִּיקְּנוּ חֶטְאוֹ בְּמַתַּן תּוֹרָה וְקַבָּלַת הַלּוּחוֹת שֶׁהָיוּ אָז חֵירוּת מִמַּלְאַךְ הַמָּוֶת (עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה ה׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
and Israel rectified his sin at Mount Sinai upon receiving the Tablets, attaining freedom from the Angel of Death (Avodah Zarah 5a);
וְזָכוּ לְנַחֲלַת הָאָרֶץ תְּמוּרַת הַגָּן, וְהָיוּ צְרִיכִים לְסֵפֶר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ
meriting the inheritance of the Land in place of the Garden, requiring the Book of Yehoshua;
וְאַלְמָלֵא חָטָא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן הָיוּ הַגָּן תְּמוּרַת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל
while had Adam never sinned, the Garden itself would have stood in place of the Land of Israel;
וּבִמְקוֹם צֵירוּפֵי הָאוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁבַּתּוֹרָה מֵחֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, הָיָה צֵירוּפִים מִסִּדְרֵי עֲצֵי הַגָּן
and instead of the textual permutations of letters reflecting post-sin realities, the permutations would have mirrored the arrangements of the trees of the Garden;
וְ״כָתְנוֹת אוֹר״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה כ:יב) תַּחַת ״כָּתְנוֹת עוֹר״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג:כא), וְהָיָה הַכֹּל בְּתוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב:
wearing "garments of light" (or with an Aleph) instead of "garments of skin" (or with an Ayin), and all would have been revealed directly within the Written Torah!
The theme: The future absorption of the Oral Torah into the Written Torah, the Two Loaves as wheat/tree
Chitah
, and the generation of souls. Throughout history, the Oral Torah is revealed incrementally through the Sages until Mashiach, when death is swallowed up forever
Yeshayah 25:8

. In the Future, the yetzer hara and the seed of Amalek will be destroyed, returning the world to the state before the Fall, where the entire Oral Torah is re-absorbed into the Written Torah. Then "they shall teach no more every man his neighbor... for they shall all know Me"
Yirmiyah 31:33

, grasping all wisdom directly from the written text without needing master-disciple instruction. At Sinai, Israel heard the first two commandments directly from the Almighty, but shrank back in fear of death
"speak you with us... lest we die", Shemos 20:16

, missing the opportunity to enter Gan Eden alive. The first two commandments contain both Torahs: Anochi is the Written Torah, while Lo Yihyeh Lecha—addressing the presence of alien gods and evil—necessitated the Oral Torah to extract the light from darkness. The Two Loaves are brought from wheat
Chitah, חִטָּה = 22
, corresponding to the 22 letters of the Torah. According to Rabbi Yehudah
Berachos 40a
, the Tree of Knowledge was wheat; on Shavuot, wheat returns to the status of a fruit tree, turning the Tree of Knowledge back into the Tree of Life. Through the Two Loaves, the blessing of children
banei

is channeled: souls are hewn from the Torah, their generational renewal matching the renewal of the Oral Torah in each era. Had Israel not sinned at Sinai, all future souls would have been revealed simultaneously in the Patriarchs without successive generations.
וְכָךְ יִהְיֶה לֶעָתִיד
And so will it be in the Future:
דְּכָל יְמֵי עוֹלָם הַזֶּה הוּא הַזְּמַן שֶׁל הִתְגַּלּוּת כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה בִּשְׁלֵימוּת עַל יְדֵי חַכְמֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבְּכָל דּוֹר
that all the days of this world are the appointed era for the revelation of the entire Oral Torah in its fullness through the sages of Israel in each generation;
כָּל אֶחָד הַשַּׁיָּיךְ לְחֶלְקוֹ עַד דּוֹרוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ, שֶׁאָז יִתְגַּלֶּה הַכֹּל וּ״בֻלַּע הַמָּוֶת לָנֶצַח״ (יְשַׁעְיָה כ״ה:ח׳)
each master revealing the insight belonging to his share until the generation of Mashiach, when all will be revealed and "He will swallow up death forever" (Yeshayah 25:8);
לֹא כִּבְמַתַּן תּוֹרָה שֶׁהָיָה רַק לְשָׁעָה שֶׁהָיָה אֶפְשָׁר לְהִתְקַלְקֵל אַחַר כָּךְ עַל יְדֵי הַחֵטְא
not like at the Giving of the Torah where perfection was temporary, susceptible to subsequent corruption through sin;
אֲבָל אָז לֹא יִתְקַלְקֵל עוֹד, כִּי יְבוּטַּל הַיֵּצֶר רָע וְכָל סִטְרָא דְּרָע וְזַרְעוֹ שֶׁל עֲמָלֵק מִן הָעוֹלָם
but then it will never be corrupted again, for the yetzer hara, all forces of evil, and the seed of Amalek will be obliterated from the world;
וְאָז יָשׁוּב הָעוֹלָם לִגְמַר תִּיקּוּנוֹ כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיָה קוֹדֶם חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן
and then the world will return to its absolute completion as it was prior to the sin of Adam HaRishon;
וְיוּכְלַל כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה בַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב
and the entire Oral Torah will be integrated into the Written Torah;
כִּי יִתְגַּלֶּה לַכֹּל הָאוֹר שֶׁבַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב, אֵיךְ כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה גַּם כֵּן כְּלוּלָה שָׁם
for the inner light of the Written Torah will be revealed to all, demonstrating how the entire Oral Law is explicitly contained therein;
וְעַל כֵּן: ״וְלֹא יְלַמְּדוּ עוֹד אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ... כִּי כוּלָּם יֵדְעוּ [אוֹתִי לְמִקְּטַנָּם וְעַד גְּדוֹלָם נְאֻם ה׳]״ (יִרְמְיָה ל״א:ל״ג)
wherefore: "and they shall teach no more every man his neighbor... for they shall all know Me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, says Hashem" (Yirmiyah 31:33);
הַכֹּל מֵהַתּוֹרָה דִּכְתִיבָא וּמַנָּחָא, דְּלֹא יִצְטָרְכוּ לְלִימּוּד שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה תַּלְמִיד מֵרַב
all wisdom being derived directly from the Written Torah laid open, without requiring oral instruction of disciple from master.
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בְּשָׁבוּעוֹת שֶׁהָיָה מַתַּן תּוֹרָה עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּלְמִידָיו
This was not so at Shavuot where the Torah was given through Moshe Rabbeinu, all Israel being his disciples;

וְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ רָצָה שֶׁיִּהְיֶה אָז תַּכְלִית הַשְּׁלֵימוּת בִּשְׁתֵּי דִּבְּרוֹת רִאשׁוֹנוֹת שֶׁשָּׁמְעוּ מִפִּי הַגְּבוּרָה, וְלֹא יִצְטָרְכוּ לְמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם וְכַלֶּעָתִיד דְּ״לֹא יְלַמְּדוּ וְגוֹמֵר״
the Blessed Name having desired that consummate perfection occur then through the first two commandments heard from the mouth of the Almighty, without needing Moshe, as in the Future;
אֶלָּא שֶׁלֹּא הִגִּיעוּ אָז עַדַיִין לְמַדְרֵגָה זוֹ, וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לִסְבּוֹל זֶה, וְאָמְרוּ: ״דַּבֵּר אַתָּה [עִמָּנוּ וְנִשְׁמָעָה]... פֶּן נָמוּת״ (שְׁמוֹת כ:טז)
but they had not yet attained that spiritual rung and could not bear it, pleading: "Speak you with us, and we will hear... lest we die" (Shemos 20:16);
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת עַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיוּ זוֹכִים לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם
even though in truth through hearing directly they would have merited eternal life;
רַק זֶה הוּא אַתְחַלְתָּא דְּחֵטְא שֶׁמִּצַּד הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה עָלְמָא דְּשִׁקְרָא הַמַּרְאֶה הַכֹּל הֵיפֶךְ הָאֱמֶת
this being the first onset of sin born of this world of falsehood which portrays everything in reverse of the truth;
וּבִמְקוֹם הַחַיִּים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים הָיָה אֶצְלָם פַּחַד הַמָּוֶת
so that in place of authentic life they experienced the terror of death;
וְהֲגַם דְּמִצַּד הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה הָיָה זֶה בֶּאֱמֶת מִיתָה
and although from the perspective of this earthly world it was indeed death;
כִּי וַדַּאי הָיָה זֶה מִיתָה לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם הַזֶּה כְּשֶׁהָיוּ זוֹכִים לְתַכְלִית הַתִּיקּוּן וְלִיכָּנֵס לְגַן עֵדֶן מִיָּד בְּחַיֵּיהֶם הַנִּבְרָא לְמִשְׁכַּן הָאָדָם
for it would have been the death of mortal bodily life, meriting the ultimate rectification of entering Gan Eden alive, the true dwelling of Man;
דַּהֲרֵי הָיוּ נֶעְדָּרִים מֵעוֹלָם הַזֶּה אֲבָל הָיוּ זוֹכִים לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם
departing this world to inherit eternal life;
אֶלָּא שֶׁלֹּא הִגִּיעַ הַזְּמַן וְלֹא זָכוּ עַדַיִין לִהְיוֹת אוֹר זֶה נִקְבָּע בִּקְבִיעוּת בַּלֵּב דֶּרֶךְ קִנְיָן
but the appointed hour had not arrived, they having not yet merited that this light be permanently acquired within their hearts;
אֲבָל מִכָּל מָקוֹם הָיָה אַתְחַלְתָּא, שֶׁעַל כָּל פָּנִים כְּבָר זָכוּ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנַפְשׁוֹת כָּל הַדּוֹרוֹת הָעֲתִידִים לָבוֹא שֶׁהָיוּ גַּם כֵּן בְּאוֹתוֹ מַעֲמָד
yet it was an eternal inception, all Israel and the souls of all future generations present there meriting;
זָכוּ כוּלָּם לִשְׁמוֹעַ שְׁתֵּי דִּבְּרוֹת מִפִּי הַגְּבוּרָה וְלִנְבוּאָה גְּמוּרָה כִּנְבוּאַת מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
meriting to hear the first two commandments from the mouth of the Almighty in consummate prophecy like the prophecy of Moshe Rabbeinu.
וּבִב׳ דִּבְּרוֹת אֵלּוּ כְּלוּלִים שְׁתֵּי הַתּוֹרוֹת: שֶׁבִּכְתָב וּבְעַל פֶּה, שֶׁהֵם נֶגֶד ״אָנֹכִי״ וְ״לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ״ (שְׁמוֹת כ:ב–ג)
And within these two commandments are contained the two Torahs, Written and Oral, corresponding to Anochi and Lo Yihyeh Lecha (Shemos 20:2–3);
כִּי מִצַּד ״לֹא יִהְיֶה לְךָ״ שֶׁיֵּשׁ עַדַיִין מְצִיאוּת אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְסִטְרָא דְּרָע
for from Lo Yihyeh Lecha, acknowledging the enduring presence of idolatry and evil;
עַל יְדֵי זֶה הוּא הַצֹּרֶךְ לְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
through this arises the necessity for the Oral Torah;

וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְכָל אֶחָד לְהַכִּיר הָאוֹר שֶׁבַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב, שֶׁהוּא הָאוֹר דְּשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁנִּגְנַז בַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁאָדָם צוֹפֶה בּוֹ מִסּוֹף עוֹלָם וְעַד סוֹפוֹ, אֶלָּא שֶׁהוּא גָּנוּז וּבְהֶעְלֵם
it being impossible for everyone to perceive the primordial light hidden in the Written Torah through which man gazes from one end of the universe to the other, it being veiled;
וְעַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה מוֹצִיאִין מֵהַהֶעְלֵם לַגִּילּוּי מְעַט מְעַט
and through the Oral Torah scholars extract it from concealment into revelation little by little.
וְזֶהוּ שְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם מֵחִטָּה כַּנּוֹדָע, דְּהוּא בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא כַּ״ב (חִטָּה = 22) נֶגֶד כַּ״ב אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה
And this is the Two Loaves brought from wheat (Chitah,
corresponding to the twenty-two letters of the Torah;
וְעַל כֵּן לֶעָתִיד עֲתִידָה שֶׁתִּתַּמֵּר כְּדֶקֶל, כְּמָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ סוֹף כְּתוּבּוֹת (קי״א עַמּוּד ב׳)
wherefore in the Future wheat is destined to soar high like a palm tree, as the Sages stated at the end of Kesubos (111b);
לֹא כְּמוֹ עַתָּה שֶׁאוֹרָהּ נֶעְלָם עֲדַיִין
unlike now where its celestial light is concealed;
וְכָךְ הָיָה קוֹדֶם הַחֵטְא, דְּעַל כֵּן סְבִירָא לֵיהּ לְרַבִּי יְהוּדָה (בְּרָכוֹת מ׳ עַמּוּד א׳): ״דְּעֵץ הַדַּעַת — חִטָּה הָיָה״, דְּאָז הָיָה מִין עֵץ
and so it was before the Fall, wherefore Rabbi Yehudah holds (Berachos 40a): "the Tree of Knowledge was wheat," it having been a fruit tree;
וּבְשָׁבוּעוֹת חוֹזֵר לִהְיוֹת מִין עֵץ
and on Shavuot it returns to the status of a fruit tree;
כִּי אָז מִתְעוֹרֵר בְּכָל שָׁנָה אוֹתוֹ אוֹר שֶׁהָיָה בִּשְׁעַת מַתַּן תּוֹרָה בִּשְׁתֵּי דִּבְּרוֹת רִאשׁוֹנוֹת שֶׁהָיָה אַתְחַלְתָּא דְּתִיקּוּן דְּלֶעָתִיד
for then awakens annually that light present at Sinai during the first two commandments, which was the prototype of the future rectification;
שֶׁמִּכֹּחָם הוּא קְדֻשַּׁת שְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם
from whose energy issues the sanctity of the Two Loaves;
וְעַל כֵּן הֵם הַמַּמְשִׁיכִים בְּרָכָה לְפֵירוֹת הָאִילָן שֶׁכּוּלָּם יוֹנְקִים מֵעֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע
wherefore they channel blessing unto the fruits of the tree which all draw sustenance from the Tree of Knowledge;
וְעַל יְדֵי שְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם הוּא כֹּחַ הַהִתְהַפְּכוּת עֵץ הַדַּעַת לְעֵץ הַחַיִּים
and through the Two Loaves is imparted the power to transform the Tree of Knowledge into the Tree of Life;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הוּא הַמְשָׁכַת שֶׁפַע ״בָּנֵי״
and through this is drawn down the blessing of children (banei).
כִּי אָמְרוּ בַּעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה (ה׳ עַמּוּד א׳): ״אִלְמָלֵא לֹא חָטְאוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל... לֹא בָּאנוּ לָעוֹלָם״, וּמַסִּיק: ״כְּמִי שֶׁלֹּא בָּאנוּ לָעוֹלָם״
For the Sages stated in Avodah Zarah (5a): "Had our ancestors not sinned, we would not have come into the world," concluding: "we would have been as though we had not come into the world";

הַיְינוּ דְּכָל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל שָׁרְשָׁם בַּתּוֹרָה, וּכְפִי הִתְחַדְּשׁוּת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה שֶׁבְּלֵב חַכְמֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר, כָּךְ הִתְחַדְּשׁוּת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר
meaning that all souls of Israel are rooted in the Torah, and according to the renewal of the Oral Torah in the hearts of the Sages in each generation, so is the generational renewal of souls;

וְאִם זָכוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁהָיָה הַכֹּל גָּלוּי בַּתּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב לְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְהָיוּ מַשִּׂיגִים כּוּלָּם כָּל הַהִתְחַדְּשׁוּת דְּדוֹרוֹת הָעֲתִידוֹת, לֹא הָיָה מָקוֹם לְהִתְחַדְּשׁוּת נְפָשׁוֹת
and had our ancestors merited that all be openly revealed in the Written Torah, grasping all future insights, there would have been no space for the progressive renewal of souls;
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמִּכָּל מָקוֹם הָיָה יְצִיאַת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת לְפֹעַל בָּעוֹלָם, מִכָּל מָקוֹם הוּא ״כְּמִי שֶׁלֹּא בָּאנוּ״
and though souls would still have emerged into the world, it would have been "as though we had not come";
כִּי כָּךְ כְּבָר הַכֹּל כָּלוּל בְּפֹעַל גָּלוּי לַכֹּל בָּאָבוֹת גַּם כֵּן וְאֵין שׁוּם הִתְחַדְּשׁוּת:
for all would already have been manifest openly in the Patriarchs, with no further novelty remaining!

15.h: The theme: Shavuot awakening the concealed light of future generations, childlessness as a spiritual impediment, and the atonement of Yom Kippur leading to Succos. On Shavuot, the light of the future Written Torah awakens in every Jew, allowing him to perceive the root of the Torah insights destined to be revealed through his descendants. No man was created incapable of fathering offspring, for "He created it not a waste, He formed it to be inhabited" (Yeshayah 45:18). Even a congenital eunuch (saris chamah) reflects merely the post-sin brokenness of this world; according to the pristine divine design, reproductive organs were formed for procreation, as Hannah argued regarding her breasts (Berachos 31b). Avraham and Sarah were initially sexually undeveloped (tumtumim, Yevamos 64a), rectifying the Fall of Adam and Chavah (the Serpent's defilement and Adam's 130 years of producing demons); once rectified, they bore Yitzchak. A childless man suffers from an impediment in his present body, in a past reincarnation, or in his root in Adam, preventing the souls of his descendants from emerging. On Shavuot, through grasping the hidden light of the Oral Torah destined to emerge through his lineage, this root is awakened in his heart, drawing it from potentiality into physical birth. This spiritual inception begins on Shavuot (the state before sin) and culminates on Yom Kippur (the atonement after sin). On Yom Kippur, the scapegoat is dispatched to Azazel, atoning for Uzza and Azael and the blemishes of the covenant (the strike against Yaakov's hip), enabling Israel to journey to Succos—"the season of our gladness"—for all sorrow in this world stems from blemishes of the covenant which extinguish holy joy.

p: וּבְכָל שָׁבוּעוֹת מִתְעוֹרֵר אוֹר זֶה דְּהַשָּׂגַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב עַל הַשְּׁלֵימוּת כַּלֶּעָתִיד
And on every Shavuot there awakens this light of grasping the Written Torah in consummate perfection as in the Future;
הַיְינוּ שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד מַשִּׂיג שׁוֹרֶשׁ הָאוֹר תּוֹרָה הַנֶּעְלָם לְעֵת עַתָּה, וְעָתִיד לְהִתְגַּלּוֹת עֲדַיִין בַּדּוֹרוֹת הַבָּאִים אֵצֶל כָּל אֶחָד בְּזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו
meaning that each Jew grasps the root of the Torah light currently concealed, destined to be revealed in future generations within his own offspring;
כִּי אֵין לְךָ אָדָם שֶׁאֵין מוּכָן לְהוֹלִיד זֶרַע, דְּ״לֹא תֹהוּ בְרָאָהּ [לָשֶׁבֶת יְצָרָהּ]״ (יְשַׁעְיָה מ״ה:י״ח)
for there is no human being who was not created equipped to bear seed, for "He created it not a waste, He formed it to be inhabited" (Yeshayah 45:18);
וַאֲפִילּוּ הַסָּרִיס חַמָּה שֶׁאֵין לוֹ רְפוּאָה וְהוּא בַּתּוֹלָדָה כֵּן
and even a congenital eunuch (saris chamah) who has no medical cure and was born thus;
הַיְינוּ רַק מִצַּד טֶבַע הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה כְּפִי הַקִּלְקוּלִים שֶׁבּוֹ
this reflects merely the impaired nature of this world according to the corruptions within it;
אֲבָל כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁ״הָאֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֶת הָאָדָם יָשָׁר״ (קֹהֶלֶת ז:כט) שֶׁאֵין שׁוּם קִלְקוּל, אֵין רָאוּי לְשׁוּם בְּרִיָּה לָצֵאת מֵהַצּוּרָה וְהַתַּכְלִית שֶׁנִּבְרֵאת לוֹ
but according to the pristine design wherein "God made man upright" without defect, no creature was meant to depart from its purposeful form;
וּמְכֻוָּון הַבְּרִיאָה הוּא לִפְרוֹת וְלִרְבּוֹת וּלְהוֹלִיד בְּדוֹמֶה, שֶׁעַל זֶה נִבְרְאוּ אֵבְרֵי הַהוֹלָדָה
the purpose of Creation being to be fruitful and multiply, for which reproductive organs were fashioned;
וְכִטְעָנַת חַנָּה: ״דַּדִּים הַלָּלוּ שֶׁבָּרָאתָ בִּי... לֹא לְהָנִיק בָּהֶם״ (בְּרָכוֹת ל״א עַמּוּד ב׳)
as Hannah argued: "These breasts which You created in me... are they not to suckle therewith?" (Berachos 31b);
וְדִבְּרָה לָשׁוֹן נְקִיָּה, וְכָלְלָה בָּזֶה גַּם כֵּן אֵבְרֵי הַהוֹלָדָה
she speaking euphemistically, encompassing thereby the reproductive organs as well.
וְאַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה מְטוּמְטָמִים הָיוּ (יְבָמוֹת ס״ד עַמּוּד א׳)
And Avraham and Sarah were originally sexually undeveloped (tumtumim, Yevamos 64a);
כִּי הֵם הָיוּ הַתְחָלַת תִּיקּוּן חֵטְא אָדָם וְחַוָּה
because they initiated the rectification of the Fall of Adam and Chavah;

וְנוֹצְרוּ כְּפִי הַקִּלְקוּל שֶׁל חֶטְאָם: בְּבִיאַת נָחָשׁ עַל חַוָּה (שַׁבָּת קמ״ו עַמּוּד ב׳), וְהוֹלָדַת אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן רוּחִין שֵׁדִין וְלִילִין אוֹתָן מֵאָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה (עֵירוּבִין י״ח עַמּוּד ב׳)
having been fashioned according to the blemish of that sin: the Serpent's cohabitation with Chavah (Shabbat 146b) and Adam fathering spirits and demons for 130 years (Eruvin 18b);
לִהְיוֹת טוּמְטוּמִים לְעֹונֶשׁ זֶה
being sealed as tumtumim in punishment for this;
וְאַחַר שֶׁתִּיקְּנוּ מַה שֶּׁהָיָה לָהֶם לְתַקֵּן, זָכוּ גַּם הֵם לְהוֹלִיד
and once they rectified what was incumbent upon them to repair, they merited to give birth;
וְכָךְ כָּל אִישׁ חֲשׂוּךְ בָּנִים הוּא מִצַּד אֵיזֶה חֵטְא שֶׁלּוֹ בְּאוֹתוֹ גּוּף
and so any childless man suffers from some spiritual obstruction in his present body,
[אוֹ בְּגִלְגּוּל קוֹדֵם, אוֹ בְּאֵיפָה שֶׁלּוֹ בְּאָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן אִם הוּא סָרִיס בַּתּוֹלָדָה וְטוּמְטוּם וְכַיּוֹצֵא בוֹ שֶׁזֶּה מוֹרֶה עַל חִסָּרוֹן שֶׁבַּתּוֹלָדָה
[or in a previous incarnation, or within his root in Adam HaRishon if born a congenital eunuch or tumtum;
אֲבָל כְּשֶׁאֵינוֹ סָרִיס בַּתּוֹלָדָה, וַדַּאי הוּא מִפְּנֵי חֵטְא עַצְמוֹ]
but when not congenitally sterile, it is certainly due to his personal sin];
שֶׁאֵין מַנִּיחַ לְהִתְגַּלּוֹת אוֹר נַפְשׁוֹת הַבָּנִים צֶאֱצָאָיו וְצֶאֱצָאֵי צֶאֱצָאָיו הַכְּלוּלִים בּוֹ בְּכָל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
preventing the revelation of the souls of the children and descendants encompassed within every Jew;
כִּי לְעוֹלָם נַפְשׁוֹת הַבָּנִים כְּלוּלִים בָּאָבוֹת, אֶלָּא שֶׁהֵם בְּהֶעְלֵם עָצוּם
for the souls of children are eternally contained within their fathers, albeit in deep concealment.
וְעַל יְדֵי הַשָּׂגַת הָאוֹר דְּשָׁבוּעוֹת, שֶׁהוּא הִתְגַּלּוּת אוֹתוֹ הָאוֹר הַגָּנוּז בְּהֶעְלֵם מִנַּפְשׁוֹת דּוֹרוֹתָיו שֶׁהֵם אוֹרוֹת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה שֶׁיִּתְגַּלֶּה עַל יְדֵיהֶם
And through grasping the light of Shavuot, which reveals that hidden light of future generations and the Oral Torah destined to emerge through them;
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁעֲדַיִין הוּא בְּהֶעְלֵם עָצוּם שֶׁהֲרֵי לֹא נִגְלָה בְּפֹעַל כְּלָל
even though it is still deeply concealed, not yet having materialized in deed;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם הוּא אַתְחַלְתָּא דְּהִתְגַּלּוּת, וְנִתְעוֹרֵר הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ הַזֶּה שֶׁל הַהִתְגַּלּוּת לְהָאִיר בַּלֵּב
nevertheless it marks the inception of revelation, awakening this root to illuminate the heart;
וּמִמֵּילָא יוּכַל לִמְשׁוֹךְ עַל יְדֵי זֶה שֶׁפַע הַהִתְגַּלּוּת לָצֵאת מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפּוֹעַל גָּמוּר בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
enabling one to channel this influx from potentiality into physical actuality in this world,
בְּהוֹלָדַת זֶרַע לְמִינֵהוּ שֶׁל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת וְאוֹרוֹת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה הַגְּנוּזִים בּוֹ
fathering physical offspring who embody these souls and the novellae of the Oral Torah concealed within him;
וְהַתְחָלַת אַתְחַלְתָּא זוֹ הוּא בְּשָׁבוּעוֹת, וְהוּא הַהַתְחָלָה שֶׁקּוֹדֶם הַחֵטְא
and the initial start of this process occurs on Shavuot, reflecting the state before the Fall;
וּגְמָרָהּ בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, שֶׁהוּא הַתִּיקּוּן שֶׁאַחַר הַחֵטְא שֶׁנִּתְכַּפֵּר הַכֹּל
and its completion unfolds on Yom Kippur, the rectification following the Fall where all is forgiven;
וְשָׁב לִכְמוֹת שֶׁהָיָה קוֹדֶם הַחֵטְא וּכְמִי שֶׁלֹּא חָטָא, וְנִגְמַר אָז הָאַתְחַלְתָּא דְּשָׁבוּעוֹת
returning to the state before sin as if one had never transgressed, completing the inception of Shavuot.
וְאָז נִפְרַד עֵשָׂו מֵהֶם לְדַרְכּוֹ: ״שְׂעִירָה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל״ג:ט״ז), לַעֲזָאזֵל הַמִּדְבָּרָה (וַיִּקְרָא ט״ז:כ״א)
And then Esav separates from Israel to his own path: "unto Seir" (Bereishis 33:16), to Azazel in the wilderness (Vayikra 16:21);
וּמְכַפֵּר עַל מַעֲשֵׂה עֻזָּא וַעֲזָאֵל בְּקִלְקוּל הַבְּרִית (יוֹמָא ס״ז עַמּוּד ב׳)
atoning for the fallen angels Uzza and Azael in the blemish of the covenant (Yoma 67b);
שֶׁבּוֹ עִיקַּר הַקִּטְרוּג עֵשָׂו שֶׁנָּגַע בְּכַף יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל״ב:כ״ו)
wherein lay the primary accusation of Esav who struck the hollow of Yaakov's thigh (Bereishis 32:26);
וְ״יַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכֹּתָה״ (שָׁם ל״ג:י״ז), הוּא ״זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵנוּ״
and "Jacob journeyed to Succos" (ibid. 33:17), entering "the season of our gladness";
כִּי כָל צַעַר שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָאָדָם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וּבִיטּוּל הַשִּׂמְחָה שְׁלֵימָה דְּ״יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי ה׳״ (תְּהִלִּים ק״ה:ג׳) וְשִׂמְחַת צַדִּיקִים בַּה׳
for all sorrow in this world and the disruption of wholehearted joy;
הוּא עַל יְדֵי פְּגַם הַבְּרִית שֶׁהוּא הַמְבַטֵּל לְשִׂמְחַת לֵב אִשָּׁה, הוּא הָאִשָּׁה יִרְאַת ה׳ הָרְמוּזָה בְּ״אֵשֶׁת חַיִל״ (מִשְׁלֵי ל״א:י׳):
is caused by blemishes of the covenant, which disrupt the joy of the woman who fears Hashem alluded to in the "Woman of Valor" (Mishlei 31:10)!

15.h: The theme: Jacob seeking serenity, the anguish of Yosef (rogzo shel Yosef), and sins transformed into merits. The Midrash expounds: "Jacob sought to dwell in serenity, but the turmoil of Yosef sprang upon him" (Bereishis Rabbah 84:3)—referring to the trial of the holy covenant (Yesod), when Yosef was sold into Egypt, the "nakedness of the land" (ervat ha-aretz). This turmoil (rogez) is the antithesis of peace and joy. Yet following rectification, when repentance covers sins like a mother hovering over her children (Zohar), intentional sins are transformed into merits (zechuyot), fulfilling: "you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good" (Bereishis 50:20). Yaakov feared that with Yosef lost among the nations, the covenant of Yesod had crumbled ("if the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?", Tehillim 11:3). The hallmark distinguishing Israel from the nations is the holy covenant: even uncircumcised Israelites are legally termed circumcised, while circumcised gentiles are termed uncircumcised (Nedarim 31b). Yaakov feared Israel would become like the nations; yet Hashem turned it into the ultimate victory of Yesod, Yosef overcoming Potiphar's wife when the visage of his father appeared before him (Sotah 36b). Yaakov is the central bolt (beri'ach ha-tichon, Shemos 26:28) running from end to end, cleaving to Hashem so completely that evil has no grasp. The transgression of the tribes was an eternal remembrance and an eternal hope (Bereishis Rabbah 84:4): remembrance (zechirah) is the primordial depth of Thought on Rosh Hashanah (Yom HaZikaron), while hope (tikvah) is the final outcome where all ends in absolute good. Knowing that Israel's sins were preordained from Creation (Shabbat 89b), Hashem did not withhold Creation, for in Israel even sins are sweetened and transformed into good.

p: וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה פ״ד:ג׳): ״בִּקֵּשׁ יַעֲקֹב לֵישֵׁב בְּשַׁלְוָה — קָפַץ עָלָיו רָגְזוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף״
And concerning this the Sages expounded (Bereishis Rabbah 84:3): "Jacob sought to dwell in serenity, but the turmoil of Joseph sprang upon him";
הַיְינוּ קִלְקוּלֵי הַבְּרִית, שֶׁזֶּהוּ עִנְיַן מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף דַּרְגָּא דְּצַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם לְעֶבֶד בֵּין הָעַמִּים וּלְמִצְרַיִם ״עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית מ״ב:ט׳), יְסוֹד דִּקְלִיפָּה

this referring to the corruptions of the covenant, which was the mystery of selling Yosef (the righteous foundation of the world) into slavery among the nations and down to Egypt, "the nakedness of the land," the unholy Yesod of the husk;
וְהוּא רָגְזוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף שֶׁמִּזֶּה נִמְשָׁךְ רוֹגֶז שֶׁהוּא הֵיפֶךְ הַשַּׁלְוָה וְהַשִּׂמְחָה
this being the turmoil of Yosef, whence issued anguish which is the antithesis of tranquility and joy.
וְאַחַר הַתִּיקּוּן נִתְבָּרַר דְּאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמַּחֲשֶׁבֶת הָאָדָם [מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב וּמִצֶּאֱצָאֵי שִׁבְטֵי יָהּ] הָיָה לַעֲבֵירָה
And following the rectification it was clarified that even though the intention of man [from the seed of Israel and the holy tribes] was toward transgression;
עַל יְדֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה דַּחֲזְיָא לַחְפָּיָא עַל כָּל עוֹבָדוֹי כְּאֵם הַחוֹפֶפֶת עַל בָּנֶיהָ, הַזְּדוֹנוֹת מִתְהַפְּכִין לִזְכֻיּוֹת (יוֹמָא פ״ו עַמּוּד ב׳)
through repentance, which hovers over all his deeds like a mother protecting her children, intentional sins are transformed into merits (Yoma 86b);
וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״אַתֶּם חֲשַׁבְתֶּם עָלַי רָעָה, אֱלֹהִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית נ:כ)
after the manner stated: "As for you, you thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good" (Bereishis 50:20);
וְנִתְבָּרַר אַחַר כָּךְ שֶׁכָּל מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף הָיָה לְטוֹבָה
and it was subsequently clarified that the entire selling of Yosef was for the ultimate good;
וּמַה שֶּׁיַּעֲקֹב נִתְיָירֵא שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה ״אֵרֵד אֶל בְּנִי אָבֵל שְׁאֹלָה״ (שָׁם ל״ז:ל״ה)
and that which Yaakov feared, crying: "I will go down into Sheol unto my son mourning" (ibid. 37:35);
כְּשֶׁחַס וְשָׁלוֹם יִטָּמַע יוֹסֵף בֵּין הָעַמִּים, וְ״כִּי הַשָּׁתוֹת — הוּא הַיְסוֹד — יֵהָרֵסוּן, צַדִּיק מַה פָּעָל״ (תְּהִלִּים י״א:ג׳)
fearing lest Yosef assimilate among the heathen, and "if the foundations (hashatot / Yesod) be destroyed, what can the righteous do?" (Tehillim 11:3);
כִּי אִם אֵין יְסוֹד אֵין כְּלוּם, וְכָל בִּנְיָן בָּנוּי עַל יְסוֹד וְצָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה הַיְסוֹד חָזָק וְקַיָּים
for without a foundation nothing exists, every structure being built upon a foundation which must remain sturdy and enduring.
וְעִיקַּר הַהֶבְדֵּל בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים הוּא בִּבְרִית קֹדֶשׁ
And the primary distinction between Israel and the nations resides within the holy covenant;
דַּאֲפִילּוּ עַרְלֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִקְרָאִים מוּלִים, וּמוּלֵי אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם נִקְרָאִים עֲרֵלִים, שֶׁהָעָרְלָה נִקְרֵאת עַל שְׁמָם, כְּמָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּנְדָרִים (ל״א עַמּוּד ב׳)
for even uncircumcised Israelites are legally termed circumcised, while circumcised gentiles are termed uncircumcised, the foreskin being designated upon their name (Nedarim 31b);
הַיְינוּ שֶׁהֵם יְסוֹדָם בָּרָע וְשָׁרְשָׁם מִיסוֹד דִּקְלִיפָּה, וְזֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְסוֹדָם קֹדֶשׁ לַה׳ מוֹרָשָׁה מֵאָבוֹת
meaning that the nations are founded in evil and rooted in the unholy husk, whereas the seed of Israel is founded in holiness unto Hashem inherited from the Patriarchs;
וּכְשֶׁרָאָה אֲבֵידַת יוֹסֵף נִתְיָירֵא דְּנִתְבַּטֵּל חַס וְשָׁלוֹם קְדֻשַּׁת הַיְסוֹד מִזַּרְעוֹ וְיִהְיוּ ״כְּכָל הַגּוֹיִם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל״ (יְחֶזְקֵאל כ:לב) חַס וְשָׁלוֹם
and when Yaakov saw the loss of Yosef, he feared lest the sanctity of Yesod be eradicated from his seed, making the house of Israel like all the nations, God forbid;
אֲבָל בֶּאֱמֶת: ״אֱלֹהִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית נ:כ) — הוּא תַּכְלִית תִּיקּוּן הַיְסוֹד, דְּ״אִמְרוּ צַדִּיק כִּי טוֹב״ (יְשַׁעְיָה ג:י)
but in truth: "God meant it unto good," which is the ultimate rectification of Yesod, for "say of the righteous, that it shall be well (tov) with him" (Yeshayah 3:10).
דְּנִתְבָּרַר קְדֻשַּׁת הַבְּרִית דְּתוֹלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף
For the holiness of the covenant was verified in Yosef the offspring of Yaakov;
שֶׁאֲפִילּוּ בִּמְקוֹם עֶרְוַת הָאָרֶץ וְהוּא בְּתֹקֶף חֻמּוֹ, וְהִיא הִסִּיתַתּוּ בְּכָל מִינֵי הַסָּתוֹת וּלְבוּשִׁים שֶׁלָּבְשָׁה לוֹ וְכוּלֵיהּ כִּמְשַׁאזַ״ל (יוֹמָא ל״ה עַמּוּד ב׳)
that even in the epicenter of the land's depravity, in the heat of youthful passion, when Potiphar's wife tempted him with all manners of seduction and changing garments (Yoma 35b);
הַיְינוּ לְבוּשֵׁי הַטּוּמְאָה דִּקְלִיפָּה וָרָע, וְלֹא יָכְלָה לוֹ
these representing the defiled garments of the unholy husk, yet she could not overpower him;
כִּי עָמַד נֶגְדּוֹ דְּמוּת דִּיּוֹקְנוֹ שֶׁל אָבִיו (סוֹטָה ל״ו עַמּוּד ב׳)
because there appeared before his eyes the visage of his father (Sotah 36b);
הַיְינוּ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַקְּדוּשָׁה שֶׁמּוֹרָשָׁה בְּכָל נֶפֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהָאָבוֹת
that is, the root of holiness inherited within every Jewish soul from the Patriarchs;
וְהָעִיקָּר יַעֲקֹב מוּבְחָר שֶׁבָּאָבוֹת, שֶׁכּוּלָּם נִקְרְאוּ עַל שְׁמוֹ כִּמְשַׁאזַ״ל (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ס״ג:ב׳)
and preeminently Yaakov, the chosen of the Patriarchs, after whose name all are designated (Bereishis Rabbah 63:2);
כִּי כָל הַקְּדוּשָׁה שֶׁבָּהֶם הָיָה רַק מַה שֶּׁעָתִיד לָצֵאת מֵהֶם יַעֲקֹב שֶׁמִּטָּתוֹ שְׁלֵימָה וְאֵין פְּסֹולֶת כְּלָל בְּזַרְעוֹ
for all holiness in Avraham and Yitzchak pointed toward Yaakov whose bed is complete, devoid of any dross in his seed;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר פָּדָה אֶת אַבְרָהָם״ (יְשַׁעְיָה כ״ט:כ״ב)
as it is said: "Jacob who redeemed Abraham" (Yeshayah 29:22);
כִּי הוּא ״הַבְּרִיחַ הַתִּיכֹן [בְּתוֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁים] מַבְרִחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה״ (שְׁמוֹת כ״ו:כ״ח)
for he is "the middle bar in the midst of the boards, reaching from end to end" (Shemos 26:28);
לִהְיוֹת דָּבוּק לְגַמְרֵי בֵּאלֹהִים חַיִּים עַד שֶׁאֵין מָקוֹם לְהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת דְּסִטְרָא דְּרָע
cleaved completely unto the Living God so that no room remains for the expansion of evil.
וּבָזֶה הָיָה הַבֵּירוּר גַּם עַל שְׁאָר הַשְּׁבָטִים כִּי כוּלָּם זֶרַע אֱמֶת
And through this was clarified the integrity of the other tribes as well, that they are entirely a seed of truth;
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁלְּמַרְאִית הָעַיִן לֹא כֵן, דְּעַל כֵּן הֵבִיא יוֹסֵף דִּבָּתָם רָעָה שֶׁנּוֹשְׂאִים עֵינֵיהֶם בִּבְנוֹת הָאָרֶץ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פ״ד:ז׳)
even though to outward appearances it seemed otherwise, wherefore Yosef reported that they cast their eyes on the daughters of the land;
וְזֶהוּ הַגְּרָם לְחֵטְא מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף, שֶׁנִּרְאָה שֶׁהֵם בִּקְּשׁוּ לְהַאֲבִיד הַצַּדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם מִן הָעוֹלָם וּלִמְסוֹר הַיְסוֹד בְּרִית קֹדֶשׁ לִטָּמַע בֵּין הָעַמִּים
and this triggered the sin of selling Yosef, appearing as if they sought to eradicate the righteous foundation of the world and abandon the holy covenant to assimilate among the nations;
אֲבָל: ״עֲבֵירָתָן שֶׁל שְׁבָטִים — זְכִירָה הִיא לָעוֹלָם, תִּקְוָה הִיא לָעוֹלָם״, כְּמָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה (פָּרָשָׁה פ״ד:ד׳)
but: "The transgression of the tribes is an eternal remembrance, an eternal hope," as stated in Bereishis Rabbah (84:4);
פֵּירוּשׁ ״זְכִירָה״ וְ״זִכָּרוֹן״ הוּא הָעֹומֶק רֵאשִׁית וְהַהַתְחָלָה, כְּמוֹ רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה נִקְרָא ״יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן״
meaning: "remembrance" (zikaron) denotes the primordial depth and inception, as Rosh Hashanah is called the "Day of Remembrance";
כִּי ״סוֹף מַעֲשֶׂה — בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה תְּחִלָּה״, וְ״יוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם״ — הַהֵרָיוֹן וְהַמַּחֲשָׁבָה
for "the end of action is rooted in the initial Thought," and "the day of the conception of the world" is divine Conception and Thought;
כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּתוֹסָפוֹת רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה (כ״ז עַמּוּד א׳): דִּבְתִשְׁרֵי הָיָה הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה דִּבְרִיאָה
as written in Tosafos in Rosh Hashanah (27a): in Tishrei occurred the Thought of Creation;
אָז זְמַן הַזִּכָּרוֹן לְהִפָּקֵד כָּל רוּחַ וָנֶפֶשׁ, כִּי רֵאשִׁית הַמַּחֲשָׁבָה הוּא הַזִּכָּרוֹן שֶׁזּוֹכֵר לְמַעְלָה בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ כָּל הַמִּפְעָל שֶׁרוֹצֶה לִפְעוֹל
then being the time of remembrance to recall every spirit and soul, the beginning of Thought being the divine memory encompassing the entire cosmic enterprise;
וְ״תִקְוָה״ הוּא עַל הַסּוֹף, כִּלְשׁוֹן הַכָּתוּב: ״אַחֲרִית וְתִקְוָה [טוֹבָה]״ (יִרְמְיָה כ״ט:י״א)
and "hope" (tikvah) points to the ultimate end, as in the verse: "an end and a hope" (Yirmiyah 29:11);
כִּי הַקִּיוּוּי הוּא עַל הֶעָתִיד לִהְיוֹת, וְהוּא הָעֹומֶק אַחֲרִית שֶׁבְּסוֹף מַעֲשֶׂה, וְסוֹף הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה
for hope looks toward the future, being the depth of the end in final deed, where all concludes in absolute good.
וְכֵן הַתְחָלַת הַכֹּל, כִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל עָלוּ בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה א:ד)
And so too the beginning of all, for Israel arose in primordial Thought (Bereishis Rabbah 1:4);
וְגַם עֲוֹנוֹתֵיהֶם ״סְדוּרוֹת וּבָאוֹת מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְּרֵאשִׁית״, כְּמָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּפֶרֶק רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא (שַׁבָּת פ״ט עַמּוּד ב׳)
and even their transgressions were "ordered and advancing from the six days of Creation," as the Sages stated in Shabbat (89b);
הַיְינוּ מֵרֵאשִׁית הַבְּרִיאָה: ״אֱלֹהִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית נ:כ)
meaning that from the inception of Creation: "God meant it unto good" (Bereishis 50:20);
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהָיָה צָפוּי לְפָנָיו וְרָאָה הַקִּלְקוּלִים, לֹא מָנַע הַבְּרִיאָה
and even though it was foreseen before Him and He beheld all future corruptions, He did not refrain from creating the world;
בִּשְׁבִיל יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהֵם עִיקַּר הַבְּרִיאָה שֶׁהַכֹּל הוּא מִתְהַפֵּךְ אֶצְלָם לְטוֹב וַאֲפִילּוּ עֲבֵירָתָם
for the sake of Israel who are the primary purpose of Creation, within whom everything is transformed into good, even their sins;
אַחַר הַתִּיקּוּן נִתְגַּלָּה הָעֹומֶק רֵאשִׁית וְהָעֹומֶק אַחֲרִית שֶׁכּוּלּוֹ טוֹב, וּמִמֵּילָא נִמְתַּק מַה שֶּׁבֵּינְתַיִים:
following rectification the primordial depth and the ultimate depth being revealed as entirely good, whereby all intermediate stumbling is sweetened!

15.h: The theme: The joy of retroactive rectification (hiskalelut le-tovah), the Four Species as life and Torah, and the eternal impression (Reshimu) in Jewish descendants. The greatest joy arises when it becomes clear after a fall that everything was for the good, evil being transformed into additional merits like one who lost all his wealth and recovered it doubled. After Yom Kippur, a heavenly voice declares: "Go your way, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works" (Koheles 9:7)—clarifying retroactively that past deeds are now accepted in divine favor, awakening the joy of Succos. This is embodied in the Four Species: the Lulav equals Chayim (לוּלָב = 68 = חַיִּים); the Hadas equals Chayim with the kollel (הֲדַס = 69); the Etrog with the kollel equals Torah (אֶתְרוֹג = 610 = תּוֹרָה, eternal life); and the Aravah equals Zera (עֲרָבָה = 277 = זֶרַע, seed). Possessing neither taste nor aroma, the Aravah represents the sinners of Israel, who nevertheless merit eternal life through their righteous offspring ("a son confers merit upon a father", Sanhedrin 104a). Even those who forfeit their individual portion in the World to Come (Sanhedrin 90a) preserve continuity through the collective species (kiyum ba-min), for a father is the supernal Mazal of his son. The Dorshei Reshumot grasped that the indelible spiritual impression (Reshimu) of the Patriarchs can never be severed from any Jew, securing their ultimate share in the World to Come.

p: וְזֶהוּ תֹּקֶף וְעֹוצֶם הַשִּׂמְחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר מִתְבָּרֵר אַחַר הַקִּלְקוּל שֶׁהַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה
And this is the intense potency of joy when it becomes clarified after the fall that all was for the good;
וְשֶׁלֹּא הָיָה קִלְקוּל מֵעוֹלָם, רַק אַדְּרַבָּא תּוֹסֶפֶת טוֹבָה וּזְכֻיּוֹת
and that there never was an irremediable defect from the outset, but on the contrary, an increase of goodness and merits;
וּכְמוֹ מִי שֶׁאִבֵּד כָּל רְכוּשׁוֹ וְחָזַר וּמְצָאוֹ אֶצְלוֹ וְנוֹסַף כִּפְלַיִם כָּהֵנָּה
like one who lost all his possessions and then recovered them multiplied twofold;
דְּבָזֶה הַשִּׂמְחָה יְתֵירָה מִמִּי שֶׁלֹּא הִפְסִיד וְהִרְוִיחַ
in which case the rejoicing is far greater than that of one who never suffered loss and merely gained;
וּבִפְרָט בְּעִנְיַן תִּיקּוּן הַבְּרִית, דְּ״יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק כִּי חָזָה נָקָם״ (תְּהִלִּים נ״ח:י״א)
and especially concerning the rectification of the covenant, where "the righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance" (Tehillim 58:11);
וְאַחַר תִּיקּוּן הַקִּלְקוּל נַעֲשָׂה מִצַּדִּיק יִשְׁרַת לֵב וְזוֹכֶה לְשִׂמְחָה
and following the repair of the defect, the righteous man attains uprightness of heart, meriting joyous celebration;
וְעַל כֵּן הַשְּׁבָטִים לֹא שָׁתוּ יַיִן דִּישַׂמַּח לֵב מֵעֵת מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף עַד שֶׁרָאוּהוּ פַּעַם רִאשׁוֹנָה
wherefore the tribal Patriarchs drank no heart-gladdening wine from the time Yosef was sold until they beheld him again for the first time (Bereishis 43:34);
אַף דְּאִינְהוּ לָא יָדְעוּ דְּהוּא הוּא, מַזָּלַיְיהוּ יָדַע כִּי נִשְׁלַם קוֹמַת הַשְּׁכִינָה וְתִקְרָתוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם
for even though they did not yet consciously know that it was he, their supernal Mazal knew that the spiritual stature of the Shechinah and the ceiling of the cosmos had been completed;
וְנִתְעוֹרֵר הַשִּׂמְחָה בִּלְבָבָם לִשְׁתּוֹת יַיִן
and joy awakened within their hearts to drink wine.

וְעַל כֵּן בַּת קוֹל יוֹצֵאת בְּמוֹצָאֵי יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים פְּעָמִים: ״לֵךְ אֱכֹל בְּשִׂמְחָה לַחְמֶךָ וּשֲׁתֵה בְלֶב טוֹב יֵינֶךָ [כִּי כְבָר רָצָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת מַעֲשֶׂיךָ]״ (קֹהֶלֶת ט:ז; קֹהֶלֶת רַבָּה ט:ז)

Wherefore a heavenly voice (Bat Kol) issues forth on the conclusion of Yom Kippur, proclaiming: "Go your way, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works" (Koheles 9:7; Koheles Rabbah 9:7);
כִּי תֵּיכֶף אַחַר יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים דִּ״כְבָר רָצָה הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת מַעֲשֶׂיךָ״, הַיְינוּ כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים שֶׁעָשָׂה מִכְּבָר גַּם קוֹדֶם הַתִּיקּוּן
for immediately following Yom Kippur, when "God has already accepted your works"—meaning all deeds performed previously, even prior to the rectification;
הַשְׁתָּא אִגַּלִּי מִלְּתָא לְמַפְרֵעַ דְּמִכְּבָר הָיוּ לְרָצוֹן
it is now revealed retroactively that from the very beginning they were oriented toward divine favor;
עַל יְדֵי זֶה מִתְעוֹרֵר הַשִּׂמְחָה בַּלֵּב, וְנוֹסֵעַ ״סֻכֹּתָה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית ל״ג:י״ז) שֶׁהוּא זְמַן שְׁלֵימוּת הַשִּׂמְחָה שֶׁזּוֹכֶה לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם
through this joy awakens in the heart, and Israel journeys "to Succos" (Bereishis 33:17), the season of consummate gladness wherein one merits eternal life;
דְּעַל זֶה רוֹמְזִים הָאַרְבָּעָה מִינִים: לוּלָב בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״חַיִּים״ [לוּלָב = 68 = חַיִּים]
unto which allude the Four Species: Lulav having the numerical value of Chayim (68);
וְכֵן הֲדַס בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״חַיִּים״ עִם הַכּוֹלֵל [הֲדַס = 69 = 68 + 1]
and likewise Hadas equals Chayim with the collective unit (69);
וְאֶתְרוֹג עִם הַכּוֹלֵל בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״תּוֹרָה״ [אֶתְרוֹג = 610, תּוֹרָה = 611 = 610 + 1] שֶׁהוּא חַיֵּי עוֹלָם
and Etrog with the collective unit equals Torah (611), which is eternal life;
וַעֲרָבָה בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״זֶרַע״ [עֲרָבָה = 277 = זֶרַע]
and Aravah equals Zera (seed, 277);
כִּי הוּא ״לֹא טַעַם וְלֹא רֵיחַ״ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה ל:יב), רוֹמֵז לְפוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְגַם מֵהֶם ״לֹא יִדַּח [מִמֶּנּוּ] נִדָּח״ (שְׁמוּאֵל ב י״ד:י״ד)
for possessing neither taste nor aroma (Vayikra Rabbah 30:12), it alludes to the transgressors of Israel, from whom likewise "no outcast shall be expelled" (II Shmuel 14:14);
וְתִיקּוּנָם לִזְכּוֹת לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם עַל יְדֵי זַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם, דִּ״בְרָא מְזַכֵּי אַבָּא״ (סַנְהֶדְרִין ק״ד עַמּוּד א׳)
and their rectification to merit eternal life is through the righteous seed that follows them, for "a son confers merit upon his father" (Sanhedrin 104a);
וּכְמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּסוֹף כְּתוּבּוֹת (קי״א עַמּוּד ב׳): רְפוּאָה לְעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ שֶׁיָּקוּמוּ בִּתְחִיַּיִת הַמֵּתִים עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמַּשִּׂיא בִּתּוֹ לְתַלְמִיד חָכָם
and as written at the end of Kesubos (111b): the remedy for the unlearned to arise at the Resurrection of the Dead is by marrying his daughter to a Torah scholar.
וְגַם אֲפִילּוּ אוֹתָן הַנִּדָּחִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם לְגַמְרֵי שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם תַּקָּנָה, כְּכָל אוֹתָן שֶׁנִּמְנוּ בְּפֶרֶק חֵלֶק (סַנְהֶדְרִין צ׳ עַמּוּד א׳) דְּאֵין לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
And even those outcasts, God forbid, who seem wholly without remedy, such as those enumerated in Perek Chelek (Sanhedrin 90a) as having no portion in the World to Come;
אַף דְּאֵין לָהֶם קִיּוּם בָּאִישׁ, יֵשׁ לָהֶם קִיּוּם בַּמִּין, וְזוֹכִים לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם עַל יְדֵי זַרְעָם שֶׁנִּקְרָאִים עַל שְׁמָם
though lacking preservation as an individual soul, they possess preservation through the holy species, meriting eternal life through their seed who are called after their name;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְלֹא יִמָּחֶה שְׁמוֹ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל״ (דְּבָרִים כ״ה:ו׳), שֶׁכְּשֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ זֶרַע נִקְרָא שֶׁלֹּא נִמְחָה שְׁמוֹ
as it is said: "that his name be not blotted out of Israel" (Devarim 25:6), for when he possesses offspring his name is not blotted out;
וְעַל יְדֵי הַזֶּרַע הַזּוֹכֶה לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם, אַף הוּא לֹא נֶאֱבַד שְׁמוֹ מִן הָעוֹלָם
and through the seed that merits eternal life, his own name is not lost from the world;
וְלֹא דָּבָר רֵיק הוּא זֵכֶר זֶה, כִּי לֹא לְחִנָּם מִתְיַיחֵס הַבֵּן אֶל הָאָב, כִּי יֵשׁ בּוֹ מִכֹּחוֹ
and this lineage is not an empty convention, for not in vain is a son attributed to the father, having received of his essential vitality;
כִּידוּעַ דְּהָאָבוֹת הֵם שׁוֹרֶשׁ לְנַפְשׁוֹת הַבָּנִים וְהַמַּזָּלָא שֶׁלָּהֶם
as is known that fathers are the root of the souls of their children and their supernal Mazal;
וּמֵאַחַר שֶׁנֶּפֶשׁ הַבֵּן יֵשׁ לוֹ קִיּוּם לָעוֹלָם, אַף הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ שֶׁל הָאָב שֶׁהוּא שָׁרְשׁוֹ קַיָּים עִמּוֹ
and since the soul of the son endures forever, the root of the father which gave him life endures with him.
וְזֶה עִנְיַן הַ״דּוֹרְשֵׁי רְשׁוּמוֹת״ שֶׁאָמְרוּ: דְּכוּלָּם יֵשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא (סַנְהֶדְרִין ק״ה עַמּוּד ב׳)
And this is the principle of the Dorshei Reshumot who affirmed: all of them have a portion in the World to Come (Sanhedrin 105b);
כִּי הִשְׁתַּלְּמוּת כֹּחַ הָאָבוֹת בַּבָּנִים אֵין נִיכָּר בְּפֹעַל אֶלָּא רְשִׁימוּ בִּלְבַד
for the transmission of the fathers' power within the sons is not always outwardly manifest, but endures as an indelible impression (Reshimu);
וְאוֹתוֹ הָרְשִׁימוּ אֵינוֹ נִכְרָת כְּלָל בְּשׁוּם זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל
and that impression is never severed from any descendant of Israel;
כִּי כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזֶּרַע אַבְרָהָם, יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב הֵם בְּתוֹלְדוֹתָם וּבִתְחִלַּת הַיְצִירָה מִשּׁוֹרֶשׁ הַטּוֹב
for all Israel of the seed of Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov are by inborn birth and initial creation rooted in primordial goodness;
וְיֵשׁ בָּהֶם מֵ״אוֹר זָרֻעַ לַצַּדִּיק״ (תְּהִלִּים צ״ז:י״א), דְּ״עַמֵּךְ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים לְעוֹלָם [יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ] וְגוֹמֵר״ (יְשַׁעְיָה ס:כא), הַזּוֹכִים עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם הַבָּא

possessing the "light sown for the righteous" (Tehillim 97:11), for "Your people also shall be all righteous, they shall inherit the land forever" (Yeshayah 60:21), meriting through this the life of the World to Come;
אֶלָּא שֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ כְּשֶׁמְּקַלְקֵל מַעֲשָׂיו הוּא מְנַתֵּק וּמַאֲפִיל אוֹתוֹ הָאוֹר מְעַט מְעַט
but subsequently when a person corrupts his actions, he obscures and distances that light little by little;
עַד שֶׁיּוּכַל לְהַגִּיעַ בְּקִלְקוּלוֹ שֶׁיְּנוּתַּק אוֹתוֹ הָאוֹר מִמֶּנּוּ לְגַמְרֵי
until he may reach a degeneration where that manifest light seems entirely severed from him.
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם הֲלֹא יָדוּעַ דְּכָל אוֹר, אַף אַחַר שֶׁנִּיתַּק נִשְׁאָר רְשִׁימוּ, וְגַם הָרְשִׁימוּ אִי אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁתִּנָּתֵק כְּלָל
Nevertheless, is it not known that after any light departs an indelible impression (Reshimu) remains, which can never be uprooted?
וְעַל כֵּן אֲפִילּוּ פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, כָּל שֶׁהֵם זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם, יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב שֶׁהָיָה בָּהֶם אוֹר צַדִּיקִים בְּתוֹלַדְתָּן
wherefore even the transgressors of Israel, as long as they issue from the seed of the Patriarchs containing the light of the righteous at birth;
אַף שֶׁקִּלְקְלוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם עַד שֶׁנִּכְרְתוּ מֵאִילַן הַחַיִּים, מִכָּל מָקוֹם הָרְשִׁימוּ לֹא נִפְקָעָה
though they corrupted their deeds until appearing severed from the Tree of Life, the holy Reshimu was never dissolved;
וְעַל יְדֵי אוֹתָהּ הָרְשִׁימוּ יוּכְלוּ לִזְכּוֹת לְבָנִים צַדִּיקִים
and through that impression they can merit righteous offspring;
וּמִצַּד זוֹ הָרְשִׁימוּ אָמְרוּ דּוֹרְשֵׁי רְשׁוּמוֹת שֶׁהִשִּׂיגוּ עִנְיַן הָרְשִׁימוּ הַזּוֹ: דְּכוּלָּם יֵשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
and from this subtle Reshimu, the Dorshei Reshumot who perceived its mystery declared that all have a portion in the World to Come;
וְזֶהוּ תֹּקֶף הַשִּׂמְחָה שֶׁמַּשִּׂיגִים אַחַר יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים דְּנִמְחַל הַכֹּל
this being the mighty joy attained after Yom Kippur when all is forgiven;
וַאֲפִילּוּ אוֹתָן פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נַעֲשִׂין כּוּלָּן אֲגֻדָּה אַחַת עַל יְדֵי אוֹר הָרְשִׁימוּ שֶׁבְּזַרְעָם אַחֲרֵיהֶם:
even the transgressors of Israel joining into one bundle through the enduring light of the Reshimu within their seed!

15.h: The theme: The Four Species embodying the four letters of the Tetragrammaton, the Aravah (Arba Chayim), and the awakening of remorse in every Jew. The Four Species correspond to the four letters of the Tetragrammaton (Y-H-V-H), each being a unique wellspring of eternal life. The Etrog (taste and fragrance) corresponds to the letter Yud (Chochmah in the brain, the seat of the pure Neshamah where evil has no grasp), equaling Torah with the kollel. The Hadas (fragrance without taste) corresponds to the upper Hei (Binah in the heart, spiritual fragrance enjoyed by the soul, Berachos 43b), equaling Chayim with the kollel (69), the fountainhead of life. The Lulav (taste without fragrance) corresponds to the letter Vav (the straight spine of Yaakov's truth extending into the six extremities), being the tallest species because action is manifest. The Aravah (neither taste nor fragrance) corresponds to the final letter Hei (Knesset Israel / Malchus), whose numerical root Arav equals four times Chayim (ע-ר-ב = 272 = 4 × 68), while the Hei alludes to the final Hei. The final Hei has an open lower foot through which one can stumble toward death; yet its upper portal remains open for repentance. Every Jew from the seed of the Patriarchs experiences moments of sincere remorse (charatah) in his lifetime; even if transient, that holy spark of the soul’s root never perishes, entering through the upper aperture of the Hei to ascend to the place where penitents stand.

p: וּבָזֶה נַעֲשָׂה צֵירוּף כָּל אַרְבַּע אוֹתִיּוֹת שֵׁם הַהֲוָיָ״ה
And through this is formed the combination of all four letters of the Name Havayah;
כִּי כָל פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲחוּזִים בְּהֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁ״רַגְלֶיהָ יֹרְדוֹת מָוֶת״ (מִשְׁלֵי ה:ה)
for all the transgressors of Israel are grasped within the final Hei, whose "feet go down to death" (Mishlei 5:5);
עַל יְדֵי הַפְּתִיחָה שֶׁתַּחְתֶּיהָ יוֹכְלִים לָצֵאת לִמְקוֹם הַמִּיתָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם
through the open gap at the bottom of the letter Hei being capable of slipping out toward the realm of death, God forbid;
וְהוּא הַפֶּתַח ״לַבָּא לִיטַּמֵּא שֶׁמַּנִּיחִין לוֹ״ (שַׁבָּת ק״ד עַמּוּד א׳) לָצֵאת
this being the opening whereby "he who comes to defile himself is allowed an exit" (Shabbat 104a);
אֲבָל מִכָּל מָקוֹם שָׁרְשׁוֹ נִשְׁאָר עֲדַיִין אָחוּז בִּמְקוֹרוֹ בִּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהִיא הֵ״א זוֹ
nevertheless, his spiritual root remains held fast in Knesset Israel which is this very Hei;
שֶׁגַּם הִיא מֵעַצְמִיּוּת מְקוֹר הַחַיִּים יִתְבָּרַךְ שְׁמוֹ
which itself derives from the essence of the Source of Life, blessed be His Name;
וְעַל כֵּן רָמוּז בַּעֲרָבָה אַרְבַּע פְּעָמִים ״חַיִּים״ בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא עֶרֶ״ב [272 = 4 × 68], וְהַהֵ״א רוֹמֵז לְהֵ״א אַחֲרוֹנָה
wherefore within the Aravah
(עֲרָבָה)
is hinted four times Chayim in the letters A-R-V
while the letter Hei alludes to the final Hei;
כִּי בְּכָל אוֹת מִשֵּׁם הֲוָיָ״ה יֵשׁ מְקוֹר חַיִּים מְיוּחָד, לְהַמְשִׁיךְ מִמֶּנּוּ חַיֵּי עוֹלָם לְכָל הֶחָפֵץ לִידָּבֵק בֵּאלֹהִים חַיִּים
for within each letter of the Name Havayah dwells a unique fountain of vitality, channeling eternal life unto all who desire to cleave unto the Living God.
וְנֶגְדָּם הֵם הָאַרְבָּעָה מִינִים: אֶתְרוֹג נֶגֶד הַיּוּ״ד שֶׁהוּא הַחָכְמָה שֶׁבַּמּוֹחַ, מִשְׁכַּן הַנְּשָׁמָה הַטְּהוֹרָה שֶׁאֵין שָׁם שְׁלִיטָה לָרָע
And parallel to them stand the Four Species: the Etrog corresponds to the letter Yud, which is Chochmah in the brain, the seat of the pure Neshamah where evil has no dominion;
דְּמִשְׁכַּן הַיֵּצֶר רָע בַּלֵּב (בְּרָכוֹת ס״א עַמּוּד א׳), כַּנּוֹדָע דִּבְאַצִילוּת הַנִּמְשָׁךְ מֵאַבָּא הוּא כּוּלּוֹ טוֹב
the dwelling of the yetzer hara being in the heart (Berachos 61a), it being known that in Atzilus issuing from the Father (Abba) all is entirely good;
וְזֶהוּ הָאֶתְרוֹג שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ טַעַם וְרֵיחַ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה ל:יב)
and this is the Etrog which possesses both taste and aroma (Vayikra Rabbah 30:12);
וְעַל כֵּן הוּא עִם הַכּוֹלֵל, רָצָה לוֹמַר עִם מְקוֹר הַחָכְמָה שֶׁהוּא הַשּׁוֹרֶשׁ הַנֶּעְלָם הָרָמוּז בְּקוּצּוֹ שֶׁל יוּ״ד, בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״תּוֹרָה״
wherefore the Etrog with its collective unit (611)—alluding to the source of wisdom hinted in the thorn of the Yud—has the numerical value of Torah;
שֶׁהִיא ״נוֹבְלוֹת חָכְמָה עֶלְיוֹנָה״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה י״ז:ה׳)
which is the "fallen fruit of supernal wisdom" (Bereishis Rabbah 17:5);
וְעַל כֵּן עִיקָּרָהּ בַּמּוֹחַ, וּמִמֶּנָּה שׁוֹפַעַת ״סַמָּא דְּחַיֵּי״ (שַׁבָּת פ״ח עַמּוּד ב׳) לַלֵּב לַמַּיְימִינִים בָּהּ לִהְיוֹת תַּבְלִין לַיֵּצֶר וּלְפוֹצְצוֹ
its primary seat being in the brain, whence overflows the potion of life (sama d'chayei) to the heart for those who turn right within it, serving as the antidote to crush the yetzer.
וְהַהֲדַס נֶגֶד הֵ״א רִאשׁוֹנָה שֶׁהוּא הַבִּינָה שֶׁבַּלֵּב, טֶרֶם יֵצֵא לַפּוֹעַל בְּכֹחוֹת הַפְּעֻלָּה הַמִּתְגַּלִּים
And the Hadas corresponds to the upper letter Hei, which is Binah within the heart before it emerges into the active faculties;
וְעַל כֵּן בּוֹ רֵיחַ וְלֹא טַעַם
wherefore it possesses aroma but no taste;
כִּי הַטַּעַם הוּא דָּבָר הַמּוּרְגָּשׁ בְּפֹעַל, מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן רֵיחַ הוּא רוּחָנִי, דָּבָר שֶׁהַנְּשָׁמָה נֶהֱנֵית בּוֹ, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בִּבְרָכוֹת (מ״ג עַמּוּד ב׳)
for taste is perceived in concrete deed, whereas aroma is spiritual, being that from which the soul derives pleasure (Berachos 43b);

וְעַל כֵּן הוּא בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ״חַיִּים״ עִם הַכּוֹלֵל [הֲדַס = 69 = 68 + 1], רָצָה לוֹמַר עִם מְקוֹר הַחַיִּים שֶׁהוּא בַּלֵּב, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״כִּי מִמֶּנּוּ תּוֹצְאוֹת חַיִּים״ (מִשְׁלֵי ד:כג)
wherefore the Hadas equals Chayim with the kollel (69), alluding to the fountain of life within the heart: "for out of it are the issues of life" (Mishlei 4:23).
וְהַלּוּלָב נֶגֶד הַוָּי״ו שֶׁהוּא עֶצֶם הַחַיֵּי עוֹלָם הַמִּתְפַּשֵּׁט בְּנַפְשׁוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל זֶרַע יַעֲקֹב עַל יְדֵי הַשְׁלָכַת הָאֱמֶת דַּרְגָּא דְּיַעֲקֹב אַרְצָה
And the Lulav corresponds to the letter Vav, which is eternal life expanding into the souls of Israel through casting the truth of Yaakov unto the earth;
שֶׁהַוָּי״ו הוּא אוֹת אֱמֶת הַמַּשְׁפִּיעַ חַיִּים, כְּמָה שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּוהַר (חֵלֶק ג׳ ב׳ עַמּוּד א׳) עַל פָּסוּק ״וְהַחֲיִתֶם אֶת [אָבִי וְאֶת אִמִּי]״ (יְהוֹשֻׁעַ ב:יג) דְּרָחָב
the Vav being the letter of truth that bestows life, as written in the Zohar on the plea of Rachav: "and save alive my father, and my mother" (Yehoshua 2:13);
עַל יְדֵי הָאוֹת אֱמֶת הוּא הַוָּי״ו הָרָמוּז בְּ״תִקְוַת חוּט הַשָּׁנִי״ (שָׁם:י״ח) הַדּוֹמֶה לְוָי״ו, וְכֵן הַלּוּלָב דּוֹמֶה לְוָי״ו
through the sign of truth which is the Vav hinted in the scarlet thread resembling a Vav, the Lulav likewise resembling a straight Vav;
וְזֶהוּ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַחַיִּים הַמִּתְפַּשֵּׁט בְּשִׁשָּׁה קְצוֹת שֶׁהֵם כָּל כֹּחוֹת הַפְּעֻלָּה דִּנְבְרָאִים
this being the root of life spreading into the six spatial extremities, the active faculties of creation;
וְעַל כֵּן כָּל הַד׳ מִינִים כְּלוּלִים בַּלּוּלָב בַּבְּרָכָה
wherefore all Four Species are subsumed under the Lulav in the blessing;
וְאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה (סֻכָּה ל״ז עַמּוּד ב׳): לְפִי שֶׁגָּבוֹהַּ מִכּוּלָּם
and the Sages expounded (Sukkah 37b): because it is taller than all of them;
הַיְינוּ שֶׁכֹּחוֹ בְּהִתְגַּלּוּת יוֹתֵר מִכּוּלָּם, כִּי כֹּחוֹת הַפְּעֻלָּה הֵם הַמִּתְגַּלִּים בַּנִּפְעָל
meaning that its manifest power is more revealed than all, for active faculties are those that manifest in deeds;
וְעַל כֵּן שְׁתֵּי אוֹתִיּוֹת אַחֲרוֹנוֹת דְּהַשֵּׁם הֵם הַנִּגְלוֹת, וְרִאשׁוֹנוֹת הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת כַּנּוֹדָע
wherefore the last two letters (Vav-Hei) are the revealed, and the first two (Yud-Hei) are the concealed;
וּבוֹ טַעַם וְלֹא רֵיחַ, כִּי הַשְּׁלֵימוּת דְּכֹחוֹת הַפְּעֻלָּה אֲפִילּוּ יִהְיוּ הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת לֹא כֵן
possessing taste [action] but no fragrance [inward aroma], for action can be perfected even when the hidden thoughts stumble,
דְּמַחֲשָׁבָה רָעָה אֵין הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְצָרְפָהּ לְמַעֲשֶׂה בְּזֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל (קִדּוּשִׁין מ׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
since an evil thought the Holy One does not combine with deed in the seed of Israel (Kiddushin 40a).
וְהֵ״א הָאַחֲרוֹנָה כּוֹלֵל כָּל הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, אַף אוֹתָם שֶׁלֹּא טַעַם וְלֹא רֵיחַ וּכְבָר יָצְאוּ לְמָקוֹם שֶׁיָּצְאוּ
And the final letter Hei encompasses all Knesset Israel, even those lacking both taste and aroma who have strayed into outer realms;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם ״אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁחָטָא — יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא״ (סַנְהֶדְרִין מ״ד עַמּוּד א׳), וְלֹא נִפְרַד מִשָּׁרְשׁוֹ שֶׁהוּא כֹּחַ הַכְּלִי קִבּוּל
nevertheless, "even though he has sinned, he is an Israelite" (Sanhedrin 44a), never severed from his root which is the capacity of the receptive vessel;
דְּזֶהוּ כָּל כֹּחַ הֵ״א זוֹ דְּדָלֶ״ת הֲוַות, רַק דְּקַבִּילַת עוּבָּרָא (זֹוהַר חֵלֶק א׳ ר״נ עַמּוּד ב׳)
this being the power of this Hei which was originally a destitute Dalet that received the holy seed (Zohar I, 250b);
כִּי הִיא עֲנִיָּה וְדַלָּה דְּלֵית לַהּ מִגַּרְמַהּ כְּלוּם
being humble and poor, having no independent light;
דְּעַל כֵּן יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹנִין לַלְּבָנָה שֶׁדּוֹמִין לָהּ, וַעֲתִידִין לְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ כְּמוֹתָהּ (סַנְהֶדְרִין מ״ב עַמּוּד א׳) בְּקַבָּלַת אוֹר מְחוּדָּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד
wherefore Israel reckons by the moon, resembling her and destined to be renewed like her (Sanhedrin 42a) in receiving renewed light every day continually;
וְכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״דַּל״, ״עָנִי״ וְכוּלֵיהּ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל מְדַבֵּר, דְּ״יָאֶה עֲנִיּוּתָא לְיִשְׂרָאֵל״ (חֲגִיגָה ט׳ עַמּוּד ב׳)
and everywhere Scripture speaks of the poor and humble it refers to Israel, for "poverty is becoming unto Israel" (Chagigah 9b);
רָצָה לוֹמַר עֲנִיּוּת בַּדַּעַת, הַיְינוּ הַרְגָּשַׁת הַחִסָּרוֹן דְּלֵית לְהוּ מִגַּרְמַיְיהוּ כְּלוּם, לֹא תוֹרָה וְלֹא מִצְוֹת דִּמְגִנּוּ עֲלַן
meaning spiritual poverty in conscious merit, feeling their personal lack and knowing they possess no Torah or mitzvos sufficient to shield them;
וְאֵין לָנוּ עַל מִי לְהִשָּׁעֵן רַק עַל אָבִינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם שֶׁהוּא עוֹזֵר דַּלִּים
and having no one upon whom to lean except our Father in Heaven Who helps the destitute;
וְאָז הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ ״שׁוֹכֵן אֶת דַּכָּא וּשְׁפַל רוּחַ לְהַחֲיוֹת וְגוֹמֵר״ (יְשַׁעְיָה נ״ז:ט״ו), וּמִתְדַּבֵּק בֵּאלֹהִים חַיִּים
and then the Blessed Name dwells with the contrite and humble spirit to revive them, cleaving them to the Living God.
וּבָזֶה כָּלוּל בָּהֶם כָּל מִינֵי חַיִּים: הַיְינוּ מַה שֶּׁמְּקַבֶּלֶת מִשָּׁלֹשׁ אוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁלְּפָנֶיהָ, וְחַיּוּת עַצְמָהּ שֶׁהוּא מַה שֶּׁיֵּשׁ בָּהּ כֹּחַ הַקִּבּוּל
And through this, all manners of vitality are encompassed within her: that which she receives from the three preceding letters (Y-H-V), and her own intrinsic life which is her receptive vessel;
וּבְצֵירוּף מָקוֹר הָעֶלְיוֹן נִשְׁלַם כָּל הַה׳ פַּרְצוּפִים הָרְמוּזִים בְּהֵ״א זוֹ
and together with the supernal Source, all five primary Partzufim are completed within this Hei;
וְהִיא הַהֵ״א דַּעֲרָבָה שֶׁכּוּלָּם כְּלוּלִים בָּהּ, כִּי הִיא אַסְפַּקְלַרְיָא הַמְקַבֶּלֶת כָּל הָאוֹרוֹת
being the final Hei of the Aravah wherein all are enclosed, she being the luminous mirror that receives all lights.
וּכְשֶׁנִּשְׁלְמָה הַקּוֹמָה אָז נִתְקַן הַכֹּל, וְגַם הַפּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁאַף הֵם מְלֵאִים חֲרָטָה
And when the spiritual stature is completed all is rectified, including the transgressors of Israel who are filled with remorse;

וְלֹא יִמָּלְטוּ מֵרֶגַע אַחַת בְּכָל יְמֵי חַיֵּיהֶם לְכָל מִי שֶׁהוּא מִזֶּרַע אַבְרָהָם, יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב שֶׁלֹּא יִתְבּוֹנֵן עַל עַצְמוֹ לְהַכִּיר שִׁפְלוּתוֹ וְהִשְׁתַּקְּעוּתוֹ, וְשֶׁיִּתְחָרֵט וְיַכִּיר שֶׁלֹּא לְתַכְלִית זֶה נִבְרָא

there being no descendant of the Patriarchs who does not experience at least a single moment of sober reflection in his life, recognizing his degradation and regretting his sin, knowing he was not created for vanity;
וְאַף שֶׁהוּא רַק כְּרֶגַע, וְ״הֲתָעִיף עֵינֶיךָ בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ״ (מִשְׁלֵי כ״ג:ה׳) וְחוֹזֵר לְרִשְׁעוֹ
and though it be merely for a fleeting instant, vanishing in a blink as he returns to his wrongdoing;
מִכָּל מָקוֹם אֵין שׁוּם הִרְהוּר וּמַחֲשָׁבָה טוֹבָה נֶאֱבָד
nevertheless, no good thought or pious musing is ever lost before Hashem;
וְאוֹתוֹ הִרְהוּר הָעוֹלֶה בְּלִבּוֹ הוּא מִצַּד שׁוֹרֶשׁ נַפְשׁוֹ שֶׁעֲדַיִין יֵשׁ בּוֹ שׁוֹרֶשׁ מַשֶּׁהוּ שֶׁלֹּא נִיתַּק מִמְּקוֹרוֹ
that inward stirring issuing from his soul-root, containing an indestructible point that was never severed from its divine Source.
וְאַף עַל פִּי שֶׁרוּבּוֹ כְּכוּלּוֹ נִשְׁתַּקַּע לְמָקוֹם שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּקַּע וְנִידּוֹן בִּשְׁאוֹל וַאֲבַדּוֹן
And even though the majority of his outer being sank into defilement and is judged in Sheol;
אוֹתוֹ שׁוֹרֶשׁ מַשֶּׁהוּ קַיָּים לָעַד, דְּבֵיהּ הֲדַר עָיֵיל בְּפֶתַח עֶלְיוֹן דְּהַהֵ״א לְהִתְעַלּוֹת לִמְקוֹם שֶׁבַּעֲלֵי תְּשׁוּבָה עוֹמְדִין
that eternal point endures forever, through which he re-enters the upper aperture of the letter Hei, ascending unto the place where penitents stand;
אַף שֶׁהוּא לֹא שָׁב בֶּאֱמֶת, הַיְינוּ כָּל הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת קוֹמַת נַפְשׁוֹ
though his entire outward personality did not achieve comprehensive repentance;
אֲבָל שׁוֹרֶשׁ נַפְשׁוֹ שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ בָּא הַהִרְהוּר לְלִבּוֹ שֶׁהוּא הַמָּקוֹר דְּחַיּוּתוֹ, אוֹתוֹ הַמָּקוֹר שָׁב וְנִתְחָרֵט וְנִכְלַל בִּכְלַל הַהֵ״א:
yet his innermost soul-root whence that remorse sprang, which is the fountain of his life, that root repented and is encompassed within the holy Hei!

15.h: The theme: Sukkah as the shadow of faith (Tzila d'Mehemnuta) for the native-born, the exemption of slaves, and the maternal wing of Imma Tata'ah. The festival of Succos was given unto the native-born in Israel (kol ha-ezrach b'Yisrael yeshvu va-sukkot, Vayikra 23:42), rooted in the holy stock. The eschatological test of the nations will be the mitzvah of Sukkah (Avodah Zarah 3a), and their failure to ascend on Succos will constitute their future punishment (Zechariah 14:16–19), for the nations possess no affinity with this holy joy or eternal life. Even the pious of the nations who earn a portion in the World to Come will exist as servants unto Israel; currently their worship is directed through intermediaries ("which Hashem your God has allotted unto all the nations", Devarim 4:19). A slave is halachically exempt from Sukkah (Sukkah 8b), because the Sukkah is the shadow of faith (Tzila d'Mehemnuta, Zohar III, 103a) and protection under Hashem's shadow, belonging exclusively to those who have no master other than Hashem. Israel was redeemed from Egypt to be His servants alone ("for they are My servants", Vayikra 25:55). The Sechach in the wilderness, grown from the earth and impervious to ritual defilement, reflects "Truth springs out of the earth" (Tehillim 85:12)—the level of Yaakov whose bed is whole. The Sukkah is Imma Tata'ah hovering with her protective wings over all the souls of Israel: even a rebellious son remains a child of Yaakov, an attachment that can never be severed, qualifying him to rejoice in the season of our gladness.

p: וְזֶהוּ חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת דְּנִיתַּן ״לְ[כָל] הָאֶזְרָח בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל״ (וַיִּקְרָא כ״ג:מ״ב), וּמַאן דְּהוּא מִשָּׁרְשָׁא וְגִזְעָא קַדִּישָׁא
And this is the festival of Succos, which was given unto "all the native-born in Israel" (Vayikra 23:42), and whoever issues from the holy root and stock (Zohar III, 103a);
וְנִסָּיוֹן הַגּוֹיִם לֶעָתִיד יִהְיֶה בְּמִצְוַת סֻכָּה, כְּמָה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּרֵישׁ עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה (ג׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
and the future trial of the nations will be through the mitzvah of Sukkah, as stated at the beginning of Avodah Zarah (3a);
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״זֹאת תִּהְיֶה חַטַּאת [מִצְרָיִם וְחַטַּאת] כָּל הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַעֲלוּ לָחֹג אֶת חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת״ (זְכַרְיָה י״ד:י״ט)
as it is said: "This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that go not up to keep the feast of tabernacles" (Zechariah 14:19);
כִּי אֵין לָהֶם שַׁיָּיכוּת לְשִׂמְחָה זוֹ וּלְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם כְּלָל
for the nations possess no affinity with this sacred joy or with eternal life at all.
דַּאֲפִילּוּ חֲסִידֵי אוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם חֵלֶק לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא (תּוֹסֶפְתָּא סַנְהֶדְרִין י״ג:ב׳), הַיְינוּ שֶׁיִּהְיוּ עֲבָדִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
For even the pious of the nations who possess a portion in the World to Come, their status will be to serve as assistants unto Israel;
וְזֶהוּ כָּל חֲסִידוּתָם וְהַשָּׂגָתָם דְּמַכִּירִים מַעֲלַת יִשְׂרָאֵל
this constituting their entire piety and understanding: that they acknowledge the supreme spiritual virtue of Israel;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁהֵם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה עוֹבְדֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם אָדוֹן אַחֵר, וְקָרוּ לֵיהּ ״אֱלָהָא דֶּאֱלָהָא״ (מְנָחוֹת ק״י עַמּוּד א׳)
just as in this world they are idolaters who serve intermediaries, designating Hashem merely the "God of gods" (Menachos 110a);
וְנֶאֱמַר: ״אֲשֶׁר חָלַק ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ [אֹתָם] לְכֹל הָעַמִּים״ (דְּבָרִים ד:יט), שֶׁזֶּה חֶלְקָם שֶׁאֵינָם תַּחַת רְשׁוּת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ עַצְמוֹ, רַק מִתְנַהֲגִים עַל יְדֵי אֶמְצָעִי
and it is said: "which Hashem your God has allotted unto all the peoples" (Devarim 4:19), their portion not being directly under the Blessed Name, but governed through intermediaries;
אֶלָּא שֶׁהֵם חָטְאוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת הָאֶמְצָעִי אֱלוֹהַּ וַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה
except that they sinned by deifying the intermediary into an idol;
אֲבָל גּוּף הַדָּבָר אֱמֶת דְּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לֹא לְקָחָם לְחֶלְקוֹ
but the essential fact is true: the Blessed Name did not take the gentiles as His direct portion;
אֶלָּא שֶׁהֵם הָיָה לָהֶם לְקָרֵב אֶת עַצְמָם וְלִהְיוֹת גֵּרִים גְּרוּרִים וַעֲבָדִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
their duty having been to draw near as attached proselytes and servants unto Israel.
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לֶעָתִיד, כְּשֶׁ״יִשְׁפּוֹךְ רוּחוֹ עַל כָּל בָּשָׂר״ (יוֹאֵל ג:א), וְיַכִּירוּ כֹּחַ מַלְכוּתוֹ, יֹאמְרוּ: ״ה׳ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֶלֶךְ״
And as will unfold in the Future, when He pours His spirit upon all flesh (Yoel 3:1) and they perceive His sovereignty, they will proclaim: "Hashem, the God of Israel, is King!";
וְיַכִּירוּ דְּהוּא רַק אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְהֵם [יִשְׂרָאֵל] אֲדוֹנֵיהֶם וְאֶמְצָעִים לָהֶם
recognizing that He is exclusively the God of Israel, and that Israel are their masters and spiritual mediators;
וְעֶבֶד פָּטוּר מִן הַסֻּכָּה (סֻכָּה ח׳ עַמּוּד ב׳)
and an indentured servant is exempt from the mitzvah of Sukkah (Sukkah 8b);
דְּהוּא הַחִסָּיוֹן בְּצֵל ה׳ וּ״צִלָּא דִּמְהֵימְנוּתָא״ (זֹוהַר חֵלֶק ג׳ ק״ג עַמּוּד ב׳), זֶהוּ רַק לְמִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ אָדוֹן אַחֵר זוּלַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁחוֹסֶה בְּצִלּוֹ
for sheltering in the shadow of Hashem, the "shadow of faith" (Tzila d'Mehemnuta), belongs solely unto one who has no other master besides the Blessed Name;
וְדָבָר זֶה רַק לְזֶרַע יַעֲקֹב שֶׁהוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרַיִם מִהְיוֹת עֲבָדִים, וְאָמַר לָהֶם: ״[כִּי לִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל] עֲבָדִים, עֲבָדַי הֵם״ (וַיִּקְרָא כ״ה:נ״ה)
and this applies solely to the seed of Yaakov whom He redeemed from Egypt from being slaves, declaring: "For unto Me the children of Israel are servants; they are My servants" (Vayikra 25:55).
וְזֶהוּ הַסְּכָךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְקַבֵּל טוּמְאָה וְגִדּוּלוֹ מִן הָאָרֶץ (סֻכָּה י״א עַמּוּד א׳)
And this is the nature of the Sechach, which cannot contract ritual defilement and whose growth issues from the earth (Sukkah 11a);
כִּי ״אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח״ (תְּהִלִּים פ״ה:י״ב), דַּרְגָּא דְּיַעֲקֹב שֶׁמִּטָּתוֹ שְׁלֵימָה וְאֵין מְקַבֵּל שׁוּם טוּמְאָה כְּלָל
for "truth springs out of the earth" (Tehillim 85:12), the spiritual rung of Yaakov whose bed is whole, susceptible to no defilement whatsoever;
וְזֶהוּ ״אִימָּא תַּתָּאָה״ הַסּוֹכֶכֶת בִּכְנָפֶיהָ עַל כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל
and this is the Lower Mother (Imma Tata'ah / the Shechinah) shielding with her wings over all the souls of Israel;
אֲפִילּוּ אוֹתָם הַמְּרֵיעִים וּמַשְׁחִיתִים נִקְרָאִים ״זֶרַע״ וּ״בָנִים״, דְּכוּלָּם זֶרַע אֱמֶת
even those who act wickedly and corruptly are called "seed" and "children," for all are a seed of truth;
רַק שֶׁלְּפִי שָׁעָה הוּא ״בֵּן כְּסִיל [תּוּגַת אִמּוֹ]״ (מִשְׁלֵי י:א), אֲבָל שָׁרְשׁוֹ הוּא מִיּוֹצְאֵי חֲלָצָיו שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם, זֶה אִי אֶפְשָׁר לִינָּתֵק
though temporarily he be a "foolish son who is the grief of his mother" (Mishlei 10:1), yet his root issuing from the loins of Yaakov Avinu can never be severed;
וּמִצַּד אוֹתוֹ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הֲרֵי הוּא ״בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח אָב״ (שָׁם), וְיֵשׁ לוֹ שַׁיָּיכוּת לִ״זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵנוּ״:
and from the perspective of that root he is "a wise son who makes a glad father," possessing an enduring connection to the season of our gladness!

15.h: The theme: Numerical mysteries of Sukkah, the nullification of the Sitra d'Muta (480), and the contrast between Yosef and Yehudah. The word Sukkah (סֻכָּה = 91) equals the two divine Names Y-H-V-H (26) and A-D-N-Y (65), uniting the Holy One and His Shechinah (Vav-Hei / Yaakov and Knesset Israel). The defective spelling Sukkat (סֻכַּת = 480) with the four letters equals seven times Chayim (7 × 68 = 476 + 4 = 480), corresponding to the seven lower Sefirot, the seven days of the festival, and the seven Clouds of Glory. This total of 480 counteracts and abolishes the Sitra d'Muta—the unholy feminine shell of death which likewise equals 480 (לִילִית = 480)—which brought mourning into the world, whereas Succos is consummate joy. Therefore, "our father Jacob never died" (Ta'anit 5b), for within him is the root of Succos, the wellspring of eternal life. Sukkot spelled fully with Yaakov spelled with a Vav (סוכות יעקוב = 496 + 182 = 678, with the two words = 680) equals ten times Chayim (10 × 68 = 680), representing the ten Sefirot. In contrast, the covenant of Bris (בְּרִית = 612) equals nine times Chayim (9 × 68 = 612), representing the ninth Sefirah, Yesod. Torah (611) with the kollel likewise equals nine times Chayim (612), for it is the ninth Sefirah from below (Chochmah). Torah study ascends from below to Above, whereas fighting the yetzer descends from Above to below into the darkest rungs. The letter Tet (ט = 9) signifies Tov (good), the 9th letter, mirroring the Tzaddik and Torah. Yosef represents the first nine Sefirot (Yehosef possessing Yud-Hei-Vav, Tehillim 81:6); while Yehudah encompasses the entire Tetragrammaton with the letter Dalet representing humility, which receiving the embryo transforms into the fertile Hei, attaining the Crown of Royalty.

p: וְעַל כֵּן ״סֻכָּה״ [91] בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא שְׁנֵי שֵׁמוֹת הַיְּדוּעִים [הֲוָיָ״ה = 26, אַדְנוּת = 65, יַחַד = 91] הָרוֹמְזִים לְאוֹתִיּוֹת וָי״ו הֵ״א
And therefore Sukkah
equals the two renowned Names [Havayah (26) and Adonut (65) = 91], which allude unto the letters Vav and Hei;
שֶׁהֵם קֻדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ, רָזָא דְּיַעֲקֹב וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
which are the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah, the esoteric mystery of Yaakov and Knesset Israel;
שֶׁכָּל הַכְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲחוּזִים בְּשָׁרְשָׁם מֵאֲבִיהֶם וּמִתְיַיחֲדִים כְּאֶחָד
where all Knesset Israel are held fast in their root from their father Yaakov, uniting as one;
and Sukkat written defectively
(סכת)
with the four letters equals seven times Chayim (7 × 68 = 476 + 4 = 480);
נֶגֶד ז׳ תַּחְתּוֹנוֹת הַכּוֹלְלִים כָּל ב׳ הַקּוֹמוֹת דְּיַעֲקֹב וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהֵם כֹּחוֹת הַפְּעֻלָּה הַיּוֹצְאִים לַפּוֹעַל
corresponding to the seven lower Sefirot encompassing the two statures of Yaakov and Knesset Israel, which are the faculties of action actualized in deed;
שֶׁבָּהֶם הוּא שְׁלִיטַת הַיְדִיעַת טוֹב וָרָע בְּהַאי עָלְמָא שֶׁמֵּהֶם נִמְשָׁךְ חַיִּים וָמָוֶת
wherein resides the dominion of the knowledge of good and evil in this world whence life and death issue;
וְזֶרַע יַעֲקֹב דְּבוּקִים בַּחַיִּים שֶׁל כָּל הַשִּׁבְעָה מִינֵי כֹּחוֹת
and the seed of Yaakov are cleaved unto the life of all these seven faculties;
שֶׁנֶּגְדָּם הֵם שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי הֶחָג, וְשִׁבְעַת עַנְנֵי כָּבוֹד שֶׁהָיוּ מַקִּיפִים אוֹתָם
parallel to which are the seven days of the festival and the seven Clouds of Glory that enveloped them in the wilderness;
וְג׳ הָעוֹדְפִים הוּא נֶגֶד ג׳ רִאשׁוֹנוֹת שֶׁהֵם ג׳ הַמְּקוֹרוֹת לְז׳ אֵלּוּ כַּנּוֹדָע
and the three supernal roots correspond to the three upper Sefirot (ChaBaD) which are the sources of these seven;
וּבָזֶה הוּא שְׁלֵימוּת כָּל הַקּוֹמָה וּשְׁלֵימוּת הַחַיּוּת, לְבַטֵּל סִטְרָא דְּמוֹתָא שֶׁהִיא הַנּוּקְבָא דִּקְלִיפָּה שֶׁהִיא גַּם כֵּן בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא ת״ף (480) כִּידוּעַ [לִילִית = 480]
and herein is the perfection of the entire stature to nullify the side of death (Sitra d'Muta), the feminine shell which likewise equals 480
(לִילִית = 480); וְהִיא שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַמִּיתָה וְהֵיפֶךְ הַחַיִּים, וְהֵבִיאָה אֵבֶל לָעוֹלָם בְּהַסָּתָתָהּ
she being the root of death and the antithesis of life, having brought mourning into the world through her seduction;
וְהַשִּׂמְחָה הוּא הֵיפֶךְ הָאֵבֶל, וְעַל כֵּן בְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת הוּא בִּיטּוּלָהּ
and holy joy is the antithesis of mourning, wherefore on Succos she is nullified.
וְעַל כֵּן: ״יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ לֹא מֵת״ (תַּעֲנִית ה׳ עַמּוּד א׳)
And therefore: "Our father Jacob never died" (Ta'anis 5b);
כִּי בוֹ שׁוֹרֶשׁ הַקְּדוּשָׁה דְּחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת שֶׁבּוֹ מְקוֹר הַחַיִּים דְּשֶׁפַע חַיֵּי עוֹלָם
for within him resides the root holiness of Succos wherein is the fountain of eternal life;
וְ״סוּכּוֹת״ מָלֵא עִם ״יַעֲקוֹב״ מָלֵא בְּוָי״ו [סוכות = 486, יעקוב = 182, ס״ה = 668, עִם הַמִּלִּים וְהָאוֹתִיּוֹת = 680] בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא עֶשֶׂר פְּעָמִים ״חַיִּים״ [10 × 68 = 680]
and Sukkot spelled with Vav together with Yaakov spelled with a Vav equals ten times Chayim (680);
שֶׁהוּא שְׁלֵימוּת הַמְשָׁכוֹת כָּל מִינֵי חַיִּים מִכָּל הַקּוֹמָה שְׁלֵימָה דְּעֶשֶׂר סְפִירוֹת שֶׁיֵּשׁ לְכָל אַחַת הַמְשָׁכַת חַיִּים מְיוּחָד
representing the complete channeling of all modes of vitality from the entire stature of all ten Sefirot;
וּ״בְרִית״ [612] הוּא בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא תֵּשַׁע פְּעָמִים ״חַיִּים״ [9 × 68 = 612]
while Bris (covenant = 612) equals nine times Chayim (612);
כִּי הוּא נֶגֶד קְדֻשַּׁת הַיְסוֹד שֶׁהִיא מִדָּה הַתְּשִׁיעִית, וּמַשִּׂיג רַק הַמְשָׁכַת תִּשְׁעָה מִינֵי חַיִּים שֶׁעַד הַיְסוֹד בָּהּ
for it corresponds to the sanctity of Yesod, the ninth attribute, grasping the nine modes of life extending unto Yesod;
וְעַדַיִין אֵין הַקּוֹמָה שְׁלֵימָה, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא צַדִּיק גָּמוּר יְסוֹד עוֹלָם
the stature not yet being fully complete, even though he is a consummate righteous man (tzaddik yesod olam);
וְכֵן ״תּוֹרָה״ עִם הַכּוֹלֵל [611 + 1 = 612] בְּגִימַטְרִיָּא כֵּן
and likewise Torah with the collective unit (612) equals nine times Chayim;
כִּי הִיא נוֹבְלוֹת חָכְמָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה שֶׁהִיא גַּם כֵּן מִדָּה הַתְּשִׁיעִית מִמַּטָּה לְמַעְלָה
being the fruit of Chochmah, which is the ninth Sefirah counted from below to Above.
וְכָךְ הִיא הַמִּדָּה: שֶׁבְּהַשָּׂגַת הַתּוֹרָה הוּא הוֹלֵךְ מִמַּטָּה לְמַעְלָה לְהַשִּׂיג בְּכָל יוֹם יוֹתֵר
And such is the spiritual dynamic: in the perception of Torah one advances from below to Above, grasping more each day;
אֲבָל הַצִּדְקוּת וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת נֶגֶד הַיֵּצֶר שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר עָלָיו בְּכָל יוֹם וְהוּא עוֹמֵד נֶגְדּוֹ, הוּא הוֹלֵךְ מִמַּעְלָה לְמַטָּה
but righteousness and conquering the yetzer which attacks daily, proceeds from Above to below;
לְהִתְגַּבֵּר בְּכָל יוֹם יוֹתֵר נֶגֶד הַיֵּצֶר אֲשֶׁר הוּא לְעוֹלָם לְמַטָּה מַטָּה
prevailing increasingly against the yetzer which resides in the lowest realms;
וְכָל מַה שֶּׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר וְעוֹלֶה יוֹתֵר, הוּא עוֹמֵד בְּמַדְרֵגָה תַּחְתּוֹנָה יוֹתֵר, עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשָׂה נָקִי גַּם בְּכָל מַדְרֵיגוֹת הַיּוֹתֵר תַּחְתּוֹנוֹת
and the higher a man ascends, the lower he is able to descend to purify even the lowest rungs;
כִּי מַדְרֵיגָה הַיּוֹתֵר עֶלְיוֹנָה שָׁם הוּא הַנְּקִיּוּת מִיֵּצֶר הָרָע יוֹתֵר
for in the highest rung purity from the yetzer is greater,
כִּי שָׁם הוּא הַדִּיבּוּק בִּמְקוֹר ״נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי — טְהוֹרָה הִיא״ (בְּרָכוֹת ס׳ עַמּוּד ב׳)
being cleaved to the source where "the soul You have placed within me is pure" (Berachos 60b);
וְכָל שֶׁמִּתְרַחֵק יוֹתֵר מִן הַמָּקוֹר הוּא הִתְגַּבְּרוּת הָרָע יוֹתֵר, וְצָרִיךְ לְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת הַצַּדִּיק ״כִּי טוֹב״
and the farther one descends from the Source, the fiercer is the yetzer, demanding the triumph of the Tzaddik who is "good" (tov);
וּבְכָל מַעֲשֵׂה בְּרֵאשִׁית נֶאֱמַר ״כִּי טוֹב״ (בְּרֵאשִׁית א), שֶׁזֶּהוּ מְכֻוָּון כָּל הַבְּרִיאָה: לִהְיוֹת טוֹב וּלְהִתְרַחֵק מִן הָרָע
and throughout Genesis it is said "that it was good" (Bereishis 1), this being the intent of Creation: to be good and depart from evil;
וְעַל כֵּן הוּזְהַר מֵאֲכִילַת עֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע, לִהְיוֹת רַק ״כִּי טוֹב״
wherefore man was warned against the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, to remain exclusively in "that it was good";
וְהוּא אוֹת הַטֵּי״ת הָרוֹמֵז לְטוֹב, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּבָבָא קַמָּא (נ״ה עַמּוּד א׳)
being the letter Tet
which alludes to good (Bava Kamma 55a);
